title: Fishing System Renovation
body:
• Fishing has undergone the following adjustments.
    • Background and Reasoning
      These adjustments were implemented to reduce the performance gap between the various platforms and to streamline the process of obtaining certain materials by making them easier to obtain than before for those of the appropriate skill level.

      Myriad aspects of fishing have changed greatly, and while it may take time to adjust to these changes, we sincerely hope you find that they offer a vastly improved experience.
      • Time Between Casting and Hooking Prey
        Attachment 9248
        • Pre-adjustment
          Reduced depending upon the angler's fishing skill, type of rod, equipment attributes, key items in possession, etc.
      • Post-adjustment
        • Shorter maximum waiting period
        • Reduced depending upon equipment attributes, phase of the moon, time of day, key items in possession, etc.
          * One's fishing skill and rod type no longer reduce the waiting period.
    • Prey Stamina Loss and Recovery
      Attachment 9247
      • Pre-adjustment
        Gradually lost or recovered based on rank compared to angler's fishing skill
      • Post-adjustment
        Should there be a difference between the skill of anglers and the rank of their prey, the following will occur depending on the situation:
        • If anglers are more skilled, their prey will continually suffer damage and put up little resistance before being reeled in.
        • If anglers' skills fall short of their prey's rank, it will be granted the effect of Regen and will be more difficult to reel in.
    • Reeling in a Catch
      • Pre-adjustment
        Press and hold the applicable movement key down so that the rod would return to its original position when it is pulled left or right—based on a frontal view of the angler—by prey
      • Post-adjustment
        Press the applicable movement key once in the direction of the arrow icons that display when the rod is pulled left or right by prey, regardless of perspective.
        • Normal Icons
          Silver arrows like those depicted below will display when anglers have hooked prey.
          Attachment 9249
        • Special Icons
          Gold arrows like those depicted below will occasionally appear while fighting with one's prey.
          Attachment 9250
          Pressing the appropriate directional key during these special occasions causes one's prey to lose more stamina than normal. Pressing the wrong key, however, allows one's prey to recover less stamina than in the same situation when silver arrows display.

          The likelihood of anglers receiving these golden opportunities depends on factors such as characters' fishing skills, the skill differential between characters and their prey, the phase of the moon, time of day, the affinity of prey for one's rod, moglification, and equipment.
    • Fishing Instinct Messages
      • Pre-adjustment
        Would display what type of prey has been hooked.
      • Post-adjustment
        In addition to the traditional messages that enable anglers to discern what prey they have on the line, golden arrow icons will now be more likely to appear and the amount of stamina recovered by incorrect key presses will be reduced.
        • Note
          The following visual effect will also display when fishing instincts come into play.
          Attachment 9251
    • Fishing Frame Rates
      • Pre-adjustment
        A constant 15 frames per second
      • Post-adjustment
        No FPS restriction
        * Should this adjustment be found to negatively impact gameplay, there is a possibility that the frame rate restriction will be reinstated.
    • Fish Numbers per Area
      • Pre-adjustment
        The number of fish inhabiting a single area was shared between characters
      • Post-adjustment
        There are no restrictions on the number of fish that can inhabit an area. However, fishing fatigue restrictions remain the same. Once an angler has reeled in a certain amount of fish, he cannot reel in any more for the remainder of the day.
      • Miscellaneous Adjustments
        • The bar displaying prey stamina will now appear closer to the center of the screen.
          Attachment 9246
        • The strength of certain prey has been adjusted.
        • The effects of certain fishing-related items have been adjusted.

title: "Freshly Picked Vana’diel 5" Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the March version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. Below is a digest of what was discussed.

<iframe width="640" height="390" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/hIFddSjntrY" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Quote:
Originally Posted by Matsui_Akihiko
Hello everyone,
Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning in to yesterday's Freshly Picked Vana'diel.

For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I've created this digest of what was discussed during the stream.

Table of contents
  • On-going Events
  • Trust System
  • New Avatar: Cait Sith
  • New Delve Content
  • Job Points
  • Appearance Lock Feature
  • Fishing Revamps
  • Auction House UI
  • Equipment-specific Inventory Plans
  • Relic Reforging
  • Quality-of-life Improvements
  • MMO Collaboration / Vana’diel Tribune Chronicles
  • Future Plans
On-going Events

Quote:
Originally Posted by Matsui_Akihiko
(01:30～)
  • Repeat Login Campaign No. 9
    During this campaign you can obtain the Lehko Habhoka alter ego. He looks really cool in battle because of his special animations, so be sure to get it! Click here full details on Repeat Login Campaign No. 9.
  • Egg Hunt Seasonal Event
    We're celebrating the 11th anniversary and we've added brand-new egg combination code words.
    http://www.playonline.com/pcd/topics...3/11973_16.jpg
    You can obtain the Hatching Shield by procuring the eggs that form the new code word.
    There's a hint on the topics page, "Egg Hunt 2014 - Jemimi's Mission: Impossible-Wossible" as to what the code word may be, so be sure to check it out and get your eggs!

    After a certain amount of time passes from the start of the event, a moogle will spawn and clue you in on the code words. If you're absolutely lost as to what the code word is, just wait for this moogle to help you out.
Trust System

Quote:
Originally Posted by Matsui_Akihiko
(4:10～)
*During the stream, the new alter egos were summoned forth and some of the new battle messages were shown off.
  • Addition of battle messages
    We've made it so alter egos speak when being called forth, dismissed, and if they should fall in battle. There are also alter egos that will have special lines when paired up with other alter egos.

    In a future version update, we are planning to make it so alter egos inform you during specific times such as when TP has been saved up and they are ready to unleash a weapon skill so that they are even more useful when fighting alongside you.
  • New alter egos
    In the March version update we've added Cherukiki, Zazarg, Nashmeira, and Ingrid. Be sure to check out each one of their unique messages. Read here for details on how to obtain each alter ego.

    Additionally, during the stream we introduced Ovjang, Mnejing, and Sakura, which can be obtained during a special Alter Ego Extravaganza that will kick off from April 1st.

    When calling Ovjang and Mnejing while you have Nashmeira out, each of their stats will be boosted. Ovjang will receive reduced enmity and increased magic damage, and Mnejing will receive increased defense and increase enmity.

    Sakura will not actually participate in battle, but by calling her out she will give you regen and an increased rate for physical combat skill increases. I didn’t mention this during the stream, but we’re making it so the regen effect will scale based on your level. Additionally, we'll be adding a new alter ego in the future that will make it easier to increase your magic combat skills.

    You'll also be able to obtain Tenzen, Mihli Aliapoh, Valaineral, and Joachim that were available during the New Year's Alter Ego Extravaganza that wrapped up in February, so if you just started playing or just came back to Vana'diel, or perhaps missed it last time, will have a chance to obtain these alter egos.
  • /hidetrust command
    We've added the /hidetrust command to hide other players' alter egos. If you find yourself in a position where there are a lot of players around and too many alter egos out which is making it laggy, please use this command.
New Avatar: Cait Sith

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(18:10～)
*The stream shows off Cait Sith in action.
  • New avatar: Cait Sith
    We've added Cait Sith as a new avatar.

    Cait Sith has a unique Blood Pacts known as “Level ? Holy” where you roll a dice and deal damage depending on the number rolled.
    Quote:
    Example:
    If you roll a 5, large damage will be dealt to enemies whose level is a multiple of 5 (5, 10, 15, etc.), and the damage will increase the larger the number you roll.
  • Cait Sith adjustments
    We'll be moving both Mewing Lullaby and Eerie Eye, which are currently categorized under Blood Pact: Rage, to Blood Pact: Ward so that it follows the same categorization of Shiva, Diabolos, and all the other avatars.

    Also, there is a bug with Cait Sith's perpetuation cost being set higher than intended, so we will be fixing this. After the fix, Cait Sith's perpetuation cost will be lowered to be the same as that of Carbuncle.

    These adjustments and fixes will take place in the April version update.
New Delve Content

Quote:
Originally Posted by Matsui_Akihiko
(24:29～)
*During the stream, new equipment that can be obtained with Mweya Plasm by defeating new Delve NMs was introduced.

We've introduced new Delve areas in the version update that took place this morning (Friday, March 21st (JST)).
Job Points

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(26:45～)
*During the stream, the UI for the Job Point system was shown off.

Job Points are a new character advancement system that allows you to enhance the traits and abilities of each job.

This system differs from the concept of the merit point system which allowed players to arrange the same jobs differently. The concept of Job Points is to enhance the actual capabilities of the job, and it’s possible to max out each category for the jobs you want to enhance.

In the March version update the first categories added were mainly special abilities and abilities that are learned at low levels. However, we will continue to add more and more categories moving forward. We’ll also be increasing the cap for each category as well.

We’ve been receiving requests to make it so stats can also be enhanced, and we are currently looking into increasing the cap on each merit point category.
Appearance Lock Feature

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(38:30～)
*During the stream the appearance lock feature was shown off.

We've added the /lockstyle command to lock the appearance of characters. By using this feature, you'll be able to freely select which equipment to use while maintaining the appearance of your choice. Additionally, it will make it so your character no longer disappears when switching equipment.

At the moment, when changing weapons or areas the appearance lock will be removed and we realize this is a slight inconvenience; however, we have plans to make this a more robust feature in the future.
Fishing Revamps

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(42:15～)
*The revamped fishing system is shown off during the stream.

We've made large revamps to the fishing system in the March version update.

We've made it so when reeling in a catch the applicable movement key will only need to be pressed once instead of having to press and hold it, and we've reduced the performance gap between the various platforms. Additionally, we've also made on-screen graphical indicators for which direction needs to be pressed to make it easier to understand.

Also, fishing skill now largely affects the difficulty when reeling in a catch. If your fishing skill is higher than a lower level fish, it will be easier to reel in with little resistance; however, if you attempt to reel in a higher level fish you'll have to prove how skilled of an angler you are as it will be more difficult.

Full details on the fishing revamps can be found here.

Additionally, we've added a fishing category to Records of Eminence. The objectives added are mainly tutorials, but moving forward we will be adding objectives that fishing masters can challenge.
Auction House UI

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(53:13～)
We've made it so when selling items on the auction house you can check the bidding history of posted items.

In a future version update we'll be displaying the number of items posted, the item help text, item category, and other information.
Equipment-specific Inventory and Equipment Change Macro Improvement

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(54:00～)
We're currently making plans to add an equipment-specific inventory that will allow you to equip gear directly without having to shuffle the gear you want to equip into your main inventory. Additionally, we’re planning to add a new equipment swapping macro that will allow you to swap out multiple pieces of equipment with one macro line.
Relic Reforging

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(58:05～)
We've unlocked the reforging of relic chest and leg armor to item level 119.

A portion of the items needed to reforge this equipment can be obtained via the new Delve content.
Quality-of-life Improvements

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(58:30～)
  • High-tier missions battlefield cost reduction
    We're aware that currently there are still certain battlefields where congestion is continuing to occur. However, with the addition of various other content we feel that the players will disperse to this content and to make it easier to take on these battles we've lowered the cost of entry.
  • Skill increase in campaign and reives
    We've made it so combat and magic skill can increase while participating in campaign battles and reives.
  • Job-specific back equipment exchange NPC
    We've added an NPC that you can trade in three job-specific back pieces for one job-specific back equipment of your choice. Please be sure to use this NPC if you are having trouble obtaining the back equipment you've been aiming for.
  • Respawn timer reduction for beastmen leaders
    We've changed the respawn times for the three Aht Urghan beastmen leaders making it easier to encounter them.
  • Outer Ra'Kaznar warp point
    As there are occasions where you are unable to leave Ra'Kaznar from certain sections, we’ve added a transportation device.
MMO Collaboration/Vana'diel Tribune

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(61:22～)
*New equipment that can be obtained during the event was shown off during the stream.
  • Anniversary campaign
    We're hosting a second MMO collaboration event.
    By participating in the collaboration event you can obtain She-slime, Metal Slime, and Spriggan themed equipment. We hope you enjoy the FINAL FANTASY XIV and DRAGON QUEST X collaboration event!


    Full details on the anniversary event can be found here.
  • Vana’diel Tribune Chronicles
    We've compiled all the Vana’diel Tribunes into a book with development commentary.

    The book comes with two in-game items: Decazoom Mk-XI, a marksmanship weapon that looks like a camera, and Escritorios, a polearm that looks like a pen.

    Details on the Vana'diel Tribune Chronicles can be found here.
Future Plans

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(71:11～)

A version update will take place on Friday, March 21st (JST) that will add the new Delve areas and fix various bugs.
(*The version update has already taken place.)

We’ll also be having a small version update in the beginning of April. Despite it being small in size, we’ll be adding high-tier mission battlefields for Tenzen and Ouryu as well as introducing job-specific weapons, so please look forward to it.

Additionally, we’ll be holding a Meeble Burrows event in April, which you can all participate in and enjoy at your leisure.

See you during the next Freshly Picked Vana’diel!

title: Apr 8, 2014 (JST) Version Update

Event-related

  • A quest to acquire job-specific equipment has been added.
    Attachment 9459
    • Prerequisites
      Players must have fulfilled one of the following prerequisites in order to undertake the quest.
      • Have defeated at least one of the following boss monsters appearing in Delve content in Cirdas Cavers [U].
        Muyingwa / Dakuwaqa / Tojil
      • Have defeated at least one of the following boss monsters appearing in Delve content in Yorcia Weald [U].
        Cailimh / Wopket / Utkux
      • Have defeated one of the mission battlefields requiring one of the items listed below on “Difficult” or “Very Difficult.”
        Microcosmic Orb / Macrocosmic Orb
      • Have defeated a high-tier mission battlefield on “Normal” or above difficulty.
        • Notes
          • When the prerequisites for accepting a relic, mythic, or empyrean weapon reforging quest are met, that quest will be given priority.
          • If you have traded a relic, mythic, or empyrean weapon to Oboro and selected “Prepare the weapon!” you will be unable to accept a job-specific weapon quest until you select “Nothing” in the dialogue where you ask him about what is required to craft the weapon.
    • Accepting the Quest
      Players will be able to receive the quest from Oboro in Port Jeuno (E-6).
      Attachment 9460
    • Required Items
      Players can check which items are needed to create which weapons by speaking with Oboro, who will then craft the requested weapon when the appropriate materials have been traded to him. Note that Oboro will not accept high quality items created through synthesis.

    • Alter egos have undergone the following adjustments.
      • Tank alter egos now approach even closer to targets when engaged in battle.
      • Many alter ego-specific weapon skills, such as Prishe's Knuckle Sandwich, now possess skillchain elements.
      • Alter egos are now permitted to enter the following battlefields.
        • Spire of Vahzl
          Desires of Emptiness
        • Mine Shaft #2716
          A Century of Hardship
        • Boneyard Gully
          Head Wind
        • Bearclaw Pinnacle
          Flames for the Dead
        • Sealion's Den
          One to Be Feared / The Warrior's Path
        • The Garden of Ru'Hmet
          When Angels Fall
        • Empyreal Paradox
          Dawn

Item-related

  • New synthesis recipes have been introduced.
  • New items have been added.
    Attachment 9503Attachment 9502
    Attachment 9500Attachment 9501
  • The following items have had their item levels removed from the help text.
    Forefront Flute / Filiae Bell / Tardus Grip / Zuuxowu Grip / Lentus Grip / Achaq Grip / Bloodrain Strap / Tzacab Grip / Mephitis Grip
    * Only the item level descriptors have been deleted. The attributes of the item are unaffected.
    * Going forward, all instruments, grips, and handbells will have their item level descriptors removed.
  • The following additions and adjustments have been made to bonanza kupons.
    • Ra’Kaznar Visages have been added to the list of items available for exchange from the following kupons.
      Kupon I-S1 / Kupon I-S2 / Kupon I-S3 / Kupon I-S5
    • Yorcia Visages II have been added to the list of items available for exchange from Kupon I-S2.
  • The following synergy recipes have been added.
    　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　< Rank: Amateur >
    <table width="600" border="0"> <tr> <td width="25.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Item</td> <td width="25.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Required Craft</td> <td width="50.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Materials</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Worm Feelers +1</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">-</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Worm Feelers, Worm Feelers</td> </tr><tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Worm Masque +1</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">-</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Worm Masque, Worm Masque</td> </tr></table>* Worm Masques will become available through the upcoming May 2014 login campaign.

System-related

  • A homepoint has been added to Riverne - Site #B01 at the coordinates E-8.
  • Alter egos have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Spaces have been deleted from NPC names so that alter egos naming conventions now coincide with those of PC ones, enabling them to be used in parties that include other PCs in the future.
    • The placeholders <p1> through <p5> may now be used to specify alter egos.
  • The following additions have been made to the auction house.
    • The number of the same type of item already on the market that players currently wish to post now displays in their transaction histories.
    • The categories for items players wish to post now display in their transaction histories.
      * Item categories will not display for items that have no successful bids.
  • The number of fish players can reel in for one day (fatigue) has undergone the following adjustment.
    • Pre-adjustment
      Characters would become fatigued more rapidly if their main job level was lower than level 20.
    • Post-adjustment
      Characters whose main job is lower than level 20 will become fatigued at the normal rate as long as one of their jobs is level 20 or higher.
  • The Effects section of the Config menu has undergone the following adjustments.
    • Battle effects for one's pets are now included under "You."
    • Battle effects for party members' pets are now included under "Party."
  • The command /checkparam has undergone the following adjustment.
    • Using the command will now display the average item level of equipment worn.
      • Calculation
        (Weapon Item Level + Armor Item Level) / 2
        • The number used for the weapon item level in the above formula is the highest item level of all weapons equipped in the main, sub, ranged, and ammo slots.
        • The number used for the armor item level in the above formula is the average of headgear, bodygear, handgear, leggear, and footgear worn.
      • Notes
        • Fractions are rounded down to the nearest whole number.
        • Average item levels affect the level of alter egos called forth and the information displayed when using /check on enemies.
        • Players' average item levels will not display if they are not currently wearing any item level equipment.
        • Average item levels do not display for pets.
  • The following text commands have been added.
    • /returnfaith, /refa
    • /returntrust, /retr
      Dismisses alter egos.　
    >>Subcommands:
    all 　Dismisses all of one's alter egos.
    Dismisses targeted alter ego if no subcommand is specified.
    • These commands cannot be used while players have a weapon drawn.
  • Measures have been taken to address the issue with Salvage content wherein players would occasionally be unable to equip pieces of equipment even after removing Pathos of Alzadaal restrictions.
  • Measures have been taken to address the issue wherein "X" would display in the equipment menu even after Encumbrance had been removed.
  • The following terms have been added to the auto-translate function.
    <table width="400" border="0"> <tr> <td width="50.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Category</td> <td width="50.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Terminology</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Text Command</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">/returnfaith</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Text Command</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">/returntrust</td> </tr></table>

Resolved Issues

  • The issue where the animation and visual effects accompanying the avatar Cait Sith’s Blood Pact: Ward ability “Raise II” were not displaying properly.
  • The issue wherein the avatar Cait Sith had an incorrect perpetuation cost.
  • The issue wherein the avatar Cait Sith’s Blood Pact: Rage ability “Regal Scratch” could not be used in skillchains.
  • The issue wherein the color of the text appearing in the log was incorrect when the avatar Cait Sith would use the Blood Pact: Ward abilities Raise II or Reraise II.
  • The issue wherein an improper key item was rewarded when vanquishing Cherti in Yorcia Weald [U].
  • The issue wherein the target cursor would float in midair when targeting the Veil in Yorcia Weald.
  • The issue wherein the NM Mahjlaef the Paintorn in Caedarva Mire would improperly receive the effects of the special ability Immortal Shield even when it failed to be executed.
  • The issue wherein the spell effects for the Ancestral Rage appearing in Cirdas Caverns during the Quest “The Communion” would occasionally display improperly under certain conditions.
  • The issue wherein alter egos active during the following missions would cast spells and abilities that were then recorded in the chatlog during cutscenes.
    The Shadow Lord / Xarcabard, Land of Truths / The Shadow Awaits
  • The issue wherein having mannequins located in the Mog House in the player's home nation equip pulse panoplia would occasionally cause their visual effects to display in Rent-a-Rooms in other nations and Mog Gardens.
  • The issue with Moblin Maze Monger’s Maze Voucher 08 Aquatic Depopulation Team wherein the equipped bait would occasionally enable the player to catch fish that they would ordinarily not be able to.
  • The issue with auction houses wherein the item lists did not display items in the “Miscellaneous” category.
  • The issue wherein dismissing the following alter egos would play the same effects and voices as when dismissing a fellow.
  • Various issues wherein NPC messages were either incorrect or incomplete.

Known Issues

  • When arrow icons appear while engaging in fishing, pressing 4 or 6 on the number pad will occasionally cause the client to crash.
  • When beginning to synthesize an item right when a Records of Eminence limited-time challenge occurs, the synthesis will be canceled and the items lost.
  • When countering an attack while under the effects of the warrior ability Retaliation, the monster’s attack will be recorded as a miss in the log even if damage is dealt.
  • The　description for the greatsword “Aettir” does not specify that it increases the effect of Swipe as well as Lunge.
  • Incorrect background music plays when entering the high-tier mission battlefield “★The Savage.”
  • When a new weapon skill is acquired after a combat skill increase, the message explaining that a new weapon skill has been learned is delayed.

[Windows/Xbox 360 versions only]
  • The names of the gnarled ramparts that appear during colonization reives in Yorcia Weald disappear when engaged.

title: "Freshly Picked Vana’diel 6" Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the April version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. Below is a digest of what was discussed.


Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello everyone,
Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning in to yesterday's Freshly Picked Vana'diel.

<iframe width="640" height="390" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/-KmR3fgDZhU" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I've created this digest of what was discussed during the stream.

Table of contents
  • On-going Events
  • Adjustments to the Maximum HP and MP for Each Race
  • Job-specific Equipment
  • Trust Adjustments
  • Repeat Login Campaign
  • New High-tier Mission Battlefields
  • Records of Eminence
  • Quality-of-life Improvements
  • May Version Update Preview
  • Double Capacity Point Campaign
  • May Version Update Preview Part 2
  • Adventurer Appreciation Campaign
  • Adventuring Fellows
  • Conclusion
On-going Events

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(01:10～)
  • Spring Alter Ego Extravaganza
    In addition to the newly added Sakura, Ovjang, and Mnejing, you’ll also be able to obtain Joachim, Mihli Aliapoh, Tenzen, and Valaineral from the previous Alter Ego Extravaganza. If you missed out last time, be sure not to miss this chance to obtain all these great alter egos!
  • The Second MMO Anniversary Collaboration Event
    Due to a bug in the version update, adventurers were temporarily unable to enjoy the anniversary event. I apologize for this issue and have restored access to the event.
    Due to this we’ve extended the event until Tuesday, April 15, 2014 at 7:00 AM (PDT), so if you haven’t had a chance to join the fun please be sure to participate.

    Since your level will be reduced to 1 for the anniversary quest, using the regen effect from Fields of Valor or joining up with other adventurers who are doing the quest will make it easier to enjoy.

    For the DRAGON QUEST X collaboration event, by equipping head, shield, and ear slime equipment with the same color, there is a hidden effect that will boost the amount of slime coins that are dropped, so please try this out.

    For the FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn collaboration event, if you don’t get your item the first time, consequent tries will boost your chances, so please keep on trying as they become easier to obtain.

    Details on the Collaboration Event can be found here.
Adjustments to the maximum HP and MP of each race

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(06:08～)
*The video shows off a graph of the maximum HP and MP of a Galka and Tarutaru as white mage and paladin.

Based on the battle balance of recent end-game content, we’ve made adjustments to the maximum HP and MP for each race. The amount was adjusted for each to close the gap between races while still preserving their unique traits.
  • HP
    Based on the maximum HP of Galkas, the other four races’ HP has been increased. With this adjustment, a level 99 Tarutaru will have their maximum HP increased by approximately 300 HP.
  • MP
    Based on the maximum HP of Tarutarus, the other four races’ MP has been increased. With this adjustment, a level 99 Galka will have their maximum MP increased by approximately 250 MP.
Monsters that have stats based on the stats of each race appear in the game, but we’ve limited the effects of this and have only made adjustments to the HP and MP of characters.
Job-specific equipment

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(09:10～)
*In the video certain job-specific equipment item help text is displayed.

We’ve added equipment that specialized stats for each job.

Instruments and shields with stats close to Daurdabla and Ochain have been added as well.

Also, as a special feature of this newly added equipment, a lot of weapons have had the “reduced enmity” effect added to them. Please add this to your arsenal of choices for times when you do not want to grab hate off your tank.

One significant point to note is that the katana for ninja also has the “reduced enmity” effect on it.
We added this with the idea that ninjas could equip this katana during times that they are using Innin. In the future we will also be adding more equipment for tanking situations.

The feedback we received on this added equipment was that it’s much harder to obtain than anticipated, but please understand that this was made challenging on purpose because this equipment has a high item level of 119.
Trust adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(11:50～)
  • Support for Certain Battlefields
    We’ve made it so Trust alter egos can be used in Chains of Promathia battlefields. Progressing through the Chains of Promathia missions will enable you to acquire the Prishe and Ulmia alter egos as well as participate in the newly added high-tier mission battlefields “★The Warrior’s Path” and “★The Savage.”
  • Tank-type Alter Ego Adjustments
    We’ve made adjustments to tank-type alter egos so it’s easier to use Trick Attack, and alter egos will now stand closer to monsters while in battle.
  • Skillchain Elements for NPC-specific Weapon Skills
    We’ve added skillchain elements to alter ego-specific weapon skills so you can perform skillchains with them.
  • Addition of the Text Command “/returntrust”
    We’ve added a new text command to dismiss alter egos. By adding the subcommand “all,” you’ll be able to dismiss all of your alter egos at the same time. Similarly, using the subcommand “t” will allow you to dismiss a targeted alter ego. If you’re regularly swapping out alter egos, be sure to try these out.
Repeat Login Campaign

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(14:30～)
*The video shows off gameplay of the equipment that can be obtained during the Repeat Login Campaign.
  • Repeat Login Campaign No. 10
    Repeat Login Campaign No. 10 begins on Thursday, April 10, 2014. During this event you’ll be able to obtain the newly added “Worm feelers” hand-to-hand weapon that has been designed based off of the worm family as well as the alter ego for Luzaf. Luzaf is the first alter ego that dual wields.
  • Repeat Login Campaign No. 11
    Repeat Login Campaign No. 11 is scheduled for May. During this campaign we’ll be adding a worm mask as well as the alter ego for Najelith as items you can purchase with login points. We’ve recreated Najelith’s besieged fighting style with her classic dagger and bow.
New high-tier mission battlefields

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(24:50～)
  • ★The Savage
    In this battlefield you will face off against Ouryu.
    The Mistmelts used during the mission battle to pull Ouryu to the ground when he takes to the sky, have had their effect changed for the high-tier mission battlefield, and can be used to enfeeble Ouryu. There is a separate condition that needs to be fulfilled in order to make Ouryu return to the ground, so please try and find it.
  • ★The Warrior’s Path
    In this battlefield you will fight against Tenzen and the triple Tarutaru squad made up of Makki-Chebukki, Kukki-Chebukki, and Cherukiki. The magic attack of the three Tarutarus will increase as Tenzen’s HP is reduced. The key to this battle is to seal their magic with the proper timing, so please try to challenge this fight.

The high-tier mission battlefields added in this version update requires 20 merit points for the key item necessary to enter. In the future we plan on reducing this amount as we keep an eye on the battlefield congestion conditions.
Records of Eminence

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(27:50～)
  • Objectives have been added for Aht Urhgan and Wings of the Goddess areas
    We’ve added battle and gathering objectives for both Aht Urhgan and Wings of the Goddess areas.
  • Addition of purchasable weapons
    We’ve added weapons that can be purchased through Records of Eminence for level 51 and above.
Quality-of-life Improvements

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(29:00～)
  • Pet Filter Changes
    While there were concerns about causing inconveniences to players who were used to this feature by changing it, we decided it would be more convenient to combine this, so we changed it.
  • Improvement to the Auction House UI
    When placing items up for sale on the Auction House, you can check the number of the same type of item already on the market as well as the item category.
  • Expansion to “/checkparam”
    We’ve made it so you can check your current average item level.
    There are other aspects we have been looking into implementing, but since this is a number that affects how strong Trust alter egos are, we wanted to make this available first.
May version update preview

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(35:45～)
*The video shows in-game footage of the additional job enhancement categories.
  • Job Points
    • Implementation of Chain Bonuses
      In order to make it easier to obtain capacity points, we will be adding chain bonuses.

      Due to the item level system, the rules will be slightly different than the existing chain bonus rules. As you defeat more and more monsters, the chain bonus cap will increase, and defeating even stronger monsters will yield a higher bonus.

      　
    • Expansion of Supported Content
      We will be making it possible to obtain job points from enemies in Skirmish I, Skirmish III, and Delve.
      　
    • Addition of New Enhancement Categories
      We will be adding new enhancement categories.
Double Capacity Point Campaign

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(42:30～)

We will be holding a special campaign, which will double the amount of capacity points you earn.
  • Round 1
    Thursday, April 17, 2014 at 11:00 PM (PDT) to Sunday, April 20, 2014 at 11:00 PM (PDT)
  • Round 2
    Thursday, May 1, 2014 at 11:00 PM (PDT) to Sunday, May 4, 2014 at 11:00 PM (PDT)
May Version Update Preview Part 2

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(43:35～)
  • Addition of high-tier mission battlefields
    We will be adding the high-tier version of the Aht Urhgan mission battlefield “Legacy of the Lost.”
    Another high-tier mission battlefield will also be added for the May version update, so stay tuned for additional information.
    　
  • Addition of new alter egos
    We’ll be adding new Trust alter egos. Stayed tuned to see which NPCs are added!
    　
  • Equipment-specific storage
    After the May version update we will be adding a specialized inventory bag that is meant specifically for the storage of equipment allowing you direct use of the equipment placed inside.
    　
  • Mythic-equivalent weapons for geomancer and rune fencer
    We’ll be adding job-specific weapons for geomancer and rune fencer. As these weapons are mythic-equivalents, we’ll also be adding specialized weapon skills after the May version update.
In addition to all of this, we’ll be continuing the Seekers of Adoulin storyline with new missions and tons of other content.
Adventurer Appreciation Campaign

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(51:00～)
*In the video, images of the alter egos that can be obtained during the campaign are showed off.

We’ll be holding the Adventurer Appreciation Campaign to celebrate the 12th anniversary of FINAL FANTASY XI.
  • Limited time event
    You’ll be able to enjoy a special, limited time event with moogles and goblins.
  • Campaign bonuses
    As a special bonus for the campaign, you’ll be able to obtain Aldo, Moogle, and Goblin alter egos as well as special equipment with designs based on moogles and goblins.
Adventuring Fellows

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(58:50～)
  • The future of adventuring fellows
    We’re currently looking into increasing the level cap of adventuring fellows to level 99 and a system to boost the power of adventuring fellows based on your average item level. We’d also like to add quests that you can do with your level 99 adventuring fellow.

    These adjustments will take place after the May version update. Once the specific timing and details have been finalized I will make an announcement.
Conclusion

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Regarding future plans, we would like to stay flexible to address your requests and feedback.

As usual, we will continue to deliver information through topics, the forum, and Freshly Picked Vana’diel.

Event-related

  • New Seekers of Adoulin missions have been added.
    Attachment 9621Attachment 9622
  • New quests have been added to Seekers of Adoulin areas.
  • A new area, Leafallia, has been added.
    Attachment 9623
    Access to Leafallia is only granted to those who have progressed to a particular point in the newly-added Chapter 4 of the Seekers of Adoulin mission.
  • Geomancers of Rune Fencer may now obtain Ergon Weapons.
    Attachment 9625Attachment 9624
    Ergon Weapons are mythic-equivalent weapons for geomancers and rune fencers, and can be obtained by completing a special quest.
    • Undertaking the quests
      Geomancers and rune fencers have different prerequisites for undertaking their respective quests.
      • Geomancers
        • Have completed the quest “The Communion”
        • Be at the rank of “Legend” for all coalitions
      • Rune Fencers
        • Have completed the quest “Destiny’s Device”
        • Be at the rank of “Legend” for all coalitions
      • Notes
        Players may undertake both of these quests at once, but at a certain point players will be tasked with delivering certain items to a particular NPC. At this point, players are only able to deliver items for one of the two jobs.
        * Players will have to abandon their current quest in order to deliver items for the other quest, and all items previously delivered will be lost upon so doing.
    • NPCs offering the quests
      Players will be able to receive one of these quests by fulfilling the above prerequisites and speaking to the following NPCs.
      • Geomancer
        Attachment 9626
        Nhili Uvolep in Eastern Adoulin (I-7)
      • Rune Fencers
        Attachment 9627
        Gaddiux in Western Adoulin (J-10)
    • High-purity bayld
      Throughout the quests, players will need to obtain items known as “high-purity bayld.”
      • Obtaining high-purity bayld
        High-purity bayld can be obtained through all manner of reives.
        • Obtained from Colonization and Lair Reives
          Players will sometimes receive high-purity bayld by reaching a certain minimum evaluation through participating in a reive.
          Colonization reives are more likely to provide high-purity bayld than lair reives.
          * Even after players have met the minimum evaluation level to receive high-purity bayld, the odds that they will receive it will continue to increase in line with increases in evaluation.
        • Obtained from Wildskeeper Reives
          Players will always receive high-purity bayld by successfully vanquishing a Naakual as long as they receive a certain level of evaluation.
        • Purchased from Runje Desaali
          Attachment 9628
          Players may purchase high-purity bayld for 10,000 bayld from Runje Desaali in Eastern Adoulin (J-10) by selecting the appropriate dialogue option.
        • Obtained from Soul Pyres
          There is a slight chance that players will receive high-purity bayld when they open a Soul Pyre containing bayld.
  • New alter egos have been added.

    Read on for details.

    • Copper A.M.A.N. vouchers have undergone the following adjustments.
      • Players are now able to specify how many vouchers they wish to redeem at once.
      • Players may now redeem vouchers for 1,000 Ballista points.
  • The maximum coalition rank has been increased to eight, and additional coalition services have been made available.

      Players will now be able to earn additional capacity points for continuously vanquishing monsters of a certain minimum level that yield capacity points within a given timeframe.

+1</td> </tr></table>

  • The amount of zeni for which Sanraku in Aht Urhgan Whitegate will sell trigger items that spawn zeni notorious monsters will be set to the minimum value whenever a server is restarted for reasons such as maintenance.
  • The following options have been added to the Config menu on the title screen.
    Attachment 9649
    • Logout destination
      Enables players to select whether they would like to return to the title screen or the character select screen upon logging out.
    • Background Aspect Ratio
      Enables the player to set the resolution of the title screen background.
      * These features are only available on the PlayStation2 and Windows versions of FINAL FANTASY XI.
  • When the background music changes back from fishing music to music of the area in which the player resides, the music will start from where it originally left off.
    * These features are only available on the PlayStation2 and Windows versions of FINAL FANTASY XI.
  • The chat filter has been adjusted so that turning on the “System Lv. 1 (“Check” notices)” option will filter the chat log displayed when equipment is changed.
  • The following phrases have been added to the auto-translate dictionary.
    <table width="400" border="0"> <tr> <td width="50.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Category</td> <td width="50.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Term</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Text Commands</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">/wardrobe</td> </tr><tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Text Commands</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">/displayhead</td> </tr></table>

Resolved Issues

  • The issue in the battlefield “★The Savage” wherein the background music would not play unless in combat.
  • The issue in Outer Ra’Kanzar [U] wherein pet behavior was incorrect around certain coordinates.
  • The issue wherein enchantments from the following items would not be used in Mog Gardens.
    Duck Ring / Moogle Cap / Nomad Cap / Chocobo Masque +1
  • The issue wherein the damage value of the following items was incorrect.
    Twebuliij / Tumafyrig
    * The values have been adjusted from 112 to 193.
  • The issue in Monstrosity wherein the eye colors of Antlion sub-families was incorrect.
  • The issue in Monstrosity wherein the icon color for Ruszor Instinct I and Ruszor Instinct II was incorrect.
  • The issue with Monstrosity wherein the Trust magic spells Luzaf and Najelith were displaying in the magic list for monipulators.
  • The issue wherein the sound effects for Joachim’s alter ego’s ranged attacks were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein nothing would be displayed in the log window when casting a spell on Sakura’s alter ego.
  • The issue wherein Luzaf’s alter ego was wielding an incorrect ranged weapon when attacking.
  • The issue wherein the weapon skill “Savage Blade” used by Trion’s alter ego was of a different elemental alignment from the same skill as used by players.
  • The issue wherein chocobo riding animations were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein, when under the effects of “Battuta” and being the victim of an attack where multiple strikes occur at once, the rune fencer would counterattack even if the second attack missed.
  • The issue wherein when a new weapon skill is acquired after a combat skill increase, the message explaining that a new weapon skill has been learned would be displayed.
  • The issue wherein one’s battle history regarding the ★Ark Angel 2 and ★Ark Angel 4 high-tier mission battlefields displayed incorrectly.
  • The issue wherein players were occasionally unable to exit the Kindred Spirits and ★Kindred Spirits battlefields under certain conditions.
  • The issue wherein speaking to Xavinien in Eastern Adoulin and receiving intelligence on the spoils for Ceizak Battlegrounds, Morimar Basalt Fields, and Foret de Hennetiel Delve content would yield incorrect information.
  • The issue wherein the abilities “Frog Song” and “Frog Chorus” used by poroggos would cause the targeted players to become transparent if the abilities missed.
  • Various issues wherein item help text and NPC dialogue were incorrect.

Known Issues

  • In the Seekers of Adoulin mission “The Gates,” the umbrils will occasionally fail to descend properly, preventing the battle from occurring as intended.
    * Players experiencing this issue should use Warp or a similar ability to force the battle to end, reacquire the trigger item, and try again.
  • If the server crashes when having Divainy-Gamainy in Western Adoulin (J-10) engrave an item with arcane glyptics, the traded equipment and materials will not be returned.
  • In Records of Eminence, limited-time challenges may occasionally be accepted outside of the predetermined periods.
  • Players are occasionally unable to properly set the explosives in the Campaign Ops “Slaughterhouse” in Beaucedine Glacier [S].
  • In the quest “Beyond Infinity”, alter egos summoned before entering the battlefield will occasionally disappear.
  • In the Moblin Maze Mongers Maze Voucher 09 “Revitalization Team,” exchanging Cave Conservation points with Sadistiq for temporary items and the like will not change the amount of points displayed in the currency list.
  • The NM Vee Ladu the Titterer appearing in Castle Oztroja [S] will occasionally not drop a bamboo birdcage.
  • In Mog Gardens, items such as auserum that affect mining and gathering will not take effect under certain circumstances.
  • In Ark Angels 3 and ★Ark Angels 3, Ark Angel MR will occasionally not execute any commands under certain conditions.
  • The help text for the weapon "Homestead Cesti" erroneously displays "Occasionally attacks twice" in place of the correct attribute ""TP Bonus"+1000"
    The help text for the bard job point category "Minuet Effect" misleadingly implies that the physical attack increase is only gained by the bard. The bonus in fact applies to all allies under the effects of Minuet.
  • The damage value for the weapon “Bestas Bane” is incorrect.

title: "Freshly Picked Vana’diel 7" Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the May version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. Below is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello,
Matsui here.

Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 7.

For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I've created this digest of what was discussed during the stream.

<iframe width="640" height="390" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/Z3mhanvtmFc" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • New Seeker of Adoulin Missions
  • Trust Alter Egos and Adventuring Fellows
  • Job Points
  • Job Adjustments
  • Ergon Weapons
  • New High-tier Mission Battlefields
  • Coalition Rank 8
  • Records of Eminence
  • Mog Wardrobe
  • Quality of Life Improvements
  • Adventurer Appreciation Campaign
  • Repeat Login Campaign No. 11
  • June Version Update Preview
  • Conclusion
New Seeker of Adoulin Missions

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
（05:35～)
*The video introduces character that appear in the missions as well as a summary of the Adoulin missions.
  • Adoulin Storyline Summary
    Under directive of Ygnas S. Adoulin, the Sacred City of Adoulin ventures to colonize the region of Ulbuka once again after a long period of inactivity. Ygnas is a mysterious person who rarely shows his face to others, and the story begins in a period of turmoil as the city is divided into factions that both support and oppose this directive.

    Shortly after, it becomes apparent that Ygnas has fallen victim to a curse. Unable to communicate normally and imparting the knowledge only to adventurers, Ygnas tells of a crisis that is approaching Ulbuka.

    Along with Arciela, adventurers act to save Ygnas, but with Arciela assuming a neutral position for colonization she is met with anger by both the supporters and opposition.
  • Important Characters
    • Ygnas: Head of the Twelve Orders of Adoulin
      The central figure of the Twelve Orders that govern Adoulin who ordered the continued colonization of Ulbuka. Two years ago he founded each of the coalitions that the adventurers are getting involved in.
    • Arciela: Ygnas's younger sister
      Heroine of the Adoulin missions.
      Possesses an uncanny power to communicate with the elementals of the forest.
    • Ingrid: A master exorcist
      Commonly known as Ingrid the Merciless One. Was called upon to break the curse placed on Ygnas, and slowly begins to think Arciela is interfering with the colonization efforts.
    • Darrcuiln: A gold tiger
      A gold tiger that lives in Ulbuka.
      Saves Arciela and becomes her guardian.
      The reason why Darrcuiln lends Arciela his power is one of the keys of the story.
    • Teodor: A mysterious aristocrat
      Imparts knowledge to adventurers when they are lost, but the condition for this knowledge is to accept his challenge to games.
    • Melvien: Leader of the Order of Woltaris
      A person with a lot of influence with the Twelve Orders.
      A character that appears frequently in the “Excerpts from Adoulin” series.
Trust Alter Egos and Adventuring Fellows

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
（12:40～)
*The video shows off in-game footage of Gessho, Maat, and D. Shantotto in action.

  • Wings of the Goddess Area Support
    Trust alter egos can now be called forth in Wings of the Goddess areas. They can also be used in Campaign battles, so combine your powers and keep the beastmen army’s at bay.
  • New Alter Egos
    • Gessho
      The first alter ego whose main job is ninja.
      A tank-type alter ego that uses Utsusemi to absorb enemy attacks.
    • Maat
      A monk-type alter ego.
      A melee fighter who will use Perfect Counter if he pulls hate.
    • D. Shantotto
      An alter ego that is a different character than Shantotto, and can be used at the same time as the original.
      Different than the original Shantotto, D. Shantotto auto-attacks with a scythe.
      Possess special weapon skills.
      D. Shantotto will be introduced during the Repeat Login Campaign that takes place in June.
  • Waiting animations for alter egos that do not auto-attack
    When fulfilling certain criteria, alter egos such as Shantotto and Sakura that do not perform auto-attacks will now display special wait animations.
  • Calling alter egos while partying with other players
    As there is a lot to be tested for this we still cannot make any guarantees, but we are working towards implementing this feature in the June version update.
  • Adventuring fellow level cap increase
    We’ve raised the level cap for adventuring fellows to level 99.
    Similar to alter egos, a player’s item level will increase an adventuring fellow’s power.
  • Expansion of the areas in which adventuring fellows can be summoned
    We are currently working towards expanding the areas in which adventuring fellows can be summoned for the next version update. To start off we plan on making it possible to summon them in Adoulin areas.
Job Points

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(23:00～)
*The video show a graph of the chain bonus.
  • Additional of new enhancement categories
    We’ve added two new enhancement categories for each job.
  • Implementation of a chain bonus
    Regardless of a player’s item level, you can earn a capacity point bonus by chaining the defeat of monsters over level 100 within a certain amount of time. The capacity points you earn will increase as you continue to defeat more and more monsters, and when defeating level 120 monsters, you can earn a maximum of a 1.6x bonus.
  • Records of Eminence support
    We added objectives that will allow you to earn capacity points.
  • Implementation of party bonuses for certain content
    Similar to Woh Gates and other dungeon areas, we’ve implemented party bonuses for Delve and Skirmish (excluding Yorcia Weald).
Job Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(27:22～)
  • New food items that affect pets
    Shiromochi increases accuracy and ranged accuracy, and Kusamochi increases attack and ranged attack.
    The effect is stronger on pets than the player.
  • Job adjustments
    • Corsair
      Increased the effect of Phantom Rolls geared toward back line jobs.
    • Blue mage
      Certain job traits now become incrementally more potent.
    • Geomancer
      The damage reduction of luopans has been increased from 30% to 50%.
    • Paladin
      The amount of damage reflected back with Reprisal has been increased.
Ergon Weapons

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(32:20～)
*The video introduces the ergon weapons and their help text.
  • Addition of job-specific weapons for rune fencer and geomancer
    These are weapons that are equivalents to the mythic weapons for the other jobs.
  • Ergon weapon specific weapon skills
    In the future we will be adding a quest to unlock the specialized weapon skills just like we did previously for mythic weapons.
New High-tier Mission Battlefields

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(35:00～)
  • ★Puppet in Peril (Lancelord Gaheel Ja)
    The boss has very high defense.
    There is an effective way to attack him, so we're looking forward to seeing you try out various strategies.
  • ★Legacy of the Lost (Gessho)
    Under certain conditions Gessho will spawn clones.
    It’s possible to make it so he does not spawn clones via a special method...
Coalition Rank 8

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(38:40～)
  • Increased coalition rank
    We’ve added new item level 117 equipment as well as other new services for each coalition.
  • Reive adjustments
    • High-purity bayld
      When receiving a high evaluation for completing a reive, it’s now possible to earn high-purity bayld. High-purity bayld is an item needed to complete ergon weapons.
    • New reive momentum bonuses
      We’ve added four new types of reive momentum bonuses.
Records of Eminence

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(40:08～)
  • Addition of new objectives
    We’ve added new Abyssea-related objectives as well as new tutorial objectives.
  • Addition of new exchangeable items
    We’ve added new level 99 accessories and equipment for level 50-98.
Mog Wardrobe

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(41:30～)
*In the video, Fujito explains how the Mog Wardrobe works.
  • Equipment changing with macros
    We've confirmed a bug where it's not possible to change multiple pieces of equipment at the same time that is split between your Gobbiebag and Mog Wardrobe by using macros. We are currently looking into ways to address this and will be fixing it soon, but please give us a bit of time. You can avoid this bug by placing the equipment you want to use into either your Gobbiebag or the Mog Wardrobe, or by using the /wait command. We apologize for the inconvenience, but in the meantime we’d appreciate it if you could use one of these methods until the issue is fixed.
  • Macro to change all equipment at once
    We are currently looking into adding a macro that will allow you to change multiple slots of equipment at once.
Quality of Life Improvements

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(55:10～)
  • Exchange certain weapons and armor for bayld
    We’ve added an NPC that will give you bayld when you trade them older weapons and armor.
  • Addition of the categories “Alchemy 2” and “Misc.2” to the auction house
    We’ve moved the locations of fireworks and trigger items into these two new categories.
  • Zeni Notorious Monster trigger item rate adjustments
    The prices of trigger items that can be purchased with zeni have been changed from the highest value to the lowest value when the server is restarted due to maintenance or other reasons.
  • Title screen configuration options
    It’s now possible to modify the aspect ratio of the title and character selection screen.
Adventurer Appreciation Campaign

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
（58:10～)
  • Green Moogle Suit and Goblin Suit
    By participating in the first ever “Grand Mooblin Battle” that is part of our 12th anniversary celebration, you can obtain these special items. When calling forth adventuring fellows while wearing these items, your adventuring fellows will also wear the same suits.
  • New alter egos: Moogle, Fablinix, and Aldo
    Similar to the brand-new suits, by participating in the “Grand Mooblin Battle” you can obtain these new alter egos. The Moogle alter ego is a Sakura-type alter ego that does not participate in battle, but will give you an effect that will boost the rate in which your magic skills increase when called out.
Repeat Login Campaign No. 11

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(61:55～)
  • Repeat Login Campaign No. 11
    In this round of the Repeat Login Campaign, you can obtain the new Najelith alter ego as well as the Worm Masque that allows you to change into a worm.
  • The future of the Repeat Login Campaign
    While this all began as a special plan for the 11th anniversary, it’s received such good reception that we will be continuing to hold these moving forward.
June Version Update Preview

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(64:10～)
  • Weapon skill stat revamps
    We’ll be revamping the stats for weapon skills as a whole as well as make them useable for skill chains and other situations.
  • Trust alter ego party support
    We will be making it possible to summon alter egos into parties with other players.
We are planning for a lot of other adjustments and additions, so please look forward to future information!
Conclusion

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Thanks to everyone’s continued support we are able to welcome in the twelfth anniversary of FINAL FANTASY XI and I would like to say a big heart-felt thank you. We’ll continue to do our best to provide you all with a fun experience.

Thank you all very much!

title: Jun 17, 2014 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

  • Weapon Skill Adjustments

Event-related

  • New quests have been added to Seekers of Adoulin areas.
  • Ergon weapon-specific weapon skill quests have been added.
    • Geomancer-only club skill, Exudation
      Attachment 9862
      • To undertake this quest, players must speak with Nhili Uvolep in Eastern Adoulin while being a level 99 geomancer.
        Attachment 9863

    • Rune fencer-only great sword skill, Dimidiation
      Attachment 9864
      • To undertake this quest, players must speak to Gaddiux in Western Adoulin while being a level 99 rune fencer.
        Attachment 9865
      * These weapon skills may only be used while being a level 99 geomancer or rune fencer, respectively.

  • Non-accessory weapons and armor of item level 115 dropped by Naakuals in wildskeeper reives will now be eligible for augmentation.
    • About the Engraving Process
      • Particular key items corresponding to the weapon or armor are required to commence the process.
        Colkhab / Tchakka / Achuka / Yumcax / Hurkan / Kumhau
    • Key Items
      The particular key items may be obtained by completing the following Records of Eminence objectives.
      <table width="350" border="0"> <tr> <td width="50.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Objective</td> <td width="50.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Obtainable Key Item</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Subjugation: Colkhab</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Matriarch Naakual paragon</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Subjugation: Tchakka</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Riptide Naakual paragon</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Subjugation: Achuka</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Firebrand Naakual paragon</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Subjugation: Yumcax</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Ligneous Naakual paragon</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Subjugation: Hurkan</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Booming Naakual paragon</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Subjugration: Kumhau</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Flashfrost Naakual paragon</td> </tr></table>
    • Prah Janimhar in Western Adoulin (J-9) is the only one capable of engraving this type of glyptic.
      Attachment 9867
    • Regarding Paragon Arcane Glyptics
      Six glyptics are available per paragon: three shared and three unique. Of these, players are able to engrave up to two: one from the shared list and one from the unique list.
      Notes
      • The paragon item will be consumed in the process.

      • Glyptic values are fixed.

      • Players are able to overwrite existing glyptics by consuming another paragon.

  • Mog Gardens have undergone the following adjustment.
    • The maximum rank for Mog Garden gathering nodes has been raised to the final rank of seven.
      Attachment 9866
  • The following changes have been made to Records of Eminence.
    • A new type of objective—daily objectives—has been introduced.
      Daily objectives may be attempted once per day, and completing them will reward players with A.M.A.N. vouchers and other types of bounties.
      Attachment 9868
      • Three types of daily objective are available as of the June 2014 version update.
        • Vanquish Multiple Enemies
          Defeat the requisite number of experience-yielding enemies.
        • Buff Allies
          Buff a party or alliance member other than yourself the requisite number of times.
        • Heal for X+ HP
          Heal a party or alliance member other than yourself for X or more HP the requisite number of times.
      • Notes
        • Daily objectives will reset at Japanese midnight.
        • Daily objectives do not count toward the total number of objectives a player has completed.
    • New objectives have been added.

  • The following additions and adjustments have been made to Super Kupowers.
    • Thrifty Transit
      • Pre-adjustment
        Outpost teleportation services incur no charge.
      • Post-adjustment
        Outpost teleportation services and teleportation between outposts with survival guides incur no charge, and players are able to receive teleportation services between San d’Oria, Bastok, Windurst, Mhaura, and Selbina from Explorer Moogles.
        * Due to this change, the Super Kupower "Ease of Exploration" has been abolished.
    • Martial Master
      • Pre-adjustment
        Combat skills and magic skills increase more rapidly.
      • Post-adjustment
        Combat, magic, and automaton skills increase more rapidly.
    • A new super Kupower, “Crystal Caboodle,” has been added.
      • Crystals are more likely to be obtained from areas affected by the Super Kupower, and may also be obtained from beastmen-controlled regions.
  • Quests and missions have undergone the following adjustments.
    • The applicable events in the quest “Sin Hunting” have been changed to occur regardless of Vana’diel time and phase of the moon.
    • The amount of Earth time that must pass to proceed with the following quests and missions has been decreased.
      • Quests
        Your Crystal Ball / Enveloped in Darkness/ Ranperre's Final Rest / Trial Size Trial by Earth / Trial Size Trial by Fire / Trial Size Trial by Lightning / Trial Size Trial by Water / Trial Size Trial by Wind / Trial Size Trial by Ice / It's Raining Mannequins
      • Missions
        Immortal Sentries / Westerly Winds / All missions in the "Promotion:" line from "Promotion: Private First Class" to "Promotion: Captain."

Battle-related

  • Weapon skills have been greatly overhauled.
    Attachment 9869
    Read up on the details.

  • Merit Points have undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    Attachment 9870
    • A new entry, “Maximum Merit Points,” has been added to the “HP/MP” merit point category.
      • Adjust your maximum number of merit points by 1 point.
        This category may be increased a maximum of fifteen times.
    • The maximum number of points that can be spent in the following general categories has been increased.
      <table width="350" border="0"><tr><td width="30.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Category</td><td width="20.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Pre-adjustment</td><td width="10.0%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7"> </td><td width="20.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Post-Adjustment</td></tr><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">HP/MP</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">15</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">→</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">45</td></tr><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Attributes</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">24</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">→</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">45</td></tr><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Combat Skills</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">32</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">→</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">56</td></tr><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Magic Skills</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">32</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">→</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">48</td></tr><tr></tr></table>

  • The following job-related adjustments have been made.
    • Paladin
      Attachment 9871
      • A new spell has been added.
        • Crusade (Lv. 88, Recast time: 10 seconds)
          Facilitates enmity gain.
    • Ninja
      Attachment 9872
      • New ninjutsu have been added.
        • Gekka: Ichi (Lv. 88, Recast time: 30 seconds)
          Facilitates enmity gain.

  • Synthesis kits have been added to streamline the synthesis process.
    Attachment 9877
    • Overview
      All players need in order to perform synthesis are these kits and their corresponding crystals.
      Kits are available from each guild and have easily associable names. For example, Blacksmiths' Guild kits are called "Smithing Kit [skill level]."

      Each kit is used to synthesize a different item. Players may synthesize bronze knives with Smithing Kits 5, while Smithing Kits 25 produce spathi.
      Attachment 9878
    • Purchasing Kits
      Kits may be purchased at their respective guilds. They will never go out of stock and their prices will not fluctuate.
    • Using the Kits
      Select "Crystal Synthesis" under the Synthesis menu in the main menu, choose a crystal with which to perform synthesis, and finally, select the desired kit. It is as simple as that.
    • Notes
      • All pertinent information, such as the required skill level, crystal type, and the item that will be obtained upon successful synthesis, is described in the kits' help text.
      • High-quality items cannot be produced by using synthesis kits.
      • Use of these kits will not change the way in which players' synthesis skills increase.
      • While it is possible to use special crystals such as inferno crystals and torrent crystals with these kits, players will not be able to inscribe their signature upon the items they craft with them.

  • The location where the number of stacked items is displayed has been adjusted

Resolved Issues

  • The issue with the Seekers of Adoulin mission "The Gates" wherein the message "Your party leader is currently inspecting the entrance" would not appear even when party leaders examined the instance entrance.
  • The issue wherein certain NPC animations that display during a cutscene for the Seekers of Adoulin mission "Summoned by Spirits" were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein certain sound effects that occur during a cutscene for the Seekers of Adoulin mission "Lighting the Way" were incorrect.
  • The issue with reives wherein players occasionally could not receive the effects of either the rune fencer trait Inspiration or the red mage trait Spontaneity.
  • The issue with Records of Eminence wherein damaging an enemy that was absorbing player attacks would count toward the completion of "Total Healing" objectives.
  • The issue with Monstrosity wherein performing certain operations would allow players to equip instincts that were not intended to be equipped.
  • The issue with Monstrosity wherein players would occasionally be unable to change instincts properly.
  • The issue wherein enemies not native to Dho Gates would spawn there.
  • The issue with the Rise of the Zilart battlefields Ark Angels 3 and ★Ark Angels 3 wherein enemies would occasionally fail to call pets or move.
  • The issue wherein the Delve NM Muyinguwa in Cirdas Caverns [U] would not behave as intended under certain conditions.
  • The issue wherein talking to adventuring fellows would not reveal how much EXP they need to level up.
  • The issue wherein alter egos were able to employ healing magic on their masters even when the players were under the effects of status ailments and such that rendered them unable to be healed.
  • The issue wherein names of items in the auction house that players had also directly equipped from their Mog Wardrobes would not display as green.
  • The issue wherein both the materials and equipment players traded to Divainy-Gamainy, Benjamien, or Heemo-Weemo would be lost if the server were to go down while those NPCs were in the process of engraving arcane glyptics.
  • The issue wherein trying to exchange ghastly stones or verdigris stones for more powerful stones with Ornery Dhole in Western Adoulin while one's inventory was full would result in the loss of those stones.
  • The issue wherein the "Sword enhancement spell damage +10" attribute on Egekings would not function properly.
  • The issue wherein the DMG value for Bestas Bane was lower than intended.
  • The issue wherein the value of the TP bonus displayed for the samurai merit point category "Yaegasumi Effect" was incorrect.
  • The issue wherein the number of Campaign vouchers players possessed would occasionally not display correctly in the Currencies menu.
  • The issue with the Equipment screen wherein help text for completely different items would occasionally display when selecting pieces of equipment.
  • The issue wherein certain NPC dialogue lines, system messages, and item help text contained erroneous information.
  • The issue wherein selecting items from the action command window while in a Mog House or Garden would occasionally cause the client to crash. (Added June 23, 2014)

[Xbox 360 Version Only]
  • The issue wherein certain visual effects that occur during a cutscene in the Seekers of Adoulin mission "A Vow of Truth" would not display properly.

Known Issues

  • The following signed items are erroneously able to be used in syntheses carried out with the /lastsynth command.
    Noble's Bed / Desk / Tarutaru Desk / Water Barrel / Tarutaru Folding Screen / 9-Drawer Almirah / 6-Drawer Almirah / 3-Drawer Almirah / Blue 9-Drawer Almirah / Blue 6-Drawer Almirah / Blue 3-Drawer Almirah / Green 9-Drawer Almirah / Green 6-Drawer Almirah / Green 3-Drawer Almirah / Yellow 9-Drawer Almirah / Yellow 6-Drawer Almirah / Yellow 3-Drawer Almirah / White 9-Drawer Almirah / White 6-Drawer Almirah / White 3-Drawer Almirah / Fine Parchment / Enchanted Ink / Padded Box / Tavnazian Salad / Green Curry / Black Curry / Red Curry / Yellow Curry / Coeurl Sautee / Batagreen Sautee / Windurst Salad / Beaugreen Sautee
  • In Records of Eminence, when undertaking the objective "Vanquish Multiple Enemies [D]," vanquishing monsters in Abyssea will not count toward its completion.
  • In Records of Eminence, "Circle"-type abilities and corsair phantom rolls do not count toward the daily objective "Buff Allies (D)."
    * This is scheduled to be rectified in the July 2014 version update.
  • The effects of Footwork will not properly apply when using Dragon Kick or Tornado Kick.
  • Alter egos will occasionally choose incorrect targets under certain conditions.
  • Archaic Ramparts appearing in Arrapago Remnants II will occasionally sink into the walls under certain conditions, rendering them unable to be attacked.
  • During Campaign battles occurring in Crawler's Nest [S], some Quadav Shieldwarriors will occasionally cease to act.
  • Party member indicolure and geocolure geomancy spells, afterglow effects, "Sphere" effects, and "Favor" effects bestowed by avatars will not function on alter egos called forth by the party leader.
  • Performing certain actions while calling forth alter egos will set players' "Seek Party" flag to "On" even if they are in a party after the alter egos are summoned.
  • When performing particular actions while selecting "Release" to dismiss an alter ego, the "Party" category of the main menu will be grayed out and cannot be selected unless the main menu is opened and closed or the page is changed.
  • Afterglow and aftermath effects are lost when a reive concludes.
  • The amount of TP accumulated by wyverns, avatars, and familiars summoned by the "Call Beast" command when they execute an attack is incorrect.
  • The bottom of the list that appears when selecting the "Sell" option when talking to Visala in Bastok Markets (H-8) contains a nameless item with a price of zero gil.
  • Ra'Kaznar arrows, bolts, and bullets cannot be stacked.
    * This is scheduled to be fixed in the July 2014 version update.
  • Due to the adjustments to weapon skills in this patch, certain monsters have erroneously had their corresponding weapon skills increased in damage.
    * This is scheduled to be rectified in the July 2014 version update.

    This change does not affect the following monsters and battlefields:
    Fomors appearing in Outer Ra’Kaznar / The battlefield accompanying the mission "Behind the Sluices" / The battlefield accompanying the quest "Quiescence"
  • Lola in Eastern Adoulin is a bit behind the times, and has not yet been apprised that adventurers may now enter skirmishes solo.
    * This is scheduled to be rectified in the July 2014 version update.
  • The number of stacked items will not display on top of the item icon when using the "Set Prices" option in the Bazaar menu.

title: Weapon Skill Adjustments
body:
• Weapon skills will undergo the following adjustments.
    • The potency of the following weapons skills will now increase depending on players' levels and main hand weapon item levels.
      Gust Slash / Cyclone / Energy Steal / Energy Drain / Aeolian Edge / Burning Blade / Red Lotus Blade / Shining Blade / Seraph Blade / Sanguine Blade / Uriel Blade / Frostbite / Freezebite / Herculean Slash / Primal Rend / Cloudsplitter / Thunder Thrust / Raiden Thrust / Dark Harvest / Shadow of Death / Infernal Scythe / Blade: Ei / Blade: Yu / Shining Strike / Seraph Strike / Flash Nova / Rock Crusher / Earth Crusher / Starburst / Sunburst / Cataclysm / Vidohunir / Garland of Bliss / Omniscience / Leaden Salute / Trueflight / Wildfire
    • Weapon skills will undergo a large-scale overhaul.
      • Overview
        The adjustments that will be implemented with the forthcoming version update mainly involve attribute modifiers and TP bonuses for weapon skills obtained at low levels.

        Many of the modifier adjustments consist of increases in potency, but others consist of changing the modifier itself.

        As a result of these adjustments, the weapon skills obtainable at lower levels should become as enticing for players to use as their high-level counterparts, thus allowing for a more diverse arsenal depending on the situation.
      • Adjustment Details
        • Modifier Adjustments
          Weapon skill potency is decided based on particular attribute modifierｓ. As a result of these adjustments, which attributes certain weapon skills use as their modifiers and/or the value of the modifiers themselves have been changed.
        • TP Bonus Adjustments
          TP bonuses that occur when using some weapon skills after a certain amount of TP has been stored will undergo adjustments.
