title: “Freshly Picked Vana’diel 8” Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the June version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. Below is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello,
Matsui here.

Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 8.

For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I've created this digest of what was discussed during the stream.

<iframe width="640" height="390" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/stDCGnVGUbo" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Trust Alter Egos and Adventuring Fellows
  • Battle Content Adjustments
  • Reive Adjustments
  • Weapon Skill Adjustments
  • Job Adjustments Part 1
  • Job Adjustments Part 2
  • Mog Garden
  • Quality of Life Improvements
  • Synthesis and Gathering
  • Records of Eminence
  • UI Revisions
  • Campaign Announcements
  • July Version Update Preview
Trust Alter Egos and Adventuring Fellows

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(06:20～)
  • Summoning alter egos while in a party
    We’ve made it possible to summon alter egos when you are in a party with other players.
    • After forming a party, the party leader will be able to summon alter egos.
    • They can be summoned prior to entering seal battlefields and after entering a skirmish area.
    Currently, in order to temporarily address a bug that was found right before implementation, the conditions for summoning alter egos was made a bit strict; however, we will be making it more convenient in a future version update.

  • Alter ego and adventuring fellow adjustments
    We’ve adjusted the behavior of certain alter egos.
    • Ayame
      We’ve made adjustments so that she uses a weapon skill that will elementally coordinate with the weapon skill last used by a player.

      She’ll function well as a skill chain initiator, and it will be extremely convenient for quests that involve performing skill chains.
    • Mihli Aliapoh
      She now uses Afflatus Solace and the amount she cures for has been increased.

  • Summoning alter egos mid-battle
    Currently, in order to prevent cases where only alter egos are continuously thrown at enemies during battles, we’ve restricted the ability to summon alter egos while you are in battle.

    In a future version update, we would like to implement a system that functions much like the charged for scholars that would allow you to summon alter egos a set number of times while you are in battle.
Battle Content Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(15：30～)
  • Skirmish
    • Outer Ra’Kaznar
      We’ve increased the drop rate of vials of transmelange and Pulchridopt Wings, and made it so it’s easier to enhance skirmish equipment to item level 119.

      As an effect of these adjustments the drop rate for Ghastly Stones, Verdigris Stones, and Wailing Stones has consequently been lowered. Of these items, Wailing Stones are an item that is in heavy demand, and in the July version update we will be restoring the original drop rate for this item.
    • Yorcia Weald
      We’ve added an option to reduce the defending time.
    • Easing of entry requirements
      We’ve made it possible to enter all skirmish areas solo.
      It’s also possible to summon alter egos in skirmish, so you’ll be able to get into this content easily even if there are not a lot of people around by using your alter egos.

  • High-tier mission battlefields
    • Adjustments to the exchange rate for phantom gems
      In order to make it so high-tier battlefields could be accessed more easily, we’ve reduced the merit point cost associated with purchasing the required key items.

      Considering the congestion conditions for Divine Might and the Ark Angels battles we have not made adjustments to the exchange rate for these battlefields.
    • Addition of Divinator and Seraphicaller as rewards to all battlefields
      As these items are very important for puppetmaster and summoner to increase their pet’s level, we made changes so that they drop as a reward for all battlefields.

      These have been set as separate slots from existing rewards, so the drop rate of other rewards will not be affected.

      Additionally, we set a certain chapter of Rem’s Tale to each battlefield as a countermeasure to disperse congestion from the Ark Angels and Divine Might.
  • Delve
    • Adjustments to the drop rate of Yggzi Beads
      We’ve made adjustments so that Delve notorious monsters spawned in field areas are guaranteed to drop Yggzi Beads.
Reive Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(20：00～)
*The video shows off gameplay footage of arcane glyptics.

  • Lair reives
    We’ve increased the amount of experience points and bayld that are earned.
    Also, we’ve reduced the delay between when lair reives respawn making it even easier to earn bayld and experience points.

  • Colonization reives
    Just as with lair reives, we’ve also increased the amount of experience points and bayld that you can earn from colonization reives, and we’ve also made it easier to breakthrough obstacles.

  • Wildskeeper reives
    • Addition of new reward equipment
      To serve as motivation to challenge wildskeeper reives, we’ve added new rewards.
    • Reward equipment customization
      We’ve made it possible to enhance the equipment you can obtain from wildskeeper reives with arcane glyptics. While the item level of the equipment will not change, by using a Naakual Paragon that is rewarded for defeating a Naakual, you’ll be able to freely select two enhancements from a list of special bonuses.

      The type of Naakual Paragon needed to add arcane glyptics will differ depending on the equipment.
Weapon Skill Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(27：00～)

*The video shows off a graph of the changes to the amount of TP generated.
  • Weapon skill adjustments
    We’ve made adjustments to the stats of nearly every weapon skill including the ones learned at low levels using the strength of merit point weapon skills as a base measurement. The adjustments enhanced all weapon skills in a certain way.

    With these adjustments, monsters’ weapon skills were also affected, but the monsters of major content such as Adoulin content and high-tier mission battlefields were not affected.

    Additionally, certain monsters’ weapon skills were also temporarily enhanced, but in the next version update we will be reverting them back to their original strength.

  • Revisions to TP gain calculations
    Previously, there were more advantageous situations for weapons with a short delay and we made adjustments to compensate for this by making it so weapons with longer delays gained more TP. However, to better fit the current game balance we’ve made changes to the calculations so that all weapons generate the same amount of TP.
Job Adjustments Part 1

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(34：30～)
  • Geomancer and rune fencer
    After clearing a quest you’ll be able to use the specialized weapon skills as geomancer and rune fencer without equipping their ergon weapon.

    When undertaking these quests, bringing the Ayame alter ego along will be a great help.

  • Addition of 5 new high-quality broths for Call Beast
    We’ve made it so when synthesizing certain broths it will be possible to create high-quality versions.

    When using the high-quality broth, the pet that is summoned will be level 119 and also have enhanced stats. In particular their defensive stats will be higher.

    Additionally, we’ve added new methods for obtaining verboshrooms as this is a special key ingredient which was often difficult to come by, and they will now drop from funguar-type monsters located in Sih Gates.
Job Adjustments Part 2

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(35：55～)
  • Rune fencer
    • New magic spell: Crusade
      We’ve added the new magic spell “Crusade” which facilitates enmity gain.
    • Elimination of enmity gain from Rune Enchantment
      This is a change that was coupled with the above adjustment. Previously it was difficult for rune fencer to gain enmity and players were constantly using Rune Enchantment as a means to do this. However, this was something that was not originally intended for this ability, so with the addition of new methods to gain enmity it will no longer be necessary to do this.
    • Adjustments to ward abilities
      We’ve made it so when harboring three runes and using ward abilities, the effects can no longer be removed by dispel-type abilities.

  • Paladin
    We’ve also added Crusade to paladin’s array of spells.
    Crusade adds an effect that is equivalent to enmity +30.

  • Ninja
    We’ve added Gekka: Ichi to facilitate enmity gain and Yain: Ichi to suppress enmity gain.

    Gekka: Ichi and Yain: Ichi give an effect of enmity +30 and enmity -15, respectively.
Mog Garden

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(38：05～)
  • Maximum rank increase
    We’ve raised the rank cap of each gathering point to rank 7.

  • Addition of a new quest
    When you reach rank 7 for all of the gathering points it will unlock a special new quest.

    If you complete this quest you’ll be rewarded with the Straw Hat item.

  • Sticky rice
    We’ll be making it possible to grow sticky rice in your garden furrow in the July version update.
Quality of Life Improvements

Quote:
Originally Posted by Matsui_Akihiko
(39：30～)
  • Easing of Earth time requirements for certain missions and quests
    We’ve eased the amount of Earth time that must pass to progress with certain missions and quests making it easier to play through them. Additionally, we’ve made it possible to upgrade Mog Lockers without having to wait for a certain amount of time to pass.

  • Door mechanic in Eldieme Necropolis and Halvung
    We’ve implemented means so that the door mechanic in these areas can be opened solo.
Synthesis and Gathering

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(41:45～)

*The video shows gameplay introducing the new synthesis kits and new synthesis features.
  • Additions to the guild shops
    We’ve eliminated the holiday for each guild shop, and one of the two guild shops will be open 24 hours.
    Depending on your synthesis skill, the items available from the 24 hour NPC will increase.
    You’ll be able to purchase a variety of different materials and their stock will not run out.

  • Synthesis kits
    With only a synthesis kit and a crystal you’ll be able to synthesize items.
    While you will not be able to make high-quality items and the synthesis kit will be lost if you fail, by using a synthesis kit you’ll be able to increase your synthesis skill easily without having to procure all your materials.

  • Sythesis history feature
    We’ve added the “/lastsynth” text command which will allow you to perform synthesis again for the last recipe you used.

  • New Super Kupower: “Crystal Caboodle”
    With the improvements to movement speed Ease of Exploration did not have as much of an effect anymore, so we changed it into a new Super Kupower.

    When Crystal Caboodle is active the amount of crystals dropped by monsters will be increased and they will also drop crystal clusters.

  • Visual indicators for gathering points
    By adding a visual effect to gathering points, we’ve made them easier to find.
Records of Eminence

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(49:30～)

*The videos shows off gameplay that introduces the new daily objectives.
  • Daily objectives
    As a response to requests for repeatable objectives that even backline jobs can easily accomplish, we’ve added daily objectives that you can set once per day.

    Completing these objectives will grant you a bonus that will give nearly triple the amount of sparks of eminence.
UI Revisions

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(51:10～)
*The video shows off the aspects that have changed.
  • Change to the method of TP display
    In order to make it easier to understand the effects of Store TP and Regain, we’ve multiplied the displayed TP values by a factor of 10.

  • Party member TP display
    We’ve added the “/partyinfo showtp on” text command which will allow you to see party and alliance members’ TP.

  • Current location coordinates display
    We’ve made it so the coordinates of a player’s current location is displayed under the compass.

  • Stacking of material items
    We’ve made it so it is now possible to stack ores and other synthesis materials.
Campaign Announcements

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(56:50～)
  • Celestial Nights
    • Addition of reward items
      The content of the event is just as it has been in the past, but we’ve added new fireworks as a reward for this year’s event, so I hope everyone has a good time participating.

  • Double Experience Campaign
    Starting on Thursday, June 26 at 11:00pm (PDT) we’ll be holding the Double Experience Campaign. The bonus will also apply to adventuring fellows, so if you have not yet maxed out your adventuring fellow’s level yet, this is the perfect time to take them up to level 99.

  • Summer Alter Ego Extravaganza
    We’ll be kicking off the Summer Alter Ego Extravaganza in July, and four brand-new alter egos from Wings of the Goddess will be added!
    • Noillurie
    • Elvira
    • Lhu Mhakaracca
    • Ferreous Coffin
    We’ll be releasing more details about the campaign on topics in the near future!
July Version Update Preview

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(64:00～)

*The video shows off gameplay footage of new spells for red mage.
  • The next version update
    The July version update is slated for an early July release.
    Though it’s a small sized version update, it’s packed with content such as the new monster raising system for Mog Garden, brand-new spells for red mage and geomancer, and much more!

title: Jul 8, 2014 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

  • Monster Rearing

Event-related

  • A new system known as Monster Rearing is now available in Mog Gardens.
    Attachment 10036
    Read on for details.
  • The following items may now be planted in Mog Garden furrows.
    Popotoes / Tarutaru Rice / Sticky Rice
  • New objectives have been added to Records of Eminence.
  • Certain conditions for progressing with missions and quests have been revised.
    Players will no longer have to wait for Japanese midnight, or, when applicable, midnight on Japanese Monday, to progress in the following quests and missions. Instead, waiting periods will be set at a maximum of one minute (Earth time).
    Coming of Age / Blue Ribbon Blues / A Greeting Cardian / The Sacred Katana / Yomi Okuri / A Thief in Norg!? / The Missing Piece / Better the Demon You Know / Behind the Smile / Tuning In / Tuning Out / Finding Faults / Got It All / Give a Moogle a Break / The Moogle's Picnic! / Moogles in the Wild

Battle-related

  • New high-tier mission battlefields have been added.
    Attachment 10037Attachment 10038
    • Battlefields and Bosses
      • ★The Shadow Lord Battle
        Attachment 10039
        Show the angst-ridden Shadow Lord that white is the new black once more!

      • ★Head Wind
        Attachment 10040
        Teach Shikaree X, Y, and Z that there's more than one way to skin a cat!
    • Joining the Fray
      The key items required to participate in these battlefields can be acquired from the following NPCs in exchange for merit points.
      • Trisvain in Northern San d’Oria (J-7)
        Attachment 10041

      • Raving Opossum in Port Bastok (J-11)
        Attachment 10042

      • Mimble-Pimble in Port Windurst (L-5)
        Attachment 10043

              Players will be able to receive items necessary to repair one of the aforementioned weapon types on “normal” difficulty or above.

            • Artifact Equipment-related
              Players will receive a number of copies of Rem's Tale Chapter 7 that varies with the difficulty selected.

  • The following job-related adjustments have been made.
    • Red Mage
      Attachment 10044
      • New spells have been added.
        • Haste II (Lv.96, Recast time: 20 sec.)
          Increases target's attack speed.
        • Distract (Lv.35, Recast time: 10 sec.)
          Reduces target's physical evasion.
        • Distract II (Lv.85, Recast time: 10 sec.)
          Reduces target's physical evasion.
        • Frazzle (Lv.42, Recast time: 10 sec.)
          Reduces target's magic evasion.
        • Frazzle II (Lv.92, Recast time: 10 sec.)
          Reduces target's magic evasion.
        • Flurry (Lv.48, Recast time: 20 sec.)
          Increases target's ranged attack speed.
        • Flurry II (Lv.96, Recast time: 20 sec.)
          Increases target's ranged attack speed.

    • Blue Mage
      Attachment 10045
      • Blue mages are now capable of learning the following spells.
        • Erratic Flutter (Lv.99, Recast time: 45 sec.)
          Increases attack speed.
        • Thrashing Assault (Lv.99, Recast time: 60 sec.)
          Delivers a fourfold attack.
        • Subduction (Lv.99, Recast time: 5 sec.)
          Deals wind damage to enemies within range. Additional effect: Weight.

    • Corsair
      Attachment 10046
      The phantom roll “Corsair’s Roll” now affects capacity point gains.

    • Pupptemaster
      Attachment 10047
      Automatons equipped with the stormwaker head are now able to use Haste II.

    • Geomancer
      Attachment 10048
      • New spells have been added.
        • Indi-Haste (Lv.93, Recast time: 12 sec.)
          Increases attack speed for party members within range.
        • Geo-Haste (Lv.97, Recast time: 12 sec.)
          Increases attack speed for party members within area of effect.
  • Targets under the effects of Weight no longer have their physical evasion decreased.
  • Colonization reives in Foret de Hennetiel, Yorcia Weald, Morimar Basalt Fields, Marjami Ravine, Kamihr Drifts, Cirdas Caverns, Dho Gates and Woh Gates have undergone the following adjustments.
    The number of monsters that spawn has been decreased.
    Monster respawn time has been increased from one minute to five minutes and monster detection radii have been decreased. These two changes also apply to colonization reives in Yahse Hunting Grounds, Ceizak Battlegrounds, Sih Gates, and Moh Gates.
  • Wildskeeper reives have undergone the following adjustments.
    The number of monsters spawning in wildskeeper reives in Yorcia Weald has been decreased.
    Wildskeeper reives in Ceizak Battlegrounds now have a chance to drop a new katana.
    Attachment 10049
    * Prah Janimhar in Western Adoulin (J-9) can engrave this new katana with arcane glyptics.
  • The Trust Initiative has undergone the following adjustments.
    • Alter egos may now be called forth when level synced.
      Attachment 10050
    • Alter egos may now be used in the following Treasures of Aht Urhgan mission battlefields.
      Attachment 10051
      The Black Coffin / Shield of Diplomacy / Puppet in Peril
      * Any alter egos called forth before entering the battlefield for The Black Coffin will disappear upon entering and must be called forth again.
      * Alter egos cannot be called forth inside the battlefields for Shield of Diplomacy and Puppet in Peril, and thus must be called forth before entering.
    • The movement logic of alter egos has been adjusted for when they are not in combat.
    • The following alter egos have received adjustments.
      • Volker
        Capabilities and action logic have been adjusted.
        Under certain circumstances, Volker will switch between offense and defense.
      • Aldo
        Capabilities have been adjusted.
        The “enhances Dual Wield effect” bonus that Aldo receives under certain conditions will now occur when the player is level 20 or greater.
  • Salvage has undergone the following adjustments.
    The number of gear-family monsters that spawn in Bhaflau Remnants-II and drop alexandrite has been increased.
  • In the “Unlocking a Myth” line of quests, the number of skillchains required to complete the quest is now set as if players have reached floor 100 in Nyzul Isle, regardless of how many floors they have completed.
  • The effects of slow will now properly work on certain enemies residing in Adoulin areas whose autoattacks are area of effect.
    *These adjustments also affect those Delve monsters that were modified in the March 18, 2014 version update.
  • Skirmishes have undergone the following adjustments.
    • The hierarchy of spoil drop rates in Outer Ra’Kaznar [U] has been adjusted.
      • Pre-adjustment
        Pulchridopt Wings > Ghastly Stones > Verdigris Stones > Wailing Stones
      • Post-adjustment
        Pulchridopt Wings > Ghastly Stones = Verdigris Stones = Wailing Stones
        * In accordance with this adjustment, the drop rate of wailing stones has been increased and that of ghastly stones has been decreased.
    • The types and number of stones that Lola in Eastern Adoulin (G-8) will exchange for pulchridopt wings has been adjusted as follows.

  • A history function has been added to the Synthesis section of the main menu.
    Selecting the History option will display information concerning pervious synthesis attempts. Simply choose the appropriate item from the list and select "OK" to perform the same synthesis as before.

    * In the event that players perform synthesis for an item not already displayed in their history and fail, the resulting item will be "Mangled Mess." If, however, they succeed and synthesize a high-quality item, the name of that high-quality item will display as the entry. The name of the Mangled Mess or high-quality item will be overwritten should a normal-quality item be produced when synthesizing that item again.
  • Favoriting
    Selecting an item shown in the history and clicking "Favorite" will display a star mark (★) next to the entry and ensure that it will remain in one's history.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue wherein selecting “Titillating Tomes” from the Goblin Footprints in Mog Gardens would occasionally display the player’s NPC assistant in cutscenes.

  • The issue with Monstrosity wherein the cursor would display in an improper position upon selecting “Set Faculties” from the “Customize” menu and performing certain actions.
  • The issue with Monstrosity wherein the ability window would display at an unnatural time when performing certain actions.
  • The issue with Records of Eminence wherein the objectives “Shiver me Timbers” and “Go With the Flow” disappeared from the list of possible objectives.
    * Players are able to progress with these objectives by re-accepting them from Nantoto in Lower Jeuno (H-8).
  • The issue with Records of Eminence wherein players were unable to complete the objective “Participate in Fish Ranking”
  • The issue with Records of Eminence wherein certain objective help text was incorrect.
  • Various issues with improper quest text.
  • Various issues with NPC dialogue and messages.
  • The issues wherein attribute adjustments for the following weapon skills were incorrect.
    Heavy Swing / Rock Crusher / Earth Crusher / Shell Crusher / Vidohunir / Garland of Bliss / Omniscience / Flash Nova
  • The issue wherein alter egos would stack together while moving in certain areas.
  • The issue wherein some animations for Elivira’s alter ego’s were incorrect.

  • The issue wherein phantom rolls would not active properly under certain circumstances when equipped with the Merirosvo Ring or Barataria Ring.
  • The issue wherein Archaic Ramparts appearing in Arrapago Remnants-II would sink into the walls under certain circumstances, rendering them unable to be attacked.
  • The issue wherein TP accumulated by attacking for pets summoned with the Call Beast command, wyverns, and avatars was incorrect.
  • The issue wherein the visual effects of certain special attacks used by monsters did not match their names.
  • The issue wherein items engraved with arcane glyptics did not appear grayed out when attempting to deliver items between characters on the same account.
  • The issue wherein the macro palette would occasionally cease to open when performing crystal synthesis from the Synthesis main menu option.
  • The issue wherein performing the /hidefaith or /hidetrust text commands while the icon type is set to 1 in the Misc. section of the Config menu option would set the icon type to 2.
  • The issue with the /lastsynth text command wherein augmented items would be selectable as materials.
  • The issue wherein the following signed items were usable in syntheses performed using the /lastsynth text command.
    Noble's Bed / Desk / Tarutaru Desk / Water Barrel / Tarutaru Folding Screen / 9-Drawer Almirah / 6-Drawer Almirah / 3-Drawer Almirah / Blue 9-Drawer Almirah / Blue 6-Drawer Almirah / Blue 3-Drawer Almirah / Green 9-Drawer Almirah / Green 6-Drawer Almirah / Green 3-Drawer Almirah / Yellow 9-Drawer Almirah / Yellow 6-Drawer Almirah / Yellow 3-Drawer Almirah / White 9-Drawer Almirah / White 6-Drawer Almirah / White 3-Drawer Almirah / Fine Parchment / Enchanted Ink / Padded Box / Tavnazian Salad / Green Curry / Black Curry / Red Curry / Yellow Curry / Coeurl Sautee / Batagreen Sautee / Windurst Salad / Beaugreen Sautee
  • The issue wherein the cursor would be placed in an incorrect location when switching main menu screens.
  • The issue wherein the Ionis effect “XXXX Synthesis Skill Gain Rate Increase” would not apply to synergy.
  • The issue wherein certain terrain features in Yorcia Weald (E-9) were occasionally stacked on top of each other.
    * This issue was resolved in the June 2014 version update, but we are announcing it now, as the fix required further testing.

Known Issues

  • In Records of Eminence, the objectives “Shiver Me Timbers” and “Go With the Flow” will have disappeared from the list of completed objectives if completed before the July 8, 2014 version update.
  • In Records of Eminence, fishing up Tavnazian goby, turnabaligi, or garpike will not count for the “Total Catches (Saltwater)” and “Total Catches (Freshwater)” objectives.
  • In Mog Gardens, the graphics for the pond will not change when they level up to a specific rank.
  • The attribute dependencies for the weapon skills “Starburst” and “Sunburst” are incorrect.
  • The visual effects of the blue magic spell “Erratic Flutter” will not display for other characters when casting it while under the effects of the job ability “Diffusion.”
  • The visual effects of the blue magic spell “Erratic Flutter” will not display for other characters when casting it while under the effects of the job ability “Diffusion.”
  • Familiars will occasionally cease to move in Arrapago Remnants and Arrapago Remnants-II.
  • The following alter egos will occasionally not cast Cure when the player is a certain distance away.
    Cherukiki / Nashmeira / Fablinix / Nollurie / Ferreous Coffin
  • When a party member under the effects of Spirit Surge uses Super Jump on an alter ego called forth by the party leader, the effects of Super Jump do not activate.
  • Wyverns will prioritize alter egos when using Healing Breath.
  • In Pankration, the amount of jettons earned decreases with each successive victory after attaining a certain number of consecutive wins.
  • Monster Rearing-related designations will now display in the selection list when speaking to Debadle-Levadle in Western Adoulin.
  • The message “Downloading Data...” will continue to be displayed in the help window if players perform specific actions immediately after an area change.
  • Players will occasionally become unable to select “Synthesis” from the main menu when using the /lastsynth text command immediately before changing areas.
    * This issue can be resolved by performing one of the following actions.
    • Performing synthesis via /lastsynth.
    • Performing synthesis by selecting a crystal from the inventory.
    • Relogging.
  • The in-game message announcing the July Login Campaign erroneously describes it as the August Login Campaign. A similar error will occur for the August Login Campaign.
  • Merchants selling magical maps in Rabao display visible macros in their sale dialogue rather than the amount of gil the maps actually cost. Please purchase your maps in another location.

title: “Freshly Picked Vana’diel 9” Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the July version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. Below is a digest of what was discussed.


Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello,
Matsui here.

Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 9.

For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I've created this digest of what was discussed during the stream.

<iframe width="640" height="390" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/8UC2Bkiw89A" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Content Adjustments
  • New High-tier Missions Battlefields
  • Job Adjustments
  • Monster Rearing
  • Synthesis Adjustments
  • Campaign Announcements
  • Future Campaign Plans
  • In-closing
Content Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(07:10~)
  • Skirmish
    • Adjustments to the exchange rates for wailing stones
      We've made adjustments to the exchanges rates for wailing stones, which eased the difficulty for obtaining them.
    • Adjustments to the drop rate of wailing stones
      After making adjustments to the drop rate in the June version update, we received a lot of feedback from players, and based on this we re-adjusted the drop rate of the other type of stones. We've lowered the drop rate of ghastly stones and raised the drop rate of wailing stones.
  • Colonization reives
    • Adjustments to the spawn rate of monsters
      We’ve made adjustments to that colonization reives can be cleared more easily with a fewer amount of people. We extended the spawn rate of monsters and increased the opportunities to attack the obstacles. Additionally, we’ve reduced monster detection range, which will reduce the danger of monsters attacking from the opposite side of the wall.
  • Salvage
    • Adjustments to Bhaflau Remnants-II
      In order to improve congestion from one remnant being heavily focused on, we’ve balanced out the amount of alexandrite that can be earned from each Salvage area.
  • Nyzul
    • Adjustments to obtaining mythic weapon skills
      Progression in Nyzul will now no longer affect the requirements for unlocking mythic weapon skills.
High-tier Mission Battlefields

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(10:00~)
*The video shows off the Shadow Lord battle.
  • High-tier mission battlefields: “★The Shadow Lord Battle” and “★Head Wind”
    The Shadow Lord and the Shikarees make their appearance in new high-tier mission battlefields. Similar to the original mission battle, mid-way through the fight the Shadow Lord will phase change and start to deal heavy attacks repetitively, so it’ll be important to deal damage to him quickly once he changes.
Job Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(24:35~)
  • Red mage
    • Addition of new enhancing and enfeebling magic spells
      Haste II gives 30% haste.
      Flurry is a new spell that reduces ranged attack delay, and Flurry II also reduces ranged delay by 30%.

      The effect for Distract II and Frazzle II will increase depending on how much MND and enfeebling magic skill you have. At the maximum, each spell will reduce physical evasion and magical damage, respectively, by 50.
    • Adjustments to the status ailment “Weight”
      To coincide with the addition of Distract, we’ve removed the reduced physical evasion effect from the status ailment “Weight”. Considering the effect of reduced movement speed, there were a lot of monsters we had make resistant to this, which then made it difficult to utilize this effect as a means to reduce physical evasion. As such we decided to completely separate this effect.
  • Geomancer
    • New spells: Indi-Haste and Geo-Haste
      The effects of both Indi-Haste and Geo-Haste are affected by the caster’s handbell skill and geomancy skill, so while I cannot give a specific number for the effect, they can both have the potential to reach the stats of Haste II.

      In recent battles haste is becoming more and more important and has been limiting the back line jobs that are being utilized. Due to this, we wanted to make it possible to reach the haste cap by using various back line jobs.
  • Blue mage
    • New blue magic spells
      We’ve added three new blue magic spells. Erratic Flutter, which gives the effect of Haste II; Thrashing Assault, which has a high amount of power in exchange for a somewhat longer recast time; and an AoE magic attack, Subduction.
    • Adjustments to high level blue magic spells
      To go along with the weapon skill adjustments that took place in the June version update, we’ve been looking into re-adjusting the blue magic spells that can be learned at high levels. We’ll be making an announcement in the coming days about when and what will be adjusted.
  • Corsair
    • Adjustments to Corsair’s Roll
      We’ve made it so Corsair’s Roll also affects capacity point gains.
  • Puppetmaster
    • Addition of Haste II to the stormwaker head
      Based on feedback from the previous Freshly Picked Vana’diel, we added Haste II to the stormwaker head.
Monster Rearing

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(29:30~)
*The video introduces monster rearing with gameplay.
  • New Mog Garden feature: “Monster Rearing”
    It’s now possible to raise monsters in your Mog Garden. By taking care of monsters you can receive various kinds of items.

    This is content that will allow you select how you’d like to enjoy it based on your preference. Depending on the choices you make when taking care of your monsters, you can choose to raise them for items or raise them as pets you can love.
Synthesis Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(45:50~)
*The video introduces the synthesis history function.
  • New feature: “Synthesis History”
    This is a feature that will allow you to remember up to 10 recipes you’ve synthesized. Please put it to good use!
Campaign Announcements

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(49:40~)
  • Summer Alter Ego Extravaganza
    During the extravaganza you can obtain alter egos of Campaign generals Elivira, Noillurie, Lhu Mhakaracca, and the scout NPC Ferreous Coffin.
  • Campaign Festa
    During the event period, you can earn double experience points and allied notes when participating in Campaign. Additionally, we’ve added various items as rewards for certain Campaign Ops, one of which is Haste II.
  • Alter Ego Expo
    Alter ego’s HP and MP have been enhanced and they also have been given strong resistance to status ailments. Bring your trusty alter egos with you and enjoy your adventures.
  • 12th Vana’versary Mog Bonanza winning numbers announcement
    Did we have any lucky winners amongst those of you who bought bonanza marbles?
    We’ve put the winning numbers on the server message, so don’t forget to check them out.
Future Campaign Plans

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(53:50~)
*The video introduces new alter egos and equipment.
  • July 2014 Login Campaign
    The new Star Sibyl alter ego can be obtained during the July 2014 Login Campaign. She is an alter ego that will not actually participate in the battle, but summoning her will give you a magic attack bonus and increase magical accuracy.

    Additionally, you can obtain the brand-new Kyuka Uchiwa item. This is not a firework, it’s a hand-held fan weapon that you can equip.
  • Sunbreeze Festival
    During this year’s Sunbreeze Festival you’ll be able to obtain new Happi items. Pairing this up with the hand fan should definitely get you in the summer spirit!

    Additionally, alongside the Sunbreeze Festival as usual Mumor and Uka will make an appearance, and you’ll be able to obtain their alter egos. By summoning them both at the same time, the stats of the abilities they use will increase. Mumor’s samba effect duration will be increased and Uka’s waltz potency will be enhanced.
In Closing

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
*The video shows off an area that is in-development.

The next version update is slated for mid-August. This is a large-scale version update where we’ll be continuing the Adoulin storyline and opening up new areas.

In addition to this, we’ll be adding new battle content for Skirmish, adding new job point categories, introducing different versions of alter egos, implementing a new equipment swapping feature, and much more! I hope you are all looking forward to it.

title: Aug 12, 2014 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • New Seekers of Adoulin missions have been added.
    Attachment 10176Attachment 10177
  • A new area, Ra’Kaznar Inner Court, has been added.
    Attachment 10178Attachment 10179
  • Coalition assignments have undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • Coalition assignments have undergone the following additions and adjustments.
      A new assignment, “Gather: Ra’Kaznar Inner Court,” has been added.
  • New alter egos have been added.
    Attachment 10181Attachment 10182Attachment 10180Attachment 10183
    Read on for details.
  • A new feature for players to search for quests and NPCs offering tutorial objectives has been added to the following NPCs.
    Attachment 10184
    Ailevia in Southern San d'Oria (I-9) / Matildie in Northern San d'Oria (J-8) / Teilsa in Port San d'Oria (F-9) / Arva in Bastok Mines (H-7) / Reet in Bastok Markets (G-8) / Dulsie in Port Bastok (J-8) / Jack of Hearts in Windurst Waters (north side, G-9) / Jack of Diamonds in Windurst Walls (C-13) / Jack of Clubs in Port Windurst (E-6) / Jack of Spades in Windurst Woods (H-11)
    • Searching for Quests
      1. First, select “I want to find some quests!”
        Attachment 10185
      2. Select the desired area.
        Attachment 10186
        The areas that display will be located in the nation where the NPC resides.
      3. Select an NPC.
        Attachment 10187
      4. The location of the NPC offering the quest will be marked on the map.
        Attachment 10188
        Players not in possession of a map will be introduced to a map vendor.
      • Quests Displayed Using this Feature
        The NPCs invovled will ruminate on players’ fame and main job level and introduce quests that meet those conditions.

        For those quests which do not have a level prerequisite, the NPCs will calculate a recommended level based on the levels at which the quest rewards can be equipped or used, as well as the average level of the monsters inhabiting the areas through which the player must pass.

        * Additional quests are scheduled to be made searchable via this system in future version updates.
    • Searching for Tutorial NPCs
      1. Select “I want to try the tutorial event!”
        Attachment 10189
      2. An NPC providing tutorial objectives will be marked on the map.
        Attachment 10190
        Players not in possession of a map will be introduced to a map vendor.
  • New Records of Eminence objectives have been added.
  • Mog Gardens have undergone the following adjustments.
    • The Green Thumb Moogle now sells the following items.
      Moko Grass / Distilled Water / Lugworm / Little Worm
    • Dung and miracle mulch may now be used as fertilizer for furrows.
      Miracle mulch may be obtained via synthesis.
    • Monster Rearing has undergone the following adjustments.
      • When selecting “Send it back home” after speaking with Chacharoon, Chacharoon’s dialogue will change based on the number of days the player has been caring for the monsters.
      • Under certain conditions, a message will now display in the chat log when feeding a monster something that may greatly speed up its growth.
      • A new monster will no longer succumb to darkness for the first two days (Earth time) after starting to rear it.
      • The requirements for attaining certain Monster Rearing-realted designations have been lowered.
      • Monsters’ mood and degree of satisfaction will now change when feeding them while their growth style is set to “enjoying the moment.”
      • Monsters will no longer change in appearing when feeding themsomething that may greatly speed up their growth is their growth style is set to “enjoying the moment.”
  • Moblin Maze Mongers has undergone the following adjustments.
    • The amount of time that must pass between ordering mazes has been decreased from twenty-four hours (Earth time) to twenty hours.
    • The amount of marbles that must be paid to Duplidoc in Lower Jeuno (H-9) to purchase a maze tabula has been decreased from twenty to five.
  • A new cutscene, which introduces the NPC to which players can turn in their adventurer coupon, has been added to the opening sequence that plays after creating a new character.

Battle-related

  • New battle content known as “alluvion skirmishes” has been added.

    Attachment 10191Attachment 10192
    Attachment 10193Attachment 10194
    • About Alluvion Skirmishes
      Alluvion skirmishes are a new type of battle content in which the fiends, bosses, and topographical features change from one labyrinth to the next. Intrepid explorers who meet certain conditions will be able to descend ever deeper into the skirmish. Rewards for vanquishing the enemy leaders include item level 119 weapons and shields and special materials used to engrave them with arcane glyptics.
    • How to Participate
      • Have installed and registered the Seekers of Adoulin expansion pack.
      • Be of level 95 or greater.
      • Be in a party of between one and six players*.
      • The party leader must be in possession of a specific “eudaemon” key item.
        * Alter egos may be called forth in alluvion skirmishes.
    • Forging Into Alluvion Skirmishes
      Oston in Eastern Adoulin (G-8) is able to forge special statues known as “eudamons” using existing simulacra segments—visages, torsos, and legs—by combining them with another newly introduced type. These new segments can be obtained from normal skirmishes.
    • Entering the World of Alluvion Skirmishes
      Alluvion skirmishes utilize the same Augural Conveyors with which pioneers are already familiar. At launch, alluvion skirmishes will be available in Rala Waterways [U] and Cirdas Caverns [U], with more areas scheduled to be added in upcoming version updates.
    • Conquering Alluvion Skirmishes
      Entering an alluvion skirmish via an Augural Conveyor will transport the player’s party into this otherworldly realm, immediately after which the clock will start ticking down.

      Time limits for these skirmishes vary between fifteen and fifty-five minutes, and are determined by the rank of the torso used to construct the corresponding eudaemon. The torso also affects how many floors players are able to attempt.

      Living Cairns situated by the entrance can be used to teleport players to other areas of the skirmish. After entering, conditions such as "vanquish a certain number of enemies," or "defeat a particular notorious monster" will be displayed. These reveal the method for calling forth the skirmish's overlord.

      Vanquishing the leader will reward players with spoils such as item level 119 weapons and shields. Additionally, all party members will receive a “fenestral key” temporary item*. Furthermore, the Living Cairn located in the vicinity will activate, enabling players to progress to further layers of the skirmish.

      * Using a fenestral key will spawn a personal treasure coffer, destroy all Living Cairns, and end the skirmish, giving players a chance to roll lots.
    • Regarding Arcane Glyptics
      Divainy-Gamainy in Western Adoulin (J-10) can engrave weapons and shields earned in alluvion skirmishes with arcane glyptics in exchange for particular items and a fee of obsidian fragments.
      • Materials Required to Engrave Arcane Glyptics
        There are several types of such materials, all of which can be earned in alluvion skirmishes. Although the glyptics engraved by these materials vary in terms of attributes, different items tend to beget particular results, making it possible for players to exert a certain degree of control over what attributes they would like to receive.
  • The amount of obsidian fragments obtainable from vanquishing monsters in skirmishes has been increased.
  • The maximum value of the equipment attribute “Enmity+” has been increased.
  • The visual effects accompanying the use of abilities of wyverns, avatars, automatons, and beastmasters’ familiars are no longer displayed.
  • The following jobs have undergone adjustments.

    • Paladin

    • Dark Knight

    • Ninja

    • Dragoon

    • Blue Mage

    • Puppetmaster

  • Alter egos have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Alter egos may now be called forth in the following Treasures of Aht Urhgan mission battlefields.
      • Shades of Vengeance / Gaze of the Saboteur / Path of Darkness / Nashmeira’s Plea
    • The following alter egos have been adjusted.
      • Curilla
        MP has been increased.
      • Excenmille
        Combat skills and “Store TP” effect have been increased.
    • A category called “Trust” has been added to the action menu.
      * Trust spells originally appearing in the magic list have been moved to this category.
    • Alter egos may now be called forth after joining those battlefields in which they are usable.
      * Note that any alter egos summoned prior to joining will vanish upon entry.
    • The visual and audio effects accompanying the calling forth of an alter ego have been changed.
  • The level of Velkk in Dho Gates needing to be vanquished for the quest “Velkkovert Operations” has been lowered.

Item-related

  • New synthesis recipes have been added.
  • New items have been added.
    Attachment 10205
  • A new katana has been made available as spoils for vanquishing Muyingwa in Delve and through exchange with Forri-Porri in Western Adoulin.
  • A new item, the “warp ring,” has been added and is available in exchange for Conquest points.
    Attachment 10206
  • The “warp cudgel” item has undergone the following adjustments.
    • The time it takes for the cudgel to become usable after equipping it has been reduced from thirty seconds to ten seconds.
    • The recast time has been reduced from one hour to one minute.
  • New items are now storable via the Porter Moogle.
    • Storage Slip 19:
      Morbol Shield / Cassie’s Shield

System-related

  • A new feature for registering different combinations of equipment and changing multiple pieces at once, termed “equipment sets,” has been added.
    * For the August version update, up to twenty sets may be registered, and we are considering increasing this number in future version updates.
    • Editing Equipment Sets
      Registering and editing equipment sets can be done via the following subcommands in the “Edit Equip. Set” subsection of the “Macros” category in the main menu.
      Attachment 10207
      • Editing
        The content of an equipment set may be edited in the same way as with the ordinary equipment screen, wherein players register equipment by slot. Players may also set whether a particular piece should remain or be removed.
        Attachment 10208
        Slots designated with “Remove piece” will be marked with an “X”, while those with “Keep same piece” will be left blank.
        • Applicable Equipment
          In order to register pieces of equipment, they must be stored with one of the following systems.
          • Inventory
          • Mog Safe
          • Storage
          • Mog Locker
          • Mog Satchel
          • Mog Sack
          • Mog Case
          • Mog Wardrobe
          *In order to equip arms and armor, they must be stored in either the inventory or the Mog Wardrobe.
          *Augmented, signed, and enchanted items will have their information displayed properly on the item select screen when hovered over, but this is not the case when the item is set.
          *Players possessing a monster in Monstrosity may not register or edit sets, nor change sets using the /equipset text command.
      • Change name
        Changes the name of the equipment set.
      • Copy
        Copies the content of the specified equipment set.
      • Paste
        Pastes the copied content.
      • Delete
        Deletes the specified set.
      • Use Current
        Overwrites the content of the specified set with that of the equipment worn.
    • Changing Equipment Sets
      Players are able to equip different sets by either selecting them from the applicable submenu or with the /equipset command.
      • /equipset [Set Number] [subcommand]
        Equips a designated set of gear.
        >>Set Number (1-20)
        Equips the armor and weapons registered to the specific set.

        >>Subcommand
        echo Displays text that results from executing the command.
        Does not display resultant text if no subcommand is specified.

        For example, to equip gear registered to Set 1, input:
        /equipset 1
    • Stored Set Information
      Items registered to a set and stored in the inventory or Mog Wardrobe will have the name of the storage in which they are placed and the internal location within that storage space displayed in addition to the item name.

      The internal location information will not be lost even if the items within that storage system are sorted. As such, players will be able to designate specific items even if they possess multiple copies of them. However, if the designated item is then moved to another form of storage, the internal location will be lost and a different item of the same name might be equipped instead.

      If an item is moved to a different type of storage after being registered, a different item of the same name will be selected if one exists within the original form of storage, as the program will remember that location.

      If an item of the same name does not exist in that location and the player has registered a piece of equipment from a location other than the inventory or Mog Wardrobe, the program will attempt to equip and item first from the inventory, and then from the Mog Wardrobe.
  • Players may now display the TP of wyverns, avatars, automatons, and beastmasters’ familiars using the text command /partyinfo showtp on.
    Attachment 10209
  • A “Title Music” option enabling players to select which song plays has been added to the Config menu of the title screen.
    Attachment 10210
    • The icons below correspond to the following theme songs.
      Attachment 10211：Vana'diel March will play after the theme song for the most recent expansion.
      Attachment 10212：Original / Rise of the Zilart
      Attachment 10213：Chains of Promathia
      Attachment 10214：Treasures of Aht Urhgan
      Attachment 10215：Wings of the Goddess
      Attachment 10216：Seekers of Adoulin
      Attachment 10217：Random
      * Players may not select a theme song from an expansion which is not installed.
  • Sorting one magic list will no longer sort other magic lists.
  • When failing a synthesis from the “History” menu, the icon displayed will now change.
  • The following phrases have been added to the auto-translate dictionary.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue wherein players would occasionally be returned to the title screen even after setting the logout destination as “Select Character” in the Config menu on the title screen
  • The issue with Mog Gardens wherein NPCs and other actors would not display properly if the area was being stressed.
  • The issue with Mog Gardens wherein audio effects related to Chacharoon would play even if he was not present.
  • The issue with Mog Gardens wherein the following items did not provide their intended effects.
    Grove Cuttings / Entisyrup / Auserum / Smelting Serum
  • The issue wherein Debadle-Levadle in Western Adoulin would not display designations related to Monster Rearing.
  • Various issues wherein NPC dialogue related to Mog Gardens and Monster Rearing contained errors.
  • The issue with Monster Rearing wherein certain effects would occasionally display continuously when caring for a monster.
  • The issue with Monster Rearing wherein, under certain conditions, players were able to rear their monsters without the monsters' attitude and level of satisfaction decreasing.
  • The issue with Monster Rearing wherein the following items would not provide the intended effects when given to certain rabbit species.
    Blue Peas / Deluxe Carrot / San d’Orian Carrot / Sunflower Seeds / Moon Carrot / Vomp Carrot / Zegham Carrot
  • The issue wherein when the effects of Super Jump would not activate when a party member under the effects of Spirit Surge used Super Jump on an alter ego called forth by the party leader.
  • The issue wherein the following alter egos would not use Cure when located more than a certain distance from the player.
    Cherukiki / Nashmeira / Fablinix / Noillurie / Ferreous Coffin
  • The issue wherein wyverns would prioritize alter egos when using Healing Breath.
  • The issue wherein Gessho's alter ego would use enfeebling ninjutsu techniques on enemies with high resistance to them.
  • The issue wherein the map name for Outer Ra'Kaznar was incorrect.
  • The issue with certain lair reives in Outer Ra'Kaznar wherein players would join the reive from locations from which they could not attack the monsters or their lairs.
  • The issue with certain lair reives in Outer Ra'Kaznar wherein certain monsters would occasionally not display properly for players when others had claimed them.
  • The issue with Records of Eminence wherein the objectives “Shiver Me Timbers” and “Go With the Flow” would disappear from the completed objectives list if completed before the July 8, 2014 version update.
    Players who had these objectives disappear from the list due to this issue should speak to Nantoto in Lower Jeuno (H-8) to have them display properly.
  • The issue with Records of Eminence wherein “Circle”-type abilities and phantom rolls did not count toward completing the daily objective “Buff Allies (D).”
  • The issue with Records of Eminence wherein the “Inventory Expansion” line of objectives would display improper fame requirements.
  • The issue wherein attempting to perform synthesis from the “History” menu under certain conditions would display a strange message.
  • The issue with Yuhtunga Jungle wherein the locations of certain gathering points were incorrect.
  • The issue with the synthesis “History” menu wherein it was difficult to tell whether or not one possessed the required crystal.
  • The issue wherein the message “Downloading Data...” would continue to display in the help window if players performed specific actions immediately after an area change.
  • The issue wherein players would occasionally become unable to select “Synthesis” from the main menu when using the /lastsynth text command immediately before changing areas.
  • The issue wherein the attribute dependencies for the weapons “Starburst” and “Sunburst” were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein the bard job point category “Clarion Call Effect” would not activate for songs that affect enemies.
  • The issue wherein the visual effects of the blue magic spell “Erratic Flutter” would not display for other characters when casting it while under the effects of the job ability “Diffusion.”
  • The issue wherein the screen would occasionally black out and the game would become unresponsive during cutscenes accompanying the quest “The Truth Lies Hid.”
  • The issue wherein an incorrect color would display for the search comment icon for player characters in the linkshell list under the “Linkshell” main menu category.
  • The issue wherein the Abyssea list would occasionally fail to display in the “Quests” category of the main menu.
  • The issue wherein the “Summoning skill +5” attribute for the “Patriarch’s Cane” item would fail to take effect.
  • The issue wherein the number of abrasion bolt heads and righteous bolt heads that could be stacked together was incorrect.
  • The issue wherein messages regarding German and French languages would display in the help text of the /translate text command.
    * The ability to use the /translate function to translate to German and French was removed in the July 2014 version update.
  • The issue wherein monsters were placed in locations in Cirdas Caverns that players could not reach.
  • The issue with the quest “What Price Loyalty” wherein NPC equipment would be displayed in incorrect locations.
  • The issue wherein the message that displayed when being hit by the monster ability “Torrent” would be of an incorrect color.
  • The issue with Wajaom Woodlands wherein ceasing to use a portafurnace would deplete its energy reserves.
  • Various issues wherein NPC dialogue was incorrect.
  • Various issues wherein item help text was incorrect.
  • Various issues with the “Unlock a Myth” line of quests wherein NPC dialogue was incorrect.
  • The issue with map vendors wherein certain map prices were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein familiars and alter egos would occasionally fail to follow players when warping to a certain location in the Inner Horutoto Ruins. (Added August 12, 2014)
  • The issue with the high-tier mission battlefield “★Head Wind” wherein NPC equipment would be displayed in incorrect locations. (Added August 12, 2014)
  • PlayStation 2 only
    • The issue wherein the order of equipment stored via the Mog Wardrobe would not be saved.
  • Windows and Xbox 360 only
    • The issue wherein losing connection after registering macros and setting items within the Config menu would cause said macros and settings to revert to their previous state.

Known Issues

  • Phantom Roll dice that have already been acquired will not display in green when viewed in the auction house.
  • Xavinien is not familiar with all the treasures hidden in Ra'Kaznar Inner Court, and thus will not mention the following segments when asked about spoils contained therein.
    Eudaemon Sword / Eudaemon Cape / Eudaemon Ring / Eudaemon Sash / Eudaemon Shield
  • Goblin Footprints in Leafallia will display incorrect mission names in some locations.
  • In the Chains of Promathia mission “Flames for the Dead,” automatons will, on occasion, accidentally damage their master with their attacks.
  • The content level of Delve instances does not display in party leaders' chat logs when examining the "Veil" actor in Morimar Basalt Fields even if the leaders have fulfilled all eligibility requirements.

title: “Freshly Picked Vana’diel 10” Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the August version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. Below is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello,
Matsui here.

Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 10.

For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I've created this digest of what was discussed during the stream.

<iframe width="640" height="390" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/1qW6Ep_A0AU" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Seeker of Adoulin Missions
  • Alluvion Skirmishes Part 1
  • Alluvion Skirmishes Part 2
  • Trust Initiative
  • Job Adjustments Part 1
  • Job Adjustments Part 2
  • Job Adjustments Part 3
  • Job Points
  • Equipment Set Feature
  • Quality-of-life Improvements
  • Campaign Announcements
  • September Version Update Preview
  • Conclusion
Seekers of Adoulin Missions

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(06:05~)

We've added another portion of Seekers of Adoulin missions.

The final chapter is rapidly approaching as the tension between those who support colonization and those who are against it reaches its max and a new threat emerges. Please be sure to check it out.

Additionally, due to a bug in the past, there were cases where it was possible to obtain two mission rewards, but in order to make it fair, we decided to make it so you exchange it for the mission rewards that were added in the August version update.
Alluvion Skirmishes Part 1

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(08:35~)
We added new battle content known as "alluvion skirmishes."

Alluvion skirmishes are content where the map layout and monster placement varies each time you challenge it. However, it's not completely random, and depending on how you organize the five new types of simulacrum segments there are certain patterns, so it's possible to form strategies based on the segments you select.

Additionally, depending on the type of simulacrum segment, special monsters will spawn that affect the entire skirmish. These special monsters will affect players by giving two types of positive and negative effects, and depending on your job you'll be able to gain an edge by using these special effects. We hope you have fun organizing parties to go along with the types of simulacrum segments you possess.

Segment Name and the Respective Advantageous Jobs
<table width="400" border="0"> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Segment Name</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Advantageous Job</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Eudaemon shield</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Tank jobs</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center">Eudaemon blade</td> <td align="center">Physical damage dealers</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Eudaemon ring</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Magical damage dealers</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center">Eudaemon cape</td> <td align="center">Healers</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Eudaemon sash</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Pet jobs</td> </tr></table>
Alluvion Skirmishes Part 2

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(15:17～)
The video introduces equipment enhancements with in-game footage.

The boss on each floor of alluvion skirmishes drops equipment.

It's possible to engrave arcane glyptics on this equipment with an item that you receive as an individual reward through alluvion skirmishes, and with this you'll be able to augment your equipment with various stats and special properties.

Depending on the type of enhancement item, there are different types of stats and special properties that can be added, and we've made it so it's easier to tailor your enhancements to your job.
Trust Initiative

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
The video summons new alter egos and uses them to challenge a seal battlefield.
(22:40~)
  • Addition of new alter egos
    We added Klara, Romaa Mihgo, Excenmille [S], and Rainemard to the array of alter egos.

    Klara is an orthodox melee fighter alter ego that can also use a special weapon skill. Romaa Mihgo can use Trick Attack if you get her in the right position to help you keep hate on your target. Excenmille [S] is the child version of Excenmille from the Shadowreign Era. Please note that it's not possible to summon both Excenmilles at the same time.
  • Summoning alter egos
    It's now possible to summon alter egos after entering seal battlefields.
  • Addition of a "Trust" category to the action menu
    Since the amount of Trust spells have increased, we created a separate magic list.
Job Adjustments Part 1

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(33:00~)
  • Addition of "Max HP Boost" to tank jobs
    We added the "Max HP Boost" job trait to jobs that have a high frequency of being targeted by monsters.
  • "Enmity+" cap increase
    To coincide with the addition of Crusade that increases enmity, we increased the maximum value for the "Enmity+" effect from equipment and spells.
Job Adjustments Part 2

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
  • Paladin
    We added cumulative enmity increases when using certain abilities, and made it easier to maintain hate on your target.
  • Dark knight
    We decreased the casting time of absorb-type spells to better fit the current quicker battle pace.
  • Dragoon
    We increased wyvern physical and magical defense, as well as boosted their resistance against AoE attacks. Additionally, by increasing their Subtle Blow effect, it should no longer be disadvantageous to have your wyvern out and attacking.

    Furthermore, the visual effects accompanying the use of wyvern breath are no longer displayed.
Job Adjustments Part 3

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
  • Blue mage
    Physical blue magic spells can now receive effects from Chaos Roll and other things that affect physical attack.
  • Puppetmaster
    We made adjustments to automaton weapon skill stats to coincide with the revamps made to player weapon skills.
  • Geomancer
    We increased the effects of certain geomancy spells. We had originally toned down the strength of geomancy spell effects as they could not be dispelled or resisted; however, looking into battle balance once again we decided to increase their stats.
Job Points

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(40:05~)
We added two new job point categories for each of the 22 jobs.

In regards to blue mage's "Learning Chance" category, based on feedback that we have been receiving we will be revamping this category and the effect will be changed in the September version update.

In the event you place job points into this category between now and the September version update, the same amount of job points will automatically carry over into the changed category in September.
Equipment Set Feature

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
The video shows an explanation of the new equipment set feature.
(45:20~)

We added a new feature known as "Equipment Sets" that allows you to simultaneously change all of your equipment at once.

You can combine equipment just like you would via the normal equipment window and save up to 20 sets.

We are planning to expand the number of sets that can be saved to 100 after the next version update.
Quality-of-life Improvements

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(58:20~)
  • Introduction of the Warp Ring
    We added the new warp ring as another means for returning to your home point. With this item you can easily get around as much as you want even at the lower levels.

    Additionally, we improved the usage of warp cudgels to maintain their value.
  • Ability to change the title screen music
    We made it so it's possible to select different music for the title screen based on the expansions that you have installed.

    The option furthest to the right will pick a song at random each time.
Campaign Announcements

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(61:30～)
  • Sunbreeze Festival
    The Sunbreeze Festival is currently underway and you can obtain a special happi with a moogle design on the back. You can also obtain the Mumor alter ego as well, so please enjoy the festival as well as these special rewards!
  • Mog Garden Campaign
    We'll be holding a Mog Garden Campaign that begins on Friday, August 22. This time around we'll be doubling the items you can earn through monster rearing.
  • Double Capacity Point Campaign
    On Friday, August 29 we'll be kicking off the Double Capacity Point Campaign. Please be sure not to miss out on this opportunity to save up points for the new enhancement categories that were added in the August version update!
  • Welcome Back Campaign
    Starting on Friday, September 12 we'll be holding a Welcome Back Campaign. Players that are taking a break will be able to return to Vana'diel and adventure again.

We're planning a lot of other campaigns, so please stay tuned for more information!

Additionally, we've been receiving feedback asking for campaigns to take place on the weekdays as well, so we will be looking into the days in which we hold these campaigns.
September Version Update Preview

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(63:55~)
  • Wings of the Goddess post-mission quests
    We'll be adding post-mission quests for Wings of the Goddess as well as a quest for the new Atomos avatar.
  • New high-level content
    We'll be adding new content geared towards the higher level players that you can challenge with 6-18 players.
  • High-tier Walk of Echoes
    We'll be adding a high-tier version of Walk of Echoes geared towards players who have procured equipment with item levels. The monsters will be powerful, but in exchange you'll be able to obtain equipment with item levels as a reward.
  • Sub-linkshell system
    We're currently looking into a system that will allow you to simultaneously equip multiple linkshells. Additionally, we will be looking into features to foster the development of the community.
  • Monster rearing
    We'll be making it possible to raise new types of monsters.
Conclusion

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
The August version updated is filled with content and focused on the addition of new missions and battle content, and I hope you enjoy everything it has to offer.

We'll be holding another Freshly Picked Vana’diel after the next version update as well, so see you then!

title: Sep 9, 2014 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • A new quest has been added to areas introduced with Seekers of Adoulin.
  • The Goblin Mystery Box has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    Attachment 10302
    • A new special dial containing weapons, armor, magic scrolls, and other fabulous items has been added.
    • Dials one through five now cost ten tally each and provide specific categories of items.
    • Goblin Mystery Box Content Post-Additions and Adjustments
      <table width="640" border="0"> <tr> <td width="20%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Dial</td> <td width="20%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Daily Tally</td> <td width="60%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Rewards</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Dial 1</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">10</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Materials</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Dial 2</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">10</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Non-fish foodstuffs</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Dial 3</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">10</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Medicine</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Dial 4</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">10</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Sundries 1 (Ninja tools, Quick Draw cards, pet items, arrows, bullets, etc.)</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Dial 5</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">10</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Sundries 2 (bait, fish, key, hatchets, etc.)</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Special Dial</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">50</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Various items including weapons, armor, and magic scrolls</td> </tr></table>
      * The special dial may be selected once per day (Earth time) and resets twenty-four hours after use.
    • The amount of tally received when trading rare items and the maximum that may be received each day by trading rare items will be increased.
      The amount of daily tally player possessed pre-update have been carried over.
    • The locations of Goblin Mystery Boxes have been adjusted.
