  • New objectives have been added to Records of Eminence.
  • Monster Rearing has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • A new monster family has been added.
    • The following items may now be fed to monsters.
      Lesser Chigoe / Rotten Meat
  • Conditions for progressing with the following missions and quests have been changed.
    Fit for a Prince
    Pre-adjustment: One Vana’diel day
    Post-adjustment: One Earth minute
    Easterly Winds / Vanishing Act / A Taste of Honey / Delivering the Goods / Missionary Man
    Pre-adjustment: One Earth day
    Post-adjustment: One Earth minute

Battle-related

  • New battle content known as Incursion has been added.
    Attachment 10303
    • What is Incursion?
      Incursion is difficult battle content in which Vana’diel’s most daring adventurers strike into the heart of the Velkk kingdom deep within Marjami Ravine. Vanquishing the fiends found within will reward the players with spoils, experience points, and capacity points. Fulfilling certain prerequisites and reattempting the battle will further increase the difficulty of the monsters appearing within, providing a level of challenge that surpasses even the most frightening of Delve content.
    • Requirements
      • Have installed and registered the Seekers of Adoulin expansion pack
      • Be of level 95 or above
      • Be in a party comprised of between three and eighteen players
      • The party or alliance leader must be in possession of a Velkk Fetish key item.
    • Joining the Fray
      Challengers can test their mettle against the Velkk by examining the Weathered Canvas in Marjami Ravine (I-11) once all party and alliance members possess velkk fetishes. These fetishes can be procured from the corpses of Velkk skulking about the ravine.
      Attachment 10304
      Monster HP within Incursion will increase proportionally for each player over six.
    • Tackling the Beasts
      Incursion battles have a forty-five minute time limit. Defeating the fiends within will reward the victors with experience, capacity points, and specially-named treasure coffers. Furthermore, besting NMs will also yield special key items.
    • Specially-named Treasure Coffers
      Subjugating monsters within incursion will occasionally provide players with specially-named coffers. Opening one of these chests, which automatically appear in all party and alliance members’ inventories, will yield materials, equipment, and other items.
      * At least one free inventory space is required to open these coffers, and different players may receive different items.
    • Key items obtained from NMs
      Six notorious monsters exist within Incursion, and defeating them will yield special key items for each party and alliance member.

      Collecting a full set of six and trading them to Grrk-Frut the Charlatan in Marjami Ravine (I-11) will raise the difficulty counter on the party/alliance leader’s next Incursion by one. As the difficulty rises, capacity point gains and the likelihood of receiving specially-named coffers increase.
      Attachment 10305
      Additionally, when a party/alliance leader enters an incursion with these key items, they are able to use Rusted Transmitters stationed within the Velkk’s lair. These transmitters can teleport the party/alliance between the entrances and the various NMs’ abodes.
      Attachment 10306
      *When an incursion is about to take place, the content level will be displayed in the chat log to all party/alliance members.
      *If the party/alliance leader goes on an incursion with a lower content level, no key items can be obtained from defeating NMs.
      *Content levels that were raised by Grrk-Frut the Charlatan in Marjami Ravine can be lowered by Veldeth in the area’s frontier station (L-7). The content level may not go lower than 123.
  • Surge Walks and Endowed Walks have been added to Walk of Echoes.
    Attachment 10307
    • Surge Walks
      Surge walks are existing walks retooled for content level 119. Clearing these walks yields capacity points and higher level versions of existing Walk of Echoes equipment.
      • Participating in a Surge Walk
        Clearing an existing walk has a chance to cause that walk to enter surge mode.

        Players can interact with the newly placed Echo Disseminator located near the entrance to check whether or not a particular walk is in surge mode. Additionally, the content level is now displayed in the log window upon entering a walk that is in surge mode.

        As is the case with ordinary walks, players must possess a Kupofried's medallion to participate.
      • Ending a Surge Walk
        Clearing a surge version of a walk will reset it to its ordinary state. Furthermore, if a battle does not start within 50 minutes (Earth time) of the time the walk converted, it will revert to an ordinary walk.
    • Endowed Walks
      In an endowed walk, players currently participating in a battle and those that enter afterwards receive a staggering amount of temporary items in addition to a bonus to their post-victory evaluations.
      • Participating in an Endowed Walk
        Vanquishing monsters or striking at their leaders’ weak points has a chance of triggering an endowed walk.

        Players can interact with the newly placed Echo Disseminator located near the entrance to check whether or not a particular walk is endowed.
      • Ending an Endowed Walk
        An endowed walk will end either when the battle ends or when no more players remain inside.
    • Checking a Walk’s Status
      Players can interact with the Echo Disseminator located near the entrance to check whether or not a particular walk is endowed or in surge mode.
      Attachment 10308
      Attachment 10309
      A filled-in star (★) means that the walk is in surge mode or endowed, whereas a blank star (☆) means that it is not. The percentage value indicates the odds that the next walk will be of the type in question. Clearing a walk raises this percentage.
      The Echo Disseminator will also teleport players to the Veridical Confluxes of each appropriate walk and inform players of whether or not there is ongoing combat.
  • Capacity points can now be earned from the treasure coffers that appear after clearing the following battlefields requiring either microcosmic or macrocosmic orbs:
    • Macrocosmic Orb
      • Horlais Peak: ★Dismemberment Brigade
      • Waughroon Shrine: ★Grimshell Shocktroopers
      • Balga’s Dais: ★Divine Punishers
      • Sacrificial Chamber: ★Amphibian Assault / ★Jungle Boogymen
      • Throne Room: ★Kindred Spirits
      • Chamber of Oracles: ★Legion XI Comitatensis
      • Qu’Bia Arena: ★Demolition Squad / ★Brothers D’Aurphe
    • Microcosmic Orb
      • Horlais Peak: ★Tails of Woe
      • Waughroon Shrine: ★The Worm’s Turn
      • Balga’s Dais: ★Steamed Sprouts
      • Qu’Bia Arena: ★Factory Rejects
  • The following jobs have undergone adjustments.
    • Beastmaster
      Attachment 10310
      • Six new familiars summonable with Call Beast have been added.
        <table width="480" border="0"> <tr> <td width="33.3%" align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Attachment 10311</td> <td width="33.3%" align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Attachment 10312</td> <td width="33.3%" align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Attachment 10313</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Warlike Patrick</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Rhyming Shizuna</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Amiable Roche</td> </tr></table>
        <table width="480" border="0"> <tr> <td width="33.3%" align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Attachment 10314</td> <td width="33.3%" align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Attachment 10315</td> <td width="33.3%" align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Attachment 10316</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Brainy Waluis</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Hurler Percival</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Generous Arthur</td> </tr></table>*The items required to summon these creatures will be sold by Theraisie, a new NPC located in Upper Jeuno (G-6).
    • Dragoon
      Attachment 10317
      • As a wyvern’s level rises, the dragoon’s physical attack and defense will increase, and the player also receives a haste effect.
        Physical attack and defense has increased by 4% for each wyvern level up to a cap of 20%, and the haste effect has increased by 2% per level up to a cap of 10%.
        These benefits are only conferred while the player’s wyvern is active. If the wyvern falls in battle or is dismissed, the benefits are lost.

        Owing to this adjustment, the physical attack and defense bonus conferred by the Spirit Surge ability has been changed to 25%.
      • The Strafe job trait, originally obtainable via merit points, is now earned by leveling up. The trait is first acquired at level 20, with the effect increasing in stages at levels 40, 60, and 80.

        Owing to this adjustment, the Merit Group 2 category “Strafe” has been renamed to “Strafe Effect”
        • Name change: “Strafe” is now “Strafe Effect”
        • Strafe effect: From Increase accuracy by 5 to Increase accuracy by 10.
      • The amount of time required for a breath to activate has been decreased from three seconds to one second.
    • Blue Mage
      Attachment 10318
      • Blue mages are now capable of learning the following spells:
        • Restoral (Lv.99, Recast time: 10 sec.)
          Restores the caster’s HP.
        • Rail Cannon (Lv.99, Recast time: 180 sec.)
          Deals light damage to an enemy.
        • Diffusion Ray (Lv. 99, Recast time: 45 sec.)
          Deals light damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area originating from caster.
        • Sinker Drill (Lv.99 Recast time: 75 sec.)
          Delivers a fivefold attack. Damage varies with TP.
      • New spells only available under the effects of Unbridled Wisdom:
        • Uproot (Lv.99, Recast time: 30 sec.)
          Deals light damage to enemies within range. Also removes status ailments from caster.
        • Crashing Thunder (Lv.99, Recast time: 30 sec.)
          Deals lightning damage to enemies within range.
        • Polar Roar (Lv.99, Recast time: 30 sec.)
          Deals ice damage to enemies within range. Additional effect: Bind.
      • The job point category “Learning Chance” has been changed to “Physical Blue Magic Effect Accuracy.”
        Any job points spent in Learning Chance will automatically be carried over into Physical Blue Magic Effect Accuracy.
    • Dancer
      Attachment 10319
      • A new ability, Contradance, has been added.
        Contradance (Dancer Lv.50, Recast time: 5 minutes, Effect duration: 60 sec.)
        The next waltz used while under the effects of Contradance will restore an increased amount of HP. If Healing Waltz was used, the effect will extend to an area centered on the target player.
      • The maximum Step level has been increased.
        <table width="360" border="0"> <tr> <td width="50.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Player Level</td> <td width="50.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Step Level Maximum</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">50</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">6</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">60</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">7</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">70</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">8</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">80</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">9</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">90</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">10</td> </tr></table>
    • Rune Fencer
      Attachment 10320
      • Valiance’s area of effect has been increased.
  • Alter egos have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Killer job trait effects are now applied.
    • Alter egos can be summoned during a reive regardless of enmity.
    • The following alter egos have been adjusted.
      • Naja
        Combat skills have been increased.
      • Mumor / Uka Totlihn
        Owing to the changes made for dancers, the maximum level for steps has been increased.
  • The following monster abilities have been adjusted:
    • Abyssic Buster
      The duration of the amnesia effect has been reduced.
    • Typhoean Rage
      This ability no longer removes players’ equipment.
    • Keraunos Quill
      This ability no longer causes encumbrance.
    • Raksha: Vengeance / Eradicator
      The effect duration of the weakened state has been reduced.
    • Ballistic Kick
      This ability no longer removes players’ equipment.The duration of the encumbrance effect has been reduced.
    • Besieger’s Bane
      The duration of the terror effect has been reduced.
    • Enthrall
      The duration of the charm effect has been reduced.
    • Hurricane Breath
      Attack power has been reduced.
  • The following adjustments have been made to Alluvion Skirmishes
    • A message will be displayed in the log window whenever and whenever a skirmish is finished.
    • The color of the message displayed in the log window when a boss monster appears has been changed.

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • The icons of the following items have been changed.
    Snowslit Stone / Snowslit Stone +1 / Snowslit Stone +2 / Leafslit Stone / Leafslit Stone +1 / Leafslit Stone +2 / Snowtip Stone / Snowtip Stone +1 / Snowtip Stone +2 / Leaftip Stone / Leaftip Stone +1 / Leaftip Stone +2 / Snowdim Stone / Snowdim Stone +1 / Snowdim Stone +2 / Leafdim Stone / Leafdim Stone +1 / Leafdim Stone +2 / Snoworb Stone / Snoworb Stone +1 / Snoworb Stone +2 / Leaforb Stone / Leaforb Stone +1 / Leaforb Stone +2
  • The “Rare” attribute has been removed from the following items.
    Mauler's Mantle / Anchoret's Mantle / Mending Cape / Bane Cape / Ghostfyre Cape / Canny Cape / Weard Mantle / Niht Mantle / Pastoralist's Mantle / Rhapsode's Cape / Lutian Cape / Takaha Mantle / Yokaze Mantle / Updraft Mantle / Conveyance Cape / Cornflower Cape / Gunslinger's Cape / Dispersal Mantle / Toetapper Mantle / Bookworm's Cape / Lifestream Cape / Evasionist's Cape
  • The following items are now storable via the Porter Moogle.
    • Storage Slip 19
      Morbol Cap / Cassie’s Cap

System-related

  • The locations of home points, telepoints, and survival guides are now displayed on maps.
    <table width="300" border="0"> <tr> <td align="center" width="30%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Icon</td> <td align="center" width="60%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Type</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Attachment 10321</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Home points / telepoints</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Attachment 10322</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Survival guides</td> </tr> </table>
    Attachment 10323
    Blinking icons indicate those with which you have not yet interacted.
  • When teleporting between home points or using the teleportation assistance function of survival guides, players are now able to check the exact location of their destination.
    Attachment 10324
  • Players are now able to rearrange party members in the party list.
    Party member order may be changed by selecting “Rearrange” from the Party section of the main menu. Selecting this option will display party members’ main and support jobs to the left of their names.
    Attachment 10325
    Main and support job information will not be displayed for alter egos.
  • A new command, /itemsearch, has been added.
    • /itemsearch
      This function allows players to search all storage systems for items that exactly match the text entered, with successful hits displayed in list format. Note that items which span multiple words must be enclosed in quotation marks (e.g. /itemsearch “Cizin Helm”).
      Attachment 10326
  • Fellows summoned by the player and alter egos are no longer targets for the argument <stnpc>.
  • Meriri and Kuzah Hpirohpon of the Weavers’ Guild in Windurst Woods (F-12) now sell synthesis kits and synthesis materials, respectively.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue wherein the price for the last item listed when selecting "Sell" while conversing with Visala in Bastok Markets (H-8) would display a null item with a price of 0 gil.
  • The issue with Records of Eminence wherein fishing Tavnazian gobi, turnabaligi, or garpike would not count for the "Total Catches (Saltwater)" and "Total Catches (Freshwater)" objectives.
  • Various errors in NPC dialogue, item help text, and quest lists.
  • The issue with the currency menu wherein related currencies would be display apart from each other.
  • The issue with the currency menu wherein currencies would not display properly under certain conditions.
  • The issue with Mog Houses and Mog Gardens wherein executing a macro for changing equipment would cause the game to slow down.
  • The issue with the quests "Introduction to/Intermediate/Advanced Teamwork" wherein the NPCs marked on the minimap were incorrect.
  • The issue with alluvion skirmishes wherein examining a Noetic Ascension while under the effects of all temporary boons would display the selection "Have benefits bestowed upon you."
  • The issue with auction houses and shops wherein Phantom Roll dice that have already been acquired would not be displayed in green.
  • The issue with the quest search function wherein the NPC offering the quest "A Knight’s Test" would be displayed even if the conditions were not met.
  • The issue wherein selecting "Change Name" from the "Set Equipment Set" submenu would occasionally erroneously change the name to that of a different equipment set.
  • The issue wherein the names and actions of certain NPCs appearing in the opening scene taking place in Windurst Waters were incorrect.
  • The issue with Morimar Basalt Fields wherein a party leader examining a Veil while meeting the conditions for participating in Delve would erroneously fail to receive a log window notification about the content level.
  • The issue with alluvion skirmishes wherein players not talking to Lorissa would see her dialogue.
  • The issue wherein targeting an NPC or monster while designating a player name with the /pcmd add command would occasionally cause the target to be invited to the party.
  • The issue wherein the background music for Eastern Adoulin would no longer play after changing jobs in a Mog House.
  • The issue with the ranged weapon Doomsday wherein the sound effect playing upon attack was incorrect.
  • The issue wherein specific background music would be heard while logging out after setting the title screen background music to "random."
  • The issue wherein cancelling a party leader switch would close the party formation window.
  • The issue with Mog Gardens wherein fish of an unnatural size would occasionally be acquired for the lake of ocean.
  • The issue wherein the cursor color was incorrect while changing leaders or removing members from the main menu.
  • The issue with the quest "A Thirst for the Eons" wherein certain the names of certain NPCs appearing in cutscenes were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein the camera location was incorrect when warping to Home Point #1 in Windurst Woods.
  • The issue with the quest Granddaddy Dearest wherein the quest would occasionally progress without specific key items being expended.
  • The issue wherein the strength of alter ego weapon skills with elemental properties would decrease when the player was equipped with weapons and armor with item levels displayed.
  • The club "Sharur" obtainable from alluvion skirmishes has been renamed "Nehushtan."

Known Issues

  • Flotsam in Mog Gardens will occasionally not display the proper visual effects.
  • The cursor will not act properly when selecting “Rearrange” from the party menu and selecting an alliance member.
  • The HP restoration effect of the geomancer ability Mending Halation will not properly remove the sleep condition.
  • The visual effects of Lilisette’s special abilities will not display properly in The Wings of the Goddess missions Distorter of Time and Darkness Descends, nor in Heroine’s Holdfast
  • When organizing blue magic spells by family in the Set Spells blue magic submenu, Archaic family-spells will not display.
  • In Walk of Echoes, the Echo Disseminator will display incorrect information for the next walk if interacted with when the battle is over and no enemies are present.
  • Article information is incorrect for some monsters and targets appearing in Incursion.

title: "Freshly Picked Vana'diel 11" Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the September version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. Below is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello,
Matsui here.

Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 11.

For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I've created this digest of what was discussed during the stream.

<iframe width="640" height="390" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/ynZs_lAVJy0" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Goblin Mystery Box Renewal
  • Walk of Echoes
  • Job Adjustments Part 1
  • Job Adjustments Part 2
  • Job Adjustments Part 3
  • New Battle Content: Incursion
  • Quality-of-life Improvements
  • Two Fantastic Campaigns Announcement
  • Active Adventurer Appreciation Campaign
  • Idyllic Vana’diel Initiative Part 1
  • Idyllic Vana’diel Initiative Part 2
  • Idyllic Vana’diel Initiative Part 3
  • Conclusion
Goblin Mystery Box Renewal

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(03:30~)
*The video shows off gameplay of the Goblin Mystery Box.

To coincide with all the changes taking place in-game, we’ve added a lot of new items that you can obtain from the Goblin Mystery Box. We’ve also changed the content for each dial, and we’ve separated dials 1 through 5 into different item categories and added a special dial where there is a chance you will get a special item.

As long as you have daily tally you can use dials 1 through 5 as much as you can, but the special dial can only be used once per day.
  • Goblin Mystery Box Content Post-Additions and Adjustments
    <table width="640" border="0"> <tr> <td width="20%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Dial</td> <td width="20%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Daily Tally</td> <td width="60%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Rewards</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Dial 1</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">10</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Materials</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Dial 2</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">10</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Non-fish foodstuffs</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Dial 3</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">10</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Medicine</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Dial 4</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">10</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Sundries 1 (Ninja tools, Quick Draw cards, pet items, arrows, bullets, etc.)</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Dial 5</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">10</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Sundries 2 (bait, fish, key, hatchets, etc.)</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Special Dial</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">50</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Various items including weapons, armor, and magic scrolls</td> </tr></table>
Walk of Echoes

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(12:40~)
*The video shows off gameplay of a surge walk.

We’ve added surge walks as new content for high-level players and also added endowed walks as a special bonus.

Surge walks are a special type of walk that is very difficult and geared towards players who have procured equipment with item levels. When a regular walk is cleared, there is a set chance that a surge walk will occur. The chance that a surge walk occurs will increase each time a regular walk occurs.

Endowed walks are walks that distribute a large volume of temporary items to players, and they have been set as a special chance to challenge these walks.

Additionally, we’ve made game balance adjustments so that monsters in these walks no longer use abilities that inflict players with Encumbrance.

In the version updates to come, we will be introducing a system where these walks naturally occur even if existing walks are not being cleared, as well as the ability to purchase Kupofried’s Medallion from within the Walk of Echoes.
Job Adjustments Part 1

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(31:10~)

We’ve made adjustments to a number of jobs.
  • Dragoon
    We made adjustments to dragoon to coincide with the concept of fighting alongside a wyvern, and as a wyvern’s level increases the dragoon will now receive enhancements. While it will be necessary to think of ways to maintain your wyvern, the dragoon will gain large effects, so please take care of your wyvern and fight alongside your trusty companion.

    Additionally, we’ve boosted the accuracy and execution speed of wyvern breath.
  • Blue mage
    We’ve added new blue magic spells.
    As previously mentioned on the forums, we added blue magic spells that are very powerful in exchange for a long recast timer, and we enhanced the burst-power of blue mages.

    Additionally, we added spells that can be learned from Naakuals and it’s now possible to obtain spells from all of the Naakuals.
Job Adjustments Part 2

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
  • Dancer
    We increased the maximum Step level to 10 when your main job is dancer. Additionally, we added the new ability, Contradance, which will increase the effect of the next Waltz used.

    For a future version update we will be looking into making adjustments to Flourishes and such to improve the damage dealing capabilities of dancer. We are also looking into making adjustments to the combat skill values for multiple jobs including dancer.
  • Beastmaster
    We added six new familiars that can be summoned with Call Beast. These are pets that are comparatively cheap to summon.

    Additionally, we are looking into increasing accuracy overall for familiars, avatars, wyverns, and automatons in a future version update.
Job Adjustments Part 3

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
  • Rune fencer
    We increased the area of effect for the ability Valiance as it serves to protect party members, and this has made it easier to give the effect to all party members when fighting large monsters.
New Battle Content: Incursion

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(39:25~)
*The video introduces an example of the rewards.

Incursion is content for players who have cleared Delve or for those who are looking for an even more challenging battle.

Every time you clear Incursion the difficulty will increase and the number of rewards will also increase. (The items that drop will not vary.)
Quality-of-life Improvements

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(43:40~)
*The video shows off gameplay illustrating the adjustments.
  • Addition of various icons to the map
    We added icons to the map and you can now check the locations of home points and other important elements.
  • Rearrange feature for the party member list
    It’s now possible to rearrange the party member list as you like. You can also see each player’s job when you rearrange the list.
Two Fantastic Campaigns Announcement

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(52:10~)
  • Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign
    This is a campaign for players who have taken a break from Vana’diel. Players who possessed an FFXI service account in the past will be able to come back and play for free during the campaign period.
  • Discount Campaign
    The digital versions of both the Seekers of Adoulin expansion pack and the all-in-one FINAL FANTASY XI: Ultimate Collection Seekers Edition will be available for a discounted price from the Square Enix Online Store.
Read here for details on these two fantastic campaigns.
Active Adventurer Appreciation Campaign

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(55:00~)

We’ll be giving a Mog Pell (Red) item to players who have an active PlayOnline/FINAL FANTASY XI subscription during the period of Tuesday, July 1, 2014 to Sunday, August 31, 2104. This item can be used to claim an item of your choice from a Festive Moogle.
Idyllic Vana’diel Initiative Part 1

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(56:00~)

We will be giving a Mog Pell (Green) to all characters where fourteen days or more has passed since creation. This item can be exchanged for Record of Eminence weapons, vouchers for various in-game currencies, and many other items.
Idyllic Vana’diel Initiative Part 2

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
  • MMO Collaboration Event
    We’re bringing back the DRAGON QUEST X and FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn collaboration event that we held in the past.
  • Double Experience Point Campaign
    During the campaign period you’ll be able to earn double the amount of experience points. Be sure not to miss out!
  • Abyssea and Atma Axtravaganza
    This is a campaign where first-time participants can obtain atma and cruor. If you’re interested in experiencing Abyssea right away, don’t miss out on this great opportunity!
Idyllic Vana’diel Initiative Part 3

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
  • Alter Ego Extravaganza Ulimited
    We’ll be holding a combination of all the Alter Ego Extravaganzas we held in the past at the same time! Now’s your chance to obtain some useful alter egos to add to your collection.
  • Wildskeeper Reive Campaign
    During the campaign the bayld prices for the key items as well as the fame required to participate in wildskeeper reives will be reduced. Players who are returning to the game will be able to take part in these easily by only progressing a bit through the Seekers of Adoulin quests.
  • Campaign Festa
    You’ll be able to earn double the amount of experience points and allied notes from evaluations. The amount of spoils obtained from treasure coffers when participating in unions will also be increased.

    Additionally, Fiat Lux and other Campaign Ops will have special rewards.
Read here for all the details on the Idyllic Vana’diel Initiative.
Conclusion

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
The September version update served to expand the variety of content by adding two new types of battle content and making adjustments to various jobs.

We'll be holding another Freshly Picked Vana’diel after the next version update as well, so see you then!

title: Oct 7, 2014 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • A new Wings of the Goddess-related quest, “A Forbidden Reunion,” has been added.
    Attachment 10417
    Players must have completed the following prerequisites to receive this quest.
    • Have completed the Wings of the Goddess mission "Lest We Forget."
    • Have completed the quest "Champion of the Dawn."
    • Have completed the Trust initiation quest in one of San d'Oria, Bastok, or Windurst.
  • An epilogue has been added to the quest A Thirst for Eternity.
  • New alter egos have been added.
    Attachment 10418
    Read on for details.
  • New objectives have been added to Records of Eminence.
  • The following adjustments have been made to the Goblin Mystery Box.
    • The scene that plays between opening a treasure coffer and receiving the items has been shortened.
    • The treasure coffers are no longer targetable.

Battle-related

  • New high-tier battlefields have been added.
    • New High-Tier Battlefields and Their Leaders
      • ★Trial by Fire / ★Trial by Ice / ★Trial by Wind / ★Trial by Earth / ★Trial by Lightning / ★Trial by Water

        In these battlefields, adventurers will square off against Ifrit Prime, Shiva Prime, Garuda Prime, Titan Prime, Ramuh Prime, and Leviathan Prime, respectively.
        Attachment 10421Attachment 10419Attachment 10424
        Attachment 10422Attachment 10420Attachment 10423
    • Joining the Fray
      The key items required to participate in these battlefields can be acquired from the following NPCs in exchange for merit points.
      • Trisvain in Northern San d’Oria (J-7)
        Attachment 10425
      • Raving Opposum in Port Bastok (J-11)
        Attachment 10426
      • Mimble-Pimble in Port Windurst (L-5)
        Attachment 10427
    • Required Key Items

      <table width="300" border="2"><tr><td width="50%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Key Item</td><td width="50%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Number of Merit Points Required</td></tr><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Avatar Phantom Gem</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">20</td></tr></table>* Players must be level 95 or greater and have cleared all six of the “Trial by” or “Trial Size Trial by” quests in order to receive these items; it does not matter if players have completed all “Trial bys,” all “Trial Size Trial bys” or a mixture of the two types.
    • Regarding Difficulty Levels
      Each mission battlefield is divided into five levels of difficulty. Boss strength, number and drop rate of spoils, as well as content level, increase in line with difficulty.

      <table width="300" border="2"><tr><td width="40%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Difficulty</td><td width="60%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Content Level</td></tr><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Very Easy</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">113</td></tr><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Easy</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">116</td></tr><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Normal</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">119</td></tr><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Difficult</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Greater than 119</td></tr><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Very Difficult</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Greater than 119</td></tr></table>* Any player may select a difficulty level, but the battlefield's level will be determined by the first person to enter.
      * Players must have cleared the battlefield on normal to select either difficult or very difficult.
      * All party members must be in possession of the required key item to enter.

    • Battlefield, Boss, and Entry Restrictions

  • The following jobs have undergone adjustments.
    • Warrior
      Attachment 10428
      • The effects of the job ability Berserk now increase in stages as the player rises in level. Physical attack increases by approximately 1% per stage at levels 50, 60, 70, 80, and 90, and reaches a maximum of approximately 30% when combined with the original effects.
      • The effects of the job ability Defender now increase in stages as the player rises in level.Physical defense increases by approximately 1% per stage at levels 50, 60, 70, 80, and 90, and reaches a maximum of approximately 30% when combined with the original effects.
    • Thief
      Attachment 10429
      • Dagger skill has been raised from A to A+.
    • Beastmaster
      Attachment 10430
      • Axe skill has been raised from A to A+.
      • Familiars summoned using the Call Beast ability now have increased physical, ranged, and magic accuracy when level 100 or above.
    • Ninja
      Attachment 10431
      • A new job trait, Daken, has been added.
        When equipped with a shuriken, the ninja will occasionally throw it upon autoattacking.
        This trait is learned at level 25 and increases in stages at level 40, 55, 70, and 95.
        * Under normal circumstance, shuriken thrown using Daken will not be consumed.
      • Sange has undergone the following adjustments.
        Sange (Recast time: 3 min., effect duration: 60 sec.)
        Daken will always activate but consume shuriken while active. Increase ranged accuracy by 25.
      • Katana skill has been raised from A to A+.
    • Dragoon
      Attachment 10432
      • Wyverns now have increased physical, ranged, and magic accuracy when level 100 or above.
    • Summoner
      Attachment 10433
      • A new spell has been added.
        • Atomos (Lv. 75, Recast time: 60 sec.)
          Removes one magic effect from an enemy and grants it to friendly players within area of effect.
          * Atomos can be received as part of the quest “A Forbidden Reunion.”
          * Atomos has no additional blood pacts usable during Astral Flow.
      • A new job ability, Apogee, has been added.
        Apogee (Lv. 70, Recast time: 5 min., Effect duration: 60 sec.)
        Decreases the recast time on the next blood pact, but causes it to consume more MP.
      • The job ability Avatar's Favor has been changed.
        • Penalties, including those to physical and magic attack, have been abolished.
        • The avatar's perpetuation cost now increases.
      • Avatars now have increased physical, ranged, and magic accuracy when level 100 or above.
    • Blue Mage
      Attachment 10434

        Metallic Body / Warm-Up / Amplification / Zephyr Mantle / Triumphant Roar
      • The effect duration of the following spells has been increased.
        Metallic Body / Memento Mori / Reactor Cool / Saline Coat / Plasma Charge / Diamondhide / Magic Barrier / Barrier Tusk / Orcish Counterstance / Nature's Meditation / Zephyr Mantle / Triumphant Roar
      • The MP cost of Triumphant Roar has been decreased.
      • The efficacy of Regeneration has been increased.
      • Attribute adjustments have been added to the following spells.
        Tempestuous Upheaval / Rending Deluge / Enbalming Earth / Foul Water / Retinal Glare / Subduction
      • Sword skill has been raised from A to A+.
    • Puppetmaster
      Attachment 10435
      • Hand-to-hand skill has been raised from B+ to A+.
      • Automatons now have increased physical, ranged, and magic accuracy when level 100 or above.
    • Dancer
      Attachment 10436

        • The recast time for steps has been decreased from fifteen to five seconds.
        • The recast time for the job ability Presto has been decreased from thirty to fifteen seconds.
        • The job ability Climactic Flourish now receives a damage boost varying with charisma.
        • The job ability Striking Flourish has had its recast time decreased from 120 to thirty seconds and now receives a damage boost varying with charisma.
        • The job ability Ternary Flourish has had its recast time decreased from 120 to forty-five seconds and now receives a damage boost varying with charisma.
      • Dagger skill has been raised from B+ to A+.
    • Geomancer
      Attachment 10437
      • A new job ability, Entrust, has been added.
        Entrust (Lv. 75, Recast time: 10 min., Effect duration: 60sec.)
        The next indicolure spell cast may target a party member.
  • The Trust initiative has undergone the following adjustments.

      The Secret Weapon / On My Way / Saintly Invitation / The Heir to the Light / Where Two Paths Converge / Moon Reading
    • Ingrid now has the job trait Undead Killer.

      Attachment 10438
    • Kupofried’s Medallions may now be purchased from the Echo Disseminator.
    • The amount of time for a walk to become active once it has been defeated has been reduced from ten minutes to one minute (Earth time).
    • If a battle has not been started for a particular walk after a certain amount of time, the forces within will determine whether the walk becomes a surge or endowed walk.
    • After a surge or endowed walk has been cleared, the forces within will now determine whether a surge or endowed walk will take place during the next respawn.
  • Experience and capacity points may now be earned from Stormy Autochthons in alluvion skirmishes and from all monsters in Yorcia Weald [U].
    Points earned from these monsters do not benefit from chain bonuses or the effects of dedication.
  • Certain special techniques used by monsters have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Fuscous Ooze
      This ability no longer removes players’ equipment.
      The amount of time the player may not change equipment after being a victim of this attack has been changed from forty seconds to between thirty and forty-five seconds.
    • Mucilaginous Ooze
      This ability no longer removes players’ equipment.
      The amount of time the player may not change equipment after being a victim of this attack has been changed from ninety seconds to between sixty and ninety seconds.

Item-related

      Flan Masque / Flan Masque +1 / Cait Sith Guard / Cait Sith Guard +1

Zhayolm (D-8) / Cape Teriggan (F-5) / Xarcabard [S] (H-9) / The Boyahda Tree (J-12) / Den of Rancor (I-8) / Fe’Yin (I-5) / Ifrit’s Cauldron (G-6) / Quicksand Cave (C-8) / Southern San d’Oria (E-8) / Northern San d’Oria (F-5) / Bastok Mines (K-7) / Bastok Markets (I-8) / Port Bastok (E-6) / The Metalworks (F-8) / Windurst Waters (J-8) / Rabao (G-6) / Norg (G-7) / Western Adoulin (H-12) / Eastern Adoulin (G-10)
  • Mog Gardens have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Tree pruning, weed removal, and excavation may now be attempted multiple times at once.
    • When selecting a furrow, the location of the cursor has been changed from “Inspect the garden” to “Harvest crops.”
  • The job-specific capes obtainable from wildskeeper reives and Incursion are now able to have their arcane glyptics removed by trading them to Makel-Pakel in the Celennia Memorial Library.
    * Trading these items to Makel-Pakel and having the arcane glyptics removed will enable the player to trade three of them for one of their choice as per usual.
  • All stones currently obtainable via skirmishes will be able to be stored with Divainy-Gamainy in Western Adoulin (J-10).
  • A new Currency 2 menu is available under Status in the main menu.
    This submenu contains some currencies that were previously found in the currency menu in addition to the number and type of skirmish stones stored with Divainy-Gamainy in Western Adoulin (J-10).
  • When the player has selected the option “Decline destination confirmation” for waypoints, the visual effect accompanying teleportation will not be displayed.
  • The background music for Incursion has changed.
  • The client load required for the /itemsearch command has been lessened.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue with gavialis helms wherein the graphic would not display properly.
  • The issue with equipment sets wherein repeatedly changing them within a short period of time would cause equipment changes to not properly complete.
  • The issue with Rala Waterways wherein engaging in combat on certain bridges would occasionally cause the monsters to fall off.
  • The issue with Rala Waterways and Rala Waterways [U] wherein there would be gaps between some textures.
  • The issue with the Sort menu wherein selecting an alliance member would cause the cursor to behave improperly.
  • The issue wherein the HP restoration effect of the geomancer ability Mending Halation would not cure the status ailment Sleep.
  • The issue with the Wings of the Goddess missions Distorter of Time and Darkness Descends, as well as Heroine's Holdfast, wherein Lilisette's special ability visual effects did not display properly.
  • The issue with chat windows wherein some cursors would not display properly.
  • The issue with Walk of Echoes wherein teleporting to a walk via the Echo Disseminator would occasionally cause the player to appear in an awkward location.
  • The issue with Walk of Echoes wherein the Echo Disseminator would occasionally display incorrect information about the status of the next walk and the odds of a special walk occurring.
  • The issue with blue magic wherein selecting "Type" from the Set Spells menu would not display entries for arcana-type monsters.
  • The issue with Ru'Lude Gardens wherein the scene when using a waypoint would not display properly.
  • The issue with the Goblin Mystery Box wherein players would occasionally receive an item that did not correspond to the type granted by the dial selected.
  • The issue wherein using Ctrl+M or Alt+M to sort magic from the magic list would occasionally cause Trust magic to be displayed.
  • The issue with the Wings of the Goddess mission Dungeons and Dancers instance wherein the exit's visual effects were incorrect.
  • The issue with the Party section of the menu wherein sorting results while in combat would occasionally cause the player to be unable to close the Party menu.
  • The issue in Delve wherein the screen to select whether or not to enter the fracture/concealed domain would appear when a party member examined a veil while the party leader was in a different area.
  • The issue wherein the item Staff Strap would occasionally not display in the list of items available for exchange with imperial standing.
  • The issue wherein manji shuriken would occasionally not display properly on the equipment change screen.
  • Various issues wherein some quest and NPC dialogue was unnatural or incorrect.
  • Various issues with quests wherein NPCs would be located in awkward locations or facing incorrect directions.

Known Issues

  • When Atomos uses his blood pact ability while suffering from a status ailment or other effects, that effect is granted to party members.
  • Nashmeira's alter ego will not use Stona when the party member is afflicted with petrification but no other status ailment.
  • Cherukiki's alter ego will not use Haste when fighting an enemy with incredibly high fire resistance.
  • In the limit break quest Shattering Stars, when losing connection or the like during the post-victory cutscene, the player will be unable to complete the quest if it does not properly complete.
  • In the cutscene accompanying the Seekers of Adoulin mission To the Victor, some NPCs will appear in awkward states.
  • In the high-tier mission battlefield ★Trial by Lightning, the visual effects of the special ability Thunderstorm are incorrect.
  • In SW Apollyon, treasure coffers will not appear if the player vanquishes elemental-family monsters in one hit if the monster if not aware of the player's presence even if the victory conditions are fulfilled.
  • In Monstrosity, the effects of the job abilities Berserk and Defender do not properly activate.
  • In Cirdas Caverns and Cirdas Caverns [U], it is difficult for players to move in some locations.
  • If the player is under the effects of the job ability Apogee, blood pact names will remain white in the menu even if the cost for using them exceeds the player's current MP.
  • It is possible for the player to select the icon of the job ability Apogee and remove it.
    * Even if the icon is removed, the player will still be under its effects for the duration.

title: "Freshly Picked Vana'diel 12" Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the October version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. Below is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello,
Matsui here.

Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 12.

For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I've created this digest of what was discussed.

(*Video will be added later.)

Table of Contents
  • Quest: “A Forbidden Reunion”
  • High-tier Avatar Battlefields
  • Walk of Echoes Adjustments
  • Job Adjustments Part 1
  • Job Adjustments Part 2
  • Job Adjustments Part 3
  • Job Adjustments Part 4
  • Job Adjustments Part 5
  • Quality-of-life Improvemnts
  • November Version Update Preview
  • Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign
  • Future Events and Campaigns
  • Conclusion
Quest: “A Forbidden Reunion”

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
*The video shows off a portion of the quest as well as the Lilisette alter ego in action.

We were finally able to implement a post-ending quest for Wings of the Goddess. Please be sure to witness what happens. After you finish the quest you’ll be able to obtain the Lilisette alter ego. She has a variety of flashy animations making her a glamorous alter ego.

Also related to Wings of the Goddess, we’ve made it possible to obtain the Karaha-Baruha alter ego from the October Repeat Login Campaign. He normally functions as a white mage, but he is also able to utilize Fenrir’s abilities. When summoning him alongside Star Sibyl they have special dialogue, so be sure to check it out.
High-tier Avatar Battlefields

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
*The video shows off in-game footage of the battlefield.

We’ve added new battlefields where you can fight against the nostalgic six avatars once again. With the home points that were added nearby the battlefields, it’s easier than ever to get to these areas, so take a friend along and have some fun with the nostalgia.
Walk of Echoes Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
In response to requests we’ve been receiving on the forums, we added a system for surge walks to occur naturally as well as a system that allows you to purchase Kupofried’s Medallion inside of Walk of Echoes.

Additionally, we’ve largely reduce the amount of time for a walk to become active once it has been beaten from ten minutes to one minute. We also added a system that will automatically remove you from the battlefield when you win.

With these adjustments we’re able to make Walk of Echoes even easier to enjoy.
Job Adjustments Part 1

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
We’ve made various job adjustments.
  • Warrior
    We’ve made it so when your main job is warrior, both Berserk and Defender will grow in strength with your level. This adjustment does not change the penalties of each of these abilities, and it simply enhances them while warrior is your main job.

  • Ninja
    We added the job trait “Daken” which makes it so you attack with shurikens between your auto-attacks. To coincide with this adjustment, we also changed the effect of Sange.

    While these adjustments do not make it so a single attack is significantly more powerful, it makes it easier to generate TP and enmity, so we’d like everyone to try it out and provide feedback.

    Additionally, Daken also has a special characteristic where the attacks do not feed enemies TP.
Job Adjustments Part 2

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
  • Summoner
    We’ve added the new avatar Atomos as well as the ability “Apogee” which allows you to immediately use another Blood Pact. We’re looking forward to hearing your feedback on both of these.

    Additionally, we also made changes to Avatar’s Favor. When using Avatar’s Favor the perpetuation cost of avatars increases, but we’ve eliminated the attack penalties and other limitations. Moving forward we plan on making further adjustments to Avatar’s Favor.
Job Adjustments Part 3

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
  • Blue mage
    In comparison to enhancement capabilities of other jobs, blue mage had some areas that were not up to par, and to improve this we increased the effect duration and reduced the casting time for enhancing-type blue magic spells.

    Additionally, we also added attribute adjustments to spells that were added after Seekers of Adoulin widening blue mage’s battle capabilities.
Job Adjustments Part 4

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
  • Dancer
    We largely reduced the recast timer for steps, Presto, Striking Flourish, and Ternary Flourish. While dancer is a job that has a lot of aspects to it, we’ve made it so more damage can be dealt.

  • Geomancer
    We added the new ability “Entrust” which allows you to cast an indicolure spell on a party member. There are many uses for this ability, so please test it out.
Job Adjustments Part 5

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
We’ve raised the skill cap for front line damage dealing jobs’ main weapon type to A+.
  • Main combat skill increases
    <table width="620" border="0"> <tr> <td width="20%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Job</td> <td width="20%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Combat Skill</td> <td width="60%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Pre-adjustment→Post-adjustment</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Thief</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Dagger</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">417 → 424</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Beastmaster</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Axe</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">417 → 424</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Ninja</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Katana/Throwing</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">417 → 424</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Blue mage</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Sword</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">417 → 424</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Puppetmaster</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Hand-to-Hand</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">404 → 424</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Dancer</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Dagger</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">404 → 424</td> </tr></table>*Values displayed are for level 99.

Additionally, we largely increased the accuracy, ranged accuracy, and magic accuracy for pets. We looked into making adjustments via abilities and such, but in order to make it easier for pet jobs to participate in content we prioritized speed. We’ll continue to make adjustments moving forward so that pet jobs can easily participate in content.
  • Accuracy adjustments for each job’s representative pet

    </td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">834 → 902</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Summoner</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Garuda</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">807 → 875</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Puppetmaster</td> <td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Automaton (Valoredge)</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">760 → 828</td> </tr></table>*Accuracy values are for pets at level 119.
Quality-of-life Improvements

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
We expanded the equipment set capacity from 20 to 100. I hope everyone will be able to put them to good use.

Additionally, we added new icons for stairs, teleport locations, and other locations to the map. We’ll be adding more as we move forward and we’re prioritizing those that involve transportation.

Furthermore, we’ve added a feature to Mog Gardens that allows you to perform tree pruning, weed removal, and excavation multiple times at once.

In the next version update we plan on adding a feature that halts consequent gathering attempts when the effects of fertilizer run out, and we’ll be making it easier to perform gathering multiple times at once when using fertilizer.
November Version Update Preview

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
  • Seekers of Adoulin Finale
    The Seekers of Adoulin missions come to a conclusion in the next version update. Be sure to find out what happens!

  • Unity Concord
    We’re planning a new type of community where you can belong to a group much larger than a linkshell and do various activities with. We’re planning to release details on a special site soon, so please stay tuned!

We’ll also be adding new growth elements when jobs will grow stronger the more you use job points, and we’ll be making adjustments to summoner and other jobs, as well as various other adjustments.
Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
We’re planning to hold another Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign in November. We’re currently working on the schedule, but once everything is decided we will make an announcement.

Additionally, we’re preparing a special event that features the quest “Babban Ny Mheillea” in celebration of “XI Day” (November 11th). You’ll be able to obtain mandragora and lycopodium suits as well as the Babban Ny Mheillea alter ego.

*The video shows off the mandragora suit and the Babban Ny Mheillea alter ego.
Future Events and Campaigns

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
  • Halloween seasonal event
    We’ll be holding the annual Halloween seasonal event this year on October 21.

  • Surge Walk Campaign
    We’ll be holding a special campaign where all of the walks in Walks of Echoes will be surge walks. This version update made Walk of Echoes even easier to participate in, so please be sure to check it out.
Conclusion

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
It’s been one year since the first Freshly Picked Vana’diel as well as our efforts to hold version updates each month. While there are times it’s been difficult on the development-side, I feel this is extremely beneficial for delivering more and more content for everyone to experience.

I hope you all enjoy the October version update, especially the quest involving Lilisette.

The development team is currently working full steam ahead on the November version update, so look forward to this and I’ll see you during the next Freshly Picked Vana’diel!

    This entrance may only be used by those in possession of the aged flashfrost naakual crest key item.
  • A new system known as “Unity Concord” has been added.
    Read on for details.
  • Mog Gades have undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • New fertilizer has been added for purchase from the Green Thumb Moogle.
    • The effects of the active fertilizer will now display when selecting a gathering point.
    • When gathering multiple times from an arboreal grove or mineral vein, the gathering attempts will stop partway if the effects of the fertilizer disappear.
    • Monster Rearing has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
      • A second rank is now available for monster rearing.
        Players must purchase a copy of the Sakura and the Magic Spoon key item from one of the following NPCs to increase their monster rearing rank.
        Skipper Moogles in Port Sand d'Oria (I-8), Port Bastok (K-11), or Port Windurst (C-8) / Zennica in Western Adoulin (E-9)

        Attachment 10644
        * Players must increase their Monster Rearing skill to rank two in order to raise these monsters.

        Cockatrice Meat / Quus / Coral Butterfly / Noble Lady
  • Fishing nodes have been added to Sih Gates.

    Ombelotte in Tavnazian Safehold (H-7) / Esteban in Selbina (I-8) / Marilionne in Mhaura (H-7)

    • It is now possible to skip the cutscenes accompanying completed official races and free runs.
    • The maximum cost for participating in free runs has been increased.
      * The cost will continue to reset to midnight (JST) as previously.
    • Prizes will no longer be awarded for novices races I-III if those races have already been completed previously.
      * Players will continue to receive rewards for their first clear.

Battle-related

System-related

  • New NPCs known as Linkshell Concierges have been added.
    Attachment 10655
    • Linkshell Concierges
      Linkshell concierges are NPCs that match linkshells looking for players with players looking for linkshells. Any player with a linkshell or pearlsack may give linkpearls to the concierge to hand out. Players looking for a linkshell may then elect to receive one such linkpearl of their choosing.
    • Linkshell Concierge Locations and Functions
      Linkshell concierge locations and the style of linkshell they are in charge of are as follows.
      <table width="480" border="0"> <tr> <td width="50.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Location</td> <td width="50.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Style</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Western Adoulin (H-12)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Casual battle content</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Western Adoulin (H-12)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Assisting each other</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Eastern Adoulin (G-10)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Hard-core battle content</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Eastern Adoulin (G-10)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Everything</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Ru'Lude Gardens (G-9)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Hard-core battle content</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Ru'Lude Gardens (G-9)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Assisting each other</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Ru'Lude Gardens (G-9)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Synthesis and trading</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Aht Urhgan Whitegate (H-9)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Vanquishing HNMs</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Southern San d'Oria (G-10)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Everything</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Southern San d'Oria (G-10)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Meet new players</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Bastok Markets (F-9)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Everything</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Bastok Markets (F-9)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Meet new players</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Windurst Woods (H-10)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Everything</td> </tr> <tr> <td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Windurst Woods (H-10)</td> <td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Meet new players</td> </tr></table>* New styles and NPCs may be added after the November version update as needed.
    • Distributing Linkpearls
      Speak to a linkshell concierge while equipped with a linkpearl or pearlsack and select "I'd like to handout linkpearls." Answer a brief questionnaire with the following information and pay a 500 gil fee to have the concierge distribute linkpearls for you.
      • Language (JP, EN, other)
      • Number of applicants desired (1-10)
      • Main days of activity (Weekdays, weekends, specific days, every day)
      • Time zone (JST, PST/PDT, GMT, no setting)
      • Main time of activity (morning, afternoon, evening, night, wee hours of the morning)

      Additionally, equipping a linkpearl and pearl sack, selecting "show me recruiting linkshells," and picking the corresponding linkshell from the list will cancel that particular registration.

      * A linkshell may only be registered once per concierge.
      * A particular concierge can only register up to sixteen linkshells at a time. New registrations will push existing ones off the list in order of oldest to newest.
      * Maintenance and area restarts will delete all registrations from the corresponding concierges.
    • Speak to a linkshell concierge and select "Show me recruiting linkshells" to display a list available linkshells. Check the list of parameters the registrant has set and choose your desired linkshell.

      * Players may only receive one linkpearl per Vana'diel day.

  • Area names shown in Survival Guides can now be displayed by expansion pack (Added on November 14, 2014)
    Areas names can now be displayed by expansion pack when selecting "Other mysteries" and then the "Select by content" options from a Survival Guide.
  • A Home Point has been added to Leafallia（H-8）. (Added on November 18, 2014)

Resolved Issues

  • The issue with the Seekers of Adoulin mission "To the Victor..." wherein certain NPCs did not display.
  • The issue with the Chains of Promathia mission "The Enduring Tumult of War" weren the screen would occasionally fame to black and freeze during cutscenes.
  • The issue with the Chains of Promathia mission "Calm Before the Storm" wherein players were occasionally unable to progress.
  • The issue with the quest "A Forbidden Reunion" wherein background music did not play when entering the battlefield.
  • The issue wherein certain sound effects playing when viewing the cutscene that occurs upon entering Celennia Memorial Library after completing the quest "A Thirst for Eternity" were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein the conditions for progressing with the quest "Blue Ribbon Blues" were incorrect.
  • The issue with the Windurst quest search NPC wherein the information regarding the NPC offering the quest "Let Sleeping Dogs Lie" was incorrect.
  • The issue with Mog Gardens wherein certain sound effects for monsters being raised were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein the Mog Gardens NPC Skipper Moogle would display incorrect dialogue.
  • The issue wherein player footstep sound effects would not play in certain areas of Ra'Kaznar Inner Court.
  • The issue wherein texture would occasionally fail to display properly in Ra'Kaznar Inner Court.
  • The issue wherein the area name would not display in map help text.
  • The issue wherein it was not possible to view a map of the entirety of Windurst.
  • The issue with Shami in Port Jeuno (H-8) wherein the abbreviated dialogue would not changing after cleaing a seal-requiring battlefield.
  • Various issues with incorrect item and job ability help text.
  • Various issues with typos for certain NPC dialogue.
  • The issue with the alter egos of Nashmeira and Karaha-Baruha wherein they would not cast Esuna on party members who were under the effect of petrification as their sole status ailment.
  • The issue wherein Cherukiki's alter ego would not cast haste while in combat with a foe having excessively high fire resistance.
  • The issue wherein some of Vokker's alter ego's animations were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein suspended sculptures in Ra'Kaznar Inner Court had incorrect resistance to status ailments.
  • The issue in Ra'Kaznar Inner Court where the map could not be displayed in some locations.
  • The issue with the avatar Diabolos wherein activating the following blood pacts would consume his TP.
    Camisado / Nightmare / Ultimate Terror / Noctoshield / Dream Shroud / Pavor Nocturnus
  • The issue with the avatar Atomos wherein using his blood pact would cause status ailments he was suffering from to be applied to party members.
  • The issue with the job ability Apogee wherein players would occasionally be able to use a blood pact even if the MP consumed would be greater than their current MP when under its effects.
  • The issue with the job ability Apogee enmity would not be generated when using a blood pact under the effect of Apogee until the blood pact took effect on the target monster.
  • The issue with the job ability Apogee wherein a blood pact would remain in white in the menu even if the cost of using said blood pact was higher than the player's remaining MP.
  • The issue in ★Trial by Lightning wherein the visual and sound effects of the special ability Thunderstorm were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein Fjalar and Mistmaw Leraje did not display proper animations after being slain on the Windows and Xbox 360 versions.
  • The issue wherein the icon graphics for the item Arciela's Grace +1 were incorrect.
