title: Unity Concord
body:
• A new system, Unity Condord, has been added.
    • What is Unity Concord?
      Unity Concord is a new system devised and promulgated by the Adventurers' Mutual Aid Network (A.M.A.N.) Pleased with the rousing success of the recently introduced Records of Eminence, the A.M.A.N. has pledged to build upon their successes and take the next step toward bringing adventurers closer together.
    • Unities: New NPC-Run Factions
      The main attractions of Unity Concord are organizations known as "Unities." There are multiple Unities, each run by one of Vana'diel's more popular personages. Adventurers are able to select a Unity they would like to join to further that leader's cause.
      Attachment 10660Attachment 10661Attachment 10662
      Attachment 10663Attachment 10664Attachment 10665
      Attachment 10666Attachment 10667Attachment 10668
    • Participating in a Unity
      Players may join a Unity by setting the Records of Eminence objective "All for One,"speaking to one of the NPCs given below, and selecting a Unity to join.
      Urbiolaine in Southern San d'Oria (G-10) / Igsli in Bastok Markets (E-11) / Teldro-Kesdrodo in Windurst Woods (J-10) /
      Yonolala in Windurst Woods (J-10) / Nunaarl Bthtrogg in Western Adoulin (H-11)
      Attachment 10669Attachment 10670
      Attachment 10671Attachment 10672
      All for One will be added to the Records of Eminence objective list when the character has completed ten or more Records of Eminence objectives and moves to one of the following areas.
      Southern San d'Oria / Northern San d'Oria / Port San d'Oria / Bastok Mines / Bastok Markets / Port Bastok /
      Windurst Waters / Port Windurst / Windurst Woods / Western Adoulin / Eastern Adoulin
    • Unity Objectives
      New Records of Eminence objectives have been added to help facilitate Unity activities. Some of these objectives are shared between Unities, while others are exclusive. There is also a third type of objective, called "Wanted" objectives, which task a player with vanquishing specific notorious monsters.
      Attachment 10673Attachment 10674
      • Unity Accolades
        Accolades can be earned by completing Unity-based Records of Eminence objectives. A small amount can be earned from non-Unity objectives and defeating certain monsters. The accolades can be used in a variety of ways, from participating in the Wanted battles described above to purchasing items, enhancing equipment found in Wanted battles, teleporting to Wanted battle staging areas, and more.
      • Wanted Battles
        Wanted battles are confrontation-style fights* that charge adventurers with slaying particular notorious monsters.
        Completing a Wanted objective will reward players with equipment and other items.
        The following prerequisites must be met to participate in a Wanted battle.
        • Be in a party or alliance of between three and eighteen players**
        • All party members must accept the requisite Wanted objective
        • All party members must possess the required number of accolades
          * In this style of battle, neither other players nor other monsters may interact with participants in the battle, which takes place in a specific area.
          ** When tackled with seven or more players, the Wanted target's HP will increase in line with the number of players over six.
    • Unity Chat
      A Unity chat channel has been added to facilitate communication between members of the same unity. This channel is the same as others such as say and tell with regard to chat settings such as font color.
      * As of the November version update, up to sixty-four people may participate in Unity chat at any given time. This upper limit may be increased in a coming version update.
      Attachment 10675
    • Unity Rankings
      Unity rankings are tabulated and announced every week (Earth time). Rankings are decided based on an average of the individual evaluation of all Unity members during that week. This individual evaluation is calculated at the rate of one point per 1,000 accolades.

      The attributes of equipment earned in Wanted battles and the amount of accolades earned vary based on Unity ranking. Higher ranking Unities enjoy increased equipment stats, while lower ranking Unities are afforded a bonus to the number of accolades earned.
      * Rankings are announced at midnight on Sundays (JST). Players who have not received at least 1,000 accolades are not counted.
      Attachment 10676
    • The Unity section of the main menu.
      A new Unity menu has been added to the "Status" section of the main menu to promote Unity Concord activities.
      Attachment 10678Attachment 10679
      • Unity Info
        The Unity Info section displays the entry shown below. Players can check their Unity's ranking and select whether or not they would like to participate in Unity chat.
        Attachment 10677
      • Ranking Info
        The Ranking Info section displays the entry shown below. "Ranking Results" displays the results of the previous tabulation period, while "Partial Ranking Results" displays the in-progress ranking for this week, with values updated every few minutes.
        Attachment 10680
      • Unity Lists
        The Unity Lists section displays the entry shown below. Selecting a Unity displays a list of logged in characters who belong to that Unity.
        Attachment 10681
  • Changing Unities
    Players may switch Unities by paying a certain number of Accolades to an A.M.A.N. representative. The fee charged depends on the difference in ranking between the current and desired Unities, with transferring to higher ranked Unities requiring more accolades. Once a Unity has been chosen, players cannot transfer again until the following Sunday at midnight (JST).

    * Additional features and content for Unity Concord are scheduled to be added in future version updates.

title: "Freshly Picked Vana'diel 13" Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the November version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. Below is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello,
Matsui here.

Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 13.

For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I've created this digest of what was discussed.

<iframe width="640" height="360" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/_jpyLzRY1uA" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Final Chapter of Seekers of Adoulin
  • Unity Concord
  • New NMs
  • Trust
  • Job Adjustments
  • Linkshell Concierge
  • Mog Gardens
  • 11/11 Campaigns
  • New Soundtrack On-sale
  • Sunshine Seeker Event
  • Pictlogica Final Fantasy Collaboration
  • December Version Update Preview
  • Conclusion
Final Chapter of Seekers of Adoulin

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(06:32~)
We’ve added the final chapter to the Seekers of Adoulin missions. Compared to chapters 1-4, this final chapter has a huge volume of high-quality cutscenes as well as a wealth of battles.

We’ve tuned these battles so that a party of six players using item level 117 equipment can win. Fight alongside the NPC's of the storyline, emerge victorious, and check out the epic conclusion to the storyline.

Additionally, we’ve released a relationship chart to the official Seekers of Adoulin site that looks back on the story.

There are some spoilers on the page, so please be careful if you decided to read it.
Unity Concord

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(11:50~)
*The video shows the flow of participating in Unity Concord as well as a wanted battle.

We created the brand-new community element “Unity Concord” based on the concept of creating a loose in-game community that’s closer than conquest yet less binding than linkshells.

We’ve also made adjustments to the minor competitive element between Unities, Unity Ranking, to coincide with this concept.

For example, we’ve prepared bonuses so the high ranking Unities will see stat increases for certain gear, whereas the lower ranking Unities will receive a boost to the amount of Unity accolades they receive. We did not, however, make it so these differences are very large.

By participating in Unity, there are a bunch of Unity-specific objectives you can undertake through Records of Eminence. There are daily objectives, weekly objectives, and there are also wanted battles where you can fight against high-tier versions of nostalgic NMs.

We’ve created all these with the idea that you can enjoy each objective easily with your Unity allies, and many of the objectives that were added are fairly easy to get into.

We planned for this to be content where you can talk to others in Unity chat, head off together to complete objectives, and then spend the saved up Unity accolades to fight wanted battles.

More than anything else though, I hope the Unity Concord system serves as a way for adventurers to meet one another.
New Notorious Monsters

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(30:50~)
We’ve added trigger-style NMs to dungeons in Seekers of Adoulin areas. We’ve continued to use instances for Adoulin-related content, but we’ll be striking a nice balance of content that does not use instances as we move forward without creating congestion in specific locations.
Trust Initiative

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(31:45~)
In the June version update we enhanced player’s weapon skill power and as a result there was a difference in the power of weapon skills used by alter egos. Because of this we made adjustments to close the gap.

Compared to support- and healer-type alter egos, it’s been difficult to use melee-type alter egos in battle, so these adjustments should make them easier to utilize than before.
Job Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(32:45~)
We made the following job adjustments.
  • Beastmaster
    We changed “Ready” so that familiars can use special attacks even without full TP as long as you have charges. In the next version update we will be looking to add methods to boost the power of special attacks even more.

    Additionally, we added the new ability “Bestial Loyalty” that allows you to summon a familiar without consuming jugs. With this ability, you’ll be able to more easily use pets that require expensive jugs.

    We’ve also added new types of familiars expanding the selections available for level 119 pets.
  • Summoner
    To coincide with the increased effect of Avatar’s Favor, we’ve eliminated the effect penalty when using Blood Pacts, and made it so that each time you use a Blood Pact the effect of Avatar’s Favor grows.

    Additionally, we made adjustments to add skill chain properties to certain physical attack-type Blood Pacts that did not previously have them.

    In the next version update we will be introducing various new Blood Pacts including Hastega II.
Linkshell Concierge

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(38:18~)
*The video shows the flow of how to register a linkpearl with the linkshell concierge and how to get a linkpearl from the linkshell concierge.

Up until now the only way to distribute linkpearls was by hand, and we had been receiving a lot of feedback about meeting players with similar goals in mind.

The linkshell concierge is a new way for you to distribute your linkpearls via NPC. For those of you who wish to increase your linkshell members or those of you who are searching for a linkshell to join, please be sure to head to a linkshell concierge.

I hope that new relationships can be forged using the linkshell concierge.

Moving forward we will be making adjustments to linkshells and the chat system, and we are looking into a system for having a sub-linkshell as well as a system that would allow you to have separate chat windows.
Mog Gardens

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui

(45:12～)
*The video shows off the flow of how to raise a baby cockatrice and gathering multiple times from gathering points using fertilizer.

We made adjustments based on feedback we received in regards to the multiple gathering feature we added to Mog Gardens. One of these adjustments was adding a system that would stop multiple gathering when the effects of fertilizer wear off. The other adjustment is that we added fertilizer to prevent gathering points from moving while in the midst of multiple gathering.

Additionally, we’ve unlocked rank 2 for monster rearing, and we’ve made it possible to raise a number of monsters including a cockatrice.

Moving forward we plan on adding other fun elements for monster rearing.
11/11 Campaigns

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(55:06~)
We’re in the midst of holding various events to commemorate 11/11, “FFXI Day”.
  • Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign
    Until November 17th, we’re holding a special campaign for all of the adventurers that are in the midst of taking a break. Please take this opportunity to experience and try out the current Vana’diel. Tetsuya Nomura has also created a nice illustration for the Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign.

    Visit the official site for details.
  • Discount Campaign
    The downloadable versions of FINAL FANTASY XI: Ultimate Collection Seekers Editions and the Seekers of Adoulin expansion pack are available at a discounted price for a limited time.

    Visit the official sitefor details.
  • Adventurer Appreciation Campaign
    As a token of appreciation for all of our active adventurers, we are sending everyone a red mog pell that can be used to purchase various items.

    Read here for details.
  • Idyllic Vana’diel Campaign
    Additionally, we’re holding 11 bonus campaigns at the same time.
    Amongst these bonus campaigns, we’re giving SP Gobbie keys as a present that will allow you to use the special dial of the Goblin Mystery Box and there is also a Meeble Burrows campaign – both of which can be enjoyed immediately by adventurers coming back to Vana’diel.

    Read up on all the campaign details.
New Soundtrack On-sale

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(58:25～)
*Lyrics lead Yaeko Sato joins the stream and talks about the lyrics for “Forever Today”.

The new mini-album that contains the Seekers of Adoulin ending song “Forever Today” is now on-sale.

The mini-album’s digital jacket was illustrated by Tetsuya Nomura! Additionally, you can view the promotional video for “Forever Today” as well as other details on the official site.
Sunshine Seekers Event

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui

(1:04:02～)
*The video shows off alter egos of Babban Ny Mheillea and Abenzio.

The Sunshine Seekers event will last until Tuesday, November 25th.

By participating in the event you’ll be able to obtain a special Mandragora suit as well as the cute Babban Ny Mheillea alter ego. This is an event that you can enjoy even at level 1.

Read the details here.

Additionally, you’ll also be able to obtain an alter ego of Babban Ny Mheillea’s friend Abenzio from the November Login Campaign.
Pictologica Final Fantasy Collaboration

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui

(1:08:18～)
*The video shows off furnishings that can be obtained through the event.

Starting on Tuesday, November 25th at 6 a.m. (PST) we’ll be holding a collaboration event with “Pictologica Final Fantasy”.

We’ve prepared special pixel art furnishings of NPCs special for this event. You’ll be able to obtain these furnishings from a variety of locations and you can also trade them with other players. Search for these items, trade them with others, and collect the whole set!

Additionally, from the end of November there will be a special event for FFXI on the “Pictologica Final Fantasy” app.

Following the beginning of the FFXI storyline you can obtain the characters you know and love through quests, and once you complete them all you will obtain Shantotto.

Please be sure to check this out.
December Version Update Preview

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(1:12:41～)
We’re currently in the midst of preparing the content for the next version update, and I’d like to give you a sneak peek at what’s to come.
  • New battle content with the Xol Triumvirate
    New battle content where you can once again fight the Xol Triumvirate that makes an appearance in the Seekers of Adoulin missions is currently in-development. We’re planning to make this a bit different than the high-tier mission battlefields you’ve seen up until now.
  • Character growth elements using job points
    We’re currently developing character growth elements that will allow you to enhance your job depending on the number of capacity points you spend. To start off, we’ll be adding a system for capacity point bonuses and additional job traits; however, in the future this will be used to learn new spells as well.
  • Sub-linkshells
    We’re working on making a system that allows you to have an additional linkshell for the December version update. We’d like this system to work in tandem with the recently added linkshell concierge to improve linkshell usability.
Conclusion

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
I hope you all enjoy the ending to the Seekers of Adoulin missions and have a new community experience with the Unity Concord system.

One of the many uses of the Unity Concord system could be to find friends to challenge the mission battles.

Though the Unity Concord system is still brand-new, we’ll be expanding it and making it easier to use as we move forward.

I look forward to hearing feedback from those of you who use this new system.

      Select "Shared" From the Window section of the Config submenu and turn multi-window on to display two log windows.
      Attachment 10763

      • Reactive window sizing
      • Maximum lines displayed
      • Minimum lines displayed
        * In line with this change, the minimum number of maximum lines displayed has been reduced from 6 to 4.
      Attachment 10764
    • Chat log settings.
      A new entry within the Config menu, "Log," enables players to set which types of logs display in which windows.
      Attachment 10765
  • Window 1 and Window 2 have been added to the tabs displayed when expanding the log window.
    Attachment 10766
    * Window 2 will be displayed when multiple log windows are active.
  • Timestamps may now be displayed in the log window.
    Timestamps may be displayed for the following chat logs.
    Say / Tell / Party / Linkshell / Linkshell2 / Unity / Emote / Shout / Yell
    • Displaying Timestamps
      Turning timestamps on from "Shared" in the Windows section of the Config submenu will display timestamps for the above logs.
      Attachment 10767
  • The Status submenu will now display a character's average item level and ability to equip superior equipment.
    Attachment 10831
  • It is now possible to confirm your destination when teleporting using waypoints.
  • Item help text will now be displayed when selecting an item from the following NPCs.

    • Records of Eminence NPCs.
      Rolandienne in Southern San d'Oria (G-10) / Isakoth in Bastok Markets (E-11) / Fhelm Jobeizat in Windurst Woods (J-10) / Eternal Flame in Western Adoulin (H-11)

      Urbiolane in Southern San d’Oria (G-10) / Igsli in Bastok Markets (E-11) / Teldro-Kesdrodo in Windurst Woods (J-10) / Yonolala in Windurst Woods (J-10) / Nunaarl Bthtrogg (H-11)
  • A new homepoint has been added in Castle Zvahl Keep [S] (G-7)
  • Survival Guides have been added to the following locations.
    Carpenters' Landing (J-10) / Bibiki Bay (H-7) / Miseraux Coast (G-7) / Tavnazian Safehold (H-6) / Phomiuna Aqueducts (J-10) / The Sacrarium (E-7) / Aht Urhgan Whitegate (L-8) / Wajaom Woodlands (C-8) / Nashmau (G-8) / Mamook (J-7) / Aydeewa Subterrane (H-10) / Southern San d’Oria [S] (K-10) / East Ronfaure [S] )J-11) / Jugner Forest [S] (G-11) / Vunkerl Inlet [S] (E-7) / Batallia Downs [S] (F-9) / Bastok Markets [S] (G-4) / North Gustaberg [S] (F-7) / Grauberg [S] (L-4) / Pashhow Marshlands [S] (K-11) / Rolanberry Fields [S] (I-14) / Windurst Waters [S] (F-5) / West Sarutabaruta [S] (I-5) / Fort Karugo-Narugo [S] (I-5) / Meriphataud Mountains [S] (L-8) / Sauromugue Champaign [S] (K-11) / Beaucedine Glacier [S] (G-7) / Castle Zvahl Baileys [S] (J-8) / Garlaige Citadel [S] (G-7) / Crawlers’ Nest [S] (M-8) / Eldieme Necropolis [S] (J-9) / Rabao (G-11) / Kazham (G-9) / Norg (H-9)
  • Some UI and text command elements have been changed in preparation for the ability to equip two linkshells, which is scheduled to be implemented in the future.
  • A new message has been added when speaking with Grrk-Frut the Charlatan in Marjami Ravine (I-11) while in possession of six Incursion key items and at the maximum content level for Incursion.
    * The key items will continue to be removed as previously.

[Windows and Xbox 360 only]

Resolved Issues

  • The issue wherein certain NPC's equipment in cutscenes accompanying the Wings of the Goddess mission "Affairs of State" was incorrect.
  • The issue with the Seekers of Adoulin mission "The Light Within" wherein PC animations were occasionally displayed incorrectly.
  • The issue with the Seekers of Adoulin mission "Undying Light" wherein the graphics of some NPCs appearing in cutscenes were incorrect.
  • The issue with the Seekers of Adoulin mission "Undying Light" wherein the background music did not play during cutscenes.
  • The issue with the goblin footprints in Kamihr Drifts (K-11) wherein background music would not play when rewatching the cutscenes in the Seekers of Adoulin mission "Blood for Blood."
  • The issue with the Seekers of Adoulin mission "Abomination" wherein some NPC dialogue in the cutscenes would occasionally not display.
  • The issue with the Seekers of Adoulin mission "The Key to the Turris" wherein the animations of certain NPCs and the locations of the camera during cutscenes would occasionally be incorrect.
  • The issue with the Seekers of Adoulin mission "Reckoning" wherein some NPC animations in the cutscenes were incorrect.
  • The issue with the Seekers of Adoulin mission "Heroes, Unite!" wherein some NPC dialogue in the cutscenes was incorrect.
  • The issue wherein the following Unity Concord NPCs would occasionally fail to respond when trading them a piece of equipment.
    Ubiolaine in Southern San d'Oria (G-10) / Igsli in Bastok Markets (E-11) / Teldro-Kesdrodo in Windurst Woods (J-10) / Yonolala in Windurst Woods (J-10) / Nunaarl Bthtrogg in Western Adoulin (H-11)
  • The issue with Unity Concord wherein the timing of switching objectives was incorrect.
  • The issue with various "Total Successful Synthesis Attempts (UC)” Unity Concord objectives wherein desynthesizing items would not count toward the total.
  • • The issue with the Records of Eminence objective “Heal for 500+ HP (D)” wherein healing players in other Unities, alter egos, fellows, and pets would not count toward the total. This bug fix also applies to instances where heals would not be counted owing to the actions of other players.
  • The issue with the Records of Eminence set objectives screen wherein entering text would cause the next page to display.
  • The issue wherein the error message would not display when a Unity Concord objective is unable to be accepted.
  • The issue with the various "Magic Bursts (UC)" Unity Concord objectives wherein magic bursts caused by enfeebling magic and pet skills that do not cause damage did not count toward the total.
  • The issue wherein the amount of Unity Points earned by vanquishing some monsters was incorrect.
  • The issue with Corsairs' Beast Roll wherein busting would occasionally cause pet attack to decrease.
    * In accordance with this fix, the values for busting with the following phantom rolls have been removed.
    Beast Roll / Drachen Roll / Puppet Roll
  • The issue wherein the following spells and abilities would not display in the magic burst log when resisted.
    Wyvern Breaths / Blood Pacts / Blue Magic / Helixes
  • The issue with the Respite Cloak wherein the item level was not set correctly.
  • The issue wherein job-specific capes obtainable from the following Velkk coffers and grand coffers would occasionally not be engraved with arcane glyptics.
    Ymmr-Ulvid / Ignor-Mnt / Durs-Vike / Tryl-Wuj / Liij-Vok / Gramk-Droog
  • The issue wherein the Charitoni Sling had the Ex attribute.
  • The issue with Pukulatmuj +1 where the actual value of the stoneskin casting time effect was lower than displayed in the help text.
  • The issue with the councillor's garb wherein selecting "Items" from the action command menu would display it in the list while it was equipped.
  • Various issues with incorrect text, item help text, and NPC dialogue.
  • The issue wherein Eternal Flame and Nunaarl Bthtrogg in in Western Adoulin (H-11) would occasionally not display.
  • The issue with chat channel settings wherein pressing the right arrow key when selecting someone to send a sell to would not return the cursor correctly.
  • The issue with chat channel settings wherein moving the mouse over the arrow icon to the right of "Tell" would display an unnatural icon. Further, selecting this option would select "Shout."
  • The issue with synergy wherein checking the following recipes at an NPC would display that the required synthesis skill rank was veteran.
    Galley Kitchen / Fizzy Broth / Electrified Broth / Saline Broth
  • The issue wherein the following blue magic spells did not take into account the main weapon's accuracy and item level.
    Pinecone Bomb / Queasyshroom / Feather Storm
    * As part of this fix, the accuracy of these spells now increases based on blue magic skull, agi, and ranged weapon.

Known Issues

  • Karaha-Baruha’s alter ego will occasionally cast Barfira after being the victim of a water elemental attack.
  • In Rala Waterways, passing through the sluice gates occasionally renders the player unable to move.
  • Pets occasionally stop being able to moving in Arrapago Reef.
  • In the Chains of Promatha mission “A Meteoric Reunion,” the screen will occasionally go black and become unresponsive during the cutscene.
  • When completing the Seekers of Adoulin mission “The Charlatan,”an error message displaying that the player is unable to hold any more items will occasionally display even though the player has actually received the reward.
  • When changing party member order, it will occasionally become impossible to enter party members’ Mog Houses or Mog Gardens.
  • Chacharoon’s Cheer effects that make it easier to raise combat skills will occasionally not activate properly.
  • Knockbacks could by enemy abilities and the line will occasionally not function properly.
  • It is occasionally impossible to target enemies during colonization reives in Yorcia Weald.
  • Danguebert in Western Adoulin will occasionally not display.
  • NPCs can occasionally be set as the target of tells via the command line under certain conditions.
  • When opening a bazaar-related menu after changing areas, the status of one’s bazaar will occasionally be reset.
  • When the maximum number of lines displayed in the log window is set to 4, NPC dialogue will occasionally not display.
  • After searching via Unity in the Unity submenu, adding “Balista” to search conditions causes the search to fail.
  • When moving from Carpenters’ Landing to other areas, the icon depicting the location of survival guides does not display.
[Xbox 360 only]
  • The visual effects of Carbuncle’s blood pact “Pacifying Ruby” will occasionally not display.

title: "Freshly Picked Vana'diel 14" Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the December version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. Below is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello,
Matsui here.

Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 14.

For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I’ve created this digest of what was discussed.

<iframe width="640" height="360" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/DtxwMghhvOY" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Quests That Expand on the Lore of Adoulin
  • New Job Enhancement System “Gifts”
  • Job Adjustments Part 1
  • Job Adjustments Part 2
  • Unity Concord: New Wanted NMs
  • Separating Log Windows
  • Quality-of-life Improvements
  • Chacharoon’s Cheer
  • Upcoming Events and Campaigns
  • January Version Update Preview
  • Conclusion
Quests That Expand on the Lore of Adoulin

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(02:22~)
The “Seekers of Adoulin” missions have come to an end, but there are still many untold stories of Adoulin. The two consecutive quests that have been added with this update tell one of these stories and they can be considered sequels to “Seekers of Adoulin.”
  • The Weatherspoon Inquisition
    Irreparable rifts. Irreconcilable discord. Unconveyed feelings.
    In their search for an ancient, hidden treasure, the true enemy will stand before both parties.

  • Eye of the Beholder
    A man who wards off evil and brings glory to a prestigious family.
    What is the unknown truth that he hides?
In the quest “Eye of the Beholder,” the contents of a certain seasonal event are used as foreshadowing. Be sure to keep your eyes out for it.
New Job Enhancement System “Gifts”

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(05:02~)
*The video shows gameplay of obtainable Gifts and equipping Superior equipment.
Now you'll be able to become stronger by spending job points on specific job point bonuses, and receive further bonuses through Gifts based on how many job points you’ve spent!
We're also looking into adding abilities and spells earned through Gifts to make it feel like you are leveling up past level 99.
  • Gift Bonuses
    In addition to Gifts that boost your base traits, we plan to add further bonuses to abilities and spells.
    I believe some players may have felt that the Gifts that were added this time only provided a small boost; however, the current set of Gifts is only the beginning.

    We'll be adding more Gifts that will stack with each other little by little to produce more noticeable effects.

    We’ve heard that some players believe that Gifts are necessary in order to tackle certain content, but based on the current set of Gifts, there is no need to make adjustments to certain content. Please think of Gifts as something that makes the content easier, rather than something necessary.

    In future, if there's a demand for more challenging content, we'll consider adding content with a difficulty which requires the boosts from Gifts.

  • Superior Equipment
    Superior has been added as a feature to further expand items post-level 99.

    Players will now be able to equip items marked as Superior [Su] after obtaining the Gift Superior.
    With the addition of Superior, we were able to add new synthesized items with an item level of 119. Moving forward, we'll consider adding even more attractive crafted items.
Job Adjustments Part 1

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(15:17~)
In situations where you are able to gain a good amount of support enhancements, the gap between one-handed and two-handed weapons were too great. For this reason, we have made adjustments to shorten this gap.

We are making careful adjustments to this, as we are worried that if we were to make the damage dealt by both one-handed and two-handed weapons the same over time, we’d end up in a situation where one-handed weapons become stronger when there's not enough support.

With that said, we wanted a feature unique to the one-handed weapons; therefore, we increased the upper limit for accuracy. You'll now be able to deliver more steady damage if you have enough physical accuracy.

We'll leave it at this for one-handed weapons adjustments for now and make further adjustments as necessary, so please continue to provide your feedback.
Next, we'll be focusing on pet-related adjustments followed by plans for adjustments to elemental magic.
Job Adjustments Part 2

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(19:37~)
In the December update adjustments have been made to summoner, blue mage, and puppetmaster.
  • Summoner
    There have been requests for some time now for Blood Pact: Hastega II and it has been added in this version update. With the addition of Hastega II, we thought it wouldn’t be right to add a Blood Pact to only Garuda; therefore, we decided to add Blood Pacts to each avatar.

    Added with this update was Carbuncle’s Pacifying Ruby, which has an effect of lowering the enmity of one target party member by 25% and should come in handy when playing in a party.

    Additionally, there are plans to add Blood Pacts to Fenrir, Diabolos, and Cait Sith as well in the future.

  • Blue Mage
    We are planning to make periodic additions to the blue mage.

    Molting Plumage is one of the blue magic spells that was added in this update. This spell alone allows blue mages to receive the effects of the job trait, Dual Wield.

  • Puppetmaster
    Puppetmasters attack side-by-side with an automaton, and frequent use of maneuvers is necessary to control it. In light of this, the animations for maneuvers have been removed, allowing for more attention to be given to attacking.

    In the next version update, we plan to address an issue wherein the Target Marker and Attuner attachments are ineffective against certain monsters.
Unity Concord: New Wanted NMs

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(29:17~)
New Wanted objectives have been added to Unity Concord.

In Unity Concord, stronger versions of previous Notorious Monsters have been added.
For example, Cactrot Veloz, which was added to Eastern Altepa Desert, is modeled after the Notorious Monster Cactrot Rapido, whom many have seen gallantly racing across the desert.
We’ve also prepared a special mechanic for Cactrot Veloz in which it hectically runs around during battle, so look forward to seeing it.

We hope you have fun with Unity Concord while reminiscing about old memories.
Separating Log Windows

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(33:42~)
*The video shows gameplay of how the battle log and the chat log can be displayed separately.

In terms of new log window functions, the ability to separate the battle log and the chat log, as well as a function that displays timestamps has been added.

By using this function, even when the logs are moving quickly during battle, there should be fewer cases in which you miss other players’ messages.

Additionally, based on feedback, we will consider including the option to have the separate windows lined up side-by-side on the PC version only.
Quality-of-life Improvements

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(40:46~)
*The video shows gameplay of how the waypoints now display the destinations.

The map of the destination can now be displayed when selecting destinations at waypoints.
This function has been available for home points and survival guides, but by extending this feature to waypoints as well, it should make it easier to get a better understanding of where you are headed.
In addition to this, when trading items with NPCs, the item help display has been made easier to use, and various other adjustments were made to make daily adventures a little more convenient.
Chacharoon’s Cheer

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(47:20~)
*The video shows gameplay demonstrating the effect of receiving Chacharoon’s Cheer.

A new system, Chacharoon’s Cheer, has been added to monster rearing.
With this system, players may speak to Chacharoon and use mementos received from monsters they have raised in order to gain a variety of effects helpful in an adventurer’s day-to-day life, such as a slight bonus to experience points gained, or a small improvement to items in the Mog Garden shop.

The gained effects and improvements to the Mog Garden shop items will vary depending on the monster, so try to raise a variety of monsters to build up your memento collection!

Please note that there is currently a confirmed issue wherein Chacharoon’s Cheer effects that make it easier to raise combat skills will occasionally not activate properly. This issue is scheduled to be addressed in the January version update.
Upcoming Events and Campaigns

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(1:00:09~)
*The video introduces new alter egos that will be added to the campaigns.
  • Double Capacity Point Campaign [Currently underway!]

  • Double Synthesis Skill Increase Rate Events [Currently underway!]
    Those who want to enjoy battling can save up job points to obtain Gifts, and those who want to enjoy synthesizing can attempt to create Superior equipment with increased rate for synthesis skills.

  • The December 2014 Login Campaign [Currently underway!]
    The alter ego that can be obtained in this campaign is Rughadjeen. If he is summoned together with the other Serpent General alter egos, it will have the effect of strengthening each of the other alter egos.

  • Starlight Celebration From Thursday, December 18, 2014 at 0:00 a.m. (PST) to Wednesday, December 31, 2014 at 7:00 a.m. (PST)
    This event starts on Thursday, December 18th.
    This year, we’ve prepared new items such as a candy-shaped club resembling a leafkin and a high-quality version of the snowman cap.

  • A Vana'diel New Year's Campaign From Thursday, December 18, 2014 at 12:00 a.m. (PST) to Wednesday, January 14, 2015 at 12:00 a.m. (PST)
    We'll be holding several campaigns which includes the Surge Walk Campaign and the Wildskeeper Reive Campaign. We'll be sharing details on topics. Start your New Years by playing in Vana'diel!

  • I Dream of Mog Bonanza Marble sales start Wednesday, December 24, 2014!
    In this year’s Mog Bonanza, we prepared many new items such as the instrumental version of "Forever Today" which can be played on the Orchestrion.　

  • New Year's Alter Ego Extravaganza From Wednesday, December 31, 2014 at 7:00 a.m. (PST) to Monday, February 2, 2015 at 6:00 a.m. (PST)
    We're planning to introduce three new alter egos, "Gilgamesh", "Kukki-Chebukki", and "Margret" to the upcoming New Year's Alter Ego Extravaganza.

    Gilgamesh will have unique motions, and Kukki-Chebukki is setup in a way that he will only cast spells matching the element of the day of the week.
January Version Update Preview

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(1:13:18~)
*The video shows images of the extended region of the Mog Garden.

Due to the holiday seasons, the January version update is planned to be a somewhat smaller update.
We'll be implementing the "Linkshell 2" feature which we couldn't include in the December update, as well as new quests which will go deeper into the side-stories that couldn't be told through the "Seekers of Adoulin" missions.

We're currently preparing the following features which we are aiming to implement sometime after the February version update.
  • Continuation of Alluvion Skirmishes
  • Addition of new Job Point Categories
  • New Gifts
  • New monsters for monster rearing
  • Expansion of the Mog Gardens
Also, in future we're planning Heroine's Combat-like content for Seekers of Adoulin. We'll share more details on this later, so please look forward to the future version updates!
Conclusion

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(1:22:48~)
In this final version update for 2014, we introduced new quests which further expand on the lore of Adoulin. We also introduced new systems and features such as the Gifts system as a post-level 99 leveling system, as well as a feature to separate the chat log to make your day-to-day conversations more pleasant. Additionally, Chacharoon's Cheer will make your daily adventures with your reared monsters even more memorable.

We just released this new version update, but the development team is already planning ahead and developing new features for next year. Please look forward to Final Fantasy XI in 2015!

See you in the next Freshly Picked Vana'diel.

I wish you all a Happy New Year!

System-related

    [09:58]

Resolved Issues

  • The issue with the quest "Moment of Truth" wherein playing certain cutscenes with the main job set to geomancer or rune fencer would prevent the player from properly completing the quest.

  • The issue wherein the functionality of /linkshell2 and /l2 would differ from those of other chat-related text commands
  • The issue wherein opening the secondary window from the full screen log window would occasionally cause the program to slow down.
  • The issue with certain guild shops wherein items that are ordinarily not able to be sold would occasionally have vendor prices displayed.
  • The issue with Batallia Downs wherein the arrows would occasionally fail to display properly while fishing.
  • Various issues with improper descriptions in NPC dialogue and help text.
  • The issue wherein teleporting to a survival guide in Buburimu Peninsula would cause the camera to be at an improper location.
  • The issue with NPCs selling magical maps wherein the prices for Al Zahbi maps were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein the locations of survival guides in Passhow Marshlands [S] and Vunkerl Inlet [S] were incorrect.

PlayStation 2 Only
  • The issue with certain cutscenes in Chains of Promathia missions and the quest "The Weatherspoon Inquisition" wherein the screen would black out and the program would become unresponsive.

Known Issues

  • The screen occasionally blacks out and the game occasionally becomes unresponsive during cutscenes in the following missions and quests.
    Wings of the Goddess mission "Where It All Began" / Chains of Promathia mission "The Chains Fall Free" / "The Long Match North"

  • When performing synthesis, the synthesis will occasionally be canceled and the materials and crystals lost even though the visual effects for a successful synthesis are displayed.
  • The effects of the increases enfeebling magic skill attribute of the items "Estoqueur's Sayon +2" and "Uk'uxkaj Boots" do not apply to Dia spells.
  • The ability Nepenthic Plunge used by the beastmaster familiar Redolent Candi displays improper help text regarding the ability's area of effect.
  • In Western Adoulin, it is possible for players to move to locations they would ordinarily not be able to.
  • When drawing a weapon without a target and receiving an ability or spell from a pet, combat with an enemy will occasionally commence with an improper target.
    * This may be fixed by leaving combat.
  • If points are put into the group one merit point category "Vallation Effect" and either Vallation or Valiance is used, the user will only gain the effects of one rune regardless of how many are active.
  • If points are put into the group one merit point category "Lunge Effect," magic accuracy is not properly increased when Lunge is used.
  • When opening the action menu with items remaining to be claimed from a treasure coffer while targeting a PC that is seeking a party, certain entries will fail to display properly.
  • When HP and MP values change after changing equipment using the text command /equipset, the following arguments will display the HP and MP values before changing equipment.
    <hp> / <hpp> / <mp> / <mpp>
  • When entering battle content with a level cap, the following familiars summoned via support jobs do not have their levels properly capped.
    Avatars / Automatons

Seekers of Adoulin Quests

In the January version update we’ve added three new quests related to Seekers of Adoulin.

In the January version update we made adjustments to puppetmaster.
  • Puppetmaster
    The Soulsoother C-1000 head will now cast Protectra and Shellra, and the Stormwaker Y-700 head will now cast Protect and Shell on the automaton.

    We’ve also made adjustments to certain attachments that were not eliciting effects on monsters that were added after Seekers of Adoulin. We are planning to add high-tier versions of attachments in the February version update, and the adjustments made in the January version update were made ahead of time as preparation. We’re looking forward to hearing your feedback.
Unity Wanted NMs
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(11：23～)
We added 5 new NMs for Unity Wanted. This time around we made some slightly different mechanics for these NMs, such as King Uropygid’s ability to heal and grow stronger depending on the weather. To make up for this strength, we’ve also added weaknesses. Steamy Samantha’s name is written differently in the objective than what is shown when you actually spawn her, but you’ll understand the reason when you fight her.

We’ve carefully created each NM with really neat aspects, so we’d like everyone to search for each NM’s special characteristics and beat them.
Linkshell 2
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(15:12～)
*The video shows how to equip two linkshells and how to send a tell to a player from the chat window.

We’ve been receiving requests asking to make it possible to equip another linkshell without having to unequip your main linkshell, especially for cases where you use different linkshells for different activities. To answer these requests, we’ve added a system that allows you to equip two linkshells at the same time.

There were even a lot of comments from within the development team in support of expanding chat features when we were discussing the linkshell 2 feature, and we decided to implement this system.

In regards to expanded chat window features, by selecting a player from the full screen mode and selecting “Tell,” a special icon will be displayed in the chat window. When recruiting members for parties you’ll be able to verify who you sent a tell to, so please be sure to put this to good use.
Event and Campaign Announcements
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(24:04～)
I’d like to introduce the events and campaigns that are currently going on.
  • I Dream of Mog Bonanza 2015 (Currently underway!)
    Marbles are on sale until Tuesday, January 27 at 12:00 a.m. (PST). This time around for the Rank 3 and Rank 4 prizes respectively, you’ll be able to select instrumental versions of “Distant Worlds” and “Forever Today” that can be played with the Orchestrion. Good luck, and have fun with Mog Bonanza!
  • Nyzul Isle Uncharted Area Survey Mysterious Item Campaign (Currently underway!)
  • Double Capacity Point Campaign (Currently underway!)
  • Double Simulacra Segment Campaign (Currently underway!)
  • Reap Greater Rewards with the Skirmish Treasure Coffer Campaign (Currently underway!)
    All of these campaigns will last until Tuesday, January 27 at 12:00 a.m. (PST).
    The Nyzul campaign is the first of its kind where NMs on floors 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100 as well as the NMs you meet along the way will drop new mysterious items. You’ll be able to obtain a variety of different items, so please give it a shot.
  • The New Year Alter Ego Extravaganza (Currently underway!)
    This campaign will last until Monday, February 2 at 6:00 a.m. (PST). Gilgamesh, Kukki-Chebukki, and Margret alter egos are up for grabs this time around!
  • January 2015 Login Campaign (Currently underway!)
    • Login points can be earned until Monday, February 2 at 6:00 a.m. (PST).
    • Login points can be exchanged for items until Monday, February 9 at 6:00 a.m. (PST).
      The month’s campaign features the cute Sheep Cap as well as the Areuhat alter ego.
February Version Update Preview

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(29:52～)
For the next version update we’re working on the following content.
  • New Alluvion Skirmishes
    We’ll be adding new Alluvion skirmishes that take place in Yorcia Weald. You’ll be able to add a third arcane glyptic to weapons and we’ll also be preparing new armor sets. The rewards will be stronger, but naturally the mechanics will also be enhanced, so please look forward to it!
  • New Job Point Categories
    We’ll be adding two new job point categories for each job.
  • Additional Gifts
    We’ll be adding high-tier elemental magic that can be learned through Gifts. There will also be useful Gifts for those jobs that do not utilize magic.
  • Unity Chat Cap Increase
    As we have been using the linkshell system for Unity chat, the current cap is 64 players, but we will be making adjustments to increase this number.
  • Additional Mog Garden Elements
    *The video shows a new section for monster rearing.
    In the February version update we will be increasing the monster rearing rank and also introducing a new area for monster rearing where you’ll be able to raise new kinds of monsters.
Conclusion

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(48:10～)
The January version update was a small-scale update, but the February version update is a large-scale one that will add a sizeable amount of content to the game.

All of the teams will be working hard together in 2015 on FINAL FANTASY XI, and I hope you all have a great year.

See you all in the next Freshly Picked Vana’diel!

  • Additional items may now be stored via the Porter Moogle.
    • Storage Slip 19
      Heartbeater / Heartbeater +1 / Leafkin Cap / Leafkin Cap +1 / Corolla / Celeste Cap
  • Goobbue Gardeners in the Sanctuary of Zi’tah now drop goobbue humus.
  • Elder Goobbues in the Boyahda Tree now drop great boyahda moss instead of goobbue humus.
  • The vendor prices of the following items have been lowered.
    Great Boyahda Moss / Wisteria Lumber

System-related

  • A new menu option has been added to relinquish rights to cast lots on all spoils contained in a treasure coffer at once.
    Attachment 11014

    Attachment 11015
    Selecting ”Done” relinquishes all items other than those with lots cast.
    * Please note that selecting this option will cause the operation to be executed automatically without displaying a yes/no dialogue.
  • The following entries have been added to the Config section of the main menu.
    • A new category, “Misc. 3,” has been added.　(Windows Only)
      Attachment 11016

      Attachment 11017
      The following categories have been added under Misc. 3
      * These entries have been added under Misc. 2 for the PlayStation 2 and Xbox 360 versions.
      • Weapon Effects
        Enables or disables the display of weapon effects.
      • Style Lock
        * This option is unavailable in the February version update.
    • An option to tile the log window horizontally under has been added to the Shared entry in the Windows submenu. (Windows only)
  • The Linkshell submenu has undergone the following adjustments.
    • Linkshells stored in mog satchels, sacks, and cases are now displayed.
    • New Linkshells stored in mog satchels, sacks, and cases can be used to produce linkshells equippable to the first linkshell slot.
  • The following entries have been added to the Currencies 2 section of the Status submenu.
    Mellidopt Wings Stored / Duskslit Stone / Duskslit Stone +1 / Duskslit Stone +2 / Dusktip Stone /
    Dusktip Stone +1 / Dusktip Stone +2 / Duskdim Stone / Duskdim Stone +1 / Duskdim Stone +2 /
    Duskorb Stone / Duskorb Stone +1 / Duskrorb Stone +2
  • A new menu option, Style Lock, has been added in the Equip Set section of the Macro submenu.
    * This option is unavailable in the February version update.
  • A new shortcut key to switch chat mode to Linkshell 2, Ctrl-X, has been added.

Resolved Issues

  • Various issues with improper text in certain NPC dialogue and help text.
  • The issue wheren background music would not play properly after watching certain cutscenes in the Seekers of Adoulin mission Balamor, the Deathborne Xol.
  • The issue wherein equipment sets would not function properly under certain conditions.
  • The issue with the Job Points section of the Status submenu wherein the cursor would not move to the proper location when selecting a particular category after choosing a job.
  • The issue with Records of Eminence wherein the setting of certain unrepeatable objectives did not function properly.
  • The issue with the text command /equipset wherein when HP and MP values change after changing equipment using the command the following arguments would display the previous HP and MP values.
    <hp> / <hpp> / <mp> / <mpp>
  • The issue wherein when opening the action menu with items remaining to be claimed from a treasure coffer while targeting a PC that is seeking a party, certain entries would fail to display properly.
  • The issue wherein the auto-translate dictionary would not function properly when chatting via an equipped secondary linkshell.
  • The issue with Cherukiki’s alter ego wherein the areas of effect of the following spells were incorrect.
    Sleepga / Sleepga II
  • The issue with the following blue magic spells wherein the accuracy of their additional effects was incorrect.
    Wild Oats / Sandspin / Hecatomb Wave / Maelstrom / Barbed Crescent / Tourbillion
  • The issue where careening twitherym roaming Foret de Hennetiel would not drop crystals.
  • The issue wherein the area of effect of beastmaster familiars Redolent Candi and Alluring Honey’s special ability Nepenthic Plunge was incorrect.
  • The issue wherein the effects of the arcane glyptics affect Phalanx were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein where points were put into the group one merit point category "Lunge Effect," magic accuracy was not properly increased when Lunge is used.
  • The issue wherein if points were put into the rune fencer group one merit point category "Vallation Effect" and either Vallation or Valiance were used, the user would only gain the effects of one rune regardless of how many are active.
  • The issue with monster rearing wherein an error message would dispaly twice when trying to procure an item from a creature being reared while the inventory was full.
  • The issue wheren Mog Garden pond graphics would occasionally not update after upgrading the pond rank.
  • The issue wherein certain Mog Garden gathering points would not display properly after upgrading the arboreal grove from rank 5 to 6.
  • The issue wherein the Seekers of Adoulin mission Behind the Sluices would occasionally not advance properly.
  • The issue wherein the screen would occasionally black out and become unresponsive during the following missions and quests.
    The Chains Fall Free / Where It All Began / Maiden of the Dusk / The Long March North /
    Navigating the Unfriendly Seas / Promotion: Second Lieutenant / Promotion: First Lieutenant /
    Divine Interference / Into the Beast's Maw / Yggdrasil / Sweets for the Soul / Flowers for Svenja /
    Do Not Go Into the Light / Hypocritical Oath / Sick and Tired
  • The issue wherein equipping fellows with certain items would cause certain graphics to not display correctly.

Windows version only
  • The issue wherein the effects of the Adamantoise family special ability Harden Shell would not display properly.

Known Issues

  • Players may occasionally become unable to move when falling through the terrain in Sih Gates (J-10).
  • The screen will occasionally black out and become unresponsive during cutscenes in the following missions.
    Maiden of the Dusk / Unraveling Reason / Light of Judgment
  • The player may occasionally become unable to move after becoming stuck in a wall in Sea Serpent Grotto (H-9)
  • When participating in an alluvion skirmish in Yorcia Weald [U], the effects of certain weaponskills will occasionally not disply properly when using them on strongholds.
  • When rearing a ziz within the Mog Gardens, an effect will occasionally play on the ziz when taking certain actions.
  • If the player acquires the dancer gift category Maximum Finishing Moves Bonus and has the icon type set to 2, a black border will occasionally display around the icon that appears when the player has six or more finishing moves.
  • When using the Dispense: Confectionery Goods ability of the Heart Apron +1, the player will occasionally receive bast parchment.
  • When using the /macro command while editing the macro palette and moving the book, the entry currently being edited will be copied over to the new location.
  • Switching between the job point and gifts categories in the Job Point submenu and then canceling will cause the client to crash.
  • When in possession of a linkshell and linkpearl of the same type, the equip section of the Linkshell submenu will not grey out and remain openable.

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 16  Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the February version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. Below is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui

Hello,
Matsui here.

Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 16.

For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I’ve created this digest of what was discussed.

<iframe width="640" height="360" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/8pxvsjfXozc" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Adoulin Lore Quest
  • Alluvion Skirmishes
  • Unity Concord
  • Unity Concord, Cont.
  • Records of Eminence
  • Job Points
  • Job Adjustments
  • Job Adjustments, Cont.
  • New Synergy Recipes
  • Mog Gardens
  • New Trust Alter Egos
  • Quality-of-Life Adjustments
  • Campaigns and Events
  • Conclusion
Adoulin Lore Quest

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(7:16~）

We’ve added the final chapter to a quest series focusing on a particular aspect of Adoulin lore. I don’t want to spoil anything, so I’ll hold off on talking about the quest content.

There will be a battle that occurs during the quest, and we’ve tuned it so that any job can clear it solo by using Trust alter egos.

Naturally since this is the final chapter, we’ve also prepared reward equipment. Definitely use this opportunity to clear the quests, especially those of you who have yet to play through the previous ones.
Alluvion Skirmishes

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(9:28~)
*The video shows off alluvion skirmish screenshots and examples of the rewards you can earn.
  • The addition of alluvion skirmishes to Yorcia Weald.
    We’ve added new alluvion skirmishes.

    By consuming the points you earn through the content, you can summon friendly monsters and aim to destroy the enemy’s stronghold. It’s slightly different from the battle content you’ve seen up until now.

  • Arcane glyptic adjustments for alluvion skirmish equipment
    It’s now possible to add arcane glyptics with even better stats to weapons you earn through alluvion skirmishes. Definitely try to challenge this content.
Unity Concord

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(15:00~)
*The video introduces screenshots of new Wanted objectives.

We’ve added four new NMs and new Wanted objectives.

We’ve also reduced the cost for warping to Wanted objective areas and increased the cap for Unity chat participants.
Unity Concord, Cont.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(18:03~)

We’ve added a new item, “Refractive Crystal,” that can be purchased with Unity accolades. This item will allow you to add arcane glyptics to job-specific back equipment.

You can add arcane glyptics by trading the back equipment and a Refractive Crystal to the NPC added to the Inventors’ Coalition in Adoulin.

Naturally you’ll be able to do this with job-specific back equipment you obtained from reives, but you’ll also be able to re-add arcane glyptics to job-specific back equipment you obtained from Incursion.

Additionally, since this makes it easier to obtain job-specific back equipment with arcane glyptics, we’ve increased the drop rate for job-specific back equipment in Incursion and eased up on the obtainment difficulty.
Records of Eminence

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(19:45~)

We’ve added new Records of Eminence objectives.

Additionally, we’ve been receiving feedback that the numbers to achieve certain daily objectives was a bit too high, so we’ve made adjustments to this.

Furthermore, we’ve also made some quality-of-life adjustments such as making it possible to indicate the number of skill boosting items when purchasing them.
Job Points

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(22:35~)

We’ve added new job point enhancement categories as well as new gifts.

There are a ton of categories and it would be tough for me to introduce them all here, so please be sure to check out the details page.
Job Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(23:35~)

In addition to adding new pets for beastmaster, we’ve also reduced the recast times of Sic and Ready and made overall adjustments to the special abilities of monsters.

Considering that it’s possible for party enhancements, especially haste, to be cast on pets, we’ve made adjustments so that the damage for each hit is higher.

Additionally, due to the fact that pet abilities are managed through charges only at the moment, we’ve added TP modifiers to each ability to give TP some purpose.

We’ve also made some minor adjustments to Amigo Sabotender, and the ability “1000 Needles” has been changed to “??? Needles.”

With all of the beastmaster adjustments that took place in the February version update I feel it has become a much more powerful job, so please be sure to try it out.
Job Adjustments, Cont.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(25:44~)
  • Blue mage
    Since blue magic skill did not affect the activation rate of certain blue magic additional effects, we’ve standardized the formula for the activation of blue magic additional effects, and made it so blue magic skill affects them.

    Additionally, we’ve increased the maximum level for certain job traits from three to four.

  • Puppetmaster
    We’ve increased the potency of automaton weapon skills. Additionally, we’ve added various new attachments.

    We’ve been receiving a lot of feedback about special battle tactics using Deactivate based on the adjustments that were performed in the December version update. The development team is of course aware of the existence of this battle strategy, and we consider it to be in the scope of how this feature was intended to work. With that said, we do not have any plans to make adjustments to prevent the use of this strategy.

    However, the development team would like to players to maintain automatons as long as possible, and they will continue to make adjustments in the future to make doing so more advantageous.

    We’re planning to make further adjustments to puppetmaster in the March version update, so please let us know your feedback afterwards.
New Synergy Recipes

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(31:25~)

We’ve added items that combine all of the elemental belts, obis, and gorgets via synergy. The elemental properties and stats have not changed, but we’ve also added a small bonus to each item:
“TP not depleted when weapon skill used +1%” for the gorget and belt, and “magic not depleted when magic used +1%” for the obi.

If you use the belt and the gorget at the same time the stats will stack for a combined 2%.
Mog Gardens

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(37:45~)
*The video shows off screenshots of the monster rearing area and new monsters.

We’ve increased the maximum monster rearing rank to three. When reaching rank 3, you’ll be able to access a new portion of the Mog Gardens specifically for monster rearing. This area will allow you to raise multiple monsters at the same time.

We’ve also added new monsters that can be rasied, notably colibris!
New Trust Alter Egos

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(44:45~)
*The video shows off screenshots of Arciela and Chacharoon.

We’ve added two new alter egos: Arciela and Chacharoon.

Arciela is a support-type alter ego and she was made based on how she moves during Adoulin missions. In terms of special characteristics, she will switch between two different modes and also has intelligence that prioritizes the support of the player who summoned her. This intelligence will be expressed through a system where your reputation with her will change through Adoulin missions.

As for Chacharoon, you’ll be able to summon him by taking part in monster rearing.

Since he is a Qiqirin child, we wanted to put this to use and created new, original abilities that are based on the idea that a child is using them. He’ll fight using the adorable wooden stick he always carries, so be sure to summon him!
Quality-of-Life Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(48:55~)

We’ve eased up on the real-world time constraints for certain quests.

Additionally, we’ve also reduced the party member requirements for certain content such as Campaign Ops so that players can enjoy this content solo when they are not able to gather a party together.

Furthermore, we added the much asked for feature to have separate chat log windows side-by-side. You’ll also be able to select what is displayed in each window based on the chat color category.
Campaigns and Events

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(54:50~)
*Fortuna from the marketing team joins to introduce on-going and upcoming campaigns.
  • Mog Bonanza exchange period
    Mog Bonanza marbles can be exchanged until Thursday, March 5. If you haven’t done so already, please make sure to do so quickly.

    The orchestrion music that was added as rank 3 and 4 prizes can only be obtained through Mog Bonanza, so if you were lucky enough to land the numbers for these ranks please consider choosing these items.

  • March Login Campaign
    At long last the alter ego for Mayakov will finally be available through the March Login Campaign.

    During the Wings of the Goddess missions Mayakov only wielded a single weapon, but brought out his second weapon when the going got tough, so we created his alter ego to dual wield based on this hidden trait. Additionally, he’ll utilize his trademark ability from the missions, so look forward to this new alter ego!
Conclusion

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
The February version update ushered in various changes and additions, as well as brand-new battle content. I hope you all try it out and provide your feedback on the forums.

We’ll be introducing the content for the March version update on topics, so please look forward to reading about it!

See you all in the next Freshly Picked Vana’diel!

title: Mar 26, 2015 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • Mog Gardens have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Monster Rearing has undergone the following adjustments.
      • A monster's mood will no longer degrade from "beaming with pure contentment" after collecting items or interacting with the monster.
      • The collective moods of all creatures will generate auras of light or darkness that affects them all.
        • Light
          When the number of creatures beaming with pure contentment is greater than that succumbing to darkness, all creatures’ contentment and mood are increased.
        • Darkness
          When the number of creatures succumbing to darkness is greater than that beaming with pure contentment, all monsters' contentment and mood are decreased.
    • The following information is now displayed when entering your Mog Garden.
      • The number of days left on assistants’ contracts.
        The number of days left on each assistant’s contract is now be announced to the player, and the timing of the announcement may be changed by speaking with the Green Thumb Moogle.
        The following three settings are possible.
        • Always announce contract information regardless of time remaining.
        • Announce when there is one day remaining, seven days remaining, or any number of days in between.
        • Do not announce time remaining.
      • Current affinity
    • If an assistant’s contract has previously expired when interacting with a gathering point, a message to that effect now displays.
    • If an assistant’s contract expires while the player is still in their Mog Garden, speaking to the assistant will cause them to disappear.
    • When entering another player’s Mog Garden, the invited player will no longer occasionally earn extra shining stars.
      Shining stars may be earned one per day by entering one’s own Mog Garden.
    • It is now possible to scrap any unwanted flotsam directly without receiving it in cases where the player’s inventory is full or he is otherwise unable to recover it.
  • Unity Concord has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • New Wanted objectives have been added.
      • Areas and notorious monsters
        The Labyrinth of Onzozo
        Voso
        Attachment 11071
        Garlaige Citadel
        Mephitas
        Attachment 11072
        Ifrit’s Cauldron
        Coca
        Attachment 11073
        The Boyahda Tree
        Ayapec
        Attachment 11074
        Kuftal’s Tunnel
        Specter Worm
        Attachment 11075
        Den of Rancor
        Azrael
        Attachment 11076
        Fei’Yin
        Orientalis Shadow／Borealis Shadow／
        Australis Shadow／Occidentalis Shadow
        Attachment 11077
        *Four notorious monsters have been added to the same objective in Fei'Yin, and each must be defeated for successful completion.
      A variety of equipment is available as rewards for vanquishing these NMs.
    • Adventurers in parties of between three and five characters may now call forth alter egos in Wanted battles.
      * A party of at least three players is required to battle notorious monsters.
    • A new option to spend Unity accolades to travel to an area for which the player has accepted a Wanted objective will be added.
      Selecting the option “Currently accepted area” will display areas for which the player has accepted a Wanted objective.
      *Areas from expansions that have not yet been installed will not be displayed.
  • Records of Eminence has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • New objectives have been added.
    • A capacity point bonus has been added to successful first time completion of certain objectives. Characters who have already completed these objectives will have the bonus retroactively applied.
    • The Unity and Achievement categories have switched locations.
    • Other characters are no longer displayed while talking to Records of Eminence NPCs in order to ease graphical burdens.
  • The items required for the quest “Choosing an Automaton Frame” have changed.
    • Valoredge X-900
      Now requires patas instead of tigerfangs.
    • Sharpshot Z-500
      Now requires a heavy crossbow instead of a repeating crossbow.
  • Vingijard in Lower Jeuno will no longer erase memories of the geomancer and rune fencer artifact quests.
    * In accordance with this change, geomancer and rune fencer quests will become temporarily unable to be undertaken again as of the March version update. A different method for attempting them again will be added in a subsequent version update.

Battle-related

  • New battle content known as Vagary has been added.
    • What is Vagary?
      Vagary is a new type of battle content that pits pioneers against members of the Xol Triumvirate, sinister forces that made their first appearance in the Seekers of Adoulin mission storyline. Engimatic gates found within Outer Ra’Kaznar connect to otherworldly realms where adventurers and their allies face off against Balamor, Dhokmak the Brash, and Ashrakk Duskbrood.
      Attachment 11080 Attachment 11081
      • Requirements for Participation
        • Have installed and registered the Seekers of Adoulin expansion disk
        • Be of level 95 or higher
        • Be in a party or alliance of between three and eighteen players
        • The party leader must have progressed to a certain point in the Seekers of Adoulin mission stoyline*
        • The party leader must be in possession of the requisite key item.*
          * Party members other than the leader need not fulfill this prerequisite, but Seekers of Adoulin lore is deeply intertwined with Vagary content. Those who wish to enjoy the story without spoilers are advised to complete the missions first.
      • Obtaining the requisite key items
        Players can obtain the necessary key items by trading vials of befouled water dropped by fomors in Outer Ra’Kaznar and Ra’Kaznar Inner Court to the odyssean passage found in Leafallia.
      • Entering Vagary
        Gates that tie Ulbuka to the otherworldly locations where Vagary takes place can be found in Outer Ra’Kaznar. There are three such gates, and the layout of this extradimensional realm and the member of the triumvirate found within differ accordingly.
        * The key items required for entry are the same for all three gates.
      • Conquering Vagary
        Vagary has a time limit of forty-five minutes. Pioneers must vanquish the threats that lie within and keep pressing forward until they come face-to-face with one of the triumvirate. Those victorious will be rewarded with handsome spoils.
      • Vagary rewards
        Besting the goes within Vagary will reward players with item level 119 equipment, materials to synthesize Superior 2 equipment, and items used to reforge empyrean armor to item level 119.
  • Alluvion Skirmishes in Yorcia Weald [U] have undergone the following adjustments.
    • The number of malicious and valiant currently present are now displayed.
    • The HP of strongholds and marchlands are now displayed.
    • The types of monsters present in a skirmish now vary more strongly with the type of Eudaemon used to enter.
    • If a player has used a eudaemon sash to gain entry, they may use motes of puissance to enhance their pets.
    • Puissance may now be used to obtain maps.
      * Maps will vanish upon changing levels.
    • Players may now convert obsidian fragments into motes of puissance.
    • There is no longer a confirmation message when amending the Ars Monstrum or summoning valiants.
  • Time limits will now be displayed for the following content.
    Skirmishes / Alluvion Skirmishes / Delve / Incursion
  • The Trust initiative has undergone the following adjustments.
    • Alter egos may now be called forth in Walk of Echoes and Wanted combat.
    • Alter egos may now be called forth in the following Wings of the Goddess mission battlefields.
      When Wills Collide / Maiden of the Dusk
    • Alter egos may now be called forth in the following Winds of the Goddess quest battlefields.
      Champion of the Dawn / The Dawn Also Rises / A Forbidden Reunion
  • The cost for purchasing avatar phantom gems, required to participate in high-tier avatar battlefields, has been decreased from twenty merit points to ten merit points.
  • The method for calculating whether a walk in Walk of Echoes would enter surge mode has been changed, and it is now more likely for surge walks to occur back to back.
  • A new Gift category enabling players to equip items marked as Superior 2 has been added.
  • The following combat-related adjustments have been made.
    • Magic burst adjustments
      • The potency of magic bursts has been increased. Magic bursts will now deal increasing damage to monsters that have lower resistance to the element generated by the magic burst.
        * The following spells are exempt from this adjustment.
        Geohelix / Hydrohelix / Anemohelix / Pyrohelix / Cryohelix / Ionohelix / Onctohelix / Luminohelix / Kaustra
      • The increased potency based on the number of skillchains has been doubled.
      • The amount of enmity generated from damage dealt during magic bursts has been decreased.
    • Enmity Adjustments
      • The enmity cap has been tripled.
      • The amount of enmity gained by dealing damage has been lowered.
        * Enmity generated by healing remains the same.
      • Enmity will now decrease based on the gap between player/pet level/item level and monster level.
        * Abilities that generate a fixed amount of enmity, such as healing magic and elemental magic, are exempt from this change.
    • The TP-based damage bonuses for the following dagger weapon skills have been slightly lowered.

    • Red Mage
      • The following enfeebling magic spells have been adjusted.
        • The damage over time effects of Poison and Poison II have been increased and their effect duration has been increased to ninety seconds.
        • The effects of Blind and Blind II have been increased and the duration is now fixed at 180 seconds.
          * The previously announced change regarding attributes that affect the strength of these effects have been put on hold pending further consideration.
        • The duration of Paralyze, Paralyze II, and Silence is now fixed at 120 seconds.
        • The accuracy of Distract, Distract II, Frazzle, and Frazzle II has been increased.
      • Red mages are now able to use job-exclusive sword weapon skills.
        Red Lotus Blade / Seraph Blade / Vorpal Blade / Sanguine Blade
    * The implementation of the previously announced spell Ardor has been put on hold pending further consideration of its effects.

        Absorb-STR / Absorb-DEX / Absorb-AGI / Absorb-INT /
        Asborb-MND / Absorb-CHR / Absorb-ACC

        Bewitching Etude / Logical Etude / Sage Etude / Swift Etude /

          Blindside (SMN Lv.99, single target Blood Pact: Rage)
          Deals physical damage.
        • Fenrir
          Impact (SMN Lv.99, single target Blood Pact: Rage)
          Deals dark damage that lowers an enemy’s strength, dexterity, vitality, agility, intelligence, mind, and charisma.
        • Cait Sith
          Regal Gash (SMN Lv.99, single target Blood Pact: Rage)
          Delivers a threefold attack.

      • The effect duration of maneuvers now increases based on the amount of time elapsed since using Deploy.
        * This effect is removed whenever the automaton is knocked out or deactivated, or when the player changes areas.
        * The effect is maintained even if combat ends, whether by vanquishing monsters, retrieving the automaton, or other such means.
