title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 18  Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the May version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. Below is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello,
Matsui here.

Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 18.
For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I’ve created this digest of what was discussed.

<iframe width="640" height="360" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/ubLYNXrpb34" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Rhapsodies of Vana’diel
  • New Area: Escha - Zi’tah
  • Assault Adjustments
  • Job Points
  • Job Adjustments
  • Trust Initiative
  • Unity Concord
  • Records of Eminence
  • Mog House Adjustments
  • Item-related
  • Quality-of-life Improvements
  • Promotions and Campaigns I
  • Promotions and Campaigns II
  • Conclusion
Rhapsodies of Vana’diel

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(4:00～)
*The video introduces screenshots of the new scenario.

We implemented the first chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana’diel.
You’ll be able to get started with the quests straight from the beginning of the game; however, to progress towards the end of the scenario you will ultimately need the Rise of the Zilart expansion.
  • Rhapsodies of Vana’diel’s Heroine: Iroha
    http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/at...290542&thumb=1
    This is the new heroine you will encounter in this scenario. When we were deciding on her name, we had to make sure that there were no other characters who shared the same name, but after a few twists and turns we finally named her Iroha.
  • Rhapsody Key Items
    By progressing through Rhapsodies of Vana’diel you’ll be able to obtain various key items.

    In chapter one, you will be able to obtain the Rhapsody in White, Rhapsody in Umber, and Rhapsody in Azure key items, which will make it easier to challenge various content, give experience point bonuses, reduce the cost of different types of warps, and other perks that make adventuring throughout Vana’diel more convenient.

    More details on bonuses can be found here.
New Area: Escha-Zi’tah

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(9:29～)
*The video introduces screenshots of the new area and Geas Fete.

As the name implies, this is a new area based on the existing Zi’Tah area.

There are a number of monsters that span a wide level range from around level 50 to above level 99, so it’s a great place for those who are returning to the game or leveling up characters for the first time.
  • Escha – Zi’Tah Currencies
    You’ll be able to obtain two different types of currency in this area.
    • Escha Silt
      Escha silt can be earned by defeating monsters and notorious monsters that dwell in Escha – Zi’Tah. You’ll need this currency to purchase temporary items, enhance equipment, use warps, and to receive the special support effects known as “vorseals.”
    • Escha Beads
      Escha beads can be earned by defeating notorious monsters in Escha – Zi’Tah. You can exchange this currency for Eschalixirs, which are used to upgrade certain equipment.
  • Vorseal
    By taking advantage of vorseals, players can receive various beneficial effects while in Escha – Zi’Tah.

    There are different types of vorseal effects, and it’s possible to have all of the effects active at the same time.

    Vorseal effects will last one hour once you enter Escha – Zi’Tah, and once you receive a vorseal it can be used each time you enter this area without having to repurchase it with Escha silt.
  • New battle content: Geas Fete
    This is battle content that involves fighting with the notorious monsters lurking in Escha – Zi’Tah.

    In order to undertake a Geas Fete, first you’ll need to form a party of 3-18 players. All members will need to possess a key item known as “Tribulens” and the party leader will have to possess the appropriate “Grisly trinket” key item for the notorious monster you are going to fight.

    It’s possible to summon alter egos during Geas Fete, but they do not count towards as party members, so please take note of this.

    If you successfully defeat a notorious monster, you’ll can earn Escha silt, Escha beads, strong equipment, and upgrade materials.

    • Enhancing equipment from Geas Fete
      The equipment that drops from Geas Fete notorious monsters can be enhanced with Eschalixirs.

      Essentially it is the same as the method for enhancing equipment from Delve; however, this time around we made it so when you change your upgrade path on equipment that has already been enhanced, it will still possess its enhancement rank. When changing your upgrade path on equipment that has been enhanced, however, you’ll need to spend a great deal of Escha silt, so be sure to carefully think over your upgrade path.
Assault Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui

(18:14～)

We’ve made adjustments to Assaults that were difficult to complete with a small number of players.
  • Imperial Agent Rescue
    We increased the frequency in which Mamool Ja Warder uses his special abilities and also made it easier to destroy objects.
  • Lebros Supplies
    We added a new temporary item called Seafood Stewpot that will make the NPC you give it to and the surround NPCs full.
  • Evade and Escape
    We increased the time in which switches stay active so that this can be completed before time runs out when playing solo.
  • Azure Ailments
    We reduced the number of status ailments that need to be accumulated since players have become stronger and now more easily resist status ailments.
  • Nyzul Isle Investigation / Nyzul Isle Uncharted Area Survery
    We increased the time in which lamps stay active so that this can be completed before time runs out when playing solo.
Job Points

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(23:02～)

Two new enhancement categories have been added to each job, and we also added new gifts. This is the final set of enhancement categories that we had planned.

Since the number of gifts have increased, we revamped the details page.
Job Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(23:46～)

We made a number of job adjustments in the May version update.
  • Warrior
    The enhancement levels of the jobs traits “physical attack bonus,” “physical defense bonus,” and “double attack” have been adjusted and they can now go higher.

    Additionally, we doubled the level-based effect bonus for Berserk and Defender.
  • Black mage
    We added the new ability, “Cascade,” which allows you to consume TP in exchange for magic damage bonus.
  • Red mage
    We added the new magic spell, “Inundation,” which was previously introduced as “Ardor” before the March version update.

    When casting Inundation on a monster, you will gain a skillchain damage bonus when multiple players perform skillchains using different weapon types.

    With the adjustments we made to this spell it has been changed from an enhancement magic spell to an enfeebling magic spell, so we changed the name of it to better fit the effect.
  • Dark knight
    We added the new ability, “Consume Mana,” which uses MP to boost the damage of your next attack.

    Additionally, we made adjustments to the enhancement levels of “physical attack bonus” and the effect of Last Resort so that more damage can be dealt.

    We also made it so more HP could be absorbed through Drain II.
  • Ninja
    Ever since the enmity adjustments that took place in the March version update, ninja has been lacking the means to generate enmity, so we added an enmity bonus to Utsusemi while under the effect of Yonin.

    Additionally, we reduced the casting time of Migawari so that it can be used in time for severe attacks.
  • Summoner
    It’s now possible to increase the effect of the job point category “Astral Flow Effect”.
  • Corsair
    We added “Naturalist’s Roll” and “Runeist’s Roll” as Phantom Rolls for geomancer and rune fencer. The former increases the duration of enhancing magic received, while the latter increases magic evasion.

    Additionally, we added the new ability, “Crooked Cards.” This ability boosts the effects of the next Phantom Roll by 20% and is similar to bard’s Marcato.

    We also increased the effect of Ninja’s Roll.
  • Puppetmaster
    We added multiple new attachments.

    Amongst these new attachments, the Amplifier is a powerful attachment that focuses on magic bursts. Please be sure to try it out.

    Additionally, we made adjustments to the effect of certain existing attachments. We eliminated the drawback to Drum Magazine, and we also made it possible to gain TP when using Barrage Turbine.

    Furthermore, we increased the effect duration of Overdrive and increased the value of the “Overdrive Effect” job point category.

    Due to the nature of puppetmaster in terms of job characteristics and utility, we need to make job adjustments very carefully so they are not able to accomplish all the roles of other jobs by themselves.

    We understand that there have been many requests to make it so puppetmaster can function better in parties, and we are continuing to look into adjustments for this.
Trust Initiative

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(35:45～)

Semih Lafihna, Halver, Zeid II, and Lion II have been added as alter egos. By progressing through Rhapsodies of Vana’diel you will be able to call them forth. The behavior for Zeid II and Lion II have been adjusted and they will move more simply compared to their original alter egos.

Additionally, alter egos can now be called forth in high-tier mission battlefields, Voidwatch, and Wanted Battles.

Furthermore, some of the attributes on all alter egos and fellows will now increase when the player is wearing item level equipment. They can now help much more when fighting against strong foe.

Following these changes, as a part of balancing adjustment, we decreased Kukki-Chebukki’s enfeebling magic a little bit; however, we adjusted this so that you shouldn’t notice much difference when wearing item level equipment.
Unity Concord

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(40:37～)
  • Unity Leader Alter Ego
    We introduced a new Unity leader alter ego system. If your personal evaluation is greater than a fixed number during the Unity ranking tabulation period, you will be able to call forth your Unity leader.

    Unity leaders will have improved attributes based on the Unity ranking held at the time of summoning.
  • Unity Wanted
    We reduced the Unity points required to take on Unity Wanted objectives. You can now call forth alter egos for Unity Wanted, so please try it out.
Records of Eminence

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(45:42～)

We were able to expand the amount of information that can be stored on a character, so we have doubled the amount of objectives you can undertake simultaneously.

Additionally, we have introduced new objectives, and also made adjustments to limited-time challenges.

Previously, we limited the time in order to have more players play simultaneously; however, since there are players that play during various times, we wanted to make sure everyone can enjoy this content, and as such we made adjustments so that some types of limited-time objectives can be constantly held.
Mog House Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(51:45～)

Mog houses can now be expanded to two stories.
On the second floor, you can place furnishings in areas you couldn’t on the first floor. There are more locations in which you can place wall furnishings. With these changes you can enjoy decorating your interiors more freely.

Additionally, you will be able access Mog Safe 2 by constructing the second story. You may use this similar to the regular Mog Safe, as well as use furnishings set inside the Mog Safe 2, allowing a maximum of up to 160 furnishings total to be used.

We have made other various improvements, such as a camera feature which can now pass through furnishings freely, and two types of controls to select from while in layout mode, so please have fun decorating your room.
Item-related

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(1:09:12～)

New synthesis recipes have been added which include new item level 119 gear. Please check these out as part of your new gear options.

Additionally, synthesis will now offer a chance to skill up even when your current synthesis skill level exceeds the recipe’s skill level.

The difficulty for synthesis has been eased, so we would like players who never tried synthesis to use this opportunity to try it out.
Quality-of-life Improvements

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(1:14:34～)

*The video introduces in-game footage of a new feature to display AoE indicators.

We have introduced a new feature to visually display AoEs. Enabling this feature will provide a visual indicator of the AoE for various actions.

Currently, this feature only displays actions with circular areas of effect.
There are currently no plans for fan-shaped AoE indicators.
Promotions and Campaigns I

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(1:23:01～)
  • May Login Campaign
    There were many players who could not receive login points due to the login issues and login congestions after the version update on May 13, therefore we have extended the duration in which you can receive the login points to Thursday, June 4 at 7:00 a.m. (PDT).

    The login point exchange period has not changed, and it is still set to end on Tuesday, June 9 at 7:00 a.m. (PDT), so make sure to exchange by then.
  • Vana’diel The Goddess’s Gala
    We currently have the following campaigns underway in Vana’diel to show our appreciation to those who continued support.
    • Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign
      Adventurers who are currently taking a break can login for free during this time.
      From Friday, May 15, 2015 at 2:00 a.m. (PDT) to Monday, May 25 at the same hour.

      Please see the Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign page for more details.
    • Discount Campaign
      Throughout the campaign, downloadable versions of the “Seekers of Adoulin” expansion pack and the FINAL FANTASY XI: Ultimate Collection Seekers Edition, together with the world transfer service, are available at discounted prices.


      From Friday, May 1, 2015 at 12:00 a.m. (PDT) to Monday, June 1 at the same hour.

      Please see the Discount Campaign page for more details.

    You can easily enjoy Rhapsodies of Vana’diel, so please use this opportunity to head on over to Vana’diel.
  • 13th Anniversary Campaign
    May 16, 2015 marks the thirteenth anniversary of FINAL FANTASY XI. As a token of appreciation for the continued support of our adventurers, we have the following campaigns underway.
    • Adventurer Appreciation Campaign 2015
      Once again, the moogles from the three nations are here with various commemorative items and trinkets waiting for everyone. Additionally, an event is underway where you get to fight a behemoth from another dimension.

      From Saturday, May 16, 2015 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) to Tuesday, June 2 at the same hour.
    • Super Kupower Mog Tablet Campaign
      Normally, all eleven mog tablets grant three randomly-selected Super Kupowers, but during this campaign the tablets will grant all eleven Super Kupowers!

      From Saturday, May 16, 2015 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) to Tuesday, June 2 at the same hour.
    • 13th Vana’versary Mog Bonanza
      In celebration of thirteen years of Vana’diel, Mog Bonanza is underway!
      The moogles have amassed piles of phenomenal prizes this year. Don’t miss out on a chance to win Vagary equipment, skirmish stones required for engraving arcane glyptics, as well as augmented Pulse Panoplia equipment sets and a bevy of other goodies!


      Mog Bonanza Marbles Sales Period: From Saturday, May 16, 2015 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) to Tuesday, June 16 at the same hour.

    Please click here for details on each campaign
Promotions and Campaigns II


Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(1:30:46～)
  • Rhapsodies of Vana’diel Ending Song
    We’ll be creating an ending song for the final chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana’diel that is set to be implemented in November.

    To make this really special, we are in the midst of planning an event where users can participate in the Vana’diel March, which will be used as the chorus portion of the ending song.

    We’re planning to use every voice that we receive and we will be announcing more details on June 1st via the Goddess’s Gala website! Stay tuned and get ready to participate!
Conclusion

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
I hope you are all having a great time with the first chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana’diel.

The next version update is scheduled to take place in June, and we are planning to add some new content as well as focus on adjustments.

Afterward, we will be holding our next large-scale version update that will introduce the second chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana’diel in July. I hope you are looking forward to it!

See you during the next Freshly Picked Vana’diel!

title: Jun 25, 2015 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • New quests have been added.
    • The Weatherspoon War
      Attachment 11227
      Players must speak to Zaffeld in Eastern Adoulin (J-8) after meeting the following requirements in order to receive the quest.
      • Have completed the quest The Weatherspoon Inquisition.
      • Be of Adoulin fame rank 3 or greater.
      Quote:
      The final showdown with the Velkk is nigh. Will the exorcists and the Blackthorn Coven be able to set aside their differences to vanquish that which threatens them both?
    • A Thirst Before Time
      Attachment 11228
      Players must speak to Roskin in Eastern Adoulin (H-8) after meeting the following requirements in order to receive the quest.
      • Have completed the quest A Thirst for Eternity and have Roskin's volume available for viewing in Celennia Memorial Library.
      • Have completed the quest The Curious Case of Melvien.
      Quote:
      A demon in black and red makes a fateful appearance that will alter the course of several Adoulinians' lives, while a hidden part of the Scouts' Coalition's maester Margret's past will finally be brought to light
    • Thanks for All the Fish
      Attachment 11229
      Players must speak to Jourdenaux in Rabao (F-8) after meeting the following requirements in order to receive the quest.
      • Be in possession of Lu Shang's fishing rod.
      • Have completed the Records of Eminence objective First Step Forward
      Quote:
      Just who is this perverted old man, and why does he want all these fish?
    • Fish Favor the Bold
      Attachment 11230
      Players must speak to Irmilant in Rabao (G-7) after meeting the following requirements in order to receive the quest.
      • Be in possession of the Ebisu Fishing Rod
      • Have fished up at least 100 types of catches by one's own hand*
        * Only catches reeled in after the June 2015 version update will be counted.
      • Have installed and registered the following content.
        Rise of the Zilart / Chains of Promathia / Treasures of Aht Urhgan / Wings of the Goddess / Seekers of Adoulin / Scars of Abyssea
      Quote:
      An exalted fisherman has come to offer a challenge!
    • Doctor Chacharoon
      Attachment 11231
      Players must enter their Mog Garden after meeting the following requirements in order to receive the quest.
      • Be in possession of the "Sakura's Excellent Adventure" key item.
  • The difficult of the following quests has been adjusted.
    • The Gustaberg Tour
      Players must now be in a party of two characters below level 15 instead of six characters below level 5 to complete the quest.
      * Alter egos and fellows do not count toward the requirements.
    • The Kuftal Tour
      Players must now be in a party of two characters below level 40 instead of six characters below level 40 to complete the quest.
      * Alter egos and fellows do not count toward the requirements.
    • The "Eco-Warrior" series of quests.
      • Alter egos may now be called forth.
      • The level limitation has been increased from 20 to 25.
      • The NPC at the dungeon entrance will now describe where the goal is located.
    • The quest log entries for Wrath of the Opo-opos and Wandering Souls have been adjusted.
    • The Warhors Footprints in the quests Promotion: Superior Private and Promotion: Corporal now appear on wide scan and have visible effects to make them better stand out.
  • Mog Houses have undergone the following adjustments.
    • The "Select an area to exit to" option that displays when exiting one's Mog House now displays at the bottom of the dialog box.
    • The "None for now" option that displays when interacting with the Symphonic Curator now displays at the top of the dialog box.
  • Mog Gardens have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Monster Rearing rank can now be increased to 5, and has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
      • Two new types of creatures may be reared.
        Attachment 11232 Attachment 11233
      • New Chacharoon Cheer effects have been added.
      • Up to three creatures may be reared at once.
      • The following items may now be given to creatures as feed.
        Blue Pondweed / Red Pondweed / Date / Royal Grape / Burdock / Popoto / Walnut / Yellow Ginseng /
        Elixir / Dragon Meat / Tavnazian Liver / Bibiki Urchin / Dragon Fruit / Kitron / Persikos / Reishi Mushroom /
        Agaricus / Coral Fungus / Sobbing Fungus
  • Escha – Zi'Tah has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • Experience point acquisition while in a party has been adjusted to be the same as in Seekers of Adoulin areas. As a result, experience point gains while in a party have been increased.
    • A new key items that will increase the maximum amount of Escha silt and beads that may be held at once has been added. This item may be purchased with Escha silt.
    • Monster respawn rate will now increase based on the amount of time it takes to vanquish them.
    • The number of monsters has been increased.
    • The monsters summoned by Muut will now grant experience.
    • The amount of Escha beads obtained by vanquishing notorious monsters has been increased.
  • Unity Concord has undergone the following adjustments.
    • Unity leaders will now participate in Unity chat.
      * Messages sent by Unity leaders will not display during certain battle content or cutscenes.
    • New Wanted objectives have been added.
      • Area
        Bostaunieux Oubliette
        Garbage Gel
        Attachment 11234
        Sea Serpent Grotto
        Bakunawa
        Attachment 11235
        The Temple of Uggalepih
        Azure-toothed Clawberry
        Attachment 11236
        Quicksand Cave
        Centurio XX-I
        Attachment 11237
        Wajaom Woodlands
        Kubool Ja's Mhuufya
        Attachment 11238
        Alzadaal Undersea Ruins
        Vidmapire
        Attachment 11239
  • New Records of Eminence objectives have been added.
  • Home points have been added to Toraimorai Canal.
  • New conquest rewards have been added.
  • Fishing has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The content of the quest Fisherman's Heart has been adjusted.
      • Katsunaga has been relocated from H-9 to G-10.
      • Katsunaga will now tell players about the types of catches they have reeled in once that have completed the quest.
        Attachment 11240

        Attachment 11241
        * Only catches reeled in after the June 2015 version update will be counted.
    • New catches have been added to the following areas.
      Cape Terrigan / Silver Sea Route / Abyssea – Miseraux / Cirdas Caverns / Moh Gates / Dho Gates
    • The rate of fishing skill gains has been adjusted.
    • The chance of successfully reeling in a catch has been adjusted.
    • The chance of reeling in fish that favor the type of bait currently used now increases if the player's fishing skill is 20 or higher.
    • The maximum amount of time required for a catch to bight has been decreased from 15 seconds to 13 seconds.
    • Beneficial effects granted by the phase of the moon have been increased.
    • Additional fish can be used in the quest Inside the Belly.
  • Players in possession of the key item Rhapsody in Azure and have proceeded to a certain point in Assault and mission conter may now purchase the following key items from Curio Vendor Moogles stationed in the three nations.
    • Assault
      PFC Wildcat Badge / SP Wildcat Badge / LC Wildcat Badge / C Wildcat Badge /
      S Wildcat Badge / SM Wildcat Badge / SL Wildcat Badge / FL Wildcat Badge
      *Players must be in possession of the previous rank's wildcat badge and have met the prerequisites for undertaking the appropriate promotion quest in order to purchase these items.
    • Seekers of Adoulin missions
      "Card Jailor Teodor"
      * Players must have met the prerequisites for receiving the mission To the Victor in order to purchase this item.
    Purchasing these items enable players to skip the promotion quests (for Assault) and the applicable minigame (for the Seekers of Adoulin mission)

Battle-related

  • Geas Fete has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • A mechanic has been added that provides a chance for a different notorious monster to spawn in the place of a previous monster that has been defeated.
    • The scaling escha silt cost of the tribulens key item has been adjusted.
    • The following grisly trinkets' item may now be purchased for five of the appropriate item instead of ten.
      Ionos's webbing / Sandy's lasher / Nosoi's feather
      Brittilis's ring / Kamohoalii's fin / Umdhlebi's flower
    • Food and status enhancements will no longer disappear when Geas Fete begins.
    • The number of escha beads earned from defeating notorious monsters has been increased.
  • The following adjustments have been made to Alluvion Skirmishes in Yorcia Weald (U).
    • It is now possible to exchange mellidopt wings for the following items.
      Snowslit Stone / Leafslit Stone / Snowtip Stone / Leaftip Stone / Snowdim Stone / Leafdim Stone /
      Snoworb Stone / Leaforb Stone / Duskslit Stone / Dusktip Stone / Duskdim Stone / Duskorb Stone /
      Snowslit Stone +1 / Leafslit Stone +1 / Snowtip Stone +1 / Leaftip Stone +1 / Snowdim Stone +1 /
      Leafdim Stone +1 / Snoworb Stone +1 / Leaforb Stone +1 / Duskslit Stone +1 / Dusktip Stone +1 /
      Duskdim Stone +1 / Duskorb Stone +1 / Snowslit Stone +2 / Leafslit Stone +2 / Snowtip Stone +2 /
      Leaftip Stone +2 / Snowdim Stone +2 / Leafdim Stone +2 / Snoworb Stone +2 / Leaforb Stone +2 /
      Duskslit Stone +2 / Dusktip Stone +2 / Duskdim Stone +2 / Duskorb Stone +2
    • Balamor's Adumbration and Strongholds can no longer be destroyed by familiars' attacks.
  • The Trust Initiative has undergone the following adjustments.
    • New alter egos have been added.
      Attachment 11242
    • It is now possible to call forth alter egos for the following content.
      ★The Moonlit Path / ★Waking the Beast / ★Waking Dreams / Delve / Incursion
    • The action logic of certain alter egos has been adjusted and will prioritize curing the following status ailments.
      Doom / Sleep
    • The following alter egos have had their action logic adjusted.
      • Tenzen
        Tenzen will now use the following abilities.
        Third Eye / Hasso / Meditate / Hagakure
      • Gadalar
        Gadalar's spellcasting delay has been reduced.
  • Adventuring Fellows have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Signal Pearls
      • Use delay has been reduced from 30 seconds to 10 seconds.
    • Tactics Pearls
      • Use delay has been reduced from 30 seconds to 10 seconds.
      • Reuse delay has been reduced from 10 minutes to 3 minutes.
      • The max charges have been increased from 4 to 50.
  • New high-tier mission battlefields have been added.
    ★The Moonlit Path / ★Waking the Beast / ★Waking Dreams
    Attachment 11243
    Attachment 11244
    Attachment 11245
    • Joining the fray
      The key items required to participate in these battlefields can be acquired from the following NPCs in exchange for merit points.
      • Trisvain in Northern San d'Oria (J-7)
      • Raving Opossum in Port Bastok (J-11)
      • Mimble-Pimble in Port Windurst (L-5)
    • Required Key Items
      <table width="540"><tr><td width="30%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Battlefield</td><td width="45%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Key Item</td><td width="25%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Number of Merit Points Required</td></tr><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="#c6e9ef">★The Moonlit Path</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Moonlit Path phantom gem</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3" rowspan="3">15</td></tr><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="#c6e9ef">★Waking the Beast</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Waking the Beast phantom gem</td></tr><tr><td align="center" bgcolor="#c6e9ef">★Waking Dreams</td><td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Waking Dreams phantom gem</td></tr></table>

    • Spoils
      Spoils are rewarded both for vanquishing the boss and clearing the battlefield, and include items needed for reforging artifact and relic armor in addition to equipment unique to each battlefield.
      • The following Chapters of Rem's Tale can be obtained from the following battlefields.
        <table width="360"> <tr> <td width="50.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Rem's Tale</td> <td width="50.0%" align="center" bgcolor="#a8d0d7">Obtained from</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Rem's Tale Chapter 6</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">★The Moonlit Path</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Rem's Tale Chapter 7</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#f5fafb">★Waking the Beast</td> </tr> <tr> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Rem's Tale Chapter 8</td> <td align="center" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">★Waking Dreams</td> </tr></table>
  • Jobs have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Monk
      Attachment 11246
      • The Footwork ability has undergone the following adjustments.
        • Footwork no longer makes kicks the primary mode of attack. Instead, autoattacks will increase the chance of kicking while Footwork is in effect.
        • Footwork effect duration has been reduced from 300 seconds to 60 seconds.
          *The effect footwork has on particular weaponskills remains unchanged.
    • Beastmaster

Resolved Issues

  • Various issues when certain incorrect help text and NPC dialogue.
  • The issue wherein the cutscenes for the Rhapsodies of Vana'diel mission Impurity were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein progressing past the Rhapsodies of Vana'diel mission At the Heavens' Door then changing nationalist and completing mission 2-3 would cause the player's progress through Rhapsodies of Vana'diel to reset.
  • The issue with event cutscenes that enable players to re-receive rewards in the Seekers of Adoulin missions The Light of Dawn Comes and Royal Blessings would occasionally improperly display error messages even when the play has successfully been rewarded with an item.
  • The issue with the Seekers of Adoulin mission Watery Grave wherein a defeat messasge would improperly display if an alter ego was knocked out even if the player successfully won the battle.
  • The issue with the quest All the Way to the Bank wheren Tuffle-Buffle's appearance would occasionally change during cutscenes.
  • The issue wherein certain sections of cutscenes in the quest The Good, the Bad, the Clement were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein season event objects would occasionally fail to display properly during cutscenes in the quest Chacharoon's Cheer.
  • The issue with coalition assignments wherein receiving the option to select two or more types of assignments, only completing one, and going to receive one's rewards would cause a dialog box regarding rewards for assignments that have not been completed to appear.
  • The issue wherein background music would not play after viewing cutscenes in the quest Howl from the Heavens.
  • The issue wherein background music would not play after viewing cutscenes in the quest Howl from the Heavens when viewed via the goblin footprints in West Sarutabaruta [S].
  • The issue with the battle in the quest Forging a New Myth wherein Barlahn would not use specific weapon skills in the time allotted.
  • The issue wherein snapweed in Escha – Zi'tah wherein snapweeds would use improper detection methods.
  • The issue with Geas Fete wherein spawning a notorious monster via certain ??? targets would not cause said monsters' HP to vary with the number of party members.
  • The issue with Geas Fete wherein using Arise would not cause the effect of reraise to be granted.
  • The issue with Geas Fete wherein Alpuachra, Bucca, and Puca would return to the same coordinates when removed from combat.
  • The issue with skirmishes in Yorcia Weald [U] wherein a familiar delivering the killing blow on Balamor's Adumbration would occasionally cause no spoils to drop.
  • The issue with Salvage wherein equipment restrictions were occasionally not immediately removed.
  • The issue with Salvage wherein disconnecting from the server and reconnecting would occasionally cause the player to be unable to progress properly.
  • The issue wherein players would be able to enter Salvage and Nysul Isle while in possession of imbued items in the Mog Satchel, Mog Sack, or Mog Case.
  • The issue with Ballista and Conflict where area of effect display functionality could not be enabled.
  • The issue with Monstrosity wherein the case time of the ninjutsu Migawari was incorrect.
  • The issue with monstrosity wherein trading slime or spriggan fetishes to Suibhne would occasionally cause them not to immediately show up in the customization list.
  • The issue wherein the status ailment Plague was unable to be removed by weapon skills or abilities.
  • The issue with the Blood Pact: Rage Rolling Thunder wherein its "En-" effect was weaker than that granted by other similar Blood Pacts.
  • The issue wherein using the white magic spell Inundation would cause an enhancement magic message to display.
  • The issue with the job point category Spur Effect wherein the damage bonus was listed as 3%.
    * The correct value is 3.
  • The issue with the Soulsoother C-1000 automaton wherein it would attempt to continuously attempt to provide beneficial effects to non-combat alter egos and perform no other action when a Water Maneuver is in effect.
  • The issue with the dark magic spells Drain and Aspir wherein the magic busy log would fail to display when used as part of a magic burst and resisted.
  • The issue wherein a result of XI on a phantom roll would occasionally cause the recast delay to be improperly calculated.
  • The issue wherein the effects of the summoner job point category Blood Pact Damage were incorrect.
  • The issue with alter egos wherein alter egos were unable to be healed or given beneficial effects when battle has ended after participating in Voidwatch, Wanted battles, or Geas Fete.
  • The issue with level restricted content wherein "spikes" type spells were not correctly damaging alter egos.
  • The issue wherein Semih Lafihna's alter ego's behavior was incorrect.
  • The issue wherein equipping a nibiru harp, blurred harp, or blurred harp +1 and attempting to sing a song would display an improper effect radius.
  • The issue wherein the actual value of physical damage reduction effects granted by equipment with a "physical damage taken -3%" or "physical damage taken -4%" attribute would slightly vary.
  • The issue wherein attempt to fix one's appearance at an improper time, such as immediately after changing jobs, would cause the style lock function to be set to "on" in the Config submenu only.
  • The issue wherein when a player invited to the second floor of a Mog House attempted to leave, the option "Chang Floors" would appear even when the proper conditions were not met.
  • The issue wherein updating the content of the Record of Eminence objective list would cause the cursor to reset to the top.
  • The issue with the emote list wherein the cursor location would fail to be remembered.
  • The issue wherein changing areas with the Adventuring Primer open would occasionally cause it to no logner display.
  • The issue wherein searching for linkshells via /itemsearch would not function properly.

PlayStation 2 Only
  • The issue wherein the screen would go black and become unresponsive in the following missions and quests.
    When Angels Fall / Promotion: Second Lieutenant / Embers of His Past / Seeing Blood-red / Howl from the Heavens / A Manifest Problem / A Feast for Gnats / Dungeons and Dancers / Tree Grafting / Friction and Fissures / To the Victor...
  • The issue with Monstrosity wherein area of effect display was enabled.
  • The issue wherein players would occasionally experience slowdowns in their Mog House if they held a certain number of items or more.
  • The issue wherein the cursor would occasionally stop functioning properly after turning on time stamps from the Config submenu.

Known Issues

  • Players will occasionally become stuck on terrain in certain areas of Sih Gates.
  • In the high-tier battlefield The Savage, spoils will occasionally fail to drop if a familiar delivers the killing blow.
  • When fishing, the player will appear to stop moving when reeling in a fish for an extending period of time would .
  • Healer-type alter egos will occasionally stop curing status ailments when a party member is knocked out.
  • In the Eco-Warrior series of quests, alter egos will occasionally not be dismissed when level restrictions are removed.
    * Alter egos who fail to be dismissed in thie way will retain their lower level attributes. Dismissing them manually and calling them forth again will resolve this issue.

PlayStation 2 Only
  • The screen will black out and become unresponsive in the quest In a Haze of Glory.

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 19  Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the June version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui

Hello, everyone.
Matsui here.

Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 19.
For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I’ve created this digest of what was discussed.

<iframe width="640" height="390" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/tq5mtHjf6VA" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Adoulin Quests
  • Alter Ego Quests
  • Difficulty Adjustments for Existing Quests
  • High-tier Avatar Battles
  • Escha – Zi'tah Adjustments
  • Geas Fete Adjustments
  • Unity Wanted
  • Unity Concord
  • Alter Egos and Adventuring Fellows
  • Job Adjustments
  • Item-related
  • Fishing Adjustments
  • Lu Shang’s Rod and Ebisu Rod Enhancement Quests
  • /Sitchair Emote
  • Mog Gardens
  • Quality-of-life Improvements
  • Ongoing Events
  • Conclusion
Adoulin Quests

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(1:27～)

We added the quests “The Weatherspoon War” and “A Thirst Before Time” which are the final portions of the quest lines that began with “Thorn in the Side” and “A Thirst for the Ages.”

Each quest have a special event battle and special equipment rewards available, so please check them out if you have yet to do so.
Alter Ego Quests

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(4:36～)

We added a quest to obtain an alter ego of one of the famous Mithran trackers, Shikaree Z. We hope you venture out to obtain this alter ego as we’ve prepared a special cutscene for this.

Shikaree Z is a dragoon-type alter ego that continues to use Jump while wielding a polearm. In addition to skill chaining with players, she will also give party support in the form of cures and haste.

While we do not have any plans at the moment for the other two Mithran trackers, if the demand is large enough, I can talk to the lead again.
Difficulty Adjustments for Existing Quests

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(6:05～)

  • The Gustaberg/Kuftal Tour
    These quests were initially created uniquely for an MMO, but since there are many that cannot clear these due to not meeting the job level requirements, we increased the level needed to participate and lowered the required number of party members.
  • Eco-Warrior Rewards
    When we originally implemented these quests they were quite challenging, and since you weren’t able to cancel them, there are many who have these in their quest log.

    We made adjustments that increased the level cap to level 25, and you can also call forth alter egos, so it’s become easier to clear this content with smaller groups. Please use this opportunity to take on this content.
  • Wrath of the Opo-opos/Wandering Souls
    These are quests that have an extremely low amount of hints, so we changed the quest log entries to add more information.
  • Promotion: Superior Private/Promotion: Corporal
    We made adjustments so that you can now search for and find the “Warhorse Footprint” needed for these quests with a smaller amount of people.

    Along with adding an effect to make it more noticeable, it also now appears on wide scan and radar.
High-tier Avatar Battlefields

Quote:
(10:30～)

We added new high-tier avatar battlefields where you can challenge stronger versions of Fenrir, Carbuncle, and Diabolos.

We’ve eliminated some of the mechanics from Carbuncle and Diabolos, and made adjustments to make this a simple, straightforward battle.

We were thinking about the cost of Phantom Gems for quite a bit, but as we expect congestion since this is just being implemented, we set the cost at 15 merit points. We’ll be keeping an eye on this and we plan to make adjustments to the cost in the future similar to the other high-tier avatar battlefields.
Escha – Zi’tah

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(13:18～)

We made various adjustments so that you could earn experience points and Escha silts more easily.

We added more monsters geared towards level 99 and above players, and we also added a system that shortens the respawn time of monsters down to 1 minute based on the rate in which they are eliminated. This has made it so the area will not be empty of monsters.

Additionally, *we eased the modifiers on experience point gains while battling as a party in this zone, and when you fight against monsters as a party you will earn more experience points and Escha silt.
Geas Fete Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(15:25～)

In order to make it easier to challenge Geas Fete, we made adjustments to the cost of Tribulens. When purchasing these key items continuously in a short amount of time, the price will not increase for the first three you buy, and the range in which it increases afterwards has been decreased.

Additionally, we added a system that will spawn an additional notorious monster at a set rate when you successfully defeating high-tier notorious monsters.

Furthermore, we increased the amount of Escha beads you can obtain from notorious monsters and also make it possible to obtain experience points from the monsters the notorious monster “Muut” summons. These adjustments have made it easier to earn the various points that are available in this content.
Unity Wanted

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(18:25～)

The drops of the new Wanted targets have their stats fashioned after the original equipment that dropped from the original notorious monsters, so please try and hunt them down.

As a side note, we originally planned on adding a new notorious monster similar to the once popular Unstable Cluster that dropped the Soboro Sukehiro; however, there was some incompatibility between the structure of Riverne and the Wanted system, and we found that it would be difficult to implement.

Since there have been many requests in the past for an upgraded version of the Soboro Sukehiro, we will be looking into a way to introduce this.
Unity Concord

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(20:52～)

We implemented a system where the Unity leaders will occasionally pop into Unity chat to say something. Each NPC has their very own unique dialogue, so please keep an eye out for it.

This feature has been turned off during certain content and battles, however, as it would be kind of odd if Maat started talking in Unity chat while you are fighting him for the limit break battle.
Alter Egos/Adventuring Fellow

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(22:27～)

We expanded the content that allows alter egos to be called forth. It’s now possible to use alter egos in the newly added high-tier avatar battles, Delve, Incursion, and Eco-warrior.

We made adjustments to the use delay, reuse delay, and max charges for both the Signal Pearl and Tactics Pearl making it easier to summon adventuring fellows.

We’re aware of all of the various requests for adventuring fellows that have been posted, but we wanted to first make adjustments so that they could be utilized more easily.

We’ll be looking into adjustments for other facets of adventuring fellows for the future.
Job Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(26:42～)
  • Monk
    We changed the effect of Footwork and made it into an ability that boosts the rate of kick attacks when auto-attacking. Footwork was originally implemented with the objective of reducing the amount of TP given to enemies; however, with the recent change in battle style, the opportunities to use this were scarce, so we changed it into a more practical effect.
  • Beastmaster
    We added six new familiars (8 if you include HQ versions). We also added a text command for the “Ready” ability. Check out the June version update information for details on this new text command.
  • Ranger
    We changed the effect of Flashy Shot for battles post-level 99. We’ve made it so the ranged accuracy and ranged attack are increased based on the difference between the target and the player.

    Additionally, we made it so Eagle Eye Shot now ignores Blink and Shadow Images. This adjustment was only made to the Eagle Eye Shot used by players and automatons, and you will still be able to avoid this attack when it is used by a monster.
  • Dragoon
    Since there were occasions that effect of equipment bonuses were not factored into wyvern breath due to the delay generated through /equipset, we increased the activation time for certain breath abilities by .25 seconds.
  • Blue mage
    We added new blue magic spells and traits.

    Of the new spells, we added in abilities used by elementals that have dual elements as well as those used by Velkk. Be sure to check out the new traits too.
  • Puppetmaster
    We increased the maximum HP of automatons.

    By combining attachments in the past it was possible to have a large amount of durability on your automaton; however, when using various attachments now that give good effects and to put maneuver effects to use, durability is being sought after. Due to this we decided to increase automaton’s survivability.

    Additionally, we made adjustments to the effect duration and effect amount of Repair which makes it possible to recover a larger amount of HP in a short amount of time. It’s now easier to support your automaton when suddenly taking a large amount of damage.
Item-related

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(38:22～)

We made it possible to exchange mellidopt wings for the various kind of stones available.

Additionally, we made it possible to purchase pet foods, broths, and automaton attachments from NPC vendors. The attachments available from the NPC will differ based on the player’s puppetmaster level.

The prices of these items have been set a bit higher so that it’s cheaper when making them through synthesis.
Fishing Adjustments

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(42:51～)

We increased the rate of fishing skill gains. Additionally, we increased the chance of reeling in a catch and cases where you don’t reeling a catch in have been reduced. This is a great opportunity to try your hand at fishing if you have yet to try it out.

Furthermore, the beneficial effects given by the phase of the moon have been enhanced. We previously did not release information about this, but new moons and full moons give an effect to fishing, and the time it takes to reel in a catch from when you initiate fishing is reduced.
Lu Shang’s Fishing Rod/Ebisu Fishing Rod Enhancement Quest

*The video shows off gameplay introducing the special effects of the rods and Katsunaga’s UI.

Quote:
We added content geared towards players who possess a Lu Shang’s Fishing Rod and an Ebisu Fishing Rod. We’ve also added in new catches and fishing-related objectives to Records of Eminence.

Furthermore, Katsunaga will now tell you about the types of catches you’ve reeled in after you complete the “Fisherman’s Heart” quest. Check out the version update information for details. We made it so the NPC will tell you information even if you do not trade him an item, and we relocated him right outside the boat boarding area so you can use this NPC more easily.
/Sitchair Emote

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(56:00～)

*The video introduce the new emotes.

We added an emote that lets you pull out a chair and sit in it. Similar to /sit, you can use certain emotes while you are sitting in your chair.

You’ll automatically have access to this emote, but by using special items available through conquest points, you will be able to sit in four different types of chairs. We plan on adding other types of chairs in the future.
Mog Garden

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(70:25～)

We unlocked rank 5 for monster rearing. We also made it possible to rear bugards and adamantoise, and you can now rear three monsters at the same time.
Quality-of-life Improvements

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(72:55～)

*The video introduces newly added items to the configuration; however, these will be implemented in the next version update.

We made it possible to lock the appearance of ranged weapons with the lockstyle feature.

Additionally, we’ve received requests for name plates not to enlarge when the area of effect display is shown, so we added a text command to turn this off.
Ongoing Events

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(77:00～)

Mosaic Art Project
As a part of the Goddess’s Gala, we are collecting screenshots of Vana’diel taken by players and creating a mosaic out of them. Please send in your screenshots that show your memories of Vana’diel!

The details on this event can be found here.
Conclusion

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
The next version update is slated for an August release.

The August version update is a major one, and we will be adding the second chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana’diel. There will be a new area as well as new battle content, so I hope you are all looking forward to it!

See you during the next Freshly Picked Vana’diel!

title: Aug 5, 2015 (JST) Version Update
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/DKvAyTEYlYk" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>
  • Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • The second chapter in Rhapsodies of Vana'diel has been added
    Attachment 11357
    • Players must fulfill the following prerequisites to receive the first mission.
      • Completion of the Rhapsodies of Vana'diel Chapter 1 mission Ring My Bell.
        * The mission may not be available depending on the character's progress in the Chains of Promathia missions.
        * Registration of the Rise of the Zilart, Treasures of Aht Urhgan, and Wings of the Goddess expansion disks are required to make further mission progress.
  • Certain key items obtainable through the Rhapsodies of Vana'diel Chapter 2 missions will make adventuring in Vana'diel even easier than before.
    Read on for details.
  • A new area, Escha – Ru'Aun, has been added.
    Attachment 11358
    Escha – Ru'Aun will become available to players through the progression of Chapter 2 of Rhapsodies of Vana'diel, and contains foes and notorious monsters even more fearsome than those found in Escha - Zi'tah. Escha – Ru'aun serves not only as a stage for Rhapsodies of Vana'diel to play out, but also a place for players to participate in battle content such as Geas Fete and engage in more peaceful activities such as fishing and gathering.
    • Escha Silt
      Escha silt can be earned from vanquishing regular and notorious monsters in Escha – Ru'Aun and can be used in the following ways.
      Teleportation in Escha areas /
      Purchasing of beneficial effects active in Escha areas /
      Purchasing of temporary items usable in Escha areas /
      Purchasing of key items and augments specific equipment
    • Escha Beads
      Escha beads can be earned from vanquishing notorious monsters in Escha – Ru'Aun and can be exchanged for materials used to augment equipment.
    • Vorseals
      Players will be able to purchase new types of vorseals by vanquishing notorious monsters in Escha – Ru'Aun. These new vorseals may be used in both Escha areas, and may be activated by speaking with Dremi in Escha – Ru'Aun (H-11) in exchange for escha silt. Vorseals will activate upon entering Escha – Ru'Aun and last for a total of sixty minutes (Earth time)
      * Escha silt payments are only required upon first receiving the vorseal. No silt is consumed upon activation.
      * Once sixty minutes has passed, players may reactivate the vorseals by changing areas and then returning.
    • Transporation Via Eschan Portals
      Examining the ??? targets that appear throughout Escha – Ru'Aun will provide players with a temporary item known as an eschan droplet*.
      Eschan droplets can be used to teleport players from eschan portals one through fifteen in numerical order. Once an eschan portal has been examined, players may be teleport to it at any time for an eschan silt fee.
      * Players may only possess one eschan droplet at a time.
  • A new quests, A Barrel of Laughs, has been added.
    Attachment 11360
    • To receive the quest, players must have completed the quest To Laugh Is to Love, wait for one Vana'diel day to pass, and speak with the Mischief Marker in Western Adoulin (J-11).
  • Treasure Caskets have been added to Escha – Zi'Tah and Escha – Ru'Aun.
  • The number of grimslights appeared in Escha – Zi'Tah has been increased.
  • Unity Concord has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • Yoran-Oran and Sylvie now lead their own new Unities.
    • The minimum number of players required to participate in Wanted battles has been decreased from three to one.
    • The new Unity leaders have their own Unity information, Unity rankings, and Unity chat messages.
    • The maximum attribute values of Unity leader alter egos obtained via Unity rankings have been increased.
    • The amount of Unity accolades required for changing Unities has been adjusted.
  • Records of Eminence have undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • New objectives have been added.
    • The requisite number of enemies that must be vanquished for the following objectives has been increase from five to ten.
      Conflit: Escha – Zi'Tah I through V
    • New items are now obtainable in exchange for sparks of eminence.
      <table width="480" border="0"><tr><td width="30%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Category</td><td width="35%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Item</td><td width="35%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Number of Sparks Required</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Level 99 Equipment</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Eminent Animator II</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">7,000</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Items</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Etched Memory</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">10,000</td></tr></table>
      * The following NPCs sell these new items.
      • Rolandienne in Southern San d'Oria (G-10)
      • Isakoth in Bastok Markets (E-11)
      • Fhelm Jobeizat in Windurst Woods (J-10)
      • Eternal Flame in Western Adoulin (H-11)
  • Campaign has undergone the following adjustment.
    • The default location of the cursor in the dialog box for obtaining op credits has been adjusted.
  • Mog Gardens have undergone the following adjustment.
    • After selecting “Raise a new creature,” the remaining number of creatures that you can bring into your garden will be displayed at the top of the dialog box.
  • The rewards provided from Mog Tablets have been adjusted.
    <table width="420" border="0"><tr><td width="50%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Pre-adjustment</td><td width="50%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Post-adjustment</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Nomad moogle statue</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Nomad moogle statue</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Talaria</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Talaria</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Black beetle blood</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Kupon I-Orche</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Macrocosmic orb</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Macrocosmic orb</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Nomad Moogle Rod</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Nomad Moogle Rod</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Moogle's Largesse</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Moogle's Largesse</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Damascene Cloth</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Invis Ring</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Malboro Fiber</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Sneak Ring</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Oxblood</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Deodorize Ring</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Dragon Meat</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Reraise Ring</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Vile Elixir +1</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Pelican Ring</td></tr></table>
  • Katsunaga in Mhaura (G-10) now displays new types of fish when inquiring about types of fish that the player has reeled in.
  • Homepoints have been added to the following areas.
    Misareaux Coast / Inner Ra'Kaznar
  • New titles have been added.
  • The following quests have been adjusted.
    • Promotion: Sergeant Major / Promotion: First Lieutenant
      The amount of time that must pass to reattempt these quests has been decreased from one Vana'diel day to one minute (Earth time).

Battle-related

  • New battle content, Sinister Reign, has been added.
    Attachment 11363
    Cross blades with memorable characters from Seekers of Adoulin in this twisted arena within the deepest recesses of Eastern Ulbuka.
    • Requirements
      • Have the FINAL FANTASY XI: Seekers of Adoulin expansion installed.
      • Have registered the Seekers of Adoulin expansion content.
      • Have completed all of the Seekers of Adoulin missions.*
        *Players must have viewed the ending scenes.
      • Must be in possession of the "Macabre Simulacrum" key item.*
        *Only characters who have completed all of the required missions can obtain this item.
        *The key item is consumed upon entering the arena. It must be re-obtained in order to fight again.
      • Must be in a party of three to six members.
    • Joining Sinister Reign
      1. Obtaining the key item
        Speak to Malobra in Ra'Kaznar Inner Court (I-8) and exchange 5,000 bayld for the Macabre Simulacrum key item.

      2. Entering the arena
        After all party members have acquired a macabre simulacrum, the party leader can send the entire party to the battle arena by inspecting the Infernal Transposer in Ra'Kaznar Inner Court.
        *If any of the party members does not possess the macabre simulacrum key item, the party will not be able to teleport to the arena.

      3. Participating in Battles
        The battle is composed of three rounds.
        Each round, a new NPC will be randomly selected and enter the ring as an opponent. A time limit of thirty minutes (Earth time) in place for the entire event.

      4. Spoils
        After the battle, speak to Malobra to collect your reward. Each participant can choose from three pieces of equipment each belonging to one of the NPCs who entered the ring, or one synthesis component.
        *Players can also choose to receive 1,000 bayld if none of the other prizes are desirable.
        Attachment 11364
        Attachment 11365
        Attachment 11366
  • New Eschan battle content, Domain Invasion, has been added.
    Attachment 11368
    Take part in dynamic raid battles with notorious monsters who only appear for limited stretches of time. Join forces with adventurers in the area to take down some of the toughest monsters Vana'diel has ever faced.
    • Requirements
      • Have reached level 99.
    • Joining the Fray
      1. Equipping yourself for battle
        During or immediately before the monster's appearance, speak to Affi in Escha - Zi'Tah (F-10) or Dremi in Escha - Ru'Aun (H-11) and obtain an "elvorseal" key item. Once the key item is obtained, it will be possible to teleport directly to the monster's location by speaking to either NPC.
        *Players who are part of a Unity will be able to see notifications of when and where a monster is scheduled to appear.

      2. Participating in Battle
        Attachment 11369
        The notorious monster can only be fought within the designated area. Any number of adventurers can fight together in this non-instanced battle. The battle is won once the monster is defeated.
        *The notorious monster will appear once every three hours (Earth time).
        *After 30 minutes has elapsed, the notorious monster will disappear, but retain its current health the next time it reappears.
        *Defeating smaller monsters in the area will shorten the time required for the notorious monster to reappear.

      3. Rewards
        When the notorious monster is defeated, all characters in the battle area will earn spoils. Additionally, the area where the monster was defeated will enjoy special blessing effects.
        *Players must have at least 2 spaces free in their inventory to claim spoils.
        (At least five spaces may be required if blessings are in effect that increase the amount of loot obtainable in the area.)
  • The following additions have been made to Geas Fete.
    • New key items available in exchange for escha silt have been added.
      * These key items increase the total amount of escha silt and beads that can be carried by a character.
    • New temporary items available in exchange for escha silt have been added.
    • New vorseals available in exchange for escha silt have been added.
  • Zeni Notorious Monsters have undergone the following changes.
    • The cooldown timer for trading a trigger item with the ??? has been shortened from 3 minutes to 1 minute.
  • The Trust initiative undergone the following adjustments.
    • New alter egos have been added.
    • It will now become possible to call forth alter egos in Vagary.
    • Area of effect items now affect alter egos.
    • The following alter egos now enjoy increased enmity generation.
      Curilla / Volker / Trion / Valaineral / Gessho / Mnejing / Rahal / Invincible Shield (UC) / Rughadjeen / Halver / Amchuchu
    • System messages displayed when alter egos cannot be called forth have been adjusted.
    • Appropriate error messages will now display when inviting a character who has called forth alter egos and is in a different area.
  • Merit points have undergone the following adjustments
    • The Attributes category has had its maximum ability increases raised from 45 to 60
    • The Combat Skills category has had its maximum ability increases raised from 56 to 112.
    • The Magic Skills category has had its maximum ability increases raised from 48 to 80.
  • Job points have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Each category's limits have been increased from 10 to 15.
    • The maximum number of points that may be stores at once has been raised from 200 to 350.
    • New gifts have been added.
      Read on to learn more.
  • Jobs have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Red Mage
      The effects of the white magic spell Temper now scale with the enhancing magic skill of the caster.
    • Dark Knight
      The Consume Mana ability is now usable with elemental weapon skills.
    • Beastmaster
      • The effects of Infrasonics used by the following familiars has undergone adjustments.
        Warlike Patrick / Audacious Anna / Lizard Familiar / Coldblood Como
        • Adjustments
          • Enemy evasion has been changed from -25% to -40.
          • Accuracy has been increased.
      • The effects of Hi-Freq Field used by the following familiars has undergone changes.
        Hurler Percival / Panzer Galahad / Beetle Familiar
        • Adjustments
          • Enemy evasion has been changed from -25% to -40.
          • Accuracy has been increased.
    • Summoner
      The recast delay of Avatar's Favor has been decreased from 5 minutes to 30 seconds.
    • Blue Mage
      Blue magic spells learned from elemntals now appear as their own sortable category.
    • Puppetmaster
      • The following animators have been added.
        Eminent Animator II / Divinator II
        *Using these animators will cause automatons to keep their distance from their combat target.
      • The following attachments have been added.
        Tension Spring IV / Heat Capacitor II / Loudspeaker IV /
        Tranquilizer III / Amplifier II / Accelerator IV / Scope III /
        Armor Plate IV / Shock Absorber III / Stabilizer IV / Dynamo III /
        Mana Jammer IV / Auto Repair Kit IV / Mana Tank IV
      • The following attachments have undergone adjustments.
        • Flame Holder
          • The TP bonus has been increased.
        • Heat Capacitor
          • The amount of TP gained has been increased.
          • The required elemental capacity has been reduced from 2 to 1.
        • Ice Maker
          • The amount of magic attack gained has been increased.
        • Replicator
          • The attachment will now produce copy images instead of shadow images.
        • Barrage Turbine
          • The amount of projectiles produced by Barrage has been increased.
          • The required elemental capacity has been reduced from 3 to 2.
        • Economizer
          • The amount of recovered MP has been increased.
        • Tactical Processor
          • The required elemental capacity has been lowered from 2 to 1.
    • Scholar
      The white magic spell Embrava now grants the effect of Flurry on its target.
    • Geomancer
      It is now possible to freely target the area of effect of Geocolure spells.
      Attachment 11372
      • Using the subcursor
        The following commands can be used to manipulate the subcursor.
        *Geomancy spells intended for enemy targets may aggravate nearby enemies even if targeted away from them.
        • PlayStation 2
          Hold the L2 or R2 button while using the directional buttons to move the cursor.

        • Xbox 360
          Hold the LT or RT trigger while using the D-Pad to move the cursor.

        • Keyboard
          Hold the Ctrl or Alt key while using the arrow keys to move the cursor.
      • Changing the subcursor movement speed
        Use the following command lines to adjust the cursor movement speed.
        /groundtargetst [num] *
        *Replace [num] with a number between 1 and 100 to set the movement increment of the subcursor.
    • Rune Fencer
      The effects of the white magic spell Temper now scale with the enhancing magic skill of the caster.

Item-related

  • New methods of enhancing cursed and hexed equipment have been added.
    • Enhancing methods
      1. Synthesizing a cursed item with the appropriate ingredient* can create a more powerful version of the cursed item.
        *The necessary ingredients can be obtained through Escha - Ru'Aun's raid as well as other battle content.
      2. Trade the enhanced cursed item and appropriate abjuration* to Alphollon C Meriard in Northern San d'Oria (L-6) to remove the curse.
        *The new abjurations can be obtained through participating in Escha - Ru'Aun's Geas Fete battles.
    • I've already removed the curse, what now?
      In order to enhance equipment that has already been cleansed using this method, the cleansed equipment must have its original curse or hex restored using the synergy crucibles.
      *Only applicable equipment can be cleansed through the use of synergy.

System-related

  • Certain expansion disk data will be downloaded when updating the client.
    The following expansion disk data will be automatically downloaded to those accounts which do not have the installed due to the implementation of Chapter 2 of Rhapsodies of Vana'diel.
    Treasures of Aht Urhgan / Wings of the Goddess
    * Completing Chapter 2 of Rhapsodies of Vana'diel requires registration of Rise of the Zilart, Chains of Promathia, Treasure of Aht Urhgan, and Wings of the Goddess. Installation is also required to enjoy the content accompanying these expansion disks.
  • Part member status will now be displayed.
    Attachment 11378
    This system provides visual indication of changes in the status of the targeted party member in the form of icons when the setting is enabled.
    • Setting Via the Main Menu
      1. Select "Misc. 3" from the Config submenu.
      2. Set Party Icon Display to On.
    • Setting Via Text Command
      • Enter /statusparty on.
        * Similarly, /statusparty off will disable the option.
        * Entering /statusparty without an argument will toggle between on and off.
  • Focus targeting has been added.
    This system designates a fixed party member for which to display status effect icons.
    This function can be used in a variety of ways, such as display status changes of a party's tank or other member.
    * The name of the currently focused target can be displayed using /focusst.
    • Setting Via the Main Menu
      1. Select "Focus" from the Party submenu.
      2. Select the character you wish to focus from the displayed list of party members.
        * Alliance members and alter egos may not be focused.
        * Selecting a new party member when one is currently being focused will change the focus target to the new character.
        * Reselecting a currently focused party member will disable the focus targeting
    • Setting Via Text Command
      1. Target the character you wish to focus.
      2. Execute the /focustarget command.
        * The target can also be selected by using /focustarget <targetname> without having the desire target selected.
        * Executing this command while having a different focus target will switch the focus to the new target.
        * Executing the command on a character that is already focus targeted will remove the focus.
  • The icons for the following abilities have been adjusted.
    Brazen Rush / Inner Strength / Asylum / Subtle Sorcery / Stymie / Larceny /
    Intervene / Soul Enslavement / Unleash / Clarion Call / Overkill / Yaegasumi /
    Mikage / Fly High / Astral Conduit / Unbridled Wisdom / Cut Card / Heady Artifice /
    Grand Pas / Caper Emissarius / Widened Compass / Odyllic Subterfuge
  • Equipment sets may now be stored server-side.
    • Registering Settings
      At the login screen, place your cursor over the character whose data you would like to save an execute the following based on which input device you are using.
      • PlayStation 2
        [L1] + [L3]

      • Xbox 360
        [LB] + Left stick button

      • Keyboard
        Shift + Alt + Ctrl + B
    • Loading Settings
      On the login screen, place your cursor over the character whose data you would like to load and execute the following based on which input device you are using.
      • PlayStation 2
        [R1] + [R3]

      • Xbox 360
        [RB] + Right stick button

      • Keyboard
        Shift + Alt + Ctrl + R
  • Area of effect display is now compatible with geomancy spells.

    • Area Display on/off
    • Party Icon Display on/off
    • Furniture Camera Collision on/off
    • Timer Display on/off
      * The timer display function is scheduled to be implemented in a coming version update.
  • The subtargeting color differentiation function now works for blood pacts.
  • A new system message has been added for attempting to attack a monster for which you have no privileges to attack under certain conditions.
  • New terms have been added to the auto-translate dictionary.

  • Various issues with incorrect NPC dialogue and help text.
  • Issues with cut scenes playing incorrectly in certain missions and quests.
  • The issue wherein Zeid's HP falling to 0 during the first fight in the "Where Two Paths Converge" Bastok mission would prevent the fight from progressing normally.
  • The issue wherein having already completed the "The Beast Within" quest and entering the Jade Sepulcher would play a cutscene from that quest.
  • The issue where re-obtaining the rewards for the "Weatherspoon War" quest would not be possible.
  • The issue wherein cut scenes related to job-specific weapon creation would not play even though all conditions were fulfilled.
  • The issue where no fishing command was displayed in the Rala Waterways, preventing any fishing.
    * It will now be possible to fish throughout the Rala Waterways.
  • The issue wherein it would be sometimes possible to catch fish from the outer moat by fishing in Bastok Market's inner moat.
  • The issue where reeling in a catch for extended periods of time would sometimes cause the character's animations to stop playing.
  • The issue where logging into a mog garden would sometimes cause the character to appear in a mog house-like area.
  • An issue wherein logging out in another character's mog garden would prevent logging in again under certain circumstances.
  • The issue wherein the "Fishing (Tenacity)" Records of Eminence objective "Catch Size and Weight" would sometimes disappear from the objectives list without granting its reward.
  • The issue where curing the status ailments of Trust alter egos would not count towards the "Cure Status Ailments (UC)" Records of Eminence objective.
  • The issue where healing characters who belong to another Unity would still count towards the "Heal Unity Allies (UC)" Records of Eminence objective.
  • The issue where lamp marimo would be counted as a saltwater fish towards certain Records of Eminence objectives.
  • The issue where the notorious monster Pazuzu would stop performing any actions after being silenced.
  • The issue with the Prishe's alter ego’s "Auroral Uppercut" weapon skill having an incorrect area of effect.
  • The issue with the alter ego of Pieuje (UC) having incorrect appearance/released visual effects.
  • The issue where certain alter egos would stop curing status ailments when a member of the party was either knocked out or asleep.
  • The issue where the effects of the puppetmaster's "Repair Recast" merit point category were incorrect.
  • The issue with the dancer's "Contradance Effect" job point category not working correctly.
  • The issue with the Doomsday ranged weapon being imporperly sorted as a bowgun.
  • The issue where the Einherjar event replay option for Smouldering Lamp in Nashmau would have its price listed as 0 gil.
  • The issue where certain text commands would become unusable when mounted on a chocobo.
  • The issue where entries in the emote list would sometimes not display when jumping down the list.

[PlayStation 2 Version Only]
  • The issue where screen effects would persist after fighting the notorious monster in the quest The Weatherspoon War.
  • The issue where logging out and back in again would change the order of items stored in Mog Safe 2.
  • The issue wherein the screen would go black and become unresponsive in the following missions and quests.
    And the Compass Guides / The Scent of Battle / Comedy of Errors, Act I / At Journey's End /
    Bonds that Never Die / Moon Reading / A New Dawn / In a Haze of Glory / The Long March North

Known Issues

  • Character graphics may sometimes appear incorrectly during the "Past Imperfect" missions.
  • The "Give a Moogle a Break" quest may sometimes not trigger even when all requirements are fulfilled.
  • Treasure caskets unlocked in the following areas do not contribute to the "Crack Treasure Caskets" limited time Records of Eminence objective.
    Escha - Zi'Tah / Escha - Ru'Aun
  • The following quests may occasionally not appear in the event replay list in Sauromugue Champaign (S).
    Ganged Up On / Sacrifice
  • After selecting the event replay for Rhapsodies of Vana'diel, "Both Paths Taken(pt.1)" and "Both Paths Taken(pt.2)" will not play correctly.
  • The event replay for "Numbering Days(pt.6)" will play incorrectly after playing "Numbering Days(pt.4)".
  • Cinematics will play incorrectly when using a Cavernous Maw to teleport to the following areas.
    Batallia Downs (S) / Saurougue Champaign (S)
  • During colonization reives in Sih Gates, Knotted Roots may sometimes not be displayed.
  • During the Assault mission, "Stop the Bloodshed", destroying all Augmented Chigoes with a familiar's area-based attack will prevent completion of the mission.
  • In the Domain Invasion raid battle, it is possible to teleport directly to a notorious monster without an elvorseal under specific conditions.
  • Both Affi in Escha - Zi'Tah (F-10) and Dremi in Escha - Ru'Aun (H-11) will repeat their explanations of elvorseals whenever a player asks to receive one.
  • In the Geas Fete battle content, battle rights for notorious monsters will occasionally be nulled.
  • During the "Waking Dreams" battlefield and the "★Waking Dreams" high-tier mission battlefield, Diabolos's enmity levels may reset under specific conditions.

  • The HP and command list for a familiar will occasionally not appear after using "Leave" and "Call Beast" again on the same familiar while the "Run Wild" ability is still in effect.
  • Some familiars may clip with terrain while in Halvung.
  • Familiars' pathfinding may function incorrectly in the following areas.

title: What should I do if I can’t progress in Rhapsodies of Vana’diel?
body:
If you have trouble triggering certain events in Rhapsodies of Vana’diel, it is more than likely that one or more of those characters integral to that section is currently tied up in another non-Rhapsodies story mission that you have active.
