title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 20 Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the August version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, everyone.
Matsui here.

Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 20.
For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I’ve created this digest of what was discussed.

<iframe width="640" height="390" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/7rWlqU5hJQA" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Rhapsodies of Vana’diel Chapter 2
  • Escha – Ru’Aun
  • Seekers of Adoulin Quest
  • Unity Concord
  • Mog Tablet Adjustments
  • Domain Invasion
  • Geas Fete
  • Sinister Reign
  • Existing Content Adjustments
  • Trust Initiative
  • Merit Point Adjustments
  • Job Point Adjustments
  • Job Adjustments
  • New Abjurations and Cursed Gear
  • Vendor NPC Adjustments
  • Quality-of-Life Improvements 1
  • Quality-of-Life Improvements 2
  • Quality-of-Life Improvements 3
  • On-going Events
  • Conclusion
Rhapsodies of Vana’diel Chapter 2
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(4:20～)

In the second chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana’diel, we implemented scenarios 4-6.

The cutscenes that were added feature character dialogue that varies depending on your progress in each of the missions, and they were also made to have other minor deviations.

We’ve made it so you can now view all of the different cutscenes from both the Melody Minstrel and footprints located in each area, so once you finish a mission, be sure to watch the other cutscene variations.

After completing the missions you will once again be rewarded with a bonus key item, and you’ll be able to gain bonuses such as an increase to the maximum amount of alter egos you can summon.

Details on all of the key items can be found here.
Escha – Ru’Aun
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(7:50～)

We implemented a new Eschan area called Escha – Ru’Aun, and as the name implies this area was based off of Ru’Aun Gardens.

Adventurers can enjoy various content in this area such as Geas Fete, Domain Invasion, fishing, gathering, and other activities.

This area is meant for players who are level 99 and up, and there are a lot of powerful monsters roaming around.
Seekers of Adoulin Quest
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(11:58～)

Continuing the story of the quest “No Laughing Matter,” we added the conclusion, “A Barrel of Laughs.”

When completing the quest you’ll be able to select one piece of equipment from four possible reward items.

In event you would like a different reward item, you can change the item you picked for another; however, you can only do this once a week.
Unity Concord
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(13:35～)

We’ve added Yoran-Oran and Sylvie as Unity leaders.

Sylvie is the first geomancer-type alter ego, and Yoran-Oran possesses a high amount of support capabilities.

We’ve also made adjustments to the Unity accolades required to change Unities, so if you’re interested in trying out a different Unity, now’s a great chance to do so.
Mog Tablet Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(15:34～)

It’s been quite some time since the rewards for finding Mog Tablets was last changed, and since we’ve been receiving requests on the forum for this, we revamped the lineup of rewards.

Mog Tablets will show up on wide scan when you are in a certain range, so if you have the opportunity, definitely try and find them!
Domain Invasion
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(18:24～)

Powerful notorious monsters will appear in Eschan areas at certain times. These monsters can't be claimed as normal, so everyone in the area will be able to fight them.

If the notorious monster is successfully defeated, you will be awarded an individual reward based on your contribution, and three types of beneficial effects will randomly be activated from the 11 available in the area.

After a certain amount of time the notorious monster will run away, but the remaining HP will carry over to the next time it appears.
Geas Fete Additions
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(21:30～)

We added a variety of notorious monsters to Escha – Ru’Aun.

If you are able to successfully defeat a notorious monster, you can earn a new Vorseal effect as well as other rewards such as cursed equipment materials and abjurations.

Please try to hunt down these monsters and make abjuration equipment.
Sinister Reign
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(22:32～)

In Sinister Reign, you’ll be able to fight against the NPCs that appear in Seekers of Adoulin, which includes Arciela. It’s rare to battle against ally characters, so give it a try.

Three NPCs will appear at random, and if you defeat them all you’ll be able to obtain an alter ego and equipment from the NPCs who appear in the battle.

The reward equipment will be augmented randomly. You can challenge this content quite easily with bayld, so it will be possible to repeat the battle until you obtain an augment you are satisfied with.
Existing Content Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(26:17～)

The wait time required to re-challenge the mini-games for Promotion: Sergeant Major and Promotion: First Lieutenant has been changed from one Vana’diel day to one Earth minute. We’ve made this adjustment so you can re-challenge immediately if you fail.
Trust Initiative
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(27:20～)

We’ve added a lot of new alter egos, which can be obtained through the second chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana’diel, Sinister Reign, and future campaigns.

As I mentioned previously when talking about Rhapsodies of Vana’diel, with the new bonus key item you’ll be able to call out a maximum of five alter egos. Try summoning different combinations of alter egos.

We’ve also made quality-of-life adjustments and stat adjustments. In addition to being able to summon alter egos in Vagary, we increased the amount of enmity for tank-type alter egos, and also made it possible for the effects of AoE items to affect alter egos.
Merit Point Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(32:30～)

We increased the cap for the attributes, combat skill, and magic skill categories making it possible to boost your character even more.

While we have been receiving feedback asking for an increase to other categories, unfortunately we are not able to increase categories other than HP/MP due to the merit point system.
Job Point Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(33:50～)

We increased the cap on each job point category from 10 to 15. To coincide with this increase, we also added gifts up to 1200 job points.

With the large amount of categories it’s a bit difficult to introduce each of them here, so please be sure to check out the gifts page.
Job Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(37:45～)
  • Red mage
    We increased the cap of the effect of Temper so it scales with enhancing magic skill.

    During the broadcast we received a question asking whether enhancing magic skill only has an effect when you cast Temper or if it affects auto-attacks, so I would like to respond to this.

    Enhancing magic skill only has an effect when you cast Temper and Temper II. Due to this, it’s useful to change equipment when casting these spells to boost your enhancing magic skill.
  • Dark knight
    We made adjustments so that the effect of Consume Mana can be applied towards elemental weapon skills.
  • Beastmaster
    We made adjustments to the effects of Infrasonics and Hi-Freq Field.

    Due to the fact that the above two special abilities reduced evasion by a percentage, they possessed an effect that was larger than we planned; therefore, we made adjustments so that evasion is reduced by a set value.
  • Summoner
    We reduced the recast delay for Avatar’s Favor so that you could quickly reapply it if it is dispelled.
  • Beastmaster and summoner pet commands
    As a plan for a future version update, we are looking into making adjustments to the range in which pet commands for beastmaster can be used. Beastmaster is a job that we’ve balanced with close to mid-range engagements, but at the moment only pets are being sent close to enemies and players are standing in the back. We feel that there isn’t enough risk being taken on by the beastmaster despite their damage output.

    In regards to summoner, this is a job that was created to be a back line job, and we are looking into making adjustments to increase the range in which pet commands can be executed so they can function better in the back.
  • Puppetmaster
    We’ve added new attachments.
    There are high-tier versions of existing attachments, and their effects and elemental values are higher.
    By switching these with the lower-tier attachments, you can save attachment slots, but you can also combine them together for sharper settings.

    Additionally, we increased the stats for attachments that elicit effects when spending maneuvers. The projectiles produced by Barrage when using the Barrage Turbine, which uses three maneuvers, has been doubled, and other attachment effects have also been increased. Please test them all out.

    Prior to the version update we made an announcement regarding UI changes to address the increase in attachments, but since we were able to address this with internal specification changes, we did not end up making changes to the UI.

    With these changes there will be a slight increase in loading time, but we adopted this method in order to avoid large changes to the way the game feels.
  • Scholar
    As Embrava didn’t have much of an effect for ranged attackers, we added a Flurry effect.
  • Geomancer
    We made it possible to freely target the area of effect of Geocolure spells. To coincide with this we also added new control methods. Please check out the version update notes for details on this.
New Abjurations and Cursed Gear
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(46:02～)

With the addition of new materials for cursed equipment, it will be possible to enhance cursed items.
By trading the enhanced cursed item and a new abjuration to an NPC, you’ll be able to obtain even more powerful equipment.

It’s extremely difficult to create the HQ items, but in addition to the HQ items having high base stats, they also have higher augment caps.

Furthermore, there are combination bonuses only for the HQ versions, and the stats have been created to fit the difficulty of making them.
Vendor NPC Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(50:42～)

We increased the variety of attachments that the NPC “Rararoon” (Nashu (G-6)) sells.

Additionally, we increased the goods sold in Waag-Deeg’s Magic Shop in Lower Jeuno. Previously hard to obtain magic spells, such as ancient magic, have been added.

In order to keep an advantage for players who obtain these spells and attachments themselves, we’ve set the price to be on the high side. However, please consider buying it from the shop if you would like to obtain these right away.
Quality-of-Life Adjustments 1
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(52:34～)

We added a feature that allows you to target a party member to check their status icons. This will allow you to check what status ailments and support effects they have.

We also added a focus target feature so you can continuously see a party member’s information even if you change your target.

In the future we would like to add a feature that allows you to see a timer for effect durations, but we're looking into whether or not this is possible while taking communication volume limitations and other factors into consideration.
Quality-of-Life Adjustments 2
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(59:14～)

We’ve made it possible to save equipment sets server-side similar to what can be done with macros and configuration settings.

This will make it possible to play comfortably with your usual settings when you are not in your normal environment.

Details on how to save this information can be found in the version update notes.
Quality-of-Life Adjustments 3
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(01:04:15～)

We addressed Blood Pacts so that the subtargeting color differentiation function now works with them. Additionally, we made the area of effect display compatible with geomancy spells.

We also made it possible to set various configuration settings with text commands.

*The timer display function located in the configuration cannot be used at the moment. It will be implemented in a coming version update, and only the button was added ahead of time.
On-going Events
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(01:08:01～)
  • The Goddess’s Gala
    As a part of the Goddess’s Gala, we are once again holding the Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign, the Discount Campaign, and the Active Adventurer Appreciation Campaign.

    Details for each of the campaigns can be found on PlayOnline.
  • Mosaic Art Project
    We’re in the midst of creating a mosaic using all of the screenshots that everyone has been sending in. We’ll be releasing the finished mosaic on the Goddess’s Gala site, so please look forward to it!

    *The submission period for screenshots ended on Sunday, August 9th.
  • Aloha Iroha
    We’ve started to release a four panel manga to coincide with the Rhapsodies of Vana’diel scenario. The manga is being created by the manga artist, Tomokichi.

    We’ll be announcing on PlayOnline when the manga will be released. Please look forward to seeing a slightly cuter side of Iroha that is different from the serious tone of the in-game scenario.
  • FINAL FANTASY XI Channel
    On Tuesday, August 11th, we will be setting up a FINAL FANTASY XI channel on Niconico.

    We have a lot of plans to add various kinds of videos that range from the videos found on old DVDs included with magazines to short movies and much more, so keep an eye out!

    The FINAL FANTASY XI channel can be found here.
    (*Please note the site is in Japanese.)
Conclusion
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
The next version update is slated for September.

This is a smaller version update that will focus on adjustments, but the development team will be working on content for everyone to enjoy, specifically content created by Associate Director Fujito.

See you during the next Freshly Picked Vana’diel!

System-related

  • A new function to request to join other players' parties has been added.
    The function enables players to communicate to others their desire to join a specific party.
    • Request
      "Request" refers to a request to join another's party. All players can use this command, even targeting players who are not actively accepting requests to join.
      This command can be executed using /recruit or /rec.
      * Requests will be automatically deleted after 30 days have passed.
      * Players who are currently possessing a monster in Monstrosity may not use this function.
      * A message will stay displayed in your log even if the player is on your blacklist.
    • Request List
      Players can view a list displaying request history, enabling them to view which players have requested to join their party.
      This command can be executed using /recruitlist or /rlist.
      * Up to 64 PCs may be displayed at once.
    • Accepting requests
      Players may show that they are actively looking for requests from other players, effectively communicating to them that they are open to having others join
      This command can be executed using /partyrequestcmd or /prcmd.
      * This function cannot be used with the automatic party or party flag functions.
      * Players cannot accept requests from those on their blacklist.
    • Example
      • Looking for requestees
        1. Describe your party's goals in your search comment.
        2. Select Request from the Party submenu and set your status to accept requests.
          Attachment 11488
          * An exclamation mark will appear next to players' heads.
          * The same icon will also display in the top right of the target window when targeted.
        3. Receive a request.
        4. Select View Request from the Party submenu to see which players have requested to join.
        5. Do one of the following.
          Send a tell / Delete the request* / Send a message / Invite to party
          * Deleting the request will remove it from your request history.
          * Clear History will remove all requests from the list.
      • Making a request
        1. Search for and select a player character.
        • Use the search function
          1. Select Request from the Search submenu.
          2. Select a character and do one of the following.
            Send a tell / Make a request / Delete a request / Send a message / Invite to party
        • Search for recruiting icons
          1. Target a character with the recruiting icon display next to his name.
          2. Select the character and execute the appropriate subcommand.
        • Search by log window
          1. Check the char log.
          2. Select the player name and do one of the following.
            Send a tell / Make a request / Delete a request / Search / Target
            * Select Delete Request to remove your request
            * The request will not remain in the other person's history.
        2. Select Request via the appropriate subcommand.

  • Timers will now be displayed on status icons.
    Attachment 11489
    This system will display the duration remaining on status effects affecting you.
    Not only will numerical values be displayed, but icons will flash when there are 15 or fewer seconds remaining.
    * Effect durations are displayed using a numerical value and a single letter. "h" refers to hours, and "m" refers to minutes. Durations less than one minute will have no letter displays.
    • Setting via the main menu
      1. Select Misc. 3 from the Config submenu.
      2. Set Timer Display to On.
    • Setting via the command line
      • Execute the "/statustimer on" command
        * Similarly, "/statustimer off" will turn off the timer display.
        * /statustimer without any subcommands will toggle between on and off.
    • Compatible timers
      • Those affecting you that have a limited duration.
        * Effects lasting five seconds or fewer will not have durations displayed.
      • Status other than the following
        Level Restriction / Sublimation: Activated / EF Badge / Battlefield / Beseiged / Encumbrance / Obliviscence / Impaired / Omerta / Debilitation / Pathos / Flurry / Concentration / Allied Tags / Level Sync / Confrontation / Atma / Pennant / Carbuncle's Favor / Ifrit's Favor / Shiva's Favor / Garuda's Favor / Titan's Favor / Ramuh's Favor / Leviathan's Favor / Fenrir's Favor / Diabolod' Favor / Cait Sith's Favor / Voidwatcher / Ensphere / Reive Mark / STR Boost / DEX Boost / VIT Boost / AGI Boost / INT Boost / MND Boost / CHR Boost / Attack Boost / Defense Boost / Magic Atk. Boost / Magic Def. Boost / Accuracy Boost / Evasion Boost / Magic Acc. Boost / Magic Evasion Boost / Attack Down / Defense Down / Magic Atk. Down / Magic Def. Down / Accuracy Down / Evasion Down / Magic Acc. Down / Magic Evasion Down / Regen / Poison / Refresh / Slow / Paralysis / Weight / Haste / Vorseal / Elvorseal / Visitant / Prowess
        * Geomancy timers will not display.
  • New entries have been added to the adventuring primer.
    Skirmish / Delve / Alluvion Skirmish / Incursion / Geas Fete / Domain Invasion / Sinister Reign
  • The widths and length of log windows when using the multiple window function may now be set individually.
    Attachment 11490
    * Available for the Windows and Xbox 360 versions only.
    • Setting
      1. Select Windows from the Config submenu.
      2. Select Window 1 or Window 2.
      3. Select Window Width or Resize Time to adjust the settings.
        * Maximum dimensions have not changed.
  • A function to compare the attributes to a selected piece of equipment with that currently worn has been added.
    * The way certain help text has been displayed has changed in order to accommodate this feature.
    Attachment 11491
    • How to use
      Perform the following when changing equipment to display the help windows for the equipped and select pieces of equipment vertically. The currently equipped item is on top and the selected item is on the bottom.
      • Controller
        Place the cursor over the item and press L2.
        * Pressing the cancel button when both windows are displayed will hide the upper help window.
      • Keyboard
        Place the cursor over the item and press Ctrl.
        * Pressing Ctrl again when both windows are displayed will hide the upper help window.
  • The icons for the following spells have been adjusted.
    Fira III / Blizzara III / Aerora III / Stonera III / Thundara III / Watera III / Geohelix II / Hydrohelix II / Anemohelix II / Pyrohelix II / Cryohelix II / Ionohelix II / Noctohelix II / Luminohelix II / Refresh III / Temper II / Full Cure / Death
  • The following have been added to the currency list.
    Rem's Tale Chapter 1 / Rem's Tale Chapter 2 / Rem's Tale Chapter 3 / Rem's Tale Chapter 4 / Rem's Tale Chapter 5 / Rem's Tale Chapter 6 / Rem's Tale Chapter 7 / Rem's Tale Chapter 8 / Rem's Tale Chapter 9 / Rem's Tale Chapter 10 / Reclamation Marks
  • A feature to store and load character settings files has been added to the character selection screen.
    • Saving files
      The command to save files remains the same.
      • PlayStation 2
        L1 + L3
      • Xbox 360
        LB + Left stick button
      • Keyboard
        Shift + Alt + Ctrl + B
    • Loading files
      The command to load files remains the same.
      • PlayStation 2
        R1 + R3
      • Xbox 360
        RB + Right stick button
      • Keyboard
        Shift + Alt + Ctrl + R
  • The following terms have been added to the autotranslate dictionary
    <table width="480" border="0"><tr><td width="40%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Category</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Term</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Text Commands</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">/statustimer</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Text Commands</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">/recruit</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Text Commands</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">/recruitlist</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Text Commands</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">/partyrequestcmd</td></tr></table>

Resolved Issues

  • Various issues wherein certain NPC dialog and help text was incorrect.
  • Various issues wherein cutscenes for certain mission and quests were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein all dialogue options would appear when speaking to Sagheera and Monisette even if the appropriate conditions were not met.
  • The issue wherein Nolan would not respond properly when spoken to after speaking with Dremi.
  • The issue with Mog Gardens wherein far-away scenery did not display properly.
  • The issue with Mog Gardens wherein the size of large fish would not display when procuring items from a reared creature.
  • The issue with the Records of Eminence objective Reel in Multiple Rusted Objects wherein reeling in rusty greatswords would not count.
  • The issue with Rainemard's alter ego wherein he would cast an En-spell of the element corresponding to a fallen monster's resistance
  • The issue with Sylvie's alter ego wherein should would alternate between casting Indi-Precision and Indi-Fury.
  • The issue wherein Koru-Moru's alter ego would cast the white magic spell Haste II on Tenzen's alter ego II.
    The issue wherein the scenes accompanying the completion of the following quests would have a lower priority than others.
    Coming Full Circle / Waking the Colossus / Divine Interference
  • The issue wherein the screen would occasionally go black and become unresponsive during the following mission and quests.
    In a Haze of Glory / To Laugh is to Love* / Apocalypse Nigh / The Heir to the Light / Fate in Haze / A Token of Troth / Bonds of Mythril
    * The story will continue even if the screen goes black and becomes unresponsive.
  • The issue wherein the experience granted from besting the following monsters was incorrect.
    Palila's Vulture / Hanbi's Demon / Yilan's Dragon / Amymone's Peapuk / Naphula's Corpselight / Kammavaca's Amoeban / Kammavaca's Clionid / Kammavaca's Murex / Kammavaca's Limule / Pakicet's Pugi / Duke Vepar's Gnat / Vir'ava's Rafflesia /
    Warder's Wynav （* Added on September 18th)
  • The issue wherein vanquishing Palila's Vulture while in combat with Palila would count as having vanquished a notorious monster.
  • The issue wherein the duration of Shah's ability Shah's Decree was incorrect.
  • The issue wherein vanquishing Muut, Muut's Hound Warrior, and Muut's Sacrifice would not count as vanquishing monsters.
  • The issue wherein alter egos would occasionally disappear when in combat with the provenance watcher.
  • The issue wherein performing a magic burst with certain blue magic spells would not display the magic burst in the combat log.
  • The issue wherein the action logic of certain notorious monsters in domain invasion was not current under certain conditions.
  • The issue wherein equipment with the enhancing magic duration attribute would not increase the duration of the following spells
    Refresh III / Temper II
  • The issue wherein the blue mage gift category Job Trait Bonus was affecting the Auto Refresh trait.
  • The issue with certain phantom rolls wherein the effects of Luzaf's Ring were not reflected.
  • The issue wherein the ability Immanence would not affect the following spells.
    Geohelix II / Hydrohelix II / Anemohelix II / Pyrohelix II / Cryohelix II / Ionohelix II / Noctohelix II / Luminohelix II
  • The issue wherein it would occasionally become possible to exceed elemental capacity limits when equipping attachments.
  • The issue wherein the attachment scanner would occasionally not function properly when equipped with an item level animator.
  • The issue wherein automaton ranged attacks would occasionally cause less damage than intended.
  • The issue wherein the effects of the attachment Flame Holder would not activate when no fire maneuvers were active.
  • The issue wherein the potency of "Waltz" effects receive attribute would not activate when the "Waltz" potency effect attribute was at its maximum value.
  • The issue wherein the subtarget color when using a geocolure spell did not match the actual area of effect.
  • The issue wherein certain quivers were usable in Mog Gardens
  • The issue wherein the value of the Enmity+ attribute of the Emicho Coronet +1 was incorrect.
  • The issue wherein item icons were occasionally incorrect when using the delivery service.
  • The issue with the currency menu wherein the description for copper A.M.A.N. vouchers was incorrect.
  • The issue wherein NPC display priority was lower than intended.
  • This issue wherein pressing F8 when a monster is in a player's field of vision would give targeting priority to monsters rather than non-combat NPCs directly in front.
  • The issue with mog houses wherein opening storage furniture would cause the game to slow down.
  • The issue wherein the error message displaying when inviting a player character who has alter egos called forth into a party or alliance was not correct.
  • The issue wherein the following missions would not display in the event replay list in Sauromugue Champaign [S].
    Ganged up On / Sacrifice

Known Issues

  • The screen will occasionally black out and become unresponsive in the quest Beneath the Mask.
  • Atma Infusionist／Cavernous Maw／Cruor Prospector／Goblin Footprint／Prishe／Transcendental Radiance
    In the battlefield The Wyrm God, fleeing will occasionally cause the following NPCs and actors to not display.
    Atma Infusionist / Cavernous Maw / Cruor Prospector / Goblin Footprint / Prishe / Transcendental Radiance
  • In the high-tier battlefield Ark Angel 1, the action login of Ark Angel HM was incorrect.
  • When being the victim of Mingyi’s special ability Royal Decree, alter egos will vanish.
  • Players are able to obtain multiples of the following items under certain conditions.
    Cipher: Halver / Cipher: Semih
  • The help text for the following abilities is incorrect.
    Chaos Roll / Drachen Roll / Beast roll
  • The following spells, abilities, and items cannot be used under certain circumstances.
    Alter egos / Call Wyvern / Call Beast / Activate / Signal pearl / Tactics Pearl
  • The icon for the white magic spell Temper II is incorrect.
  • When viewing automaton items at an auction house and sorting by name, items are displayed in an improper order.
  • When changing jobs multiple times in quick succession, the player’s job will occasionally fail to change.
  • Status icons will occasionally fail to display under certain conditions.
  • When using the party request function, making a request of a player character immediately after changing areas will cause an incorrect system message to display.
  • When targeting an alliance member using the argument “stal,” the names of other party members will be emphasized.
  • When accepting a party invitation while the Alarm Type window is displayed, selecting Sort or Focus from the Party menu will cause the Alarm Type window to display.
    * This issue can be resolved by closing the Alarm Type window after closing the main menu or changing areas.

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 21 Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the September version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.


Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, everyone.
Matsui here.

Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 21.
For those of you who were unable to watch the stream, I’ve created this digest of what was discussed.

While there weren’t any additional scenario aspects implemented in this version update, there was a wealth of battle content, adjustments, and quality-of-life improvements. All the details can be found
here.

<iframe width="640" height="360" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/M_APOpmMj4g" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Mog Garden Additions and Adjustments
  • Seekers of Adoulin Quests
  • High-tier Mission Battlefields
  • Domain Invasion Adjustments
  • Geas Fete Additions
  • Unity Concord Additions
  • Adjustments to Existing Quests
  • Adjustments to Existing Areas
  • Adjustments to Existing Content
  • Coalition and Reive Adjustments
  • Job Adjustments
  • Alter Ego Adjustments
  • Food Additions and Adjustments
  • Emote Additions
  • Quality-of-life Improvements
  • Announcements
  • Conclusion
Mog Garden Additions and Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(2:21～)

We’ve unlocked monster rearing rank 6. To coincide with this, we’ve also made it possible to raise two new types of monsters from the bomb family and behemoth family. When fully grown, the behemoth will become King Behemoth. This is a really big monster, but you can move him over to your Mog Garden.

Additionally, we’ve made adjustments to how monsters move around. Up until now monsters had been walking around quite often, but as time passed their movement would become dull. We’ve adjusted this so that they continuously walk about.
*Adjustments were made on 9/19/2015 to reduce the frequency of monster movement.

Furthermore, the feature that automatically creates names when naming a monster has been adjusted. We’ve made it so names do not overlap with monsters that have already been given a name. During the campaign period, the moogles will sell quite nice items, so please check them out.
Seekers of Adoulin Quests
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(8:02～)

We added the final chapter to the Seekers of Adoulin quest “The Secret to Success.” The reward for clearing this quest is a throwing weapon with Refresh +1 on it. It has some stats on it that haven’t been seen before, so I think it’ll come in handy. It’s an item that can only be equipped by jobs that have divine magic skills.
High-tier Mission Battlefields
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(9:11～)

Two new nostalgic battlefields with stronger monsters have been added: “One to be Feared” and “Dawn.” Relive those amazing memories from the past once again.

This time around there aren’t any NPCs to fight alongside you, but we’ve tuned the battle so that you can handle it without them. There also won’t be any mammets you need to kite around the battlefield, so you’ll be able to devote your focus to the two main bosses.
Domain Invasion Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(11:42～)

We made adjustments so that it’s easier to enjoy this content even when there are not many people participating.

We’ve also implemented a system that reduces the respawn time and amount of regular monsters needed to summon notorious monsters when there are only a few participants.

Additionally, we added an evaluation system. This is not only for when you fight notorious monsters, and we’ve made it so that as long as you participate and get an average evaluation, you will be able to receive a reward. We’ve also addressed some of the larger requests on the forum; namely raising players after the battle has concluded and a reduction in monster detection range.
Geas Fete Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(13:06～)

We’ve added high content level notorious monsters which will allow for challenging battles. There are popular monsters from the past making an appearance, so please try and hunt them down.
Unity Concord Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui

(14:49～)

Wyrm-type, behemoth-type, and adamantoise-type notorious monsters have been added. The wyrm-type notorious monster will not drop an item level version of Ridill, but we’d like to introduce this weapon when the timing is right.
Adjustments to Existing Quests
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(16:45～)

Adjustments were made to aspects of certain quests that were troublesome.

As a difficulty adjustment for the quest “Scholar Attire,” we made the “Indescript Markings” easier to locate.

Additionally, as an adjustment to the quest “In the Name of Science,” we’ve made it so the hints given by the NPC “Yurim” when trading an apple pie are more specific.
Adjustments to Existing Areas
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(17:57～)

New hunting spots have been added to Seekers of Adoulin dungeons for high-level players. There are monsters with extremely high HP, so it would be efficient to hunt them as a party.

Monsters respawn every minute, and while they are aggressive, they will not link. Think about using these areas as safe spots for earning capacity points.
Adjustments to Existing Content
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(19:11～)

We’ve increased the drop rate of ciphers from Sinister Reign. There are many who are participating in this content in order to obtain alter egos, so because of this we increased the obtainment rate. In the event that you’ve already obtained a certain alter ego, the cipher will no longer drop, and it won’t weigh on your rewards.

We’ve also made adjustments so that Incursion, Delve, and Einherjar can be enjoyed with only a few party members.

Additionally, we lowered the base damage that is split amongst party members for Gorge and Disgorge used by sandworm-type notorious monsters in Abyssea and Voidwatch.
Coalition and Reive Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(22:38～)

We’ve made it so coalition ranks are easier to increase and at the same time harder to decrease. Furthermore, we adjusted the rewards earned when completing a coalition assignment. The rewards will scale with the difficulty, so you can now choose assignments with this in mind.
Job Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(24:07～)
  • Dark knight
    The duration of the maximum HP bonus effect of Drain II and Drain III has been increased. The effect duration of Dread Spikes and Absorb-type spells has also been increased, and at 500 skill the effect duration will be doubled. The recast time and effect duration of Scarlet Delirium has been adjusted, and it’s a uniform 90 seconds when taking damage and before taking damage. This can now be used more often, so please put it to good use.
  • Beastmaster
    The range in which certain abilities and pet commands can be used has been shortened. While this changes the style of play a bit, please try it out and let us know your feedback.
  • Ninja
    TP-related ninjutsus, Myoshu: Ichi and Kakka: Ichi, have been adjusted. Their casting time has been decreased, and the effect duration has been increased.
  • Dragoon
    We made adjustments to better maintain wyverns. Due to the adjustments made, the Strafe bonuses found on certain equipment is not functioning properly. We are looking into switching this with another bonus in a future version update.
  • Summoner
    In order to make summoner easier to play as a backrow job, we’ve increased the range in which pet commands can be executed.
  • Blue mage
    The series classic Mighty Guard has been added as a blue magic spell. It’s extremely powerful, so put it to good use. Also, please note that the new spells Cruel Joke, Cesspool, and Tearing Gust cannot be learned from the Xol Triumverate encountered in the missions.
  • Corsair
    We made it so Beast Roll and Drachen Roll give ranged attack and ranged accuracy bonuses to sharpshot automatons.
  • Puppetmaster
    We increased the combat and magic skills for automaton heads. With this adjustment, combining the same type of head and frame will allow you to reach an A+ skill.
  • Scholar
    We reduced the level needed to learn each of the storm spells. At level 99, you will be able to cast all of these spells when scholar is set as your support job.
Alter Ego Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(33:37～)

We’ve added more areas and content in which alter egos can be summoned. You can now use them in Abyssea and Legion.

Additionally, we’ve made it possible for certain ranged, magic, and support-type alter egos to attack monsters from a distance. We’d love to hear your feedback on their behavior.
Food Additions and Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(35:17～)

We’ve adjusted the effects for each kind of crepe. The sweet-type crepes will boost your magic accuracy based on percentage, so please decide which food you’d like to use based on your stats. As for the savory crepes, they will increase your stats by a set value.

Behemoth meat has been added as a new reward for King Behemoth, but this does not alter the equipment drop rate, so please don’t worry!
Emote Additions
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(39:43～)

We added an emote where your character sits in a chair, and there are four kinds of chairs. You can exchange chocobo coins as well as mummers’ coins for the Chocobo Chair. The Shadow Throne can either be crafted with bonecraft or purchased with cruor.

Additionally, we added job emotes for geomancer and rune fencer.
Quality-of-life Improvements
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(49:04～)

We added a party participation request feature. When creating a party, it will be easy for the leader to see who is looking for a party with a list. Using this feature will make it easier than ever to form a party for the objectives you are looking to accomplish.

Additionally, we added a status icon timer, the ability to change the size of the various windows when using the multiple window function, and an equipment comparison feature.

As an item-related quality-of-life improvement, we’ve made it possible to send certain notorious monster trigger items to characters under the same account. We’ve also made it possible to store Rems Tales with an NPC, so this should lighten the load on your inventory.
Announcements
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(1:01:14～)

A new blu-ray disc music album will go on sale soon. Experience the music of Vana’diel in high-quality sound with accompanying videos. Details can be found here. (*Please note the site is in Japanese only.)

All of the screenshots we received for the Mosaic Art Project have been compiled into a jig-saw puzzle that is going to be available soon. Pre-orders can be made here. (*Please note the site is in Japanese only.)

Finally, pre-registration for FINAL FANTASY Grandmasters has begun. Check here for all the details.
(*Please note the site is in Japanese only.)
Here is a trailer that was debuted at Tokyo Game Show 2015.

<iframe width="640" height="360" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Vrx0zkkIZaM" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>
Conclusion
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(1:13:19～)

We’ll be holding a variety of campaigns between September and October, and I hope you enjoy these along with the version update.

The development team is moving forward with all the preparations for the November version update, so please look forward to it. The next Freshly Picked will have a lot of content, including the finale to the Rhapsodies of Vana’diel scenario.

See you in November!

title: Nov 10, 2015 (JST) Version Update
body:
<iframe width="640" height="360" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Vj4mG0kfzds" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/49065?p=565262#post565262">Event-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/49065?p=565264#post565264">Battle-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/49065?p=565265#post565265">Item-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/49065?p=565266#post565266">System-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/49065?p=565267#post565267">Resolved Issues</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/49065?p=565268#post565268">Known Issues</a>

Event-related

  • The final chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana'diel has been added.
    Attachment 11551
    • Players must meet the following prerequisites to receive the initial mission.
      • Have completed the Rhapsodies of Vana'diel Chapter 2 mission "Uncertain Futures."
        * Players must have visited Aht Urhgan Whitegate at least once after the Wednesday, August 12, 2015 emergency update.
        * Players may be unable to progress with the final chapter depending on their progress in certain expansion missions.
        * Progressing in Rhapsodies of Vana'diel requires registration of Rise of the Zilart, Chains of Promathia, Treasures of Aht Urhgan, Wings of the Goddess, and Seekers of Adoulin.
    • Certain key items available from progressing in Rhapsodies of Vana'diel will make adventuring throughout the land even easier than before.
      Read on for details.
  • A new area, Reisenjima, has been added.
    Attachment 11552 Attachment 11553
    Players will be able to make the arduous journey to the isle of the gods as they progress through Rhapsodies of Vana'diel.
    • Movement via Ethereal Ingresses
      Players will receive a temporary item known as an ethereal droplet when examining ??? targets located in certain parts of Reisenjima. Using this item will teleport to the first of several ethereal ingresses. Once an ethereal ingress has been examined, players may teleport to it for a small escha silt fee.
      * Only one ethereal droplet may be held at a given time.
  • A quest has been added to obtain a new class of weapons known as "aeonic weapons."
    Aeonic weapons are of the same caliber as relic, mythic, and empyrean weapons. Their aftermath effects provides the ability to use radiance and umbra skillchains, which are a step above the light and darkness versions.
    * Players must first complete the final chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana'diel to start this quest.
    * Players will be able to complete the quest and obtain their aeonic weapons in a future version update.
    Attachment 11554
  • New quests have been added.
    • Vegetable Vegetable Frustration.
      Attachment 11555
      • Players must meet the following prerequisites and examine the door to Amchuchu's laboratory in Western Adoulin (J-10) to accept the quest.
        • Have completed the quest "The Usual."
        • Have completed the quest "Vegetable Vegetable Crisis," and have had one Vana'diel day pass after completion.
    • Rowing Together
      Attachment 11556
      • Players must meet the following requisites and zone in to their Mog Garden to accept the quest.
        • Have completed the quest "Doctor Chacharoon."
        • Be in possession of the Sakura and the Holy Grail key item.
  • Mog Gardens have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Monster rearing rank 7 is now available, and the following related additions and adjustments have been made.
      • Two new creature families are available.
        Attachment 11557 Attachment 11558
      • Up to four creatures may be reared at once.
      • Up to three creatures may enter your Mog Garden per Earth day.
      • The following items may now be used as feed.
        Kazham Peppers / Habaneros / Gem of the North / Gem of the East / Gem of the South / Gem of the West / Honey Wine / Sweet Tea / Cerberus Meat
    • New Chacharoon cheer effects have been added.
  • Records of Eminence have undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • New objectives have been added.
    • The maximum number of sparks of eminence that may be accumulated at any one time has been increased from 50,000 to 99,999.
  • The A.M.A.M. Reclaimer now accepts new items.
  • Unity Concord has undergone the following additions.
    Attachment 11559
    • New Wanted targets have been added to the following areas.
      Wajaom Woodlands / Mount Zhayolm / Caedarva Mire
    • Unity NPCs will now offer to teleport players to Caedarva Mire.
    • Players are now able to participate in Wanted battles without having accepted the corresponding Records of Eminence objective.
      * Players are able to participate as long as at least one party member has set the objective.
      * Players who have not accepted the objective will still be able to receive experience points (and capacity points if the content level is 119 or greater.)
      * Participating players who have not set the objective will not lose any Unity accolades.
    • The maximum number of Unity accolades that may be accumulated at any one time has been increased from 50,000 to 99,999.
    • Players may now trade unwanted Wanted material drops for Unity accolades.
    • Players will now receive a bonus to capacity points earned based on their Unity's ranking.
      * The lower the ranking, the greater the bonus.
  • Coalitions have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Coalitions will now maintain services that have been unlocked even if the coalition's rank falls. However, fees will increase if the coalition's rank has fallen below the minimum to use that service.
    • Ornery Dhole at the Inventors' Coalition will now allow players to select exactly how many obsidian fragments or skirmish stones they would like.
  • A new achievement has been added to Celennia Memorial Library.
  • A new option to designate favorite locations has been added to home points and survival guides.
    Players may designate up to nine different locations as favorites.
  • When selecting areas at a home point, players will now be able to choose by region or by expansion.
  • The locations of the following home points have been adjusted.
    Port San d'Oria #1 / Bastok Markets #1 / Port Bastok #1 / Port Bastok #2 / Port Windurst #1 / Ru'Aun Gardens #2 / Ru'Aun Gardens #3
    * Players will need to visit the above home points again to register them.
  • New home points have been added to Windurst Waters and Windurst Woods.
  • Survival guides have been added to the following areas.
    Caedarva Mire (Dvucca Isle) / Arrapago Reef / Halvung / Behemoth's Dominion / Dragon's Aery / Valley of Sorrows / Ifrit's Cauldron / Zeruhn Mines
  • Fishing has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • Fishing has been added to Reisenjima.
    • The chance of reeling in the following catches has been increased.
      Duskcrawler / Ashen Crayfish
    • Katsunaga in Mhaura (G-10) will now provide information about newly-added fish.
  • The respawn time of the following notorious monsters has been decreased to five minutes.

  • When speaking with Emporox in Reisenjima, it is possible to cancel merit point charging and prevent the completion flag from activating.
  • In the Records of Eminence objective Magic Bursts (UC), a single magic burst may occasionally count multiple times under certain conditions.
  • After participating in Domain Invasion, choosing to return an elvorseal may occasionally cause the player to become unable to call forth alter egos until the Domain Invasion ends.
  • It is not possible to call forth alter egos when taking an enmity-generating action against sturdy pyxis chests and the NPC Martello.
  • In the ENM Holy Cow, the monster Apis will occasionally stop acting.
  • Certain notorious monsters in Escha – Ru'Aun will despawn quicker than intended.
  • When being the victim of a certain attack from the Warder of Love in Escha – Ru'Aun, players will occasionally become able to move to places they ordinarily wouldn't be able to reach.
  • ??? targets in Escha – Zi'Tah will occasionally fail to respond when examined.
  • In a Wanted battle occurring in the Den of Rancor, Azreal will occasionally stop using certain special abilities.
  • When using the argument <t> with the ability Ready, a message will occasionally appear saying that that action cannot be taken.
  • Charges for the ability Ready occasionally accumulate at a rate faster than intended.
  • When using a controller, pets cannot be targeted via subtargeting for the following abilities and pet commands when engaged in PvP.
    * These ability/pet commands can be used properly when targeting oneself.
    Reward / Sic / Snarl / Spur / Run Wild
  • Pets do not move properly in Reisenjima.
  • The help text for the 1355-point scholar gift category Capacity Point Bonus is incorrect.
  • The help text for the rune fencer job point category Elemental Sforzo Effect does not match the actual effect.
  • Some items ordinarily unobtainable from the Goblin Mystery Box can be obtained.
  • When using the borderless window mode and starting FINAL FANTASY XI, pressing alt+tab will cause the mouse cursor to display, and returning FINAL FANTASY XI to the active window will not cause the mouse cursor to vanish.

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 22 Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the November version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.


Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui

Hello, everyone. Matsui here.
Thanks for tuning in to Freshly Picked Vana’diel 22.

We’ve just implemented the final chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana’diel with the recent, major version update. During Freshly Picked Vana’diel I talked about the content we added as well as plans for the future, so please give the digest a read when you have a moment.

<iframe width="640" height="360" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/WlWMHIFUj0k" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Rhapsodes of Vana’diel
  • Seekers of Adoulin Quests
  • Aeonic Weapons
  • Relic, Mythic, and Empyrean Weapons
  • Domain Invasion
  • Geas Fete
  • Unity: Wanted
  • Mog Gardens
  • Records of Eminence
  • Job Adjustments
  • Trust Initiative
  • Campaigns and Announcements
  • Conclusion
Rhapsodies of Vana’diel

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(4:26～)

The final chapter has been implemented. I had the lead event planner, Saito, give an explanation about the process until the cutscenes were complete. Check out the archived video and watch as he shows how he takes a text based scenario and develops the animations, the backgrounds, and everything needed to make a completed cutscene. There are a lot of flashy action scenes in the final chapter, so be sure to keep an eye out for them when you play through the missions.

Along with the final chapter, we also introduce a new area, Reisenjima. The map creation lead organized the various parts together to give it a very Japanese feel.

Furthermore, we’re also in the midst of a special collaboration event with FINAL FANTASY XIV – “The Maiden’s Rhapsody.” During the event, Iroha will find herself in Eorzea. The event lasts until December 31st, so go lend her a hand.
Seekers of Adoulin Quests
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui

(22:30～)

We’ve added the new quest “Vegetable Vegetable Frustration.” Completing this quest will reward you with an item that will allow you to feel kinship with the NPC Midras.
Aeonic Weapons
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui


(23:40～)

We’ve added a new quest line for creating a new set of weapons – Aeonic weapons.

During the stream we showcased the new ultimate skillchains that are possible with these weapons. When wielding an aeonic weapon, you’ll gain an aftermath effect when using the weapon skills learned through merit points at 3000 TP. While under the effect of the aftermath, performing skillchains with certain weapon skills will activate an ultimate skillchain. There’s a 7 second window for magic burst after creating this, and I think you’ll be excited to see the damage. The aftermath will wear off after executing the ultimate skillchain, so it’s effective to wait until it’s about to wear off before doing this.

The quest we added in November is just an introductory quest for making the Aeonic weapons, and it’s not possible to finish making them just yet. One thing to note is that the process of making these weapons won’t be something you work at slowly over time, the concept is to earn it by defeating a lot of powerful enemies.

Marsyas, the Aeonic instrument, grants you the ability to use the special song “Honor March.” This effect of this song is quite close to combination of Sword Madrigal, Archer’s Prelude, Valor Minuet III, and Advancing March all rolled into one.
Relic, Mythic, and Empyrean Weapons
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(32:25.5～)

Except for the shields and instruments, we’re planning to enhance the stats of each of these special weapon groups. Naturally, this will include Ergon weapons as well. To give an idea of what we are aiming for, we showed off some example stats for Excalibur, Burtgang, and Almace during the stream. Additionally, we debuted the stats for Sequence. Be sure to pay attention to the damage value, combat skill increase, and the other bonuses.
Domain Invasion
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(39:05～)

We added the notorious monster Quetzalcoatl to Reisenjima. Also, as a counter measure against lag, we made it so that unrelated monsters will no longer be displayed during these battles.
Geas Fete Additions
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(42:53～)

Besides Quetzalcoatl, we added a number of notorious monsters to Reisenjima for Geas Fete. Additionally, there was a large amount of feedback on the forums to make it so lottery-type monsters do not spawn, and we added in two key items to address this: mollifier and radialens. The latter allows notorious monsters to be spawned and fought continuously.
Unity: Wanted
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(44:07～)

We added Hydra-, Cerberus-, and Khimaira-type notorious monsters. Additionally, we’ve made it so even if you do not have the Records of Eminence objective you will still be able to participate in the battle. This should make it easier to help other adventurers in the fray. However, those that help will only earn experience points (or capacity points if the content level is above 119).
Mog Gardens
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(45:40～)

We unlocked rank 7 for monster rearing. To coincide with this, we also implemented a quest with Chacharoon. Be sure to give lots of love and care to the newly added Dragon Hatchling and Pequetender.
Record of Eminence
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(46:46～)

We increased the cap for sparks to 99,999 because there are a lot of times you’d hit the cap without even realizing it. Additionally, we added several objectives that appear after completing a specific amount of objectives.
Job Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui

(48:07～)

We adjusted beastmaster by making familiars the targets of certain abilities and pet commands. With this change, a sub-target will appear on the familiar, and you’ll be able to determine whether you are in range to execute the command based on the color displayed. If you’d like to target yourself, which was the standard until now, you can do this by creating a macro.

For puppetmaster, we increased the enmity values for the Strobe and Strobe II attachments.

We also expanded the merit point and job point systems by boosting the caps on each category. To coincide with this, we also added new gifts. Reaching 2,100 points will unlock “★Master!,” which gives you a special job trait, title, and animation. For those of you who wish to hide your master status, you can do this by using the text command “/jobmasterdisp off”.
Trust Initiative
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui

(52:47～)

We increased the area of effect of all Protectra and Shellra magic, which has reduced the need to individually cast these spells on party members and alter egos that were out of range.

We also introduced some new alter egos during the stream. Check out the archived footage to see examples of battle with Iroha and Shantotto II. Iroha can skill chain and Shantotto II can follow up with repeated magic bursts.

Iroha can execute 4 skillchains by herself. You can indicate when she does this by using Meditate. She can be obtained by progressing through Rhapsodies of Vana’diel.

Shantotto II only uses one type of elemental magic, but it is extremely powerful. Additionally, her auto-attacks have elemental properties, and she will select the element that your opponent is weak against. She can be obtained through the November Login Campaign.

We also showed off the various ark angel alter egos we are planning to release in the future.
Campaigns and Announcements
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(1:06:36～)

■Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign
We’re currently in the midst of the Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign.
It ends on Tuesday, November 24 at 12:00 a.m. PST, so be sure to use this opportunity to experience Rhapsodies of Vana’diel.

■Discount Campaign
The FINAL FANTASY XI: Ultimate Collection Seekers Edition is available for 75% off until Monday, November 30 at 12:00 a.m. PST. Additionally, World transfers are half off!

■Active Adventurer Appreciation Campaign
Until Tuesday, November 24 at 12:00 a.m. PST, we will be handing out a red mog pell to all eligible players with active subscriptions, and two green mog pells to everyone who logs before this time. If you’re coming back after a while, I recommend using your green mog pells for copper vouchers, and then exchanging these for 20,000 sparks. With these points you’ll be able to purchase item level 117 equipment and get much stronger right away.

■Rhapsodies of Mog Bonanza
There are a ton of new items this time around for Mog Bonanza and that includes the moogle-related items such as the Kupo Suit, Kupo Masque, Kupo Rod, and Kupo Shield.
Marbles are available for purchase until Thursday, December 10 at 12:00 a.m. PST.
  • Kupo Rod
    Moogle Blessing: Cures weakened

  • Kupo Shield
    Synthesis skill +3

  • Kupo Masque
    Gluttony: Extends food effect duration

  • Kupo Suit
    Movement speed +18%

■Final Chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana’diel Celebration Campaign
We have various campaigns currently underway that provide a multitude of bonuses. The campaigns end on Monday, November 30 at 6:59 p.m. PST.

■Special Anniversary Battle Event: A Feast Most Dire
In celebration of the “XI Day” we are holding a special event, “A Feast Most Dire.” This will also last until Monday, November 30 at 6:59 p.m. PST.

Visit the campaign page of the Goddess’s Gala site for details on each campaign.
Conclusion
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui

(1:25:23～)

Thank you very much to all of the adventurers that continue to support us and welcomed in the final chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana’diel. Please enjoy the cutscenes and story that the development team has poured their energy into making.

Looking towards the future, we will be holding another version update in early December. This update will include the completed Aeonic weapons.

Additionally, after April we will be implementing monthly battlefields and Records of Eminence content. I’ll be sure to let you know more details soon. Furthermore, service for the PS2 and Xbox 360 will end in March of next year, but before this we are planning to have another version update as a show of gratitude.

Rhapsodies of Vana’diel was created with a large feeling of thankfulness. If you haven’t yet, we’d love for you to try it out and look forward to the future. Thank you very much.

Event-related

  • A new quest related to Aeonic weapons has been added.
    Attachment 11614 Attachment 11615
    Aeonic weapons are a new class of weapons alongside Relic, Mythic, Empyrean, and Ergon weapons.
    These weapons allow their bearers to use weapon skills obtained through the power of the bushin and grant and Aftermath effect when used. While this Aftermath effect is active, the wielder can execute the ultimate Radiance and Umbra skillchains.
    *You must have completed the final chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana'diel to receive this quest.
    *The strength of used weapon skills is equivalent to that of a fifth tier upgraded merit point category.
    *While the Aftermath effect is active, applicable skillchains will be imbued with either Light or Darkness.
    *If an ultimate skill chain is successfully executed, the Aftermath effect will be lost.
  • The following additions have been made to Unity Concord.
    • New Unity shirts have been added.
      Attachment 11616
      If you have an individual evaluation of 10 points or greater for two weeks running, you will be able to purchase a unique outfit styled after your Unity leader from your Unity's item exchange list.
      Calling forth your Unity leader's alter ego while your Unity shirt is equipped will grant you status effect bonuses that scale with your Unity's ranking.
      *Speak to either Urbiolaine in Southern San d'Oria (G-10), Igsli in Bastok Markets (E-11), Teldro-Kesdrodo Yonolala in Windurst Woods (J-10), or Nunaarl Bthtrogg in Western Adoulin (H-11).
      *You can only claim the Unity shirt of your current Unity.
    • During Wanted battles, unrelated PCs, NPCs, and monsters will be hidden from view.
  • A new jump emote has been added.
    Attachment 11617
    A player character can now leap into the air by selecting "/jump" from the emote list or by entering the "/jump" text command.
    *This emote cannot be used to jump to raised platforms or otherwise access new areas.
    *The jump emote may be interrupted, for instance, when receiving damage.
    • When can I jump?
      The /jump emote can be used together with the following actions:
      Standing still / Walking / Running / Sliding / Moving backwards / Sheathing a weapon / Drawing a weapon
  • Item exchange NPCs will now handle the following items.
    Sarissaphoroi belt / Luminary sash / Tatenashi gote / Tatenashi gote +1 / Thureous earring /
    Dignitary's earring / Exemplar / Tatenashi sune-ate / Tatenashi sune-ate +1 / Sanctity necklace / Solemnity cape
  • New titles have been added.

Battle-related

  • The following changes and additions have been made to Geas Fete.
    Attachment 11618
    • Notorious monsters have been added to Reisenjima.
    • The radius of Geas Fete battle areas has been reduced in the following areas.
      Escha - Zi'Tah / Escha - Ru'Aun / Reisenjima
    • The number and re-spawn times of monsters that appear near ??? targets in Reisenjima have been adjusted.
    • New spoils have been added for the following notorious monsters.
      Ascended Chapuli / Ascended Mosquito / Ascended Mantis / Ascended Beetle /
      Ascended Luckybug / Ascended Lucani / Ascended Porxie / Ascended Cyhiraeth /
      Ascended Tiger / Ascended Naraka / Ascended Panopt / Ascended Poroggo /

    • The temporary items sold by NPCs have been changed.
      Affi in Escha - Zi'Tah (F-12), Dremi in Escha - Ru'Aun (H-11) and Shiftrix in Reisenjima (F-12) will now sell Super Revitalizers* instead of Revitalizers. Also, any Revitalizer obtained in one of the above areas already in a character's inventory will be replaced with Super Revitalizer.
      * This item instantly resets the recast time for all non-one hour abilities.
    • The effect duration timer for the radialens key item will now continue to run even while your character is logged off.
    • The number of items required for the exchange of the following key items has been decreased.
      Strophadia's pearl / Gajasimha's mane / Ironside's maul /
      Sarsaok's hoard / Old Shuck's tuft / Bashmu's trinket /
  • The drop rate of spoils from Dynamis-Buburimu, Dynamis-Qufim, and Dynamis-Valkurum have been adjusted.
    The quality and quantity of damaged relic equipment earned from defeating regular monsters has been balanced so that equipment for all jobs and slots has an equal chance of dropping.
  • Alter egos have undergone the following adjustments.

      • The fifth tier of the merit point category "Quick Draw Accuracy" has been added.

    • Nanaa Mihgo

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 23 Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the December version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another "Freshly Picked Vana'diel" to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui

Hello, everyone. Matsui here.

This time around for Freshly Picked Vana'diel we tried incorporating some new aspects and segments into the mix, so I hope you enjoy the new content.

<iframe width="640" height="360" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/1eZB_ngFuc4" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Aeonic Weapons
  • Geas Fete Additions and Adjustments

  • Campaign and Event Announcements
  • Conclusion
Aeonic Weapons

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(3:43～)
As a special guest we’ve invited the item team lead, Kasa, on the show who gave an overview of Aeonic weapons.

With the addition of a new quest, you can now obtain Aeonic weapons once you have completed it.

These weapons have high damage, high combat/magic accuracy skill, and when compared to other existing item level 119 weapons, they are quite superior. Additionally they all possess the Store TP and TP Bonus traits and are tailored towards using weapon skills.

The new ultimate skillchains, “Radiance” and “Umbra,” can be activated while under the effects of each weapon’s aftermath in the following manner:
With level 1 aftermath: Any skillchain -> any skillchain -> level 3 skillchain -> level 3 skillchain -> ultimate skillchain.
With level 2 aftermath: Any skillchain -> level 3 skillchain -> level 3 skillchain -> ultimate skillchain.
With level 3 aftermath: Level 3 skillchain -> level 3 skillchain -> ultimate skillchain.

Also, currently as of Dec. 10, 2015, we have confirmed an issue with the Marsyas. The “March+” bonus upon equipping the instrument is not being applied to the song “Honor March” that is usable by having the instrument equipped. We are planning to fix this issue.
Geas Fete Additions and Adjustments

Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(5:52～)
In regards to the adjustments to battle area sizes, we have received all of your feedback, and we decided to temporarily implement the first option to decrease the battle area size.

The team’s structure may change in the future, and we would like to implement this and have you try it out while the content design lead is on the team. If there are any opinions and feedback asking to revert it back to the original size, we will adjust it as needed, so we thank you for your cooperation.

Also, as we noted in the version update notes, the effect of the Key Item “radialens” now persists even if the character is not logged in. The effect duration will deplete even while logged out, but originally the effect ran out the moment the user logged off, so we have implemented this as a way to fix that.

The temporary item “Revitalizer” is a powerful medicine and leaving it as is would necessitate the need to nerf it, so it has been replaced with the “Super Revitalizer” that does not reset SP abilities.

Unity Concord
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(13:22～)
Equipment sets for Unity have been added. Summoning the corresponding Unity leader while wearing the equipment will apply a small status bonus. The bonus will increase with higher ranking.

Also, all of this equipment can be stored with the Porter Moogle, so try your hand at collecting them all.
Equipment Adjustments
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(15:09～)
Certain items of the following sets have been adjusted.

Lustratio Gear / Souveran Gear / Argosy Gear / Rao Gear
Apogee Gear / Carmine Gear / Emicho Gear / Ryuo Gear
Adhemar Gear / Amalric Gear / Kaykaus Gear

The gear obtained from Reisenjima Geas Fete battle content is powerful, so we have adjusted some of the abjuration equipment to hopefully catch up to it. With these adjustments, the gear strength should fall in the following order: HQ abjuration equipment > Reisenjima equipment > NQ abjuration equipment. However, it should be noted that some pieces may not follow this order.
Emote Additions
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
A jump emote has been added. This is something that was suddenly created, though not quite as sudden as the adjustment to the beetle’s right front leg. However, this does not function as a means of movement within the game.

Similar to the “/sitchair” emote, this is a special emote, but please give it a try.
Directly Picked Vana’diel

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(18:14～)

This is a new segment of the show that utilizes the questionnaire feature of the Nico Nico Live Broadcasting. Users are able to answer questions on various topics with the questionnaire, and the development team explains directly on in “Directly Picked Vana’diel.”

Making his second appearance on the show, Lead Event Planner Saito aided us in giving answers.

Now for the first question.
“When augmenting gear from Reisenjima with Arcane Glyptics, what items do you most often use?”
Below are the results of the questionnaire:
  1. Pellucid Stone: 29.6%
  2. Fern Stone : 13.3%
  3. Taupe Stone: 17.0%
  4. Other: 40.1%

There were a lot of viewers who chose “Other” as their answer since they have yet to obtain this gear.
Pellucid Stones allow for high values of attack and accuracy, Fern Stones have higher values for ability-related properties, and Taupe Stones allows for a high value of STR to be added.

Also included in “Other” are those that choose to trade in Dark Matter with their equipment and gain a special Arcane Glyptic. Among them is “Treasure Hunter” which is a property that cannot be obtained through normal Arcane Glyptics. Also among the best results include having “Double Attack +5%”, “Triple Attack +4%” and “Quadruple Attack +3%” all at the same time. Dark Matter also has a chance to yield higher stat gains than other stones. For example, a Pellucid Stone can give up to +40 but Dark Matter can give up to +50.

Since Dark Matter is an item in low supply, we have thought of implementing a new campaign that would let the user use Dark Matter for their Arcane Glyptics up to 3 times in a day, but there have been requests to let the user use them even more than that, so we will implement a campaign that will let you do this up to 6 times a day--meaning you use this for a weapon and 5 pieces of gear. Please look forward to this!

Onto the second question.
“Which of the following holds the highest sway in the power balance of Vana’diel?”

The following is a tally of the answers we received:
  1. Altana: 40.3%
  2. Promathia: 5.4%
  3. Bahamut: 5.4%
  4. Crystals: 48.8%

Crystals do in fact hold the highest sway in the power balance followed by Altana, Promathia, and finally Bahamut. However, this is only speaking in terms of the Vana’diel that you see in the game today. Had it been in the world as it was originally, Altana and Promathia would be at the same level. Provenance Watcher would also be somewhere in between Altana and Promathia.

This is all in terms of their deific hierarchy and not related to their actual strength and power. For example, when it comes to Cait Sith and Bahamut, godhood-wise Cait Sith is higher ranking, but in a battle Bahamut would like win. One thing to note as well is that Abyssea is a world where the borders of the world no longer exist, so all beings are even.
What if Vana’diel…

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(37:34～)

This is another new segment that we started where we’ll discuss aspects and ideas for Vana’diel that didn’t quite make it into the game.

The first for today is that there was actually one more chapter for the Seekers of Adoulin story.

Separate from the ending for Seekers of Adoulin that everyone is familiar with, there was actually a different ending planned. We determined that it would be difficult to implement this, and instead we adopted the ending that you can currently play. If you look at the video, we showed off some images of Tartarus, an area that we planned on adding. This is a realm that was created by Hades, though he has no knowledge of the fact that he made it. Additionally, we showed off an illustration of the boss that awaited in Tartarus, which is a manifestation of Hades absorbing August’s power. Another idea we had was to create a boss that was a fusion of Balamor and Omega.

Next is how we were going to originally implement Empyrean armor as different color Artifact armor.

About one year prior to implementing Abyssea we had planned on implementing new equipment based on Artifact armor with modified colors and pieces. However, we ultimately ended up completely redesigning the equipment.

As a matter of fact, the original design for Masamune was completely different at first. Since there were a lot of great katanas that looked similar, we ended up redesigning it to what it is currently.

Finally, we originally had plans to make it so Galkas could have two food effects active at the same time.

When we were designing the system for food, we originally had two slots for effects, but the effects at that time and what we ended up implementing were quite different, and we determined that it would be too powerful to have two effects at the same time. We thought to possibly reduce the effect duration to compensate, but ultimately decided to scrap this idea.
Campaign and Event Announcements
Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(50:42～)

We’re planning to hold a variety of campaigns and events both in and out of the game, so please look over the schedule.
  • New Year Adventurer Assistance Campaign
    This campaign is set for a slightly longer duration, so please take advantage of it during the holidays!
    It’s active from Thursday, December 10, 2015 at 12:00 a.m. (PST) to Tuesday, January 5, 2016 at 6:59 a.m. (PST).

  • Starlight Celebration
    By using the Leaf Bench item that can be obtained from this seasonal event, you’ll learn a new sitting emote. It works great with the Astral Cube item that can be obtained from the December Login Campaign, which makes it possible to seat three people at once.

  • Rhapsodies of Vana’diel Ending Song Video
    We’ve released a promotional video for the Rhapsodies of Vana’diel ending song. Many of you contributed to the chorus, and those who did were added to the credits. Be sure to watch the video!

  • Shantotto joins Dissidia FINAL FANTASY
    Shantotto has been added to the Dissidia FINAL FANTASY arcade game. As her HP gets lower she starts to become enraged and becomes more powerful. If you have the opportunity, please be sure to try her out.
Conclusion

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
(54:32～)

Thanks to everyone’s support, we were able to usher in the ending to Rhapsodies of Vana’diel. During development while performing checks on the scenario, we were becoming teary eyed as it made us think about everything that we had made over the past thirteen years. I’m sure you can all feel this too. If you haven’t yet, please experience the climatic ending of this scenario.

As I mentioned in my message on PlayOnline, from April 2016 onward we will be placing a focus on battles and story content. Around that time as well, we will also be planning on adding in mounts other than chocobos. Though we are still touching this system up, I showed off a demo of the raptor mount during the stream. Naturally we are planning to add other monsters as mounts as well, so stay tuned.

The next version update is schedule for February, so I’ll see you again around then!

Event-related

  • <strong>An event to further reforge relic, mythic, empyrean, and ergo weapons have been added.</strong>
    Oboro in Port Jeuno (E-6) has been further refining his techniques and is ready to share them with the world. Improving relic, mythic, empyrean, and ergon weapons requires possession of the weapon in question and the scintillating rhapsody key item.
    Attachment 11653 Attachment 11654
    • Weapons that may be reforged
      • Relic Weapons
        The damage and combat skills of the following weapons will be increased via reforging.
        Spharai / Mandau / Excalibur / Ragnarok / Guttler / Bravura / Apocalypse / Gungnir / Kikoku / Amanomurakumo / Mjollnir / Claustrum / Yoichinoyumi / Annihilator
        * Aegis and Gjallarhorn may not be further reforged.
        Only item level 119 weapons may be forged, and those that do not have n afterglow effect will have one granted. Additionally, the weapons will receive an aftermath effect.
        * The details of the various aftermath effects are given in the items' help text.
