  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51345?p=585328#post585328">Known Issues</a>

Event-related

  • The following additions and adjustments have been made to Records of Eminence.
    • New objectives have been added.
    • The action logic for selecting entries when exchanging speaks of eminence for items has been adjusted.
      When receiving points or items, the cursor will be displayed on the selecting item.
  • Spoils have been added to the quest The Moonlight Path.
  • The following additions and adjustments have been made to Mog Gardens.
    • The creature species will now display when examining a creature that is currently being reared.
    • Various Mog Garden-related data is now viewable.
      Select “Learn about the garden” then “Tidbits of information” to view this data.
  • A new alter ego has been added.
  • A new designation has been added.

Battle-related

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes found in Ambuscades and Intense Ambuscades have been changed.
      Attachment 11805
      • Certain rewards obtainable for total Hallmarks have been changed.
        Equipment is now available in exchange for a new type of voucher.

        Players may trade one of the vouchers below to Gorpa-Masorpa in Mhaura (G-9) to receive a corresponding piece of equipment detailed in the voucher's help text.
        Ambuscade Voucher: Head / Ambuscade Voucher: Chest /Ambuscade Voucher: Hands /
        Ambuscade Voucher: Legs / Ambuscade Voucher: Feet / Ambuscade Voucher: Head +1 /
        Ambuscade Voucher: Chest +1 / Ambuscade Voucher: Hands +1 / Ambuscade Voucher: Legs +1 /
        Ambuscade Voucher: Feet +1
      • Certain rewards obtainable for badges of gallantry have been changed.
  • Master Trials have undergone the following additions.
    • A new trial, Sealed Fate, has been added.
      Attachment 11806
      • Requirements
        • Be in possession of the beckoning bell item.
          * All participating players must be in possession of this item.
        • Be of a main job level of 99 and have received the Job Master designation for that job.
          * Players will be unable to participate if they are on a job they have not yet mastered.
      • Joining the Fray

        1. Speak to Emporox in Reisenjima and purchase a beckoning bell for 250 potpourri.
        　　* Players must have completed Rhapsodies of Vana'diel.

        2. Trade the beckoning bell to the transcendental radiance in Empyreal Paradox and select “Sealed Fate” to enter the battlefield.

        3. Vanquish the designated fiends.
        • Between one and six players may participate.
        • The time limit for the battle is 60 minutes.
          * Players will be removed from the battle once the time limit expires.
        4. Receive Rewards
        　　* A system message will display if the spoils cannot not be obtained.
  • The system in which the damage of certain area of effect special abilities used by monsters is decreased against non-primary targets has been introduced to all areas.
  • The spoils available in Walk of Echoes have been changed.
  • The following job-related adjustments have been made.
    • Summoner
      • The areas of effect of the following pet command have been increased.
        Lunar Roar / Slowga / Diamond Storm / Thunderspark / Shock Squall / Nightmare /
        Ultimate Terror / Sleepga

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
    Attachment 11807
  • New synthesis recipes have been added.
  • The following items have been added to Kupons AW-WK
    Nepote Bell / Barataria Ring
  • Chococards are now deliverable to other players on the same account.
  • Detailed help text has been added to the following items.
    Sea Bass Croute / Salmon Sandwich / White Bread / Black Bread / Bretzel / Orange Kuchen / Galkan Sausage /
    Sausage Roll / Cinna-cookie / Roast Trout / Baked Apple / Carp Sushi / Tortilla / Hard-boiled Egg / Roasted Cord /
    Dhalmel Stew / Mushroom Risotto / Baked Popoto / Roast Mutton / Dhalmel Steak / Navarin / Whitefish Stew /
    Eel Kabob / Goblin Bread / Nebimonite Bake / Stone Cheese / Goblin Stew / Garlic Cracker / Colored Egg /
    Vegetable Gruel / Pickled Herring / Puls / Windurstian Tea / San d'Orian Tea / Goblin Chocolate / Bubble Chocolate /
    Heart Chocolate / Chocomilk / Iron Bread / Marron Glace / Mutton tortilla / Rarab Meatball / Wild Steak /
    Coin Cookie / Royal Tea / Soft-boiled Egg / Delicious Puls / Medicinal Gruel / Boiled Crayfish / Blackened Frog /
    Roast Carp / Boiled Tuna Head / Brain Stew / Mushroom Stew
  • The help text of the following items has been adjusted.
    Mujin Band / Ochu / Arasy Staff / Arasy Staff +1 / Samnuha Coat / Amalric Gages / Amalric Gages +1

System-related

  • A new confirmation system has been added to the porter moogle.
    The porter moogle will now tell you if an item can be stored when a player trades him the said item.

    If an item can be stored, the portal moogle will tell you which slip the item corresponds to.
  • Mounts and personal chocobos have undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • New mounts have been added.
      Attachment 11808
    • Mounts and personal chocobos may now be ridden in the following areas.
      Yahse Hunting Grounds / Ceizak Battlegrounds / Foret de Hennetiel / Yorcia Weald /
      Morimar Basalt Fields / Marjami Ravine / Kamihr Drifts
  • Chocobo digging may now be enjoyed in the following areas.
    Yahse Hunting Grounds / Ceizak Battlegrounds / Foret de Hennetiel / Yorcia Weald /
    Morimar Basalt Fields / Marjami Ravine / Kamihr Drifts
    * Digging in these areas will reward players with bayld in lieu of beastmen currency.
  • Synthesis has undergone the following adjustments.
    • The rate at which synthesis skills increase below skill level 70 has been greatly raised.
      * This adjustment does not apply to fishing or synergy.
  • A new category, “Active Effects,” has been added to the key items menu.
    This category will display which Moghancements and Chacharoon Cheer effects are active.
  • The following terms have been added to the autotranslate dictionary.

    <table width="400" border="0"><tr><td width="40%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Category</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Term</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Tactics</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Piercing</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Tactics</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Slashing</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Tactics</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Blunt</td></tr></table>

Resolved Issues

  • The issue with Domain Invasion wherein alter egos would occasionally despawn in battle.
  • The issue with the black magic Helix spells wherein the effects of the Helix Effect Duration augment were not activating.
  • The issue with chocobo digging wherein players successfully rolled to dig up beastmen currency or imperial standing without meeting the necessary prerequisites to do so would have their failed attempt count for Records of Eminence objectives.
  • The issue with chocobo digging wherein no message is displayed when digging yields nothing.
  • The issue with Records of Eminence NPCs wherein the confirmation window when selecting a skill-up book for purchase would not display.

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 28 Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the September 2016 version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by “Akihiko_Matsui”
Hello, everyone!
Matsui here. Thanks for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 28.

For this month’s broadcast we streamed the day prior to the version update and focused on giving insight into the content that would be implemented.

If you missed the stream or just want to check out the information once again, I’ve compiled a digest of all the content.

<iframe width="640" height="360" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/gkp5q7Ph-e8" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents:
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51373#mogivana28_01" class="brlink">Version Update Overview</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51373#mogivana28_02" class="brlink">Ambuscade</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51373#mogivana28_03" class="brlink">Master Trials</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51373#mogivana28_04" class="brlink">Mounts</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51373#mogivana28_05" class="brlink">Other Adjustments</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51373#mogivana28_06" class="brlink">Directly Picked Vana’diel</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51373#mogivana28_07" class="brlink">Fujito’s /shout</a>

<div id="mogivana28_01"></div>
  • Version Update Overview
    (6:25～)

    This segment of the show revolved around information about the larger parts of the September version update. We explained about this month’s Ambuscade challenges as well as the newly added Master Trial.

    <div id="mogivana28_02"></div>
    • Ambuscade
      (7:08～)
      Director Yoji Fujito took on the new Ambuscade challenges, so if you’d like to see the result of that please take a look at the video.

      This month’s Regular Ambuscade challenge is against a single gnole. While gnoles typically have varying power depending on the moon phase, we removed this trait for Ambuscade so it can be challenged with ease.

      When challenging this with only a few people, it’s a good idea to use alter egos of non-human character to guard against the gnole’s special trait “human killer.”

      (15:49～)
      Fujito also tried his hand at this month’s Intense Ambuscade challenge, which is against a group of Mamool Jas. The strategic point of this challenge is removing the aura that surrounds each monster.

      We introduced the new AAGK alter ego, but Fujito fell in battle instantly, so we weren’t able to show him off in full. Get your hands on this alter ego and try out his power for yourselves.

      (22:22～)
      The rewards for this month are tickets which you can exchange for previously available Ambuscade armor. There are also tickets for the HQ versions of the armor. If you missed out on any piece of equipment from prior months, please put these tickets to use!

      <div id="mogivana28_03"></div>
    • Master Trials
      (25:33～)
      We introduced the new master trial, “Sealed Fate.”

      (26:43～)
      This battle is against Omega and Ultima. It’s at a difficulty where not just anyone can beat it, so we hope you can win after repeating through trial and error.

      (28:12～)
      The reward this time around is a pair of hand-to-hand weapons. As usual, it is a piece of cosmetic gear for lock style, and can be used by all jobs.

      <div id="mogivana28_03"></div>
    • Mounts
      (31:01～)
      At long last we implemented Fenrir as a mount. To obtain it, you need to complete the quest “The Moonlit Path.”

      We’re planning on expanding the areas in which mounts can be ridden as we move forward, and in the next version update it will be possible to ride mounts in Adoulin areas.

      <div id="mogivana28_03"></div>
    • Other Adjustments
      (41:17～)
      In addition to the above content, we also made various other adjustments and went over them on the stream.
      • Synthesis adjustments
      • Porter moogle confirmation system
      • Addition of physical damage types to the auto-translate dictionary
      • Expanded monster AoE ability adjustment to all areas
      • Addition of “Active Effects” added to the key item menu

<div id="mogivana28_06"></div>
  • Directly Picked Vana’diel
    (44:41～)
    As usual, during this segment we used a survey tool to interact directly with viewers.

    Question #1:
    “How many Hallmarks do you aim to get each month?”

    Viewers answered with the following:
    1. 1,050+: 17.1%
    2. 8,500+: 6.8%
    3. 14,500+: 41.2%
    4. 20,000+: 27.0%
    5. 50,000+: 7.9%

    Based on the results of this poll, it seems that most aim to get a full set of the HQ armor each time.
    1,050 is the amount needed to get a full set of NQ armor, and 8,500 is what is needed to get up through the HQ legs.

    While the points required to fully enhance a cape are quite high, getting a full party together and beating the very difficult mode will yield a good amount of points, so definitely give this a try if you have yet to do it.

    Speaking of Hallmarks, we tallied up the total amount of Hallmarks earned by all players during the month of August…

    355,247,725
    *Tally based on the period from August 3, 2016 to August 31, 2016

    We also looked at the total number of Hallmarks earned to date (9/4), and it is 4 times the above number!

    (50:05～)
    Question #2:
    “How do you primarily earn your points?”

    Results:
    1. Regular Ambuscade: 56.8%
    2. Intense Ambuscade: 33.0%
    3. Equally between the two: 10.2%

    (51:56～)
    Question #3:
    “How do you normally challenge Ambuscade?”
    1. Solo: 40.6%
    2. Party: 59.4%

    The results of these polls are very useful for the development team, so thank you to all who participate each time! The questions this time around were quite simple, but we’d like to start asking some deeper questions!

<div id="mogivana28_07"></div>
  • Fujito’s /shout
    (56:15～)
    This is a new segment with Director Yoji Fujito that is primarily about campaigns and future announcements.

    (56:51～)
    →September Login Campaign / Beat the Heat Campaign
    The September Login Campaign starts a bit later than usual. We’ll be adding time to get points to compensate.

    We’re also holding various in-game campaigns this month as well.
    Based on everyone’s feedback, we’ll look into the campaigns for October and November.
    (1:03:49～)
    →Future version update
    We’re currently in the midst of planning new battle content that is separate from Ambuscade and Master Trials. Hang in there a bit and we’ll be able to show it off soon.

The next Freshly Picked Vana’diel will take place in two months, and since it will fall in November, the month of XI, we will be delivering even more information than usual!

I’ll see you all then!

Event-related

  • New Records of Eminence objectives have been added.
    Attachment 11823

Battle-related

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The villains lying in wait in normal and intense ambuscades have been swapped out.
      Attachment 11824
    • The rewards obtainable for hallmarks have been swapped out.

    • The rewards obtainable for total hallmarks have been swapped out.

    • The rewards obtainable for badges of gallantry have been swapped out.
  • The Trust Initiative has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • New alter egos have been added.
    • Alter egos may now be called forth in the following battlefields.
      A Thief in Norg!? / The Puppet Master / Carbuncle Debacle / Class Reunion / Omens / Against All Odds / Puppetmaster Blues / Seeing Blood-red
    • The attributes and abilities of the following alter egos have been adjusted.
      • Luzaf
        • Weapon skill usage logic has been updated.
        • The potency of the weapon skill Bisection has been increased, and its skillchain attribute has been changed to Scission / Detonation.
        • The potency of the weaponskill Akimbo Shot has been increased, and its skillchain attribute has been changed to Compression.
        • The potency of the weaponskill Grisly Horizon has been increased, and its skillchain attribute has been changed to Darkness / Distortion.
        • The attributes Accuracy+ and “Store TP” have been added.
        • The frequency of use and activation of the ability Triple Shot have been increased.
      • Ovjang
        • The chance of executing, and the potency of, the weapon skill Sixth Element have been increased.
      • Mnejing
        • The chance of executing, and the potency of, the weapon skill Shield Subverter have been increased.
        • The attribute “Physical Damage Taken-“ has been changed to “Damage Taken-“ and its effect has been increased.
        • Mnejing now uses a shield.
      • Nashmeira
        • The potency of the weapon skill Imperial Authority has been increased.
      • Nashmeira II
        • The potency of the weapon skill Imperial Authority has been increased.

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • A new synergy recipe has been added.

    Cotton Coin Purse / Linen Coin Purse / Heavy Metal Pouch / Pluton Case / Beitetsu Parcel / Boulder Case / Pluton Box / Beitetsu Box / Boulder Box / Aged Box (Bayld) / Frayed Sack (Pel) / Frayed Sack (Fer) / Frayed Sack (Tau)

    Smoked Salmon / Raisin Bread / Boiled Cockatrice / Coeurl Saute / Bream Risotto / Salmon Croute / Herb Crawler Eggs / Batagreen Saute / Windurst Salad / Steamed Catfish / Herb Quus / Seafood Stew / Pamama Tart / Royal Omelette / Moon Ball / Quadav Stew / Beaugreen Saute / Steel Bread / Sausage / Blackened Newt / Bass Meuniere / Salmon Meuniere / Flounder Meuniere / Broiled Carp / Broiled Trout / Broiled Eel / Wild Stew / Salmon Riceball / Pumpernickel / Rock Cheese / Party Egg / Blackened Toad / Lucky Egg / Sopa Pez Blanco / Naval Rice Ball / Hydra Kofte / Hydra Kofte +1 / Hellsteak / Hellsteak +1 / Konigskuchen / Lebkuchen House / Lebkuchen Manse / Roast Turkey / Candy Ring / Candy Cane / Tonno Rosso / Tonno Rosso +1 / Maple Cake / Silken Siesta / Yogurt Cake / Silken Smile / Orange Cake / Silken Squeeze / Pumpkin Cake / Silken Sash / Chocolate Cake / Silken Spirit / Cupid Chocolate
  • New items are now storable via the porter moogle.
    • Storage Slip 22
      Kakai Cap / Kakai Cap +1
    • Storage Slip 23
      Flamma Zucchetto / Flamma Korazin / Flamma Manopolas/ Flamma Dirs / Flamma Gambieras / Flamma Zucchetto +1 / Flamma Korazin +1 / Flamma Manopolas +1 / Flamma Dirs +1 / Flamma Gambieras +1

System-related

  • The following items are now available via chocobo digging.
    Misareaux Parsley / Lufaise Fly
  • The page transfer routines of survival guides have been adjusted.
    If you do not have sufficient currency to pay the teleportation cost, the game will switch to a window in which you can select the payment method.
  • The page transfer routine of atmacite refiners and planar rifts have been adjusted.
    When powering up atmacite, the game will switch to a window where the type of atmacite may be selected.
  • The maximum amount of phase displacers that may be purchased from Ardrick at a time has been adjusted to 99.

Resolved Issues

  • Various issues with erroneous NPC dialogue and help text.
  • Various event display issues with certain missions and quests.
  • The issue with Master Trials wherein the magic evasion of notorious monsters appearing in Sealed Fate was higher than intended.
  • The issue with the Records of Eminence objective Conflict: Sih Gates II in which vanquished monsters not part of the objective would count toward successful completion.
  • The issue with Monstrosity wherein the appropriate system message does not display when engaging in Belligerency.
  • The issue with the Arasy Sword wherein the graphic was incorrect.
  • The issue with chocobo digging wherein the items obtained from certain areas were incorrect.

Known Issues

  • Fulfilling the requirements of the Records of Eminence objective “It’s Over Ninety-Thousand” will occasionaly fail to yield proper credit for completion.
  • When speaking to Kupipi in Heavens Tower, the cutscene for the Cipher: Semih acquisition event will occasionally erroneously play.
  • Speaking with Monisette in Port Jeuno (I-8) wile meeting the prerequisites for only reforging empyrean equipment will cause an improper visual event.
  • The line editor will overlap with the HP bar under certain conditions.

Event-related

  • Mog Gardens have undergone the following adjustments.
    • When feeding reared creatures, it is now possible for the creature to transform into a subspecies regardless of parenting style.

    • A new message will display when a monster transforms into a subspecies.

Battle-related

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes present in normal and intense Ambuscades have changed.
      Attachment 11837
    • Some rewards obtainable in change for total hallmarks have been changed.

    • Some rewards obtainable for badges of gallantry have been changed.
  • The value of the job trait Smite has been increased.
  • The hand-to-hand combat damage cap has been increased.

title: Freshly Picked Vana’diel 29 Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the November 2016 version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, everyone! Matsui here.

Thank you so much for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel the other day.
This month we held the stream the prior to the version update, and we focused on an overview of the November version update as well as a bunch of other information.

For those of you who were not able to catch the broadcast live, or just simply want a recap on all of the information, the archived video is available below and I’ve organized this digest.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/1PfOq5vix78" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of contents:
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51675#mogivana29_01" class="brlink">Version Update Overview</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51675#mogivana29_02" class="brlink">Battle Content: Ambuscade</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51675#mogivana29_03" class="brlink">Job Adjustments</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51675#mogivana29_04" class="brlink">New Segment: “The More You Know – Vana’diel”</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51675#mogivana29_05" class="brlink">Fujito’s /shout</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51675#mogivana29_06" class="brlink">New Battle Content: Omen</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51675#mogivana29_07" class="brlink">Ultimate Sythesis Equipment (tentative name)</a>

<div id="mogivana29_01"></div>
  • Version Update Overview
    (0:02:42)
    This segment of the show focused on the big aspects of the November version update.

    <div id="mogivana29_02"></div>
    • Battle Content: Ambuscade
      (0:03:26)
      Director Fujito challenged the latest Ambuscade Volume 2 battle, so be sure to give the video a watch to get an idea of the fight.

      This month’s Volume 2 enemy is a Belladonna; however, she doesn’t use charm. She will switch into a mode where she has an aura, and once this is up it will place various debuff effects on players. The key point of the strategy is determining how to remove this aura. We gave a small hint while Fujito was fighting, so check out the video is you want to find out.

      Intense Ambuscade on the other hand features Trolls. In addition to the boss, there are multiple adds that will appear as well. The adds are paladins and rangers, and depending on the difficulty the number of adds will vary. The theme of this fight is “whack-a-mole”, so try and decipher what that means by heading into the fight and giving it a try.

      (0:11:25)
      This month’s reward is an equipment set for pet jobs. Naturally, there is a +1 version as well.

      (0:12:37)
      We’ve been updating Ambuscade since April, and we’ve received a lot of feedback and requests since its release. In regard to the difficulty, we’re striving to make adjustments so that both our casual players and our hardcore players are satisfied based on the responses we have been seeing. To give an example based on past content, we feel that the right difficulty is somewhere between the taurus and the dragon. Additionally, depending on the enemy there will always be cases where certain jobs may be tailored slightly better, and while we apologize for this, we’d appreciate it if you select the appropriate difficulty if you are having trouble clearing it with a particular job.

      (0:14:23)
      During the live stream we received comments mentioning that the total amount of Hallmarks needed for the +1 equipment felt too high. The idea behind +1 is that you put effort in and are able to get the full set, and we feel that there is no issue with the current balance. The Ambuscade equipment is filled with useful stats that are quite high, but there is also high-tier equipment available through avenues such as the Geas Fetes in Reisenjima, so we’d like players to see this as an another option. As for the other feedback we received during the show, we will keep it in mind for future considerations.

      <div id="mogivana29_03"></div>
    • Job Adjustments
      We gave an explanation on the job adjustments that took place in the November version update.

      ▼Pet command: Blood Pact
      （0:21:05）
      • Addition of a TP modifier for physical Blood Pacts
      • Damage adjustments to each hit of multi-hit physical Blood Pacts
      We made adjustments so that the stats of physical Blood Pacts are increased through a TP modifier. Coinciding with this, we also made changes so that each hit of multi-hit physical Blood Pacts would receive a damage modifier, and with this change even if the first hit misses the overall damage would not be greatly lowered. I’d like to note that monsters who use avatars have not been adjusted in the same way.

      ▼Adjustments to two-handed weapons and hand-to-hand
      (0:22:59)
      • The effect values of the job trait Smite have been increased
      • The damage cap for hand-to-hand has been increase through a change in the specs
      Compared to dual wielding one-hand weapons, both two-handed weapons and hand-to-hand were lacking in performance, so we made adjustments to boost the amount of damage that can be dealt while using two-handed weapons and hand-to-hand.

<div id="mogivana29_04"></div>
  • New segment: “The More You Know – Vana’diel”
    (0:25:43)
    This is a new segment of the stream that delivers some fun trivia. During the stream we had viewers guess the word should be placed in the “???” area, and then we revealed some hidden Vana’diel lore.
    If you didn’t watch the stream, try to guess the answer to the below! For the answer watch the stream and click on the spoiler box.
    • There was a possibility that Shantotto could sprout ???.
      Wings

    • ??? is not used in the Far East (though there is an exception).
      Kanji (Chinese characters)



<div id="mogivana29_05"></div>
  • Fujito’s /shout
    Fujito made announcements about campaigns and the future.
    • Campaign announcements
      (0:39:57)

      →Anniversary event: Jingle Baaas
      You can obtain a special in-game T-shirt item and other rewards.
      →”XI Day” campaign
      When logging in during the campaign period, you will receive a silver mog pell which can be exchanged for a variety of items.
      →Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign and the Discount Campaign
      Adventurers who have been taking a break will be able to log in for free during the Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign period. Additionally, the Ultimate Collection and Seekers of Adoulin are on sale during the Discount Campaign. Please use this opportunity to get back into the adventure!
      →FINAL FANTASY Record Keeper collaboration campaign
      The high-tier battle field version of the Rank 5 mission has a remixed version of Awakening for the background music, and if you beat this battle during the campaign period you can obtain the music sheet for the orchestrion. It can be obtained on any difficulty so check it out!
      →Mog Bonanza 2017
      There’s a new line up of rewards on tap. We’ll explain more on this in just a bit.
      →November 2016 Login Campaign
      Two new items are featured this month: a beetle mount and a mask item that can be seen on the NPC throughout the Rhapsodies of Vana’diel missions. There is also a fun new item, “Pungent Powder,” that will transform you into a baby version of a creature that can be reared in Mog Gardens.
      →November Appreciation Campaigns
      Eleven different campaigns are taking place at the same time. This includes an experience points campaign, so those returning should definitely take advantage! Next month we’ll have an array of campaigns geared towards returning adventurers.

      <div id="mogivana29_06"></div>
    • New battle content: Omen
      (1:06:28)
      We’re currently progressing with development on new battle content geared towards parties. The difficulty will range from the regular monsters found in Reisenjima up to the very difficult version of Intense Ambuscade. The stage for the battles will be set in a secret area of Reisenjima. We’re currently creating new maps and are in our testing phases for the systems.

      In a previous broadcast, we mentioned that we really didn’t want to create new content that focused only on defeating a boss, and so this content will revolve around exploring through this secret area while defeating monsters, and then ultimately arriving at a boss which you must defeat. Additionally, the regular monsters found in the area will also drop loot, so going into this area to focus only on defeating regular monsters is a possible. Likewise, just aiming for the boss is possible as well, and you will be free to choose based on your play style.

      (1:13:24)
      Along with Omen, we will be introducing materials that will allow you to reforge your Artifact armor to +2 and +3 versions. The items needed for the +2 version will be dropped from the regular monsters, and these can be obtained with just a few people or with trusts.

      In addition to the materials for reforging, we’ll also be implementing accessories with very high stats, and we’ll talk about those soon.


      <div id="mogivana29_07"></div>
    • Ultimate synthesis equipment (tentative name)
      (1:17:40)
      We are planning to implement equipment that is comparable to relics for crafters. Since the slot it will occupy is the sub-weapon slot, they cannot be used in tandem with the Kupo Shield, but they will have very good stats to compensate for this. You will need to undertake various trials to obtain and enhance this equipment, and ultimately it will become something with a unique graphic. We’re working hard on creating this and carefully making adjustments, so it will take a bit of time to finalized, but we hope you look forward to it.

The next Freshly Picked is slated for January, but I’m hearing whispers that we might do something in December as well! In any event, we would like to share the freshest information with you all in the very near future, so stay tuned!

Event-related

  • Item level 119 artifact armor may now be further reforged.
    • Getting Started
      Speak with Coelestrox in Reisenjima to commence the reforging event.
      Attachment 11855
    • Items Required for Reforging
      Job cards and other specialized materials are required for reforging. Job cards may be obtained in Omen.
      • Exchanging cards
        Job cards may be traded for other job cards by speaking with Coelestrox. Ten cards of one type may be traded for one card of another type.
        * Up to 790 cards of a particular type may be traded at once.
    • Esha Bead Fees
      Escha beads are required to reforge artifact armor, with the number required varying by reforging method.
      • Cheap
        Equipment will be ready in one day (Vana’diel time) for a small Escha bead fee.
      • Quick
        Equipment will be ready immediately after trading it for a large Escha bead fee.
        * This option will not display if you do not possess the requisite number of Escha beads.
  • New designations have been added.

Battle-related

  • New battle content known as Omen has been added.
    Attachment 11856
    Omen is all-new battle content in which a goblin known as Incantrix draws forth the power of Phoenix to teleport the player to an area in Reisenjima in one of many possible futures.
    • Requirements
      • Have completed the final chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana’diel
      • Be in possession of the Goblin canteen key item.
        * All party members must be in possession of this item.
      • Be solo or in a party of up to six players.
    • How to participate in Omen
      1. Speak with Incantrix after completing Rhapsodies of Vana’diel to receive an explanation about Omen.
        * Incantrix may be found near the final teleportation entry in the list that appears when interact with an ethereal ingress after receiving the final Rhapsody key item.

      2. Receive a Goblin canteen key item from Incantrix.
        * Players may only possess one Goblin canteen at a time.
        * Players may receive one Goblin canteen every 20 hours (Earth time).

      3. Have the party leader teleport to Reisenjima Henge by interacting with an earthly concrescence in Reisenjima, ensuring that all party members meet to conditions, and selecting Omen.
        * Your key item will be consumed upon entry.
        * You many only participate a limited number of times.

      4. A new ethereal ingress will appear as you complete objectives. The amount of time you may spend in Omen will increase each time you us an ethereal ingress to proceed further in.
        * The starting time limit for Omen upon entry is ten minutes (Earth time)

      5. Proceed forward through ethereal ingresses to tackle the boss that awaits in the innermost recesses.
        * Rewards may vary based on your level of progressions.
    • Completing additional objectives
      Additional objectives will display when you are first detected by a foe or are otherwise placed on its enmity list.
      Completing the tasks posed to you within the time limit will provide you with a personal reward. These tasks will automatically fail if you leave the area or time expires.
    • Rewards
      Omen features both personal and boss rewards.
      • Personal Rewards
        Personal rewards include items known as “job cards,” which are earned some of the time for completing additional tasks in various areas and can be used to reforge artifact armor.
        The job cards you earn depend on the job you are participating as.
      • Boss Rewards
        Rewards vary by boss and may be obtained as spoils for the party when the boss has been vanquished.
  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The enemies within normal and expert Ambuscades have been changed.
      Attachment 11857

  • A tenth ethereal ingress has been added to Reisenjima.
    This ethereal ingress is available to players in possession of the final Rhapsody key item.
  • Fellows are now able to equip the following items.
    Black Chocobo Head / Black Chocobo Suit
    * This is a visual-only change that only takes effect when both items are equipped.

Resolved Issues

  • Various issues with incorrect NPC dialogue and help text.
  • The issue wherein using a skill chain involving the ability Immanence against the notorious monster Wopket in Yorcia Weald [U] would cause certain battle gimmicks to become disabled via an improper attribute.
  • The issue wherein the notorious monster Wreaker in the Spire of Holla would not take action for a certain period of time after using the ability Shadow Spread.
  • The use wherein the defense down effects of spells and abilities such as the white magic spell Banish would occasionally fail to function on certain high-level undead monsters.
  • The issue where in the absorb effects duration increase equipment augment would not function properly.
  • The issue wherein equipping a fellow in certain way would cause graphics to display improperly from the elbow down.
  • The issue with Eschan portals in Escha – Zi’Tah and Escha – Ru’Aun, as well as ethereal ingresses in Reisenjima wherein graphics would not display properly.

Known Issues

  • When jumping or using abilities such as the black magic spell Tractor while waiting in the appropriate area after applying to join Omen in Reisenjima, reservations will not be canceled properly
    * Players must first leave Reisenjima in order to re-apply.
  • Equipment and merit points wherein an automaton’s magic skill increase attribute does not properly apply to all magics.

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 30 Digest
body:
Greetings,

To coincide with the December 2016 version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, everyone. Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 30.

This is a month filled with holidays, and this will be the final broadcast of 2016, so we filled it with great stuff to show off, including the implementation of the new battle content, Omen.

For those of you who were not able to tune into the broadcast, or for those that just want to check out the content, I’ve compiled another digest. The stream had a lot of explanations while playing a live demo, so be sure to check out the archived video.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/UQ8CizuLGeA" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51830#mogivana30_01" class="brlink">Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51830#mogivana30_02" class="brlink">New battle content: Omen</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51830#mogivana30_03" class="brlink">Battle content: Ambuscade</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/51830#mogivana30_04" class="brlink">Starlight Celebration & New Years</a>

<div id="mogivana30_01"></div>
  • Version Update
    (0:03:38)
    This segment of the stream focused on the major points of the December version update.

    <div id="mogivana30_02"></div>
    • New battle content: Omen
      (0:04:11)
      We explained about the new battle content, Omen, while showing it off with live gameplay. Director Fujito and myself formed a party, and fought our way to the mid-boss. Be sure to check out the video to see what happens! Additionally, Naoshi Mizuta created a brand-new track for the background music, so enter the content and give a listen.

      (0:30:29)
      During the broadcast we showed off one of the new rewards you can earn from Omen—a grip for damage dealers. This item adds to the DEX modifier applied to weapon skills, and it’s a completely brand-new stat. There’s tons of great new rewards, so do your best to defeat the bosses.

      (0:32:16)
      We also showed off the +2 version of the reforged warrior artifact equipment. While the original item level 119 artifact items had a lot of the same stats on multiple pieces (enmity etc.), the +2 version offers a lot of variety on each piece, so it’s great to use in conjunction with other equipment. Naturally, the +3 version bumps the power up even further.
    <div id="mogivana30_03"></div>
    • Battle Content: Ambuscade
      (0:36:52)
      Director Fujito is always challenging this content by himself during the streams, and this time around we let a little hint slip—hit em’ with hand-to-hand! Since the enemy you face is a corse, blunt attacks work exceptionally well. We also showed off the rewards for this month, so check out the video to see.

    (0:39:35)
    A bit ago on the forums we received a request to make it so party members can see your recast times when using /recast. We shared the current progress and status of the development team. During the broadcast we received a lot of comments and feedback on Twitter and other places. Thank you very much. We’ll take everything into consideration as we look into this.

<div id="mogivana30_04"></div>
  • Starlight Celebration and Happy New Year
    (0:58:08)
    As this is the last broadcast of the year, we expressed our thanks to everyone and wish you all a happy New Year.
    • Campaign announcements
      (1:06:32)
      We introduced all of the campaigns that are going on and coming up.

      →Starlight Celebration
      Event period: Thursday, December 15 from 12:00 a.m. (PST) to Saturday, December 31 at 6:59 a.m.
      →I Dream of Mog Bonanza 2017
      Marbles can be purchased from Friday, November 11, 2016 at 12:00 a.m. (PST) to Thursday, December 15 at the same hour. Don’t forget to grab them!
      →December 2016 Login Campaign
      The end of the year can be quite busy and hectic, so we figured it would be hard for people to log in every day for the campaign. As such, we added a log in bonus for the first three log ins, and we also cut the point cost of everything in half. Please visit the official site for all the details.
      →Dig for Something Other Than Coal with the Chocobo Digging Campaign
      This campaign lasts until Saturday, December 31, 2016 at 6:59 a.m. PST. This is the first time to hold a chocobo digging skill increase campaign and the hyper chocobo digging campaign, so raise your skill levels and put it to good use!
      →Returner Support Campaign (tentative name)
      We’ll be holding a campaign from January 1 through January 31 to support adventurers that return to Vana’diel. This is a weekly rotating campaign that will last 4 weeks. Since we received a lot of feedback from everyone, stating that it would be good to have a special bond with trust, we decided to add this. All the details will be posted on the official site in the near future, so be sure to check back. Additionally, if you have a friend who is thinking to come back and play after a while, this is the perfect opportunity to get together with them.

The next Freshly Picked Vana’diel is schedule for either February or March, so we will see you all in 2017!

Battle-related

  • The issue wherein players are occasionally unable to receive Epeolatry and Idris from Oboro when reforging them.

Event-related

  • A new quest has been added.
    Attachment 11875
    • The Ygnas Directive 5
      Players must speak with Ploh Trishbahk in Eastern Adoulin (K-9) after meeting the following prerequisites to receive the quest.
      • Have completed the quest The Ygnas Directive 4, with the clock passing midnight (Vana'diel time) after it has been completed.
  • A quest for equipment known as Escutcheons has been added.
    Escutcheons are shields jointly developed by synthesis guilds and the inventor's coalition which draw forth the true craftsmanship skills of players.
    Escutcheons are improved by meeting objectives laid out by each guild's guildmaster.
    * Completing the escutcheon upgrade process requires the player to see the questline out to its end; the questline will be rolled out in future version updates.
    * Players cannot forfeit their corresponding guild rank while the upgrade in is progress.

    Players must speak to Mewk Chorosap in Port Jeuno (G-8) once they have achieved a rank of Expert or above in any guild skill other than fishing.

    Upgrading escutcheons requires special craftsman's crystals and other materials.
    • Craftsman's Crystals
      Craftsman's crystals are new items required for upgrading escutcheons, and can be earned by trading an escutcheon that has reached 100% craftsmanship to the requisite guild master. An escutcheon's craftsmanship increases when a synthesis or the corresponding skill is performed while the shield is equipped.
      * Craftsmanship will decrease by a certain amount when the shield is traded, but players will be able to improve it again to receive more crystals.
      Attachment 11876
    • Upgrade Materials
      Materials used to upgrade escutcheons may be purchased in exchange for craftsman points. Craftsman points are earned by using analysis crystals to perform a "quality-value" synthesis and delivering the item to the appropriate guild. Analysis crystals can be purchased in exchange for guild points by players whose skill is expert or above. "Quality value" is a figure that represents the quality of an item synthesized using various synthesis sets and is affected by item quality and required synthesis skill rank.

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 31 Digest
body:
Hi, there!

To coincide with the February version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, everyone. Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana'diel 31, which happens to the first broadcast for this year! We thank you for your continued support! This month we held the stream prior to the version update, and focused on the February version update as well as a bunch of other information.

For those of you who were not able to catch the broadcast live, or just simply want a recap on all the information the archived video is available below and I've organized this digest.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/0Bzjg7OK2X4" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • Version Update
  • Battle Content: Omen
  • Escutcheons
  • Battle Content: Ambuscade
  • Job Adjustments
  • The More You Know – Vana'diel
  • Fujito's /shout

<div id="mogivana31_01"></div>
  • Version Update
    (00:02:31)
    This segment of the show focused on the major aspects of the February version update.


    <div id="mogivana31_02"></div>
  • Battle Content: Omen
    (00:03:23)
    Video showed live gameplay of the new route introduced to the Omen battle content. There are no bosses within the new route but there are many monsters; therefore, this route is recommended for those who are trying to collect job cards. Players are also able to extend the time limit by 30 minutes.

    Aside from the above additions, we have made adjustments to existing mid-bosses, especially for the Glassy Thinker who has been adjusted so they don’t use their special ability, Pain Sync, continuously. With this change, players should be able to attack more frequently than before. Additionally, we have lowered the damage players take from this ability, in case you are by hit them.


    <div id="mogivana31_03"></div>
  • Escutcheons
    (00:15:19)
    Previously we mentioned that we’re planning to implement equipment that is comparable to relic for crafters. In this version update, we introduced new shield equipment for crafters, and a quest to upgrade them. The quest we are introducing this time is just the first step and players will be able to upgrade the equipment further through quests added in future.


    <div id="mogivana31_04"></div>
  • Battle Content: Ambuscade
    (00:20:25)
    We introduced new enemies for the Ambuscade in February. Players will face off against the Velkks first, and the Adamantoise next. In the show we gave a tiny hint about creating strategies to use against each target. If you're curious, be sure to check it out!

    (00:22:32)
    We also showed off some of the equipment players can receive as a reward.
    While the magic attack attribute is lower for this month's gear compared to other waist equipment of same item level, the magic damage property is higher, so this equipment is useful when casting lower-tier spells repeatedly. This new equipment also has an attribute to shorten the cast times of elemental spells, so we recommend using this along with other existing equipment.


    <div id="mogivana31_05"></div>
  • Job Adjustments
    During the show we talked about adjustments made in this version update.

    • Geomancy
      (00:23:38)
      The values of the following geomancy colures have been decreased.
      Indi-Focus / Indi-Attune / Indi-Vex / Indi-Languor /
      Geo-Focus / Geo-Attune / Geo-Vex / Geo-Languor
      The magic accuracy and magic evasion from the spells listed above were being calculated differently, causing the effect values to be much higher than what we presumed to be. If we were to balance this by boosting other jobs, it would have made boosting from equipment inadequate; therefore, we have adjusted geomancy back to correct values.

      Along with this adjustment, we have greatly reduced the magic evasion, as well as battle and magic skills from enemies simultaneously. In general, the higher the level the enemy is, the higher the reduction rate would be. Due to this balancing, geomancers' performance will decrease when using the above-mentioned geomancy colures on enemies. We made sure that buffs/debuffs based on the difference of the enemies' status/skill is balanced so players don’t feel that there is no method to defeat them.

    • Enfeebling Spells
      (00:27:29)
      • The values of the black magic spells Distract III and Frazzle III values have been increased
      • The duration of the following black magic spells have been increased.
        Distract / Distract II / Distract III / Frazzle / Frazzle II / Frazzle III
        The duration of these spells will take full effect even if the spell has been half-resisted. We are aware of requests to change the system so that the spells aren't resisted similar to geomancy; however, red mage's enfeebling spells can take various roles. By changing it to work similarly as geomancy colures, there is a concern where it will break the balancing between jobs. For this reason, we currently made adjustments to the values and the duration. Also, enemy's magic evasion has been greatly lowered in this version update, so we would like the players to try it out by making tweaks in their equipment or support jobs.

    • Songs
      (00:30:09)
      • We have also raised the values of certain songs.
        Please check the version updated information from February 10, 2017 for a list of songs being adjusted with this update. As part of balancing adjustment, some values of songs from the Song + property has been lowered; however, the base values have been increased, so the values will be higher than what it was up until now, no matter which skill obi or gear is used.

      • Heirloom necklaces (Adoulin's Refuge, Arciela's Grace, Ygnas's Resolve)
        (00:34:51)
        We have been receiving requests on forums and other sources to let players obtain this equipment again; however, due to quest progression flags from Seekers of Adoulin, and the addition of +1 versions, it has made the method of obtaining this quite complex; therefore we are having difficulties making this possible. However, we can take a different approach where instead of making it available as a mission reward (make it so you can obtain a similar item with the same stats), then it may be possible to resolve this issue, so we're currently looking into this approach. Please be sure to let us know your thoughts on this on the forums!

    <div id="mogivana31_06"></div>
  • The More You Know – Vana'diel
    (00:48:43)
    In this segment, we had viewers guess the word which should replace the “???” area, and then revealed some hidden Vana'diel lore. If you haven't watched the stream, try to guess the answer to the below! The answer will be displayed within the spoiler box below.
    • There was a plan to add ??? in Vana'diel.
      Add different eras.
      Currently when you check the Vana'diel clock, you can see the crystal era, but there were plans to introduce other eras into the Vana'diel lore. When the development team introduced time into the game, they went ahead and added years as part of role playing feature for players, and felt adding different eras would be easier to talk about specific events; however, they decided this was probably too much, and stayed with a single era.

    • Non-combat NPCs are ??? than the adventurers.
      Non-combat NPCs are stronger than the adventurers.
      This is based on level one adventurers, but the non-combat NPCs have 100 HP, which is higher than the players at this point. The reason why we had to add HP to the NPCs is due to the system where if the NPC's HP was set to 0, it would cause the servers to crash; therefore, they needed to set some values to the non-combat NPCs as well.

    <div id="mogivana31_07"></div>
  • Fujito's /shout
    (1:02:19)
    Fujito made announcements about current campaigns and events.
    • Valentione's Day
      Rewards include items such as aprons, so be sure to get it before the event concludes later this month!
    • Mid-winter Battle Content Campaign
      This campaign features battle content such as seal battlefields. We also have received suggestion to hold a new battlefield campaign in March, so we’re currently working on this moving forward.
    • February 2017 Login Campaign
      We have introduced new head equipment, the Arthro's Cap! With the HQ version of this item, players will be able to earn an item related to crabs, so be sure to try it out once you get it!

From the next Freshly Picked Vana’diel we’re going back to broadcast every odd number month, so the next one is in March, which is next month! We’re working hard to make it something which everyone can enjoy, and feel the FINAL FANTASY XI 15th year anniversary spirit, so stay tuned!

title: Mar. 10, 2017 (JST) Version Update
body:
• <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52281?p=593660#post593660">Event-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52281?p=593661#post593661">Battle-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52281?p=593662#post593662">Item-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52281?p=593663#post593663">System-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52281?p=593664#post593664">Resolved Issues</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52281?p=593665#post593665">Known Issues</a>

Event-related

  • Escutcheon quests have undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • New quests have been added.
      Players must have completed the Records of Eminence objective First Step Forward to receive these quests.
      In progressing with the quests added in this version update, players will no longer be able to exchange mithril screws with the delivery NPCs,
      and instead will gain the ability to exchange gold screws.

      To receive the quests, players must trade one of the following items to Mewk Chorosap in Port Jeuno (G-8).
      Joiner's Ecu / Smythe's Ecu / Toreutic Ecu / Plaiter's Ecu / Beveler's Ecu / Ossifier's Ecu / Brewer's Ecu / Chef's Ecu
    • The following items may now be purchased with Crafter Points.
    <table width="300" border="0"><tr><td width="60%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Item</td><td width="40%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Exchange Rate</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Gold Screw: Woodworking</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center" rowspan="8">8,000</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Gold Screw: Woodworking</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Gold Screw: Goldsmithing</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Gold Screw: Clothcraft</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Gold Screw: Leathercraft</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Gold Screw: Boneworking</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Gold Screw: Alchemy</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Gold Screw: Cooking</td></tr></table>
    • Players are now able to deliver multiple synthesis sets at once.
    • When synthesizing with an escutcheon equipped, a message will be displayed in the log when the craftsmanship bonus conditions change.
    • The log entry displaying the numbers of craftsman points earned will no longer display when trading a synthesis kit if the player already has the maximum number of points.
  • Records of Eminence has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • A new synthesis category has been added.
      * Players must have completed the objective First Step Forward to unlock this objective.
      * Escutcheon-related objectives will be added to the list after the player accepts an escutcheon upgrade quest added in this version update.
      Attachment 11893
    • Objectives for completing a certain number of successful syntheses have been moved to the Crafting category.
  • The amount of gil that may be stored in the gil repository has been raised to one billion.
    As such, players may put up to 999,999,999 million gil may be deposited into the repository at a time.
    * The gil repository’s graphic remains unchanged.
  • New designations have been added.

Battle-related

  • Omen has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • A new boss has been added.
      * The instance owner must be in possession of five key items to test their mettle against this boss. The other players need not be in possession of these items, but any they have will be removed upon entry.
      Attachment 11894
    • The maximum number of players that may participate in Omen has been raised from six (a full party) to 18 (three parties.)
      * If entering Omen as an alliance, only the alliance leader may apply for entry.
      * Even if entering with more than six players, the additional objectives will be tuned for a six-person party (number of successful objectives necessary, etc.) Further, the number of additional objectives will remain the same.
    • Up to two mystical canteens may now be held at once.
    • New key items obtainable when vanquishing the following monsters have been added.
      Kin / Gin / Kei / Kyou / Fu
  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes found in normal and intense Ambuscades have been changed.
      Attachment 11895
    • Some rewards obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been changed.
    • Some items obtainable for total hallmarks have been changed.
    • New tokens, which may be exchanged for specific equipment, have been added. These tokens can be redeemed by trading them to Gorpa-Masorpa in Mhaura (G-9), and can be used to receive any item marked as redeemable.
      Ambuscade token: head / Ambuscade token: body / Ambuscade token: hands / Ambuscade token: legs / Ambuscade token: feet / Ambuscade token: head +1 / Ambuscade token: body +1 / Ambuscade token: hands +1 / Ambuscade token: legs +1 / Ambuscade token: feet +1
  • The following notorious monsters have been adjusted.
    • Warder of Courage
      • The amount of damage that must be dealt to the Warder of Courage to seal away his special abilities has been reduced.
    • Zerde's stun resistance has been reduced, his darkness resistance has been greatly reduced, and he now has a cumulative resistance to the black magic spell Death.
    • Zerde's Haupia / Zerde's Kacamak / Zerde's Drisheen
      • These monsters’ darkness resistances have been greatly reduced, and they now have a cumulative resistance to the black magic spell Death.
* Updated on Mar. 10th, 2017 at 3:00 a.m. (PST) / 11:00 a.m. (GMT)

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • New synthesis recipes have been added.
  • +2 and +3 versions of item level 119 artifact armors now have set bonuses.
    These bonuses apply even if +2 and +3 set pieces are mixed together.

System-related

  • Storage slips have undergone the following adjustment.
    • The item help text for the item currently selected will display when checking if an item can be stored and when returning a stored item.
      * Note that augments will not display.
      Attachment 11896

Resolved Issues

  • Various issues with incorrect help text and dialogue.
  • Various issues with incorrect effects in missions and quests.
  • The issue in Records of Eminence wherein the objective Rhapsodies of Vana'diel Chapter 3, Part 11 would not properly award credit upon completion.
  • The issue with omen wherein additional objectives would not count if their target was a chapuli.
  • The issue wherein a message would erroneously appear in the log for all players in the area when fighting Cactrot Velox in a Wanted battle.
  • The issue with Alluvion skirmishes in Yorcia Weald [U] wherein the number of monsters remaining would not display properly.
  • The issue wherein the messages displaying upon using the spell Death or other instant-kill mechanics upon an automaton were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein monsters delivering an autoattack of seven hits or more would not activate the job trait Kick Attacks.
  • The issue wherein the Songs+ attribute would not increase the accuracy of Maiden's Virelai.
  • The issue wherein the Nibiru Harp‘s attribute Carols+2 would not apply to Carols II.
  • The issue wherein a cast bar would display when using analysis crystals from the command line.
  • The issue wherein certain vendorable items would display their vendor price as 0 gil, rendering the item unable to be vendored.

Known Issues

  • The event occurring when starting the second step of the Escutcheon questline will occasionally be skipped under certain conditions.
  • In Omen, characters may occasionally become responsive under certain conditions.

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 32 Digest
body:
Hi, there!

To coincide with the March version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, everyone. Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana'diel 32. This month, we held our broadcast once again the day before the version update, so we could focus on the March version update and other information.

For those of you who were not able to catch the broadcast live, or just simply want a recap on all the information the archived video is available below and I've organized this digest.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/0h9JoLZiC2w" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52390#mogivana32_01" class="brlink">Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52390#mogivana32_02" class="brlink">Battle Content: Omen</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52390#mogivana32_03" class="brlink">Battle Content: Ambuscade</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52390#mogivana32_04" class="brlink">Escutcheons</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52390#mogivana32_05" class="brlink">Geas Fete Adjustments </a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52390#mogivana32_06" class="brlink">Login Campaign</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52390#mogivana32_07" class="brlink">Intense Ambuscade in April</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52390#mogivana32_08" class="brlink">The More You Know – Vana’diel</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52390#mogivana32_09" class="brlink">Fujito’s /shout</a>

<div id="mogivana32_01"></div>
  • Version Update
    (0:01:44)
    This segment of the show focused on the major aspects of the March version update.

    <div id="mogivana32_02"></div>
    • Battle Content: Omen
      (0:02:39)
      The video showed live gameplay of the new notorious monsters added. In this version update, we also made it possible to participate as an alliance. The difficulty of the boss is set based on a six-person party. The monster's HP will not scale based on the number of participants, so please use this to freely play with your linkshell friends. Furthermore, players are now able to hold up to two mystical canteens which are needed to enter this content.

      (0:14:18)
      The video introduced some gear rewards which can be obtained from notorious monsters. The Regal Cpt. Gloves has a new attribute where the number of attacks will increase when your accuracy is lower. This will take effect when a player’s accuracy is lower than 60% of the enemy. The Regal ring has a set bonus which increases accuracy, ranged accuracy, and magic accuracy, and also has a similar set bonus effect as the +2 and +3 artifact armors added in this version update, so you’ll be able to retain individual bonuses when mixing artifact armor and other equipment.

      <div id="mogivana32_03"></div>
    • Battle Content: Ambuscade
      (0:17:49)
      The video showed director Fujito challenging this content solo. This time we added Ahriman and Shadows type enemies equipped with weapons similar to those of item level 119 relic weapons. Similar to players, the Shadow type enemies will gain an Aftermath effect after using their specific weapon skill (they will not gain Afterglow effect). While we haven’t introduced any new gear rewards, we have introduced new tokens, which may be exchanged for specific equipment.

      <div id="mogivana32_04"></div>
    • Escutcheons
      (0:27:13)
      New quests have been added. As part of requirement, players will need to complete a specific Records of Eminence objective.

      <div id="mogivana32_05"></div>
    • Geas Fete Adjustments
      (0:27:42)
      We have made adjustments to the notorious monsters Warder of Courage and Zerde. When we decreased the effects of Geomancy in February’s version update, the difficulty for these two monsters increased; therefore we made adjustments. For Warder of Courage, we reduced the amount of elemental damage needed to overcome this monster's mechanic, so players are able to handle this easier using elemental III magic. As for Zerde, we have reduced its resistance to stun and darkness. It is easier to use the black magic spell Frazzle against it now, so we believe players have a wider range of strategy to tackle the battle. However, we have set a cumulative resistance to the black magic spell Death.

      <div id="mogivana32_06"></div>
    • Login Campaign
      (0:31:26)
      We're thinking of bringing back items from previous campaigns in future Login Campaigns. During the show, we asked the viewers to see what kind of items they would like to be able to reobtain. Based on the comments we receive, we'll consider the options moving forward.

      <div id="mogivana32_07"></div>
    • Intense Ambuscade in April
      (0:39:08)
      To prepare for the 15 year anniversary, we're considering bringing back monsters which players faced until now in the Intense Ambuscade. During the show, we asked the viewers which monster they would like to face off against. The survey showed lots of votes for Gigas type monsters, so we’ll bring them in April.

<div id="mogivana32_08"></div>
  • The More You Know – Vana’diel
    (0:44:25)
    In this segment, we had viewers guess the word which should replace the “???” area and then revealed some hidden Vana’diel lore. If you haven't watched the stream, try to guess the answer! The answer will be displayed within the spoiler box below.
    • The sabotender NM in Abyssea, Cuijatender, is ??? while they’re not using their "??? Needles" ability.
      The sabotender NM in Abyssea, Cuijatender, is growing needles while not using their "??? Needles" ability. Cuijatender's ability "??? Needles" is actually not random. The longer it takes to use this ability, the more damage the players will take. This is because they are growing needles on their bodies. So talking about mechanics, it'd be wise to make this NM use their "??? Needles" quicker to take less damage!
    • When service for FINAL FANTASY XI started in Japan, players were able to fish up ??? in a certain area.
      When service for FINAL FANTASY XI started in Japan, players were able to fish up Excalibur in a certain area. At the time, we hadn't introduced anything like relic weapons, so they added Excalibur as one of the rarest weapons you can catch. The rate was something close to 1 in 20,000 to fish up this weapon. Looking at the data, we found out that no one was able to catch an Excalibur from fishing. The team in charge of fishing probably added this thinking even if players were able to get it, they wouldn't be able to equip it, since the level of the weapon was set to level 70 when the level cap was still at level 50. This surprised us when we found this out later. If a player was able to successfully catch Excalibur from fishing, we would've never seen Excalibur created as a relic weapon! Also just to note, the item ID for this weapon is different from the relic weapon version, so the stats on this weapon were much lower than the current Excalibur and were probably closer to Ridill's stats.

<div id="mogivana32_09"></div>
  • Fujito’s /shout
    (0:57:42)
    Fujito made announcements about current campaigns and events.
    • Doll Festival
      This seasonal event has ended already, but we hope you all were able to enjoy it!
    • Early Spring Battle Content Campaign
      We have the Microcosmic Orb Campaign where players are able to obtain job cards, so be sure to give it a try!
    • March Login Campaign
      In a previous Freshly Picked, our community team member Mocchi asked for a Warmachine mount, and so we finally introduced this in-game.

The next Freshly Picked Vana'diel is scheduled for May. We’ll do our best to bring fresh information, so stay tuned!
