title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 33 Digest
body:
Hi, there!

To coincide with the February version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, everyone. Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana’diel 33. This month, we had our broadcast once again the day before the version update, so we could focus on the May version update, as well as bunch of other information.

For those of you who were not able to catch the broadcast live, or just simply want a recap on all the information the archived video is available and I’ve organized this digest.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/zIhn7UCpYao" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52658#mogivana33_01" class="brlink">Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52658#mogivana33_02" class="brlink">Battle Content: Ambuscade</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52658#mogivana33_03" class="brlink">Escutcheons</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52658#mogivana33_04" class="brlink">15th Vana'versary</a>

<div id="mogivana33_01"></div>
  • Version Update
    (0:06:16)
    This segment of the show focused on the major aspects of the May version update.

    <div id="mogivana33_02"></div>
    • Battle Content: Ambuscade
      (0:07:31)
      Video showed live gameplay of Director Fujito challenging the Ambuscade Primer Volume Two. The new alter ego “Ark Angel TT” can be seen fighting alongside him, so be sure to check out the video.

      This time players will go up against Pteraketos tribe. Their HP is higher, but there’s only one boss with no reinforcements. They’re easier to damage as well, so the key strategy this time would be to watch your enmity carefully while fighting. Also, we changed the effects of Angry Seas and other annoying enemy abilities so it is easier to fight.

      (0:15:46)
      In April, we brought the Gigas tribe back into Intense Ambuscade and the data showed that the win rate was much higher. This may have been because players were accustomed to this enemy. During the broadcast we asked the viewers which monsters they would like to fight against in future. The results showed many requests for the Shadow tribe; therefore, we’ll consider adding them moving forward.

      <div id="mogivana33_03"></div>
    • Escutcheons
      (0:22:02)
      We added a new Escutcheon questline in the May version update. By completing this quest, players will be able to further upgrade their Escutcheons which includes an attribute that will shortens the synthesis motion speed. The “60” in the attribute “synthesis speed +60” refers to the number of frames, so this attribute will shorten the motion by 60 frames (about 1 second). We plan to further increase this value in the future. And of course, we’re planning to attach other attributes as well.

      (0:26:21)
      Additionally, we have implemented Superior 3 equipment as a new craftable item. In the video we showed the stats on some of the equipment, so be sure to check it out. These pieces have pretty strong stats. As for the key item required for the crafting, this can be earned through the Escutcheon quest.

<div id="mogivana33_04"></div>
15th Vana’versary!
(0:30:59)
This year we celebrate the 15-year anniversary for FINAL FANTASY XI. In this segment, we introduced various upcoming events to celebrate the 15-year anniversary.

The theme for this year’s anniversary is to “relive.” We plan to bring various events where veteran players can feel memories of “oh yeah, I forgot this happened before.” We would like those players to relive past moments to feel nostalgia while sharing their past experience with players that may have started recently.

*Please note that the event names are subject to change.
  • Let’s Go! Vana’diel Day!
    (0:34:04)
    Every fifteenth day of the month, something will happen within Vana’diel. We’re planning the first one to take place on Thursday, June 15. We hope this can be something that everyone logs into the game to enjoy. We’ll follow up on the details for this at a later day on the official website.

  • 15th Vana’versary Record of Eminence
    (0:39:13)
    We’re planning a special Record of Eminence which celebrates the 15-year anniversary beginning in July. We’re preparing an objective where players will track footsteps of the adventurers who began their journey from the three nations. Difficulty will range from easy to some that may be a bit difficult, so please choose the one that best fits your play style. Players will collect some “parts” as a reward, and by collecting them you’ll be able to get a mount... for more details, please check out the video. There will also be special 15-year anniversary tickets for the Gobbie Mystery Box as part of the reward. We’re planning to put something good inside these boxes, so please look forward to it.

  • 15th Vana’versary Event “Quiz of the Age”
    (0:53:39)
    This 15-year anniversary event will commence Tuesday, May 16. In this event players will be quizzed on the knowledge they have gained throughout their adventure. Players will be given crab-themed goods as rewards, so make sure to try it out.

  • 15th Vana’versary Mog Bonanza
    (0:57:32)
    A special Mog Bonanza celebrating the 15-year anniversary will begin Tuesday, May 16. We have added items such as the Onion Sword II cosmetic item as a reward.

  • The One I Can Trust
    (1:00:17)
    We’re planning to introduce an alter ego which will journey alongside our adventurers during the 15-year anniversary. The alter ego which will be implemented will be decided by your vote and can be from any NPC which hasn't been implemented as an alter ego already. We’ll also ask the players what kind of stats the alter ego should have; however, this is a support-type alter ego, so we’ll be asking what type of Sphere effect you would like to see added. Implementation is scheduled further down the road. Details for this event will be announced at a later date through the official website.

  • May 2017 Login Campaign
    (1:05:49)
    This event is currently underway. Be sure to login and get the Firetongue cosmetic weapon. Until now we have alternated between equipment and mounts, but as part of the 15-year anniversary, we have also included a very special statue. Even if you miss out on this, you’re able to re-obtain them later, so please don’t worry and play at your own pace.

  • Previous FINAL FANTASY Equipment
    (1:08:29)
    In this event we plan to introduce famous weapons from previous FF titles for FINAL FANTASY XI. We’ll go over the details at a later time, so stay tuned!

  • Dengeki PlayStation – Lightning Brigade Celebrates the 15 Year Anniversary
    (1:11:57)
    A special article is being added to the Dengeki PlayStation for three months. In the article you can read up on the Lightning Brigade challenging themselves to see how far they can go in 15 hours from character creation.

  • Famitsu 15 Year Celebration 16 Page Coverage!
    (1:14:46)
    The latest edition of Famitsu covers a special 16 page article of FINAL FANTASY XI. Various articles are covered, and one includes an interview with the voice actor Yuichi Nakamura, who used to play FINAL FANTASY XI a lot.

  • Niconico Live “Let’s All Celebrate FFXI’s 15 Year Celebration [Famitsu]”
    (1:16:30)
    A special broadcast is scheduled for Saturday, May 13 at 7:00 p.m. (JST) on the Famitsu channel celebrating the 15-year anniversary. We invite voice actors Yuichi Nakamura, Emiri Kato, and Yu Asakawa to the show, so be sure to check it out.

  • Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign and Discount Campaign
    The Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign and Discount Campaign will begin Tuesday, May 16. Experience the world of Vana'diel with a variety of new content that has been added throughout the fifteen years of development, along with many system which may come to a surprise for our previous players. We would love to see you return back and try the game out in this special 15-year anniversary.

  • Mog House Decoration Contest
    (1:18:36)
    The Mog House has been expanded with the introduction of the 2nd floor/patio so we would like to hold a Mog House decoration contest with this additional area. The Community team has requested that we add a new furnishing item as a reward for the contest, so we’ll try our best to make this possible. We’re planning to hold this event sometime in winter.

  • Future Updates
    (1:23:48)
    As mentioned previously, the development team has been reduced, and for this reason we aren’t able to make and systematic changes that would affect the foundation of our system. For this reason, we would like to respond back to our players letting them know that we aren’t able to make those changes and give suggestions on how we may be able to fulfill the request by taking a different approach. We would like to continue to maintain our relationship with the players through forums and such and update you all moving forward.

    That being said, this is the 15-year anniversary, so the development team would like to deliver new types of content in which players can enjoy playing as much as possible, so we’re currently preparing development for a new battle content. We’ll update you with further details as they become available.

The next Freshly Picked Vana’diel is scheduled in July. We’ll do our best to bring fresh information worthy of the 15-year anniversary, and we thank you for your support!

Until then, see you!

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 34 Digest
body:
Hi, there!

To coincide with the July version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui held another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed. This time around, Director Yoji Fujito made the post on behalf of Matsui.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Yoji_Fujito
Thank you for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana'diel 34.
For those of you who were not able to catch the broadcast live, or just simply want a recap on all the information the archived video is available and I've organized this digest.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/pL95YLyjKb8" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52884#mogivana34_01" class="brlink">Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52884#mogivana34_02" class="brlink">Battle Content: Ambuscade</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52884#mogivana34_03" class="brlink">15th Vana’versary</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/52884#mogivana34_04" class="brlink">Fujito’s /shout</a>

<div id="mogivana34_01"></div>
  • Version Update
    (0:06:19)
    This segment focused on the major aspects of the July version update.

    <div id="mogivana34_02"></div>
    • Battle Content: Ambuscade
      (0:06:49)
      Video showed live gameplay of Director Fujito challenging the Ambuscade Primer Volume Two. While it may look like you're going up against a Treant, Rafflesia, and Snapweed, once you land an attack, you'll notice that you’re up against vermin. The types of monsters that will spawn is set, so please select the one you wish to fight against. Also, as long as you don’t touch the plant type monsters, the next monster will not spawn, so you'll be able to call out your alter egos during this time.

    • Login Campaign Revival
      (0:14:26)
      We collected opinions regarding which items to bring back into the login campaign. We'll be looking into some of the suggestion received, so please look forward to it. During the show, we asked our viewers for their opinion and saw many request for a "Magic Pot" mount, so we'll consider that, as well as few other requests we received during the show.

    • Regarding the selling of uncommon items by NPCs
      (0:18:47)
      On the Japanese forums, there is a discussion regarding whether or not NPCs should sell "Sleeping Potions." We responded back stating that we'll consider either selling them at a high price, or sell them in exchange for materials. However, we received feedback stating that the issue can be resolved simply by collecting the materials, or that if we sell the items through NPC, that it may take away means for crafters to make money for this time. We asked our viewers for their opinion, and saw suggestion for other items to be sold through NPCs as well. If you have any suggestions on items which you would like to see sold from an NPC, please be sure to leave a feedback on the forums.

      In addition to this, if you have recently started playing or returned to the game and noticed any part of the main story which requires collecting certain items which are difficult to obtain, be sure to leave feedback on those as well, so we can look into them. We'll try our best and see if we can address these issues.

      Please note that this is more of a type of support for those starting the game or returning to the game that may have trouble progressing through the story.

    <div id="mogivana34_03"></div>
  • 15th Vana’versary
    (0:32:12)
    Continuing from last time, in this segment we introduced various upcoming events to celebrate the 15-year anniversary.
    • The One I Can Trust
      (0:32:37)
      We receive a lot of entry submissions, so we'd like to say thank you!
      In the show, we introduced popular NPCs and popular Sphere effects.
      The final results are scheduled to be announced in September.

    • Let’s Go! Vana’diel Day!
      (0:45:39)
      The first one was very well received and the next is scheduled to take place on July 15.
      The details will be kept a secret until the day of event. Unlike other campaigns, the changes are very subtle, and in there as a small bonus.

    • 15th Vana'versary Objectives
      (0:53:10)
      We have a special Records of Eminence objectives with "Reliving Experiences" as the theme. It is based on the road that adventurers have traveled until now. This event is divided into five parts.
      The objective of the first part requires adventurers to travel around the three nations and pick up on the things which were popular among players when service first began. We brought back the "Mythril Marathon" as well. The rewards will be an anniversary-related item (details are hidden until the fifth part is implemented), and the "Dial Key #ANV," which might reward you with something better than a special dial, maybe.
    <div id="mogivana34_04"></div>
  • Fujito’s /shout
    (1:06:28)
    Fujito made announcements about current campaigns and events.
    • Celestial Nights
      It lasts until July 13, 23:59 (JST), so if you haven’t participated yet, don’t forget.

    • July 2017 Login Campaign
      The featured prize for the July 2017 Login Campaign is a Xzomit mount. The cool looking color fits in perfectly for a day on the beach in the summer!

    • Summer Alter Ego Extravaganza
      This year's Summer Alter Ego Extravaganza is scheduled for August.
      Those who have returned recently can take this opportunity to obtain lots of alter egos, so be sure to check it out!

    • Job-Specific Equipment Reforging Campaign
      As the name suggests, there will be tons of campaign which will help augmenting job specific armor such as Artifact armor and Empyrean armor.
      A new campaign that makes it easier to obtain job cards in Omen will also take place, so please make use of it.

Well, the next “Freshly Picked Vana’diel” is scheduled for September.
We’ll be doing our best to bring you tons of fresh content next time as well, so don't miss out!

Until then, see you!

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 35 Digest

Hi, there!

To coincide with the September version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui hosted another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:

Hello, everyone. Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning in to Freshly Picked Vana’diel 35.
Once again, we had our broadcast before the version update. Our primary focus was the September version update details, as well as other information.

We’ve put together a digest and an archived video for those of you who were unable to join us for the broadcast, or simply want a recap on all of the information.

<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/ahwtjflTtpk" allowfullscreen="" frameborder="0" height="315" width="560"></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • All-Night Offline Event
  • Version Update
  • Battle Content: Ambuscade
  • Escutcheons
  • 15th Vana’versary
  • Fujito’s /shout
  • All-Night Offline Event
    (00:02:24)
    We asked Composer Naoshi Mizuta to create a new song, which will play in a new battle content that is currently under development.
  • Version Update
    (00:15:04)
    This segment of the show focused on the major aspects of the September version update.
    • Battle Content: Ambuscade
      (00:15:36)
      This segment featured director Fujito challenging the Ambuscade battle content.
      This time he went up against wyrms with the theme of "rain, lightning, and storms."
      They wield elemental magic pertaining to the theme, as well as wyrm-specific abilities; however, the abilities have been adjusted for Ambuscade. For instance, the duration of Absolute Terror has been shortened.
    • Ambuscade Adjustments
      (00:21:45)
      Some adjustments were made to the difficulty of Intense Ambuscade.
      In Easy mode, HP has been doubled, and the amount of Hallmarks and Gallantry obtained has also been doubled.
      In Normal mode and above, HP and points obtained has been tripled.
      As a result, the effects of Abdhaljs Seal have become very useful. Please try it out!

      There has been concern from players that longer battle times would only worsen congestion,
      but currently only the entrance to the content is congested. Beyond that, the battle rooms still have space. The idea is to fill up the rooms for longer periods of time, and reduce the frequency of players knocking on the entrance.
    • Escutcheons
      (00:24:07)

      The final form of Escutcheons are finally being released. Base attributes on these escutcheons include: synthesis skill+, synthesis speed +240, decreases the likelihood of synthesis material loss -5%, increases rate of high-quality item synthesis success +2. Upon using the enchantment, it’ll further grant the following effects on top of the base attributes: decreases likelihood of synthesis material loss -15%, increases rate of high-quality item synthesis success +3, Subskill +10 (Max 70), and an effect that will make it so that you cannot synthesize normal quality items. This means that if high quality is not possible, it will be considered a failure, similar to how a stubborn craftsman might destroy an imperfect work out of frustration.

      Here, we also offered two pieces of information which may be valuable to crafters of Vana’diel.
      The first is regarding high quality crystals.

      High quality crystals are often used to sign your name onto crafted items; however, they also have the hidden effect. They can decrease the rate of synthesis materials being lost from failure as well.

      The other is regarding the synthesis success rate cap.
      The synthesis success rate cap is 95%, but with equipment and food which increases the success rate of sysnthesis the success rate can be raised to 99%. We may have overdone it a little...
    • The forumula for the attribute "Increases the rate of high-quality item synthesis success"
      (00:36:54)
      We have changed the formula used to calculate the attribute which increases the success rate of high-quality item synthesis. With this adjustment, the overall success rate to synthesize a high quality item has been increased. You may have noticed that we had in-game food items called Rusk which didn't display any food effects. The reason why it didn’t display the effects for these items was because we first wanted to make this adjustment.
  • 15th Vana’versary
    (00:39:54)
    • The One I Can Trust Campaign
      (00:40:06)

      We have selected "Cornelia" to travel alongside you in your adventures!

      Two characters were particularly popular, and the management and development teams held many heated discussions regarding choosing between Cornelia and Lady Lilith.

      Cornelia usually equips a cape, but if we were to implement the Trust as-is, it would take up a lot of resources, so she will be implemented without a cape.

      Cornelia is a supportive alter ego who grants the player calling her forth the following benefits:
      Haste+ / Accuracy+ / Range Accuracy+ / Magic Accuracy+
      The value of these effects will vary based on the callers level, but at maximum it'll be +20% Haste and +30 Accuracy / Range Accuracy / Magic Accuracy.

      Furthermore, Cornelia stands out among your other Trusts so we believe you can look forward to bringing her along on various adventures with you.

      Further details can be found here.
    • 15th Vana’versary Records of Eminence Objectives Part Two
      (00:44:45)

      The overarching theme for the 15th Vana'versary Record of Eminence Objectives is nostalgia. This time around we put our focus on Mhaura and Selbina. For example, you’ll see objective such as these:
      • Selbinary
        Receive magicked skulls as spoils the requisite number of times.
      • Crustacean Infusion
        Perform fusion skillchains on crabs the requisite number of times.　
      • No Time to Be Sheepish
        Vanquish (something) in La Theine Plateau or (something) Rex in Konschtat Highlands the requisite number of times.
        For this one, we implemented a Notorious Monster specifically for the Record of Eminence. And since it’s a Notorious Monster, there has to be loot! Therefore, we made it so they drop a specific item as well.
  • Fujito's /shout
    (01:04:21)
    • September 2017 Login Campaign
      Point distribution period: Until Wednesday, October 4 at 7:00 a.m.
      Point exchange period: Until Monday, October 9 at 7:00 a.m.

      This time we are implementing the ♪Hippogryph mount!
    • Good Omens Campaign
      The event will be held until September 30, 23:59 (JST).

      This time we will be implementing 10 campaigns!
      Additionally, in order to have plenty of ideas for November’s campaigns, we asked what campaigns players would like to see during the show.
      The Capacity Point Campaign, Macrocosmic Orb Campaign, Domain Invasion Treasure Coffer Campaign, and a few others were prominent answers, so we would like to plan with those in mind.

    The next Freshly Picked Vana'diel is scheduled for November.
    We hope to bring you lots of fresh content next time as well, so please look forward to it!

    Until then, see you!

title: October. 11, 2017 (JST) Version Update
body:
• <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/53242?p=601257#post601257">Event-related</a>

  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/53242?p=601262#post601262">Known Issues</a>

Event-related

  • A new alter ego has been added.
    Attachment 12019
  • New objectives have been added to Records of Eminence.
  • The amount of bayld required to purchase equipment from Vesca and Craggy Bluff in the Peacekeeper’s Coalition has been decreased.
    * These items now cost 1/10 of their previous amount. As such, the amount of bayld Runje Desaali will give you in exchange for them has been lowered as well.

Battle-related

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes found in normal and intense Ambusacdes have been changed.
      * As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have been changed as well.
      Attachment 12020
    • Abdhaljs fiber has been added.
      Players may trade Abdhaljs fiber to Gorpa-Masorpa in Mhaura (G-9) together with a piece of equipment to reforge it. Normal equipment will become +1, and +1 equipment will become +2.
      • Equipment sets that can be reforged with five spools of Abdhaljs fiber:
        Flamma / Tali’ah / Munmu / Ayanmo / Mallquis
      • Equipment sets that can be reforged with ten spools of Abdhaljs fiber:
        Flamma +1 / Tali’ah +1 / Munmu +1 / Ayanmo +1 / Mallquis +1
    • New ambuscade tokens have been added with which players may purchase rings.
      • They made be traded to Gorpa-Masorpa in Mhaura (G-9) to receive one of the following rings.
        Flamma Ring / Tali’ah Ring / Munmu Ring / Ayanmo Ring / Mallquis Ring
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been changed.
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for total hallmarks have been changed.
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been changed.
  • The maximum number of mystical canteens, required for participation in Omen, that may be held at once has been increased from two to three.
  • Volker’s provoke ability logic has been adjusted.
    The adjustments occur when the player’s group already has a main tank so that Volker is able to better fill a sub-tank role.

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • Empyrean armor will now grant its set bonuses even if items of differing item level are equipped.
  • The following equipment obtainable from the Peacekeepers’ Coalition have had their item levels raised to 119.
    Homestead Cesti / Homestead Dagger / Homestead Blade / Homestead Claymore / Homestead Axe / Homestead Labrys / Homestead Scythe / Homestead Lance / Senkutanto / Senkuto / Homestead Wand / Homestead Staff / Homestead Scepter / Homestead Bow / Homestead Bowgun / Homestead Gun / Homestead Shield / Gorney Morion +1 / Gorney Haubert +1 / Gourney Moufles +1 / Gorney Brayettes +1 / Gorney Sollerets +1 / Shneddick Chapeau +1 / Shneddick Tabard +1 / Shneddick Gloves +1 / Shneddick Tights +1 / Shneddick Boots +1 / Weatherspoon Corona +1 / Weatherspoon Robe +1 / Weatherspoon Cuffs +1 / Weatherspoon Pants +1 / Weatherspoon Souliers +1
    * Suppa Shuriken have not had their item level adjusted.
  • The following items are now storable via the Porter Moogle.
    • Storage Slip 22
      Aphmau Statue
    • Storage Slip 23
      Flamma Zucchetto +2 / Flamma Korazin +2 / Flamma Manopolas +2 / Flamma Dirs +2 / Flamma Gambieras +2 / Tali’ah Turban +2 / Tali’ah Manteel +2 / Tali’ah Gages +2 / Tali’ah Seraweels +2 / Tali’ah Crackows +2 / Munmu Bonnet +2 / Munmu Jacket +2 / Munmu Wrists +2 / Munmu Kecks +2 / Munmu Gamashes +2 / Ayanmo Zucchetto +2 / Ayanmo Corazzan +2 / Ayanmo Manopolas +2 / Ayanmo Cosciales +2 / Ayanmo Gambieras +2 / Mallquis Chapeau +2 / Mallquis Saio +2 / Mallquis Cuffs +2 / Mallquis Trews +2 / Mallquis Clogs +2 / Flamma Ring / Tali’ah Ring / Munmu Ring / Ayanmo Ring / Mallquis Ring

System-related

  • Skillchain attribute information has been added to weapon skill help text.
  • The following areas no longer count for conquest tally.
    Horlais Peak / Waughroon Shrine / Boneyard Gully / Stellar Fulcrum / Cloister of Gales / Mine Shaft #2716 / Balga’s Dais / Full Moon Fountain / Throne Room / Bearclaw Pinnacle / Cloister of Storms / Chamber of Oracles / Cloister of Tremors / La’Loff Ampitheater / The Celestial Nexus / Sealion’s Den / Monarch Linn / Qu’Bia Arena / Cloister of Frost / The Shrouded Maw / Sacrificial Chamber / Cloister of Tides / Cloister of Flames

Resolved Issues

  • The issue with Moblin Mazemongers wherein the amount of capacity points obtained from the Sanitation Teams was incorrect.
  • The issue wherein the attribute of the Qutrub ability Mangle was incorrect.
  • The issue wherein the effect of Raetic Arrows would activate in unintended situations.
  • The issue with the Glyphic Doublet +1 wherein the attribute “Avatar: Critical hit rate +12” did not function properly.
  • The issue wherein the following item names were not auto-translated correctly.
    D. Frame: Smith. / G. Emblem: Smith. / A. Screw: Gold.

Known Issues

  • The Super Kupower Crystal Favor will occasionally activate in areas where it ordinarily should not.
  • In Promyvion - Mea, monsters will occasionally spawn in areas where players cannot reach.

title: November. 11, 2017 (JST) Version Update
body:
• <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/53352?p=602565#post602565">Event-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/53352?p=602566#post602566">Battle-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/53352?p=602567#post602567">Item-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/53352?p=602568#post602568">Resolved Issues</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/53352?p=602569#post602569">Known Issues</a>

Event-related

  • Item level 119 relic equipment may be further reforged.
    Progressing in Dynamis-Divergence, battle content to be described below, will enable players to further enhance relic equipment of item level 119.
    • Conditions for Reforging Relic Equipment
      • Reforging equipment to +2
        Enter Dynamis-Divergence as a job that can equip the relic equipment you would like to reforge.
      • Reforging to +3
        Defeat the first boss in Dynamis-Divergence as a job that can equip the relic equipment you would like to reforge.
    • Items Required for Reforging
      In addition to items obtainable in currently existing battle content, players will require footshards and void footwear of the appropriate job.
      • Footshards
        Footshards can be purchased in exchange for beastmen’s medals or occasionally obtained directly as spoils in Dynamis-Divergence.
      • Void Footwear
        Void Footwear can be purchased in exchange for kindred’s medals or occasionally obtained directly as spoils in Dynamis-Divergence.
        * Beastmen’s medals and kindred’s medals may be exchanged with ??? in Ru’Lude Gardens (G-8).
  • The third batch of 15th Vana’versary Records of Eminence objectives has been added.
    Read on for details.
  • The Escutcheon questline has undergone the following adjustments.
    • Players will now be able to change the order of selected materials when using the Synthesis Focuser II.
      Players will be able to switch between “crystal” and “sphere” using this new option.
      * The default option will be “crystal” once the version update is live.
    • Players are now able to check synthesis recipes when using the Synthesis Focuser II.
  • New designations have been added.

Battle-related

  • New battle content known as Dynamis-Divergence has been added.
    Attachment 12067
    • Requirements for Participation
      • Have defeated one of the following foes in Dynamis-Tavnazia.
        Diabolos Heart／Diabolos Diamond／Diabolos Spade／Diabolos Club
      • Have completed the final chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana’diel
      • Be in possession of the Empty Hourglass key item.
        * Be in a party or alliance of between three and 18 members.
        * All party members must be in possession of the requisite key item.
    • Enjoying Dynamis-Divergence
      1. Speak with ??? in Ru’Lude Gardens (G-8) after having met the above conditions to hear an explanation on Dynamis-Divergence.

      2. Receive an empty hourglass from Aurix in Ru’Lude Gardens (G-8) in exchange for one of the following items. Note that your empty hourglass will not be consumed upon entering Dynamis-Divergence.
        Lungo-Nungo Jadeshell / Montiont Silverpiece / 100 Byne Bill
      3. The party leader must examine the enigmatic footprints in Southern San d’Oria (K-10) and elect to enter Dynamis-San d’Oria (D).

        Restrictions on Participation
        Players will not be able to participate in Dynamis-Divergence if any of the following are true.

        - One or more participants does not possess an empty hourglass.
        - 50 or more parties are currently participating.
        - One or more party members is currently awaiting entry with a different party.
        - One or more party members has participated in Dynamis-Divergence in the last 60 hours (Earth time).
        - One or more party members is currently located in a Mog House.
        Cancelling Registration.
        Registration will be canceled if any of the following are true.
        - The party leader has canceled registration via the enigmatic footprints.
        - Three minutes have passes since being notified that Dynamis-Divergence is ready for entry.
        - One or more party members is currently located in a Mog House.
        - The party leader leaves the area.
        *The party leader teleports to another home point in the same area, whether by the black magic spell Warp or other means.
        * If a non-party member leaves the area, registration will not be cancelled, but the character who left will not be able to enter Dynamis-Divergence.
        * Adding more party members after registration will not cancel the registration, but the party will only be able to enter if it contains the same number of players at the time of registration or fewer.
        * A party can enter with fewer than the number of players present at the time of registration, but the number of alter egos that can be called forth will be based on the original number of party members.
      4. The party leader must examine the enigmatic footprints once they have received notification that Dynamis-Divergence is ready.

      5. Vanquish the monsters and bosses within Dynamis-Divergence.
        If there is a player present who has not vanquished the mini-boss or main boss, all players will receive personal rewards when the said mini-boss or boss is vanquished.
        * The time limit is 60 minutes (Earth time).
        * The time limit will increase if certain objectives are successfully completed.
        * A message will be displayed if the player does not have enough space in their inventory to receive personal rewards.
        * When wave 3 starts, all remaining monsters from wave 2 will vanish when wave 2’s boss monster has been defeated.
        * Players will be automatically removed once the time limit has passed.
        * Players may use the black hourglass temporary item to leave early.
  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes present in Normal and Intense Ambuscades have been switched out.
      Attachment 12068
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been switched out.
    • Certain rewards obtainable for meeting total hallmark milestones have been switched out.
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been switched out.
  • The following alter egos have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Maat
      • The effects of TP on the following weapon skills are now the same as those for players.
        Combo / One Inch Punch / Howling Fist / Dragon Kick / Asuran Fists
      • The potency of the weapon skill Bear Killer has been increased.
    • Domina
      • The potency of the weapon skill Salvation Scythe has been increased.
    • Aldo
      • The potencies of the following weapon skills have been increased
        Iniquitous Stab / Shockstorm Edge / Choreographed Carnage / Lock and Load

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • A new synergy recipe has been added.
    <table width="540" border="0"><tr><td style="border-style:none;" colspan="3" align="center"><<Amateur>></td></tr><tr style="text-align:center;"><th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="30%">Item</th><th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="25%">Required Skill</th><th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="45%">Materials</th></tr><tr style="text-align:left;"><td style="background:#c6e9ef;text-align:center;">Blizzard Brand +1</td><td style="background:#eaf2f3;text-align:center;">-</td><td style="background:#eaf2f3;">Blizzard Brand, Blizzard Brand</td></tr></table>
  • Additional items may now be stored via the porter moogle.
    • Storage Slip 22
      Blizzard Brand / Blizzard Brand +1

Resolved Issues

  • The issue wherein background music would not play on the title screen after logging out under certain conditions.
  • The issue with Promyvion-Mea wherein monsters would occasionally spawn in areas where players could not reach.

Known Issues

  • Article information for certain monsters appearing in Dynamis-Divergence is incorrect.
  • Glowing effects occasionally display at certain coordinates in Dynamis-San d’Oria (D).

title: Freshly Picked Vana’diel 36 Digest
body:
Hi, there!

To coincide with the November version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui hosted another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, everyone. Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning in to Freshly Picked Vana’diel 36.
Once again, we had our broadcast before the version update. We focused on the November version update details, as well as other information.

We’ve put together a digest and an archived video for those of you who were unable to join us for the broadcast, or simply want a recap on all of the information.

Table of Contents
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/53391#mogivana36_01" class="brlink">Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/53391#mogivana36_02" class="brlink">Battle Content: Ambuscade</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/53391#mogivana36_03" class="brlink">Battle Content: Dynamis-Divergence</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/53391#mogivana36_04" class="brlink">15th Vana’versary</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/53391#mogivana36_05" class="brlink">Event/Campaign Notices</a>

<div id="mogivana36_01"></div>
  • Version Update
    (0:01:31)

    This segment of the show focused on the major aspects of the November version update.
    <div id="mogivana36_02"></div>
    • Battle Content: Ambuscade
      The enemies this time around are the Dvergr. Players will also encounter the Poroggo in Expert, who will return as their heavy-resistant selves.

      <div id="mogivana36_03"></div>
    • Battle Content: Dynamis-Divergence
      We introduced this segment of the show alongside some live footage of gameplay
      Please check the November version update information for entry method and requirements.

      During the broadcast, we entered with three members. A group of three is enough to defeat the mobs, but the content is balanced so that a party would be required for a full completion. In Dynamis-Divergence, players will face waves of enemies as they progress. The first wave is about the same difficulty as the smaller light route in Omen.
      There is a chance of obtaining materials used in reforging IL119 relics as loot upon defeating monsters.

      This time around materials for upgrading leg equipment are obtainable. Upgrade materials for other pieces will be made obtainable in areas to be added in upcoming updates. In the future, we plan on implementing Bastok, then Windurst.

      Additionally, the BGM playing in the content is a new song by Mizuta, so please enjoy that as well.
  • 15th Vana’versary
    (0:21:29)

    It’s the 11th month of the 15th year, and so we received a video message from former FFXI producer Hiromichi Tanaka, who is currently the producer of GungHo Online Entertainment’s mobile online RPG “Seventh Rebirth." Not only was there a video message, but he appeared in the broadcast as a special guest! Who would have thought that the first guest of Freshly Picked Vana’diel would be Tanaka? Tanaka shared stories of FFXI development, and introduced a collaboration event with “Seventh Rebirth”, so please take a look in the video.
    • 15th Vana’versary Records of Eminence Objectives Part Three
      The third group of objectives centers on Jeuno. Here players will revisit some of the nostalgic objectives such as:
      • Gathering ancient papyrus for Limit Break
      • Gathering Tarut cards with other players
      • Escort quests in which you could obtain Miratete's Memoirs.
    • Records of Tanaka
      (0:30:03)

      In this segment we reflected upon Tanaka’s stories of FFXI development. Stories such as episodes leading up to FFXI’s release as an online game were discussed.
    <div id="mogivana36_05"></div>
    Event/Campaign Notices
    (0:53:40)

    We announced upcoming events and campaigns in this segment of the show.
    • Return Home to Vana'diel and Discount Campaign
      Currently ongoing. If you’re considering returning to the game, please take advantage of it!
      <br>
    • Phase One of the Returnee Support Campaign
      Over the next three months, we'll be rolling out a series of campaigns designed to assist those adventurers who are returning to Vana'diel after a period of absence, whether brief or otherwise. The first phase has three separate parts that will help players improve their item level.

      There will be a one-day only campaigns as well, so be sure to read up on it here!
      <br>
    • Adventurer Gratitude Campaign
      By logging in once a week, you can obtain up to four types of items in this campaign.
      The campaign period lasts until Sunday, December 31st, so you could obtain all 4 rewards by logging in during 4 of those weeks. You can still make it in time if you’re considering to start or return to the game!
      <br>
    • The Fall Alter Ego Exravaganza
      For a limited time, players are able to obtain helpful alter egos such as Amchuchu, so be sure to check it out!
      <br>
    • November 2017 Login Campaign
      During the show, Director Fujito equipped the Blizzard Brand, which is obtainable through this campaign.

      Point distribution period: Until Sunday, December 3 at 6:00 a.m. (PST) / 2:00 p.m. (GMT)
      Point exchange period: Until Saturday, December 9 at 6:00 a.m. (PST) / 2:00 p.m. (GMT)
      <br>
    • I Dream of Mog Bonanza 2018
      In this Mog Bonanza event, a Demonic Axe will be available as the reward for 4th place!

      Marble sales will be available until Saturday, December 11 at 12:00 a.m. (PST) / 8:00 a.m. (GMT)
      <br>
    • Return of the Anniversary MMO Collaboration Event
      Enjoy chasing after spriggans and bopping slimes on the head with the return of this special collaboration between FINAL FANTASY XI, DRAGON QUEST X ONLINE, and FINAL FANTASY XIV!

      Event Period: Until Thursday, November 30 at 6:59 a.m. (PST) / 2:59 p.m. (GMT)

      If you missed your chance to participate, now's the time to get in on the action!
      <br>
    • FFXI × FFXIV Collaboration Event: The Maiden's Rhapsody
      This event returns to FINAL FANTASY XIV!

      Event will be held until Wednesday, November 29 at 6:59 a.m. (PST) / 2:59 p.m. (GMT)
      <br>
    • Return of the Pictlogica Final Fantasy Collaboration
      Players can receive eleven different types of retro-style picture furnishings based on some of your favorite NPCs. Be sure to get one for your Mog House!

      The event will be held until Thursday, November 30 at 6:59 a.m. (PST) / 2:59 p.m. (GMT)
      <br>
    • Seventh Rebirth Collaboration Event
      (1:03:27)

      During the broadcast, we had the title’s producer Tanaka reveal the details of the event. In this collaboration, players will see monsters and hear BGM from FFXI in Seventh Rebirth.

      Click here for more details on Seventh Rebirth.
      *This game is available in Japan only.
Will the next Freshly Picked Vana’diel be at the end of the year? Or perhaps at the beginning of the new year? It may be later than either, but please look forward to it!

Until then, see you!

• <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/53462?p=603312#post603312">Event-related</a>

Event-related

  • Additional item level 119 relic equipment pieces may now be reforged.
    Players will be able to further reforge additional pieces of relic equipment by progressing in Dynamis– Bastok (D).
    • Requirements for Reforging
      • To reforge to +2
        Enter Dynamis– Bastok (D) as the job for which you would like to reforge relic armor.
      • To reforge to +3
        Best the first boss monster in Dynamis – Bastok (D) as a job for which you are able to reforge relic armor.
    • Required Items

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 39 Digest
body:
Hi, there!

To coincide with the May version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui hosted another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana'diel 39.
Once again, we had our broadcast before the version update. We focused on the May version update details, as well as other information.

We've put together a digest and an archived video for those of you who were unable to join us for the broadcast, or simply want a recap on all of the information.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/860FBplkbgE" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54012#mogivana39_01" class="brlink">Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54012#mogivana39_02" class="brlink">Over Picked Vana'diel</a>

<div id="mogivana39_01"></div>
  • Version Update
    (0:14:09)
    This segment of the show focused on the major aspects of the May version update. May marks the beginning of the sixteenth anniversary as well, so we talked about some of that as well.
    <br>
    • Battle Content: Ambuscade
      (0:14:50)
      Director Fujito challenged the latest Ambuscade! Be sure to check out the video to see the outcome.

      In the normal version of the Ambuscade, players will go up against imps. Also, May is the month for the Feast of Swords event, which involves samurai, therefore we made it so that samurai job will have advantage this time around with their Demon Killer trait. We believe samurais will have some advantage against the mechanics as well. When the imps blow their horns, they can summon will summon more monsters that players must defeat, so the key is to taking care of them quickly.

      In the Intense Ambuscades, the goblins will make their return.
      <br>
    • Policy for Ambuscade Moving Forward
      (0:21:29)
      We'll continue to make updates towards Ambuscade every month; however, for the Intense Ambuscades, we'll be bringing back previous foes.

      There is two reasons for this. Firstly, we would like to put in the development resource to develop new content and systems.

      Development resources that were used for Intense Ambuscades will be used to expand upon Dynamis-Divergence and Master Trials.

      We are considering adding weapons to Dynamis-Divergence that are as powerful as the strongest weapons currently available, as well as further upgrading Relic/Mythic/Empyrean weapons.

      As for the other reason, we would like to reduce the time cost for players.

      Having looked at the initial clear data for Intense Ambuscade every month, we believe the participation and clear rates are lower than expected. It seems that it takes a while to start earning points.

      Additionally, while Ambuscade was the main content when it was released, other content have been thriving since then, and it seems players end up spending their playtime elsewhere.

      Of course, we will continue to have monthly updates for Normal mode, so we hope that you continue to enjoy the new battles we prepare there.

      Also, regarding the addition of the lockstyle gear exchange that was requested by one of our community rep, we have received the specifications from the Community Team. It should be ready by this summer. The equipment will have brand new model, so please look forward to it.
      <br>
    • Quests to Upgrade Alter Egos
      (0:31:39)
      Quests to increase the maximum level of alter egos will be implemented.
      For details such as quest requirements, please see the May Version Update.
      The quests involve a series of Record of Eminence quests where you will be earning 150 job points with your alter egos.

      As you are actually earning capacity points, you will be able to proceed as a Job Master.

      It may seem a little overwhelming, but at every 50 job points (50/100/150) you will receive alter egos that are obtainable from Sinister Reign, Cipher: Ingrid II, Cipher: Rosulatia, and Cipher: August, so feel free to progress at your own pace.
      <br>
    • Upgrading Alter Egos
      (0:40:40)
      The strength of alter egos is determined by the average item level and number of members (excluding the alter ego) of a party.

      You will be able to progress solo, but partying with others will be more beneficial. We hope that you take this opportunity to band together with others.

<div id="mogivana39_02"></div>
  • Over Picked Vana’diel
    (0:49:56)
    We have some upcoming news that is too far off to call “fresh”, so we’ve put together this section.
    <br>
    • New Weapon Models
      0:50:43
      We showed off some equips that are currently in development.
      (Some of you may know it as the “blue Blurred Lance”.)
      One of the challenges we’re taking on this year is creating new models.
      There are quite a few equipment planned, so please look forward to it.
      <br>
    • Anniversary Event “Premium Mooblin Battle”
      (0:55:39)
      This is a new event to commemorate our 16th anniversary.
      The event will be available until May 31 at 7:59 a.m. (PDT)
      We have various rewards available, such as the Cornelia Statue, so we hope you give it a try.
      <br>
    • Limited-Time Rewards Added to Return to Delkfutt’s Tower
      (0:58:31)
      Our community rep mentioned that “Kam’lanaut seems bored nowadays,” and so we have prepared another fight between him and our adventurers.
      For a limited time, you can obtain lockstyle gear that have the appearance of Kam’lanaut’s sword and shield. This will be available starting Friday, June 1.
      <br>
    • 16th Anniversary Mog Bonanza
      (1:05:54)
      This time, Brave Blade II will be added as a new reward.
      For the announcement date and sale period, please refer to the Mog Bonanza page.
      <br>
    • May 2018 Login Campaign
      (1:10:07)
      The featured prize for the May 2018 Login Campaign is a ♪Coeurl mount.
      We showed it off in-game, so be sure check out the video.
      <br>
    • The Spring Alter Ego Extravaganza
      (1:15:28)
      The campaign will be available until May 31, at 7:59 a.m. (PDT), so be sure to check it out!
      <br>
    • Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign and Discount Campaign
      (1:16:16)
      Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign: Until Monday, May 28 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT).
      Discount Campaign: Until Thursday, May 31 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT).
      <br>
    • Adventurer Appreciation Campaign
      (1:16:48)
      The campaign will be available in three parts, and assists both players currently playing and those returning to Vana’diel.
      <br>
    • Only in Vana’diel Screenshot Campaign
      (1:19:00)
      Another screenshot campaign, the Only in Vana’diel Screenshot Campaign is now underway.
      Show us your unique moments that can only happen in Vana’diel by submitting on the forums.

We will try our best to deliver as much as we can throughout this 16th year, so please continue to support us.

The next Freshly Picked Vana’diel is scheduled for July.

Until then, see you!

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 40 Digest
body:
Hi, there!

To coincide with the July version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui hosted another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana'diel 40.
Once again, we had our broadcast before the version update. We focused on the July version update details, as well as other information.

We've put together a digest and an archived video for those of you who were unable to join us for the broadcast, or simply want to recap on all the information.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/hDWmdGaZrH8" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>


Table of Contents
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54229#mogivana_01" class="brlink">Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54229#mogivana_02" class="brlink">Over Picked Vana'diel</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54229#mogivana_03" class="brlink">Fujito's /shout</a>

<div id="mogivana_01"></div>
  • Version Update
    （0:04:15）
    This segment of the show focused on the major aspects of the July version update.
    • Battle Content: Dynamis - Divergence
      （0:04:33）
      We showed live gameplay of the new Wave 3. We used a special dev. command, so we don't get attacked while exploring and explaining the changes made to each of the Wave in Dynamis-Jueno (D).

      For Wave 1, made changes so that the time limit will now increase not only by vanquishing boss monsters but statues as well. This was something that was requested on our forums. Please note that the maximum time extension of 30 minutes haven't changed, so you won't be able to stay in Wave 1. The time extended from vanquishing statues will be added first, so we believe this should make it easier to collect materials from monsters.

      （0:10:40）
      Players will now be able to obtain materials for new neck gear in Wave 1 and 2 from each of the Dynamis areas. During the broadcast, we showed some of the attributes on them. A red mage will have a new attribute called Dispel+1, and what this will do is remove two effects if there are two effects that can be removed with Dispel. We're planning to make it where you can attach augments to these gear in the future. Similar to the Oboro job-specific equipment, it'll be where you collect Reinforcement Points (RP) to upgrade. However, once you attach an augment, you will not be able to put the item up on auction house. We're planning to make it possible to attach augments in the September version update.

      （0:16:28）
      In Wave 2, we changed it so that when you vanquish the boss monster, all the other monsters will disappear, so it should be easier to tell when it's moving into Wave 3.

      （0:17:53）
      The strength of the boss monster in Wave 3 is close to those from the Master Trials, so we believe it'll be challenging. Objects are placed throughout the map, and by breaking these objects you can weaken the boss monster from Wave 3. We would like for you to actually try it out yourself to see how they'll be weakened.

      In addition to this, we prepared a new BGM for the boss battle; however, since the system was set up in a way where the music didn't change until you engaged the boss monster, so we changed it where the new BGM will play once Wave 3 begins in the July 10th server maintenance.

      （0:23:38）
      We also introduced new weapons with new graphic designs. These can be crafted by synthesizing items collected from Wave 1, 2, and the new material obtained by exchanging Demon's Medal from Wave 3. New weapon designs are available for every job. During the broadcast, we showcased the weapons for scholar and rune fencer. In order to synthesize these weapons, you'll need to have the aurum tomes key item obtained at the final phase of the escutcheon.

      Since these are craftable items, these will have the Superior attribute on them. Normal quality and high quality will be Superior 4, and high quality 2 will have Superior 5. You'll need 1200 and 2100 Gift, and the Superior 5 equipment is aimed at job masters. During the show, to show an example of the stats, we showed monk and white mage's weapons.

      Augments will be able to be attached on these weapons. This is also planned for the September version update. Similar to the Oboro job-specific equipment, augments can be upgraded by collecting RP, but we're planning to make it so that you can select from several patterns. Also, there isn't any aftermath effect. Please look forward to what kind of augment can be attached.

      （0:32:40）
      We discussed future upgrades for the Relic, Mythic (including Ergon), Empyrean, Ionic weapons (RMEA weapons). In order to upgrade these weapons, you'll need to flag them for an upgrade.
      Each of the RMEA weapons is tied in with each of the Dynamis areas. You will need to accumulate enough damage towards the Wave 3 boss monster equipped with the same weapon you would like to flag the weapons for an upgrade. Please refer to below for weapon types and areas associated with them.
      <table width="540" border="0"><tr style="text-align:center;"> <th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="30%">Type</th> <th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="40%">Dynamis Area</th></tr><tr style="text-align:center;"> <td style="background:#c6e9ef;text-align:center;">Relic</td> <td style="background:#eaf2f3;text-align:center;">Dynamis-Windurst (D)</td></tr><tr style="text-align:center;"> <td style="background:#c6e9ef;text-align:center;">Mythic/Ergon</td> <td style="background:#f5fafb;text-align:center;">Dynamis-Bastok (D)</td></tr><tr style="text-align:center;"> <td style="background:#c6e9ef;text-align:center;">Empyrean</td> <td style="background:#eaf2f3;text-align:center;">Dynamis-Sandoria (D)</td></tr><tr style="text-align:center;"> <td style="background:#c6e9ef;text-align:center;">Ionic</td> <td style="background:#f5fafb;text-align:center;">Dynamis-Jeuno (D)</td></tr></table>*Please note this excludes Relic: Aegis, Gjallarhorn / Empyrean: Ochain, Daurdabla / Ionic: Srivatsa, Marsyas
      Here are the requirements to upgrade the RMEA weapon
      • In order to upgrade, you'll first need to flag them
      • To flag the weapon, you'll need to accumulate enough total damage against the Wave 3 boss monster equipped with the corresponding weapon. (Example: For relic weapon, you'll need to accumulate enough damage against Wave 3 boss monster in Dynamis-Windurst (D)
      • There aren't any restrictions, such as whether the damage needs to be physical or magic damage. Furthermore, damage dealt by your party and alliance members will also count towards the accumulation.
      • Since the July version update, the total amount of damage is recorded onto the character itself.
      • You do not need to equip, possess the weapons you would like to upgrade
      • You do not need to be on the job of the weapon you would like to upgrade
      • Upgrade will become possible around September
      During the broadcast we mentioned that this system requires some time until implementation, there may be a change where we will change the system or make additions to them. We're currently discussing to see if we should make it possible to upgrade them solo as well.
    • Battle Content: Ambuscade
      （0:45:27）

      To give it a summer feel, playes will go up against the Cracklaws in the second volume of Ambuscade Primer. This time, players will need to deal an equal amount of physical and magical damage in order to make the fights manageable. Please give it a try to figure out a strategy.

      For the first volume of Ambuscade Primer, players will go up against the Yagudo. We have selected the Yagudo, as we introduced the new lockstyle equipment, the Yagudo polearm. This was a request made by one of our community team members in Japan, and you'll now be able to earn Hallmarks from points accumulated. Aside from equipment, we have prepared items until December based on the beast tribes you confront in the Intense Ambuscade. Please look forward to what new lockstyle gear will be introduced in-game!

<div id="mogivana_02"></div>
  • Over Picked Vana'diel
    （0:50:58）
    Last time, we revealed some information on upcoming events during the sixteenth-year anniversary, but we have more coming down the line.
    • Battle Content: A.M.A.N. Trove
      （0:52:12）
      The Adventurer's Mutual Aid Network (A.M.A.N.) have prepared some treasure trove for our adventurers. This is scheduled for implementation in August. To simply put, in this content, players will open boxes. There are ten boxes available, and one is a dummy box with strong monsters hidden within. If the monsters spawn, you'll need to defeat them to be able to leave the field and take the items back with you. Players can freely choose how many boxes they would like to open. Players will find new accessories that can only be obtained from this content, as well as equipment from the Geas Fete, and materials from Delve.

      Players will be able to enter this battlefield using an orb obtained by exchanging the silver vouchers, which is planned to become available by exchanging through Record of Eminence.
    • Shadow Lord Event
      （1:06:34）
      We're going to hold a special in-game event related to the Shadow Lord. During this event, players will be able to obtain a two-handed sword that resembles the one the Shadow Lord wields. This is scheduled from Thursday, August 30 to Sunday, September 30, so we still have some time, but hope you'll take part in this event.

    • Screenshot Campaign
      （1:10:14）
      We're planning another screenshot campaign. This time themed around "summer." And talking about summer, summer in FFXI is the Sunbreeze Festival. As an award, players will receive a Uka statue. Be sure to add this to your collection if you have collected Murmor and Ullegore statue and set them up together.
    • Summer outfit schedule for August
      （1:11:07）
      We prepared a new swimming outfit to beat the heat of the summer. This will be the key item for the August Login Campaign (not July). We'll have separate swimming outfits for males and females.

<div id="mogivana_03"></div>
  • Fujito's /Shout
    （1:13:05）

    →Celestrial Nights
    Take part in the Celestial Nights event, which is going on until Monday, July 16 at 7:59 a.m. (PDT) / 14:59 (GMT) / 15:59 (BST).

    →July 2018 Login Campaign
    This time around, you can obtain the Zanmato, a weapon introduced in various FINAL FANTASY series.

    →Battle Content Campaign Redux
    This campaign is aimed at those who have returned to FFXI around May, so they can prepare their equipment.

    →16th Vana'versary Mog Bonanza
    The winning numbers will be announced on Tuesday, July 17 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) / 8:00 (GMT) / 9:00 (GMT). Be sure to check in-game to see if you've won!

During the show, we mentioned the next Freshly Picked Vana'diel will be in September, but it may be a bit earlier. We'll continue to strive to deliver fresh information, so please continue to support us.

Until then, see you!

title: August. 7, 2018 (JST) Version Update
body:
• <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54299?p=608937#post608937">Event-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54299?p=608938#post608938">Battle-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54299?p=608939#post608939">Item-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54299?p=608940#post608940">Resolved Issues</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54299?p=608941#post608941">Known Issues</a>

Event-Related

  • New content, A.M.A.N. Trove, has been added.
    A.M.A.N. Trove is new content in which players aim to open a variety of treasure chests and retrieve the spoils that lie within.
    Attachment 12236
    • Requirements for participation
      • Be of a main job level of 99.
      • Be participating as a character for whom at least 45 days have passed since character creation.
    • Enjoying the content
      1. Set the Records of Eminence objective “Exploring the Trove.”
      2. Speak with Greyson in Lower Jeuno and trade silver A.M.A.N. voucher(s) for a Mars orb or Venus orb.
      * The number of vouchers that must be traded vary by orb type. Venus orbs provide a better chance at higher quality items.
      3. Trade one of the above orbs to the burning circle located in Horlais Peak, Waughroon Shrine, or Balga’s Dais and enter the battlefield.
      • Between one and six players may participate.
      • The time limit is 30 minutes.
    • Treasure chests
      Each battlefield contains ten wooden chests and one gold chest.
      • Wooden Chests
        If you strike it lucky with a wooden chest, you will receive an additional item drop when you clear the content. If you are unlucky, all the treasure chests will vanish and you will have to engage in combat against a fierce mimic.
        * If you best the mimic, the gold treasure chest will appear once more and you may open it to clear the battlefield.
      • Gold Chests
        Opening the gold chest will complete the battlefield, and you will receive a number of spoils proportional to the number of wooden chests you have opened.
        * If an item with the Rare attribute would drop but you already possess that item, it will not appear in the list of spoils and there will be no system log to notify you of this.
  • New Records of Eminence objectives have been added.
    These objectives are mainly weekly objectives focused on Vagary battle content.
  • New designations have been added.

Battle-Related

  • New battle content, Heroines’ Combat II, has been added.
    Two items have been added for this content: a Letter from Iroha for the battlefield version, and a Letter from Reisenjima for the master trial version.
    Attachment 12237
    • Letter from Iroha
      • Requirements for participation
        • All party members must have completed Rhapsodies of Vana’diel.
        • The party leader must be in possession of the Letter from Iroha key item.
      • Enjoying the content
        1. Speak with Emporox in Reisenjima and purchase a Letter from Iroha for one merit point.
        * You must have completed Rhapsodies of Vana’diel to purchase this item.
        2. Trade the Letter from Iroha to the Reisen Crystal in Reisenjima Sanctorium and select “Letter from Iroha” to enter the battlefield.
        3. Emerge victorious.
        • Between one and six players may participate.
        • The time limit is thirty minutes.
          * Players will be automatically removed from the battlefield once the time limit has expired.
        4. Receive individual rewards.
        * A system message will be displayed in the log if you are unable to receive the item.
    • Letter from Reisenjima
      • Requirements for participations
        • All players must be in possession of the designation received upon clearing the battlefield Letter from Iroha.
        • The party leader must be in possession of the Letter from Reisenjima key item.
      • Enjoying the content
        1. Speak with Emporox in Reisenjima and purchase a Letter from Reisenjima for five merit points.
        * You must have completed Rhapsodies of Vana’diel to purchase this item.
        2. Trade the Letter from Reisenjima to the Reisen Crystal in Reisenjima Sanctorium and select “Letter from Reisenjima” to enter the battlefield.
        3. Emerge victorious.
        • Between one and six players may participate.
        • The time limit is sixty minutes.
          * Players will be automatically removed from the battlefield once the time limit has expired.
          * Alter egos may not be called forth.
        4. Receive individual rewards.
        * A system message will be displayed in the log if you are unable to receive the item.
  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • New foes are now available in Normal and Intense Ambuscades.
      * As such, the accompanying Records of Eminence objectives have been changed.
      Attachment 12238
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been changed.
    • Certain rewards obtainable for total hallmarks have been changed.
    • Certain rewards obtainable for badges of gallantry have been changed.

Item-Related

  • New items have been added.
  • The following items may now be equipped by all jobs.
    Wooden Arrow / Crossbow Bolt
  • Help text for the following items has been adjusted.
    Peltast’s Cuissots / Peltast’s Cuissots +1 / Vishap Brais +1 / Vishap Brais +2 / Vishap Brais +3 / Vishap Greaves / Vishap Greaves +1 / Vishap Greaves +2 / Vishap Greaves +3 / Brigantia’s Mantle / Kasuga Kote / Kasuga Kote +1
  • The following items are now storable via the Porter Moogle.
    • Storage Slip 22
      Melon Slicer / Fancy Gilet / Fancy Top / Fancy Trunks / Fancy Shorts
    • Storage Slip 23
      Soulflayer Wand

Resolved Issues

  • The issue wherein the Apex Ironclad in Outer Ra’Kaznar would take unintended actions.
  • Various issues with improper dialogue and help text.
  • The issue wherein the auto-sort function and auto-sort type one would not properly sort the following items.
    Scout’s Crossbow / Arke Crossbow / Sharanga
  • The issue wherein the following item icons were incorrect
    Sagitta / Xiucoatl / Gandring / Barfawc / Rostam / Setan Kober / Crocea Mors / Moralltach / Zomorrodnegar / Morgelai / Pangu / Labraunda / Father Time / Aram / Fudomasamune / Fusenaikyo / Asclepius / Bhima / Kaumodaki / Draumstafir / Musa / Sharanga / Tzee Xicu's Blade

Known Issues

  • Various issues with incorrect dialogue and help text.
  • Various issues wherein certain Records of Eminence objectives that ordinarily could not be repeated were able to be repeated under certain conditions.
  • Various issues with incorrect weapon skill icons.

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 41 Digest
body:
Hi, there!

To coincide with the July version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui hosted another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana'diel 41.
This time, we were invited to a summer offline meeting set up by Dengeki at the Tokyo Culture Culture in Shibuya. The broadcast was separated into two parts this time. In the first part, we invited voice actor Katsuyuki Konishi and singer RiRiKA as guests. We focused on the September version update details, as well as other information. In the second half, we answered some questions we received from our fellow adventurers.

We've put together a digest and an archived video for those of you who were unable to join us for the broadcast, or simply want to recap on all the information.

With that said, let's start with a recap of part 1.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/gUw27FzTNrE" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54395#mogivana_01" class="brlink">Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54395#mogivana_02" class="brlink">Fujito's /say </a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54395#mogivana_03" class="brlink">Matsui-P Q&A</a>

<div id="mogivana_01"></div>
  • Version Update
    (0:01:56)
    This segment of the show focused on the major aspects of the September version update.
    • Dynamis - Divergence Upgrading Synthesis Equpment
      (0:02:16)
      As mentioned in our previous Freshly Picked Vana'diel 40, after the September version update players will be able to attach augment to synthesized equipment from Dynamis - Divergence.

      There are three routes available for the augment, each themed around follow-up attack, increase in attack, and those specific to the weapon type.

      The follow-up attack is a new weapon property that deals an additional attack after an auto attack. When combined with Double Attack and Triple Attack, it'll increase the number of attacks to three or four.

      We also quickly went over the other properties from the other available augment routes in the video.

      (0:06:20)
      We also introduced the neck equipment available from Dynamis - Divergence as well.

      You upgrade both the weapon and the neck equipment by accumulating Reinforcement Points, which then upgrades them in stages. There are two ways to accumulate the Reinforcement Points, the first method is by turning in items. For this one, we're planning a new item. Another method is by defeating regular monsters inside Dynamis - Divergence. The upper limit on the Ranks available on the equipment varies depending on their quality (NQ/HQ/HQ2). The higher the quality, the higher you will be able to upgrade.
    • Relic/Mythic(Ergon)/Empyrean/Aeonic Weapon Upgrades
      (0:10:43)
      We went over the upgrades for Relic/Mythic(Ergon)/Empyrean/Aeonic weapon upgrades in the stream and showed the before and after stats for the Scythe as an example.

      We also went over how these weapons will be upgraded. Along with the method we explained in the previous Freshly Picked Vana'diel, where you must deal a specific amount of damage to the Wave 3 boss, you will also accumulate Reinforcement Points by defeating the boss. Furthermore, we added a new condition where you can accumulate a specific amount of Job Points as well. These weapons will also be upgraded in stages by accumulating Reinforcement Points.
<div id="mogivana_02"></div>
  • Fujito's /say
    (0:24:26)
    • Day of the Shadow Lord
      The Day of Shadow Lord is among us and continues until September 30, at 7:59 a.m. (PDT) / 2:59 (GMT) / 3:59 (BST). In this event, adventurers can receive the Shadow Lord's storied blade, the Lament, as spoils for completing the Shadow Lord Battle battlefield, so be sure to participate in the event!

      The Community Team is looking into other ideas for future events, so please look forward to them as well!
Here's the digest for the second part of the broadcast.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Let's move onto the second part of the broadcast.
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/27BHQvorQWA" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

<div id="mogivana_03"></div>
  • Matsui-P Q&A
    (0:01:08)
    In this segment, Fujito, the Community Team, and myself answered some of the questions we received from our audience.

    Quote:
    Q: Can you please tell us how the FFXI team was when it started development? 0:01:54）
    A：
    The FFXI team was made by combining different teams together. From Tokyo, we had the Secret of Mana team and the Chrono Cross team, from Osaka, we had the Brave Fencer Musashi team and the Parasite Eve 2 team. Since all the teams worked differently, it was difficult to get everything together.

    Matsui: Also, we didn't have anyone that was experienced in working with a large-scale team, such as this one, so everyone was working freely on their own, and we had frequent meetings to discuss those points. As a result, there were times where we had to point out that we can't create a game because of all the meetings.

    Quote:
    Q: Do you have plans to adjust the Empyrean Armor?
    Q: Do you have plans to adjust existing content?* We answered both questions at once. (0:08:05)
    A：
    Fujito: We'll be doing both! However, since we just implemented the Wave 3 for Dynamis - Divergence, so we'll be doing these after some time. We're planning to adjust Vagary and Sinister Reign. For Vagary, we'll adjust so you can flag the Empyrean armor for an upgrade with few people, and for Sinister Reign, we're thinking of a system where you can select your opponent.

    Quote:
    Q: When the FFXI service began there was a text in the patch notes that mentioned "xxx issue has been avoided," but who thought of this text? * This question is referring to the Japanese patch notes. (0:11:35)
    A：
    Mochizuki: We don't recall writing this, but there's a time where we made a bug fix announcement that mentioned: "We corrected a bug where the text in the patch notes was incorrect."

    Quote:
    Q: Can you give us details on job adjustments? (0:13:49)
    A：
    Matsui: We're deciding on the upper equipment stats, so we'll finally start touching up on the job adjustments. The job adjustments won't be done by looking at specific jobs, but all around adjustments that'll affect all jobs, big or small.

    Quote:
    Q: What do you do as a Producer of FFXI? I would like to see more collaboration event with other titles. Please add Ajido-Marujido in Dissidia Final Fantasy: Opera Omnia! * We answered both of these questions together.
    (0:15:31)
    A：
    Matsui: I arrange meetings to plan out things like what was asked, such as collaborations. We also talk about budgets and such, but we cannot disclose this information, so I'll leave it at that.

    There's a lot of meeting that takes place, by having myself attend these meetings there are situations that can be resolved or go smoothly, so I try and attend these as much as possible.

    Quote:
    Q: Do you have any plans to increase more magic spells, avatars, songs, and attachment for the automatons? (0:18:20)
    A：
    Fujito: There are things we could increase, but we're currently in a situation where the available slot is at its limit and we cannot increase. In general, the slots available for magic spells is already at the limit. However, we're not giving up here, we're continuing to discuss and looking for ways to do this.

    Quote:
    Q: Do you have plans for any new mount? I would like to sit on Shadow Lord's shoulder and walk around. (0:20:42)
    A：
    Fujito: We're preparing new mounts! Don't think it'll look good seeing Shadow Lord flying in when you blow a horn, so that's not going to happen, but we're looking into various mounts, so please look forward to it.
    * During the broadcast we showed screenshots of the Goobbue and Adamantus mounts.

The next Freshly Picked Vana'diel is scheduled for November or December. Please look forward to the next show!

Until then, see you!

title: September. 10, 2018 (JST) Version Update
body:
• <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54410-?p=609526&viewfull=1#post609526">Event-related</a>
