Event-Related

  • The equipment rewards for the following quests may now be obtained more than once.
    When choosing your reward for the following quests, you will now be able to choose equipment that you have already received.
    Trial by Fire / Trial by Earth / Trial by Water / Trial by Wind / Trial by Ice / Trial by Lightning
    The Moonlit Path / Waking Dreams / Divine Interference / Unwavering Resolve / A Stygian Pact / The Dawn Also Rises

Battle-Related

  • Dynamis-Divergence has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The method for counting cumulative damage to Wave 3 bosses has been adjusted.
      • Damage will be counted when you are in possession of the following key items. Moreover, when you are in a Dynamis-Divergence area, an on-screen damage indicator will be displayed.
        Elvaan Mask of Darkness / Galka Mask of Darkness / Tarutaru Mask of Darkness / Mithra Mask of Darkness
        After defeating the Wave 3 boss, or when the cumulative damage you have inflicted exceeds 30,000,000 HP, the aforementioned key items will transform as follows (respectively):
        Elvaan Mask of Light / Galka Mask of Light / Tarutaru Mask of Light/ Mithra Mask of Light
        *Players can acquire these items along the way to their confrontation with the Wave 3 bosses.
        *Any damage inflicted prior to this version update will also be counted toward the cumulative total. If you have already met the conditions above, your Mask of Darkness will transform into the corresponding Mask of Light upon receiving it.
      • An on-screen indicator has been added to display reinforcement points accumulated for augmented items.
        *The indicator will be displayed while you are in a Dynamis-Divergence area with an appropriate weapon equipped.
        *This applies only to weapons and accessories created via items obtained in Dynamis-Divergence.
    • New battle reward items have been added.
  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • New foes are now available in Normal and Intense Ambuscades
      *As such, the accompanying Records of Eminence have been changed.
      Attachment 12257
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been changed.
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for total hallmarks have been changed.
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been changed.
  • New rewards have been added for Omen.
  • The following rewards have been added to Unity Wanted Campaigns for levels 119 and above.
    Pluton / Beitetsu / Riftborn Boulder

Item-Related

  • New items have been added.
  • It is now possible to add augments to relic, mythic, empyrean, ergon, and aeonic weapons.
    • Requirements

      You will be able to augment your weapons by meeting any one of the following conditions:
      • You have acquired any of the following key items from an area of Dynamis-Divergence corresponding to your weapon:
        Elvaan Mask of Light / Galka Mask of Light / Tarutaru Mask of Light / Mithra Mask of Light
      • Deposit 10,000 job points with Oboro while fulfilling the following conditions:
        • You have upgraded at least one relic, mythic, empyrean, ergon, or aeonic weapon to its maximum potential.
        • You are a job master for the job that will equip that weapon.
          *You can deposit up to 700 job points per week (Earth time). Furthermore, you can also donate job points from other jobs you have mastered.
    • Area List
      <table width="400" border="0"><tr><td width="40%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Weapon Type</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Area</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Relic</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Dynamis - Windurst (D)</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Mythic/Ergon</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Dynamis - Bastok (D)</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Empyrean</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Dynamis – San d’Oria (D)</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Aeonic</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Dynamis - Jeuno (D)</td></tr></table>
    • Procedure
      1. Speak with Oboro, and ask about “Upgrading my weapon even further.”
      2. Trade the weapon you wish to augment to Oboro along with one of the required items below to receive upgrade points. Accumulate enough points, and your augment rank will increase, further upgrading your weapon.
    • Required Items

      S. Astral Detritus / M. Astral Detritus
    • Weapons with Dispensable Projectiles
      When augmenting the following weapons that dispense projectiles, you will receive two items: your weapon and a projectile-dispensing item.
      Yoichinoyumi / Gandiva / Fail-Not / Gastraphetes
      Annihilator / Death Penalty / Armageddon / Fomalhaut
  • Additional items have been made augmentable.

    Players will now be able to augment weapons and accessories created via items obtained through Dynamis-Divergence.
    *Please note that augmented items may not be put up for auction.
    • Requirements

      Enter any of the areas for Dynamis-Divergence.
    • Procedure
      1. Trade the item you wish to augment to the NPC Oboro.
      2. Choose from among one of three routes.
        (*There is only one option for accessories.)
      3. Gain points via one of the following two methods. Accumulate enough points, and your augment rank will increase, further upgrading your equipment.
      • Trade the equipment you wish to augment along with one of the required items below to Oboro.
      • Defeat foes in Dynamis-Divergence while equipped with the gear you wish to augment.
    • Required Items

      Heroism Crystal / Heroism Aggregate
  • The effects of the items below will now be displayed in their respective item descriptions.
Simit / Simit +1 / Bloody Chocolate / Roasted Almonds / Pepperoni / Dried Berry / Rolsin / Withered Berry / Chalaimbille / Marinara Pizza / Marinara Pizza +1 / Marinara Sauce
  • <strong>The following items are now storable via the Porter Moogle.</strong>
    • Storage Slip 22
      Uka Statue / Iroha Statue / Lament / Lamia Staff

System-Related

  • The following phrases have been added to the auto-translate dictionary.
    <table width="400" border="0"><tr><td width="40%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">カテゴリ</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">登録単語</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Stymie</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Intervene</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Soul Enslavement</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Unleash</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Clarion Call</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Overkill</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Yaegasumi</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Mikage</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Fly High</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Astral Conduit</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Unbridled Wisdom</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Cutting Cards</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Heady Artifice</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Widened Compass</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef">Job Abilities 2</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb">Odyllic Subterfuge</td></tr></table>

Resolved Issues

  • Various issues with improper error messages and help text.
  • An issue wherein under certain conditions, the query options displayed when replaying the quest “The Moonlit Path” would be incorrect.
  • An issue wherein under certain conditions, the Record of Eminence “Omen Participation” could not be achieved.
  • An issue wherein under certain conditions, certain Geomancy abilities would have improper areas of effect.
  • Various issues with incorrect weapon skill icons.

Known Issues

  • Under certain conditions, certain status benefits will not affect pets.
  • Certain key items may be sorted into the wrong category.
  • Various issues with incorrect dialogue.

title: October. 10, 2018 (JST) Version Update
body:
• <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54525?p=610162#post610162">Battle-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54525?p=610163#post610163">Item-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54525?p=610164#post610164">Resolved Issues</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54525?p=610165#post610165">Known Issues</a>

Battle-Related

  • A new feature has been added to Sinister Reign to allow players to take on foes of their own choosing.
    Attachment 12266
    • Requirements
      • Have the FINAL FANTASY XI: Seekers of Adoulin expansion installed.
      • Have registered the Seekers of Adoulin expansion content.
      • Have completed all of the Seekers of Adoulin missions.
      • Must be in possession of the “Macabre Simulacrum” key item.
        *One to six players may take part in the battlefield.
        *All party members must fulfill the necessary requirements.
        *The “Macabre Simulacrum” key item is consumed upon entering the arena. It must be re-obtained in order to fight again.
    • Joining Sinister Reign
      1. Obtaining the key item
      • Speak to Malobra in Ra’Kaznar Inner Court (I-8) and exchange 5,000 bayld for the Macabre Simulacrum key item.
      2. After all party members have acquired a macabre simulacrum, the party leader can send the entire party to the battle arena by inspecting the Infernal Transposer in Ra'Kaznar Inner Court (I-8).
      • Initially, you will be able to choose from Ingrid, Darrcuiln, and Arciela.
      • Defeating all opponents will result in further selectable foes being unlocked.
      3. Triumph over your foe to claim your reward
      • A time limit of 30 minutes (Earth time) is in place for the battle.
      • Emerge victorious, and you will earn a reward commensurate with your choice of foe.
        *If you have no room in your inventory, you will be unable to claim your reward, and a message will be displayed asking you to clean out your inventory.
        *You cannot earn experience points or capacity points from this content, nor will Malobra reward you for emerging victorious.
  • New battlefields have been added to Vagary where players can face off directly against a boss enemy of their choosing.
    The following battlefields have been added to Vagary:
    Vagary: Putraxia / Vagary: Rancibus / Vagary: Pallitorus / Vagary: Perfidien / Vagary: Plouton
    Attachment 12267
    • Requirements
      • Putraxia / Rancibus / Pallitorus
        • Must have completed the Seekers of Adoulin mission “Watery Grave.
        • Must be in possession the “prototype sigil pearl” key item.
      • Perfidien
        • Must have completed the Seekers of Adoulin mission “Reckoning.”
        • Must be in possession of the “prototype sigil pearl” key item.
      • Plouton
        • Must have completed the Seekers of Adoulin mission “Abomination.”
        • Must be in possession of the “prototype sigil pearl” key item.
        *One to six players may take part in the battlefield.
        *All party members must fulfill the necessary requirements.
        *The “prototype sigil pearl” key item is consumed upon entering the arena. It must be re-obtained in order to fight again.
    • Joining the Fray
      1. Obtain the “prototype sigil pearl” key item from the Odyssean Passage in Leafallia.
      • The key item may be obtained by trading the “befouled water” dropped by Fomor enemies encountered in Inner and Outer Ra’Kaznar.
      2. Inspect the Ominous Postern in the Ra’Kaznar Turris and select the battlefield of your choice.
      3. Dispatch your foes.
      • A time limit of 30 minutes (Earth time) is in place for the battle.
      • After the battle, you will receive a title befitting your victory.
        *These battlefields will not grant experience points, capacity points, or treasure.
        *These battlefields will not count toward the Vagary objective for Records of Eminence.
  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • New foes are now available in Normal and Intense Ambuscades.
      *The corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have also been changed accordingly.
      Attachment 12268
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been changed.
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for total hallmarks have been changed.
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been changed.
  • In Besieged, the speed at which the enemy army advances has been increased.
    This change will be more apparent for armies of lower strength levels, but affects all armies.

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • New synthesis recipes have been added.
    <table width="540" border="0"><tr><td style="border-style:none;" colspan="3" align="center"><<Amateur>></td></tr><tr style="text-align:center;"><th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="25%">Item</th><th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="25%">Required<br />Synthesis Skills</th><th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="50%">Materials</th></tr><tr style="text-align:left;"><td style="background:#c6e9ef;text-align:center;">Lost Sickle +1</td><td style="background:#eaf2f3;text-align:center;">—</td><td style="background:#eaf2f3;">Lost Sickle, Lost Sickle</td></tr></table>
  • Afterglow effects have been added to the following weapons:
    Epeolatry / Idris
    *This only affects versions of these items that have been upgraded by trading 10,000 chunks of beitetsu to the NPC Oboro.
    *Visual effects have also been added to the weapons in question.
  • The following items are now storable via the Porter Moogle:
    • Storage Slip 22
      Lost Sickle / Lost Sickle +1
    • Storage Slip 23
      Gramk’s Axe

*A revision was made to the details on Thursday, October 11 at 2:00 a.m. (PST)
*A revision was made to the details on Thursday, 11 October at 9:00 a.m. (GMT) / 10:00 a.m. (BST)

Resolved Issues

  • An issue wherein various NPC dialogue lines contained typographical errors.
  • Various issues wherein the help text for certain items contained errors.
  • An issue wherein certain key items were sorted into improper categories.
  • An issue with Unity "Wanted" quest battles wherein the notorious monster Kubool Ja's Mhuufya could not be knocked out under certain circumstances.
  • An issue with Dynamis-Divergence wherein the "Mask" gauge would not display properly under certain circumstances.
  • An issue wherein "Enhancing magic effect duration +n%" properties augmenting the following items would, under certain circumstances, not activate.
    Duelist's Torque / Duelist's Torque +1 / Duelist's Torque +2
  • An issue with Campaign wherein adventurers would, under certain circumstances, become unable to move after climbing onto their mounts.
  • An issue wherein specific buffs would not, under certain circumstances, be applied to pets.
  • An issue with Master Trials wherein, upon completion of Sealed Fate, the corresponding title would be applied to party members not on the battlefield.
  • An issue wherein augmenting weapons and accessories made from items obtained in Dynamis - Divergence would cause signatures to be removed.

* The contents of this document were updated on Thursday, November 1, at 11:00 p.m. (PST) / Friday, 2 November, at 6:00 a.m. (GMT)
* The contents of this document were updated on Tuesday, November 6, at 6:00 p.m. (PST) / Wednesday, November 6, 2:00 a.m. (GMT)

Known Issues

  • Incorrect log text displays when, under certain circumstances, adventurers are afflicted with weakness.
  • The visual effects for Poison Breath do not display when the ability is used by specific monsters under certain circumstances.

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 43 Digest
body:
Hi, there!

To coincide with the January version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui hosted another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana'diel 43.
Once again, we had our broadcast before the version update. We focused on the January version update details, as well as other information.

We've put together a digest and an archived video for those of you who were unable to join us for the broadcast, or simply want to recap on all the information.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/7JF8UOxwRdc" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>


Table of Contents
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54950#mogivana_01" class="brlink">Freshly Picked Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54950#mogivana_02" class="brlink">Over Picked Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54950#mogivana_03" class="brlink">Fujito's /shout</a>

<div id="mogivana_01"></div>
  • Freshly Picked Version Update
    （00:04:15）
    This segment of the show focused on the major aspects of the January version update.
    • Battle Content: Ambuscade
      （00:04:25）
      As some of you may know, 2019 is the year of the boar, so we kicked off our January Ambuscade with the Raaz as a new foe, and the Quadavs have made its return. Raaz will get stronger over time if one character maintains hate, so managing hate is going to be the key this time. As this is the beginning of a new year, we didn't want to make it too difficult from the get-go, so from a difficulty perspective, we didn't make it too difficult. We invite all players who haven't touched the Ambuscade in a while to give it a try. As for the returning Quadavs, we have made adjustments to their original resistances, and also have addressed an issue we had previously, so we believe it should be easier to fight against them.

      （00:08:00）
      While this only applies to the Ambuscade Primer Volume Two, we increased the overall amount of hallmarks and gallantry that can be obtained.
      <table width="540" border="0"><tr style="text-align:center;"><th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="40%">Difficulty</th><th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="30%">≪Hallmarks Obtained≫</th><th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="30%">≪Gallantry Obtained≫<br>(With a six member party)</th></tr><tr style="text-align:center;"><td style="background:#c6e9ef;text-align:center;">Difficult</td><td style="background:#eaf2f3;text-align:center;">200 → 250</td><td style="background:#eaf2f3;text-align:center;">100 → 125</td></tr><tr style="text-align:center;"><td style="background:#c6e9ef;text-align:center;">Normal</td><td style="background:#f5fafb;text-align:center;">100 → 200</td><td style="background:#f5fafb;text-align:center;">50 → 100</td></tr><tr style="text-align:center;"><td style="background:#c6e9ef;text-align:center;">Easy</td><td style="background:#eaf2f3;text-align:center;">75 → 150</td><td style="background:#eaf2f3;text-align:center;">25 → 75</td></tr><tr style="text-align:center;"><td style="background:#c6e9ef;text-align:center;">Very Easy</td><td style="background:#f5fafb;text-align:center;">50 → 100</td><td style="background:#f5fafb;text-align:center;">5 → 50</td></tr></table>* Tough enemies will yeild the same amount as before
      Ambuscade was originally added to motivate players to challenge in high-end difficulty content, and for this reason we had the rewards set based on the difficulty; however, as we introduced more ways to use the points, it required you to earn more, which resulted in a situation where you lost the desire to engage in the content. For this reason, we've decided to increase the amount earned through volume two.

      （00:10:18）
      Aside from these changes, we introduced the Za'Dha Chopper, a new great axe that is available for exchange with hallmarks.
    • Job Adjustments
      （00:12:31）
      We felt it was necessary to an adjustment to the general framework in order to make individual job adjustments. Therefore in December, we added a new job trait, Damage Limit+ as part of the adjustment to the general framework, and this was done to try and close the overall gap between physical and magical DPS job’s damage. Physical DPS jobs tend to require full buffs during a battle, while the magical DPS jobs do not, therefore we decided that we’ll need to increase the damage cap and added this trait.
      By adding this trait, we've heard that dark knights became too strong. However, but the adjustments were based on a warrior job. With warriors they have the Double Attack trait and when considering that, the damage output from dark knight isn’t that much.
      That being said, we’ll continue to observe and make individual job adjustments, and we’re also planning to make further adjustments to the general framework like we did this time.
      * In the video, we mentioned warriors gains three physical damage cap increase, but the correct amount is two.

      （00:20:29）
      In the January version update, we have de-linked the recast times of dragoon's Jump, Spirit Jump, High Jump, and Soul Jump. By having their own recast times, it's now possible to use all four at the same time.

      （00:21:38）
      The recast timer for the dancer's Waltz ability, such as the Curing Waltz and Divine Waltz has been de-linked so they're not sharing the same cooldown. While it still consumes TP, we believe you'll be able to fight better by making a slight adjustment to your fighting style. We have also greatly increased the effect of Presto.
    • Record of Eminence
      （00:24:43）
      We've added new conditions related to Besieged in the Record of Eminence. There was an issue where the Record of Eminence objective could not be completed due to enemies being defeated while the besieged status was on Advancing. This update was to address this issue.

<div id="mogivana_02"></div>
  • Over Picked Version Update
    （00:28:36）
    We've revealed some information regarding the upcoming February version update. Please note that the information is based on the current state and may be subject to change.
    • Ambuscade Weapons
      （00:29:50）
      In addition to adding a third and fourth phase of the Ambuscade weapon upgrade, we're also planning to change the design of the weapon as well. The weapon upgrade phase doesn't end on the fourth phase but will go on just a bit longer. As for the final stats on these weapons, we're thinking of setting them so that these weapons are adequate enough before obtaining the “best” weapon.
    • Job Adjustments
      （00:31:32）
      We're planning to make adjustments to red mages; however, there's a possibility where we may make an adjustment to another job depending on the development status. We are thinking of making adjustments to all the jobs, and it also doesn't mean that we won't make any further adjustments after we make the adjustments. It'll take a while for the job adjustments, so we ask you for your patience and understanding.
    • New Mount
      （00:46:03）
      During the show, we've showcased images of a new mount. Since this mount is very important in the story, we've prepared a specific quest to obtain it. Please look forward to it!

<div id="mogivana_03"></div>
  • Fujito's /shout
    （00:50:43）

    →New Year's Wishes
    （00:50:57）
    The New Year's event was available until Tuesday, January 15th.

    →January 2019 Login Campaign
    （00:51:24）
    Our featured item of the month is the ♪Raaz mount! Don't worry, you won't fall off!

    →New Year's Geas Fete Campaign
    （00:53:00）
    Various campaigns will be held, so keep an eye out for them!

    →I Dream of Mog Bonanza 2019
    （00:53:30）
    The winning numbers have been announced! We apologize for temporarily suspending the exchange when the winning numbers were announced. Reward exchange has resumed on Tuesday, January 15th. For details please refer to this news.

    →Aphmau Arrives in DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY OPERA OMNIA! (Japanese Version)
    （00:54:26）
    Aphmau arrives in DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY OPERA OMNIA. While her outfit is the white Nashmeira outfit, we kept the name as Aphmau to avoid spoilers. The Japanese version of this character is voiced by Haruka Tomatsu.
    * In the video, we've mentioned Lion and Prishe will be buffed. The "buff" here is referring that this character gives a status buff during the event.

We hope to share the future of Vana'diel once again with everyone this year and thank you all for your continued support.

Until next time, see you!

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 44 Digest
body:
Hi, there!

To coincide with the March version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui hosted another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana'diel 44.
Once again, we had our broadcast before the version update. We focused on the March version update details, as well as other information.

We've put together a digest and an archived video for those of you who were unable to join us for the broadcast, or simply want to recap on all the information.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/3LQfj-8Icbk" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54950#mogivana_01" class="brlink">Freshly Picked Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/54950#mogivana_02" class="brlink">Fujito's /shout</a>

<div id="mogivana_01"></div>
  • Freshly Picked Version Update
    (00:02:07)
    This segment of the show focused on the major aspects of the March version update.
    • Battle Content: Ambuscade
      (00:02:21)
      We introduced a new foe. In the normal mode, players will encounter the hippogryph, and in the Intense Ambuscade, players will encounter tonberry.

      The Ambuscade in February involved fighting six hecteyes, so this time we changed it up to fight one hippogryph. Since the hippogryphs had an image of wind, we have increased their evasion using an ability called Airy Shield. We made sure that the enemy can't be taken down easily with full force, just because it's a single target this time. Therefore, this hippogryph is hiding their weakness against ranged attacks; however, if you meet a certain condition, you can remove the Airy Shield effect. Additionally, they become vulnerable when they use a specific ability as well. Players should be able to take down the enemy if they can focus their attack when these opportunities become available. We ask you to give a try and find the most effective way to win your victory.

      (00:05:24)
      We're finally introducing the final upgrade for the Ambuscade weapons. The name of the weapons and their graphics will change. Furthermore, they will have unique stats and effects to them. We've showcased two of the weapons, Gokotai (Katana) and Xoanon (Staff) during the show, so be sure to check the video out! The "Enhances Regain based on Dual Wield effect" on the Gokotai gives TP+1 for every Duel Wield +1 effect. (This will only take effect when equipped as the main weapon.) As for the "Increases magic damage based on the amount of TP" stat on the Xoanon, this gives an additional Magic Damage +100 when the TP is at TP3000, and so the effect will take effect if you can maintain the TP.

      As for reforging the weapons to their final form, you'll need to obtain a new item called the Abdhaljs Matter first. For the other items, please go talk to Gorpa-Masorpa in Mhaura.

      Also, all current Ambuscade weapons and grips can now be stored, so please make use of this if you're working on multiple weapons.

    • Job Adjustments
      (00:13:07)
      We're adding new attachments for puppetmaster. The Magniplug enhances the weapon's damage, the Arcanoclutch enhances the magic damage, and Truesights, which is wind-based attachment and this enhances the ranged damage. We're also introducing a higher-tiered version of the existing attachments as well. Additionally, these attachments can be purchased from vendors, but we've also made it possible to be synthesized.

      (00:16:49)
      We made adjustments to existing adjustments, and also adjust certain attachments so that they will no longer consume maneuvers, but instead add burden to the element. We believe this will change the combination of attachments that'll be used and the way you fight with them, so be sure to read the patch notes for more details.

<div id="mogivana_02"></div>
  • Fujito's /shout
    (00:19:49)

    →The March 2019 Login Campaign
    (00:20:10)
    This month's featured item is the Prishe Statue II. We already had a Prishe statue, but the person in charge had a strong desire, so we've decided to create a second variation of the statue.

    →Item Hunter Campaign
    (00:21:03)
    We're going to have a bunch of campaigns that'll help to acquire items throughout various contents, such as Assault and Adoulin Dial.

(00:25:03)
At the end of the show we mentioned that starting next fiscal year, we're going to focus our development and operations on a long-term goal of the twentieth anniversary. As such, there may be some time where the version updates may feel a bit lighter, but we're hoping to be able to deliver something that can surprise everyone later on.

(00:34:20)
Furthermore, we're also planning to renew our client installer and configurations, as well as make adjustments so that the installation is much easier to understand. This should allow, not only new players but returning players an easier environment into the game. We'd like everyone to invite your friends over to try the game out once this becomes available.

We'll hype FFXI together and ask you all for your continued support!

Until next time, see you!

title: May. 10, 2019 (JST) Version Update
body:
• <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/55360?p=615386#post615386">Event-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/55360?p=615387#post615387">Battle-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/55360?p=615388#post615388">Item-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/55360?p=615389#post615389">System-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/55360?p=615390#post615390">Resolved Issues</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/55360?p=615391#post615391">Known Issues</a>

Event-related

  • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.

Battle-related

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes in Normal and Intense Ambuscades have been swapped out.
      * As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.
      Attachment 12412
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain rewards obtainable for total hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain rewards obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been swapped out.
  • The white mage job has undergone the following adjustments.
    Attachment 12413
    • The merit point categories Protectra V and Shellra V have been changed to Animus Solace and Animus Misery.
      * Any points placed in Protectra V and Shellra V prior to the version update will be automatically carried over to the new categories.
      • Job Trait: Animus Solace
        Grants a bonus to the maximum damage absorbed by stoneskin effects granted by certain healing spells during Afflatus Solace.
      • Job Trait: Animus Misery
        Grants a bonus to maximum damage stored during Afflatus Misery.
    • The white magic spells Protectra V and Shellra V are now learned via scrolls.
      * Players who had acquired these spells via merit points prior to the version update will not need to learn them again.

      The default values for these spells are equivalent to having 5 merit points in the appropriate category and being equipped with the Protectra V/Shellra V effect increasing augment of the Piety Attire.
    • The augments increasing the effects of Protectra V and Shellra V have been changed to affect Animus Solace and Animus Misery, respectively.
      • Animus Solace Effect
        Increases the magic attack of Holy spells.
      • Animus Misery Effect
        Increases the magic attack of Banish spells.
    • The effects of the following white magic spells have been increased.
      Protect / Protect II / Protect III / Protect IV / Protect V /
      Protectra I / Protectra II / Protectra IV / Protectra IV /
      Shell / Shell II / Shell III / Shell IV / Shell V /
      Shellra I / Shellra II / Shellra III / Shellra IV
    • The effects of the white magic spell Esuna have been changed.
      • Esuna now affects a single target.
      • Esuna now removes all of the following status ailments, and does not require the caster to be affected by them.

        Poison / Paralysis / Blind / Silence / Curse/ Disease / Plague / Petrification

        While under the effects of Afflatus Misery, Esuna will also remove all status ailments removable with Erase, as well as Amnesia.
      • The recast time has been increased from 30 seconds to 120 seconds.
      • The MP cost has been increased from 24 to 178.
    • The effects of the White Magic spell Sacrifice have been changed.
      • When transferring a status ailment, the duration will be halved.
      • Silence and petrification may now be transferred.
      • During Afflatus Misery, the caster gains resistance to the ailment transferred, and hence will not become afflicted.
  • The alter ego of Pieuje (UC)’s combat logic has been adjusted.
    • He will no longer use the weapon skill Starlight.
    • He will now attempt to use the white magic spell Esuna on party members while he is under the effects of Afflatus Misery.

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • The Cleric’s Wand’s Afflatus Misery effect has been changed from increasing the number of status ailments cured by Esuna by 1 to restoring 2% HP for each status ailment cured by Esuna.
  • The Piety Wand’s Afflatus Misery effect has been changed from increasing the number of status ailments cured by Esuna by 2 to restoring 3% HP for each status ailment cured by Esuna.
  • The Asclepius’s Afflatus Misery effect has been changed from increasing the number of status ailments cured by Esuna by 3 to restoring 4% HP for each status ailment cured by Esuna.
  • The Scphoria Ring will now be able to dispel the additional effect of Amnesia applied by some abilities such as Winds of Oblivion.
  • The Morbol Latte may now transform players into a red mini morbol as well.
  • Hasim in Lower Jeuno now sells scrolls of Protectra V and Shellra V.
  • The help text of the scrolls of Esuna and Sacrifice have been adjusted.
  • The following items are now storable via the Porter Moogle.
    • Storage Slip 22
      Jody Shirt / Jody Shield
    • Storage slip 23
      Dullahan Shield

System-related

  • A new status, Emporox’s Gift, has been added.

    If this status is active when you are at the merit point cap, you will automatically receive 1 potpourri when you accumulate 10,000 limit points.

    There are two ways to receive Emporox’s Gift.
    • Pay 100 escha beads to Emporox in Reisenjima.
      The effect will last for 72 hours.
    • Purchase an Emporox’s ring from Emporox in Reisenjima for 500 escha beads.
      The effect will last for 24 hours.
  • The FINAL FANTASY XI Config settings window has changed.
    Read on for details.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue with certain monster abilities in which the font color was incorrect.

Known Issues

  • In Magian trials, Marksmanship weapon skills will not be counted under certain conditions.
  • Certain gamepads may not operate correctly in the gamepad settings.
  • In the FINAL FANTASY XI Config, certain checked entries will remain active even if the legacy settings are turned off.
    * These entries can be disabled by first enabling legacy settings the de-checking the applicable boxes and turning legacy settings off once more.
  • The enchantment effect of the Jody Shield cannot be used in Mog Gardens.

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 45 Digest
body:
Hi, there!

To coincide with the May version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui hosted another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana'diel 45.

Once again, we had our broadcast before the version updated. We focused on the May version update details, as well as other information.

We've put together a digest and an archived video for those of you who were unable to join us for the broadcast, or simply want to recap on all the information.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/HBAc3gwEmis" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/55414#mogivana_01" class="brlink">Freshly Picked Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/55414#mogivana_02" class="brlink">Fujito’s /shout </a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/55414#mogivana_03" class="brlink">Q&A Segment</a>

<div id="mogivana_01"></div>
  • Freshly Picked Version Update
    This segment of the show focused on the major aspects of the May version update.
    • Job Adjustments
      (00:04:52)
      In the May version update, we made adjustments to the white mage job.

      For more details on the version update, please check here.

      First, we have changed the Protectra V and Shellra V merit point categories to Animus Solace and Animus Misery.
      The white magic spells Protectra V and Shellra V have been changed so you now learn them through magic scrolls. Since these were spells that you learn through merit points, we have decided it would be better to convert them to magic scrolls. As such, we're planning to make similar adjustments to other spells for other jobs that are learned through merit points.

      With this change, we’ve made the default values of these spells so that they're equivalent to having 5 merit points in the appropriate category. In order to make sure there isn’t any difference between the values from when there are 5 merit pints and those with 1 to 4, we increased the overall values for those with 1 to 4 merit points.

      Changes to Esuna
      Before, the caster had to absorb the negative status ailments in order to remove them using Esuna. To mitigate this issue we changed it so it can now remove individual status ailments directly. Furthermore, during Afflatus Misery, status ailments that can be removed using Erase and Amnesia can also now be removed.

      While more status ailments can be removed, we have changed it so the spell only affects a single target, and made further balance adjustments by increasing the casting time and the amount of MP required to cast the spell.
      * Yagrush’s Divine Veil effect will not make the spells effect to area-wide effect.

      Changes to Sacrifice
      Many times, Sacrifice was cast together with Esuna, therefore, we have made changed the effect of Sacrifice as well.
    • Ambuscade
      (00:19:39)
      Players will go up against Dullahan and Gallu in this month’s Ambuscade.

      Gallu will appear in the Ambuscade for the first time, and they appear in a set of two. The key to this fight is to maintain the HP of both enemies. Don’t worry, these Gallu won’t remove your gear or add weakened status!

      As May is the anniversary for FINAL FANTASY XI, we have snuck in Dullahan’s shield as a reward.
    • Quality of Life Improvements
      (00:22:21)

      Auto-Potpourri Charge
      We’ve implemented a way to automatically receive potpourri so you don’t have to manually receive them. You may speak to Emporox in Reisenjima to receive a buff that’ll last for a good amount of time, and every time the merit point cap is reached, it’ll convert to potpourri. Additionally, if you’d like to receive potpourri at your specific time, we also prepared an Emporox’s Ring, which can be exchanged with Emporox in Reisenjima for escha beads. The effect duration of Emporox’s Gift status will suspend when you’re not logged into the game, so we recommend getting the buff directly from Emporox if you’d like to collect a lot of potpourri.

      *During the broadcast, we mentioned that one of the requirements was to have the limit points reach its cap; however, the correct requirement is merit point to reach its cap. Sorry!

      New Config Settings Window
      We’ve made improvements to the config settings window as the previous one may have been difficult to understand. Also, you’re now able to backup and restore macros, lock-style, map markers, data that are stored locally on your computer. By backing up the data here, you’ll be able to load the data if you happen to need to reinstall the client and such. For more information, see here.

<div id="mogivana_02"></div>
  • Fujito’s /shout
    (00:33:00)

    →SHINING BLESS Special Live Concert
    (00:33:25)
    Come enjoy the live concert held by the hit group SHINING BLESS! And don’t forget to shake their tentacles!? There’s some changes coming to the FFXI ReFriender as well, so be sure to check it out when the event goes live.

    →17th Vana’versary Mog Bonanza
    (00:34:40)
    For the first place prize, players will receive the crystal of murky astral detritus, and Hotengeki is now available as the fourth place prize. Hotengeki can be transferred to characters under the same account, so if you’ve won this prize on your alternative characters, you can still pass it to your main! We’re planning to make all lock-style gear moving forward to be transferrable to characters under the same account.

    →Return Home to Vana’diel and Discount Campaign
    (00:36:17)
    The Return Home to Vana’diel and Discount Campaign is coming. Why not take this opportunity to invite your friends back or start a new adventure with you!?

    →The Spring Alter Ego Expo, A.M.A.N. Trove Test Your Luck Campaign, and the Adventurer Appreciation Campaign
    (00:36:41)
    We’ve got plethora of campaigns going on, so we recommend everyone to take part in them!

    →Adventurer Gratitude Campaign
    (00:37:08)
    And if that’s not enough campaigns, we have more! Through these campaigns, players will receive more experience, capacity points, and much more! Furthermore, some of the campaigns will be upgraded from May 16th, so don’t miss this opportunity!

    →Welcome Back to Vana’diel Screenshot Campaign
    (00:41:08)
    As we bring back the Return Home to Vana’diel campaign, we ask for your help to bring back your fellow comrades with open arms by sharing screenshots depicting the current lifestyle of Vana’diel! Show us what you enjoy doing most in Vana’diel currently and we’ll not only award you with a Marvelous Cheer in-game item but feature your screenshot on our official Twitter account!

    →May 2019 Login Campaign
    (00:43:25)
    This month’s featured item is the ♪Adamantoise mount! We also have the alter ego, Shantotto II in the list, so don’t miss out!

    →Jeuno, Back in the Spotlight
    (00:44:23)
    We'll be doing this again! Since it's just being brought back, the details will be same.

<div id="mogivana_03"></div>
  • Q&A
    (00:46:18)
    In this segment we answered some questions that were brought up by the community on our forums.

    Quote:
    Q. I’ve been reporting bots every time I see them; however, it seems like there’s still a lot out there. I would like to know what’s being done.
    A. We’ve taken measures so that the STF team can periodically report back the status on the forums, so if you could please check those. All the reports received from our players are being shared with the STF team. Thanks to all those reports, we were able to take against more RMT, and it also helped increase the speed of our investigations. However, to counter this the RMT have been fighting back and increasing. So our current status is that we are taking action against them constantly.

    There’s also a method to shut down the ways they accumulate money, but this would affect normal players as well, so we’re discussing the matter on a regular basis with the Development team to see what would be the most effective way to take. Please understand that we can’t go into details, as if we do that, it’ll just notify the RMT what we’re doing. No matter what measures we take, it ends up being a game of cat-and-mouse, but we’ll continue our efforts.

    We understand that for those that have ill feelings due to RMT aren’t satisfied with the current situation. However, we would appreciate if you could please continue to support us by reporting them so we can continue to take as many actions against them and share information with you all.

    Quote:
    Q. Would it be possible to change the stack amount of items to 99?
    A. Systematically it’s possible; however, the looking over the effect due to this change would make this difficult. For example, for the auction house, the server decides on a stack based on 12, if we increase the amount of the stack, we’ll need to stop the auction house. Also, we also worry that by increasing the stack amount would also mean you can only up to a stack of 99 on the market as well.

    We understand there are requests to use a system seen in Dragon Quest X and other MMORPG titles; however, due to the difference in the base structure of the game, it’ll require as many resources to create the system from scratch and this isn’t realistic to do. That said, we should be able to do this for items that aren’t able to be put up on sale on the auction house, so we’d like for you to please let us know which items you’d like to be able to increase the stack amount for.

    ■Items we’d like to be able to stack to 99
    https://sqex.to/ro1qr

    Quote:
    Q. When can we expect new additions to orchestrion rolls?
    A. We have more slots available, so we’ll consider adding more.
    We apologize for this taking long. The person in charge has moved to a different team.

    Quote:
    Q. Can you make rewards from missions and quests that can only be obtained once storable?
    A. We’ll see if we can do this.
    Missions and quests have completion flags to them so it may be possible to use that as a reference to make them obtainable again. However, it’s not where you store them but may become a system where you’ll need to purchase from an NPC for a cheap price.

    Quote:
    Q. We’d like for you to look over the rewards from the Mog Tablet quests. Also, do the mog tablets appear at the same timing for each area?
    A. We looked into this a while back, but we haven’t proactively looked into it recently. The reason behind this is because we worry that it may cause illicit activity from those going after the rewards. We understand that there’s a difference in the value of the items you can receive; however, we’re also thinking that it may make more sense to adjust the Super Kupower that has an effect on a greater number of players. We’d like some more time to think about how to adjust this. We’d like to hear your comments on this as well.

    As for the timing in which the mog tablets appear. They pretty much appear at the same time in each of the areas. In a recent update, you can use the Widescan to confirm it as well.

    Quote:
    Q. I’d like to see new fishing quests. For example, go catch x amount of a specific fish.
    A. If we’re going to add something new, we’d like to make it a quest that’ll excite the fishers out there. I think just making it a simple go catch tons of fish would just be tiring.

    Quote:
    Q. I’d like to see more fishes for Inside the Belly.
    A. Once we decide on what we’d like to use for the reward, we’ll do this!

    Quote:
    Q. Ambuscade is congested and I’m having a hard time doing the content due to queue. I would like for something to be done.
    A. We’re currently experimenting to half the wait time by adding another entrance area for the Ambuscade. As to why this is being delayed, we have few areas remaining that can be used. We were concerned if it's wise to use these areas that could be utilized for new content, such as Omen. However, looking at the current situation, we felt it is necessary and have started experimenting. It seems effective, but we’d require some more time until we can implement it. We ask for your patience.

We’ve mentioned the next Freshly Picked broadcast will be July, but it may be in August. As usual, we’ll announce the broadcast schedule on the official website, so please be on a lookout for it.

Until next time, see you!

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 46 Digest
body:
Hi, there!

To coincide with the August version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui hosted another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning into Freshly Picked Vana'diel 46.

Once again, we had our broadcast before the version update. We focused on the August version update details, as well as other information.

We've put together a digest and an archived video for those of you who were unable to join us for the broadcast, or simply want a recap of all the information.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GS96h0d3n5w" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/55810#mogivana_01" class="brlink">Freshly Picked Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/55810#mogivana_02" class="brlink">Fujito's /shout</a>

<div id="mogivana_01"></div>
  • Freshly Picked Version Update
    0:02:19
    This segment of the show focused on the major aspects of the August version update.
    • Red Mage Job Adjustment
      0:03:25
      For the adjustment details, please check the version update information. Here we'll go over the reasoning and policy behind the adjustments.

      Converted Merit Point Group 2 Spells into Scrolls
      As mentioned previously, we are gradually converting spells that were learned through merit points into magic scrolls.

      With this change, Merit Point Group 2 has been redesigned to focus on emphasizing red mage's main characteristics. We've made the default values of these spells equivalent to investing 5 merit points. We've also changed augment effects according to the new category.

      We'll be gradually addressing other jobs as well, so please look forward to it.

    • Puppetmaster Job Adjustment
      0:06:27
      Again, please refer to the version update for the adjustment details. Here we'll go over the reasoning behind the adjustments.

      Changed Maneuver-Consuming Attachment into Burden-Reducing Type
      We received positive feedback regarding Burden-reducing attachments, and so we’ll be changing a number of Maneuver-consuming attachments into Burden-reducing attachments.

      However, Schurzen would be too powerful as a Burden-reducing type, so it will remain a Maneuver-consuming type. Likewise, Condenser has an effect to prevent Overload from Burden, and will also remain a Maneuver-consuming type.

      Additionally, Overload chance is now displayed when using a Maneuver. We understand that players would like to see the actual Burden value rather than a percent chance. However, Overload chance is determined after equations have been applied to the Burden value, so we believe it would actually be more informative to display a percentage.

      Please try it out in-game and let us know your feedback.

    • High-Tier Battlefield
      0:10:25
      A High-Tier Battlefield featuring Alexander has been added.

      This version of Alexander features many mechanics that are completely different from previous iterations, and will change accordingly handle the situation. It may be difficult to decipher its mechanics at first, but you'll be able to come up with a battle plan once you figure them out.

      During the broadcast, we showed off the body equipment and shield which are available as rewards.
      The other equipment pieces are available as well, so we hope you’ll give the battle a try!

      As a side note, the name “Sacro” means “holy”.

    • Ambuscade
      0:15:11
      This month's foes are poroggo and mandragora.

      The new Vengeful Citrullus is a mandragora with a watermelon-like appearance. In the broadcast we showed off the rewards you can obtain, as well as some gameplay footage of Director Fujito trying out the battle.

      The August version update also added more instances for Ambuscade in an effort to lower queue times. Though we were very careful during the testing phase, there are certain factors that can't be confirmed until they are publicly released. We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the issues that arose immediately after release.

<div id="mogivana_02"></div>

    Once the Sunbreeze Festival begins, new items will be sold at the Morbol Café in Lower Jeuno as part of the Green Festival, so be sure to take a peek!

title: Freshly Picked Vana'diel 48 Digest
body:
Hi, there!

To coincide with the November version update, Producer Akihiko Matsui hosted another Freshly Picked Vana'diel to go over some of the new content and discuss other topics pertinent to adventuring. The following is a digest of what was discussed.

Quote:
Originally Posted by Akihiko_Matsui
Hello, everyone. Matsui here.

Thank you for tuning in to Freshly Picked Vana’diel 48.
In this broadcast, we focused on the November version update details, as well as other information.

We’ve put together a digest and an archived video for those of you who were unable to join us for the broadcast, or simply want a recap on all of the information.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/qKyJKTF9CYI" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Table of Contents
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/XXXXX#mogivana_01" class="brlink">Version Update</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/XXXXX#mogivana_02" class="brlink">Fujito’s /shout</a>

<div id="mogivana_01"></div>
  • Version Update
    This segment of the show focused on the major aspects of the November version update.
    • Battle Content: Ambuscade
      (0:05:09)
      In November, Volume 1 will see the return of the Mamool Ja, and Volume 2 will feature Sea Monks.

      Only one monster will appear in Volume 2.
      The key is to watch for the effects of a certain ability and using physical or magical attacks, whichever is more effective! Rewards include a great sword lockstyle item, which was shown off in the video.

    • Beastmaster Job Adjustment
      (0:07:33)
      The Lucani and the Citrullus are now available as pets.

      The Lucani are thief-type pets, and they have relatively high evasion. During the night, they will glow like fireflies! The item required for summoning them can be obtained through synthesis or synergy.

      The Citrullus are monk-type pets. The item required to summon them can be purchased from vendors, so you’ll be able to obtain them quite easily. It shares the same Ready ability as Lycopodium.

    • Scholar Job Adjustment
      (0:10:06)
      The maximum total MP accumulated by the ability Sublimation has been increased to 50% of maximum HP.
      The duration of the black magic spell Klimaform has been increased to 300 seconds to reduce busyness.

    • Battle Content: Dynamis ~Divergence~
      (0:11:04)
      Statues received graphical changes to improve the visibility of certain mechanics. We also wanted to address player concerns about variations in color perception, so we came up with a way to address both.

      Take a look at the video to see some gameplay footage of the changes!

<div id="mogivana_02"></div>
  • Fujito’s /shout
    (0:15:10)
    → Return Home to Vana’diel Campaign / Discount Campaign
    If you’re considering returning to Vana’diel, take advantage of these campaigns and continue your adventures!

    → The Fall Alter Ego Extravaganza
    If you’re missing any of the following Alter Egos, be sure to check it out!
    • Makki-Chebukki
    • King of Hearts
    • Morimar
    • Sakura
    • Ovjang
    • Mnejing
    • Cid
    • Rahal
    • Koru-Moru
    • Qultada
    • Adelheid
    • Amchuchu

    → Autumn Double the Fun Campaign (Part One / Part Two)
    The campaign consists of two parts, and include campaigns that help you earn job points, the highly requested Dark Matter Arcane Glyptics Campaign, and more!

    → Adventurer Gratitude Campaign
    Once per week, you’ll receive rewards for logging in!
    There are four weeks’ worth of rewards. If you already own them, you’ll be able to receive Mog Pells and other items instead.

    → I Dream of Mog Bonanza 2020
    In the video we showed off Grudge, the new 4th place reward, so check it out!

    → Vana’diel’s MonSTAR Screenshot Campaign
    Submit an exceptional screenshot of your favorite monSTAR!
    Winners will receive the new Byakko Masque item!

    → November 2019 Login Campaign
    The ♪Dhalmel mount will be available for exchanging!

    → A Challenge from Lion
    (0:21:51)
    We created a special event for the 11th month of the year!
    The trigger item required to participate in the ongoing A Challenge from Lion: Part 1 is obtainable from the November 2019 Login Campaign. Overcome this challenge to obtain Lion’s Norgish Dagger, a fashionable item to add to your lockstyle collection!

    Part 2 will be available starting from Tuesday, November 19.
    The trigger item for Part 2 will also be available from the Login Campaign exchange.
    In Part 2, Lion returns with two additional allies, and the reward will be the synthesis materials for the reward from Part 1. Synthesizing this will grant the dagger with the appearance of the weapon wielded by the Lion II Trust!

    There will also be Record of Eminence objectives related to this battle.
    Complete them to earn rewards such as the Mandragora Pouch and the Moogle Sacoche!

We’ll let you know when we decide when the next Freshly Picked Vana’diel will be. We hope to bring you lots of fresh content next time as well, so please look forward to it!

Until then, see you!

title: December 10, 2019 (JST) Version Update
body:
• <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/56243?p=622466#post622466">Event-related</a>
  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/56243?p=622467#post622467">Battle-related</a>

  • <a href="http://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/56243?p=622470#post622470">Known Issues</a>

Event-related

  • Records of Eminence have undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The Monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been changed.

Battle-related

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes in Normal and Intense Ambuscades have been swapped out.
      * As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.
      Attachment 12594
    • Certain items obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain items obtainable for total hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain items obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been swapped out.

  • Domain Invasion has undergone sweeping changes.
    Domain Invasion is cooperative battle content in which adventurers work to defeat monsters in Escha – Zi’Tah, Escha – Ru’Aun and Reisenjima.
    The Domain Invasion adjustments greatly change the battle structure and rewards.
    • Requirements for participation
      • Be level 99.
    • Enjoying the Content
      1. Receive an elvorseal by speaking with a particular NPC* before the monsters have appeared** or while they are active.
        Next, select “Teleport to the target monster” to be transported to the area where Domain Invasion is taking place.
        * Affi in Escha – Zi’Tah (F-10), Dremi in Escha – Ru’Aun (H-11), and Shiftrix in Reisenjima (F-12).
        ** Players who are members of a Unity will receive messages related to where and when monsters will spawn.

      2. A battle against various smaller monsters will unfold in the Domain Invasion area, and wiping them out will cause a notorious monster to spawn.
        Defeat the notorious monster to receive rewards.
        * Monster tagging is not active during a Domain Invasion, meaning that players can work together even if they are not in the same party.
        * There is no time limit for battles against either the smaller monsters or the notorious monsters.
        * Alter egos may be called forth in battle.
        * The notorious monster names are the same as before, but their attributes, skills, and attack patterns have changed.

      3. Once a notorious monster has been defeated, another Domain Invasion will commence in a different area after a certain amount of time has passed. The Domain Invasion rotation is Escha - Zi’Tah > Escha – Ru’Aun > Reisenjima > Escha Zi’Tah, repeating indefinitely.
        * Updated December 10, at 5:00 p.m. (PST) / 11 December, at 1:00 a.m. (GMT)
    • Rewards
      All players participating in an Domain Invasion will receive Domain Points once the notorious monster has been vanquished. Domain points may be exchanged for rewards by speaking with Zurim in Norg (I-7).
      * Escha silt and beads will continue to be earned as before.
      * Spoils will no longer be awarded directly upon defeating the notorious monsters.
      • Acquiring Domain Points
        Players will receive a baseline of 10 domain points, which are then modified by certain factors.
        * The below bonuses stack.
        • Bonuses for number of participants
          <table width="200" border="0"><tr><td width="50%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">No. of Participants</td><td width="50%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Bonus</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">1</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">1.0x</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">2</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">1.2x</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">3</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">1.4x</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">4</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">1.6x</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">5</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">1.8x</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">6</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">2.0x</td></tr></table>
        • Bonuses for battle contribution
          <table width="400" border="0"><tr><td width="70%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Condition</td><td width="30%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Bonus</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Delivering the final blow to the last monster</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">2.0x</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Delivering the final blow to the notorious monster</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">2.0x</td></tr></table>
      • Domain Point Limit
        Up to 80 domain points may be earned per day (Earth time).
    • Special Buffs
      Certain special buffs will activate based on how a Domain Invasion battle plays out.
      • • The player who delivers the final blow will receive the Awakening buff.
        Awakening adds the following buffs:
        Regen / Refresh / Regain / Increased damage dealt / Decreased damage taken
      • If the affected character is knocked out, they will be automatically revived once a certain amount of time has passed.
        * A character revived in this way will not suffer any experience loss.
    • Domain Effects
      A perpetual Domain effect will be applied to each area based on the total number of times a notorious monster has been slain in that area. This affect applies to all characters in the area.
      * The running tally of notorious monsters slain will be calculated for each world, and the counter will begin to increment once the version update has gone live.
      * This counter will not reset during server maintenances.
    • Unity Chat Notifications
      Players belonging to a Unity will receive Domain Invasion-related chat messages featuring the following information:
      10 minutes until smaller monsters spawn / smaller monster spawn notification / notorious monster spawn notification / notorious monster defeat notification / notorious monster tally

  • The following jobs have undergone adjustments.
    • Paladin
      Attachment 12593
      • A new ability has been added
        <table width="800" border="0"><tr><td width="20%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Ability</td><td width="10%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Lv. Acquired</td><td width="10%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Recast Time</td><td width="10%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Duration</td><td width="50%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Effect</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#c6e9ef" align="center">Majesty</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">70</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">60s</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">180s</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="left">Increases potency of Cure / Cure II / Cure III / Cure IV, and decreases the spells’ recast time. Additionally, Cure / Cure II / Cure III / Cure IV will heal party members in range of target.</td></tr></table>
      • The following spell may is now learnable by paladins.
        Banishga (Lv. 30)
    • The maximum damage of scythes has been increased.
      Attachment 12592

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • New synthesis recipes have been added.
  • Monsters in the Labyrinth of Onzozo now have an increased chance to drop quake grenades.
  • Abdhaljs seals and Abdhaljs tomes can no longer be re-used if their effects are already active.
  • A new method to obtain the Delkfutt key key item has been added.
    The key can now also be obtained by interacting with the ??? that appears shortly after vanquishing Porphyrion in Upper Delkfutt’s Tower.
  • Additional items are now storable via the Porter Moogle.
    • Storage Slip 22
    Esikuva / Norgish Dagger / Mandragora Pouch / Moogle Sacoche / Byakko Masque

Resolved Issues

  • The issue with the beastmaster pets Weevil Familiar and Stalwart Angelina wherein skillchain effects would not display in the log when using Disembowel or Extirpating Salvo.
  • The issue with woodworking wherein it was not possible to synthesize cypress lumber with a wind crystal, bundling twine, and three cypress logs.
  • The issue with the Currencies 2 menu wherein the entry for “Earth Crystals Set” was erroneously labeled as “Wind Crystals Set.”
  • The issue with Unity Concord NPCs wherein selecting “Bring me to a Wanted encounter area” would occasionally display improper destination names.
  • The issue with the Poroggo ability Frog Chorus wherein PC and alter ego targets would become transparent under certain circumstances.
  • The issue wherein the malignance gloves would have an incorrect graphic under certain conditions when equipped by a Galka.

Known Issues

  • When attempting to enter a battlefield from the Stellar Fulcrum while in a party, you may enter a different battlefield under certain circumstances.

Event-related

  • A new alter ego has been added.
    A cipher of Monberaux’s alter ego may be obtained in exchange for deeds of heroism.
Attachment 12653
  • Records of Eminence has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.
    • A new category for Odyssey has been added.

Battle-related

  • New battle content, Odyssey, has been added.
    Odyssey is exploratory battle content in which players progress through an area of Walk of Echoes known as a Sheol.
    Materials you acquire in Sheol A can be used to augment equipment described later.
    Attachment 12654
    • Requirement for Participation
      • Be in possession of a moglophone key item.
    • Enjoying the Content
      1. Examine the ??? in Rabao (G-6) to receive a moglophone.
      * You may receive another moglophone by interacting with the ??? again once twenty hours have passed.

      2. While in possession of a moglophone key item, examine the Veridical Conflux in Rabao (G-6) and select “Sheol A (Level: 119).”
      * Your moglophone will be consumed upon entry.
      • Parties must be between 1 and 6 people.
      • There is a time limit of 30 minutes.
    • Izzat
      Players will earn izzat, a special currency unique to Odyssey, as they vanquish monsters within.
      Izzat may be used to open the various chests and coffers found scattered throughout.
      * Izzat is shared amongst all party members and will be lost once your current Odyssey has ended.
    • Leaving Odyssey
      • Interact with the NPC found at the Sheol A exit.
      • Reach the time limit.
      • Use the moglophone temporary item.
        *The moglophone temporary item will be automatically granted to all players upon entering Odyssey.
  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes in Normal and Intense Ambuscades have been swapped out.
      * As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.
      Attachment 12655
    • Certain items obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain items obtainable for total hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain items obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been swapped out.
  • Domain Invasion has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • Mireu’s spawn interval has been increased.
    • The content level now displays once Mireu spawns.
    • A domain point bonus is now given upon defeating Mireu.
      *This bonus is separate from the daily maximum.
    • The base number of domain points Mireu awards has been increased based on the number of successive times that Mireu has been defeated.
    <table width="500" border="0"><tr><td width="20%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Number of Successive Kills</td><td width="50%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Base Domain Points</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">0</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb">　10</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">1</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">　15</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">2</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb">　20</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">3</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">　30</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">4</td><td bgcolor="#f5fafb">　40</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">5+</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">　50<br>　Domain point limit increased to 100.</td></tr></table>
    • Mireu’s evasion and magic evasion have been greatly decreased.
    • Players will receive a status buff called “mobilization” when they participate in Domain Invasion.
    Players will not take any damage while this buff is active, but it will be removed when they take any enmity-generating action towards monsters.
    * The buff will not be removed if actions that do not generate enmity are taken.
    * Players will not receive any rewards while the buff is active.
    • An accuracy and magic accuracy bonus has been added to the “Awaken” buff.

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • A new synergy recipe has been added.

  • The following equipment may now be augmented.
    These augments can be received from Unity Concord NPCs in various nations by completing Records of Eminence objectives.
    Emeici +1 / Buramgh +1/ Tancho +1 / Kunimune +1 / Pouwhenua +1 / Mengado +1 / Wing Cutter +1 / Refined Grip +1 /
    Gelatinous Ring +1 / Imperail Wing Hairpin +1 / Rosette Jaseran +1 / Lugra Cloak +1 / Agony Jerkin +1 / Zoar Subligar +1 /
    Hippomenes Socks +1 / Unmoving Collar +1 / Apeile Ring +1 / Metamorph Ring +1 / Evalach +1 / Macabre Gauntlets +1 /

    Sailfi Belt +1 / Acuity Belt +1 / Lugra Earring +1 / Nourishing Earring +1 / Arete del Luna +1 / Handler’s Earring +1
  • Some augment descriptions have been adjusted.
    The way base attribute (STR/DEX/VIT/AGI/INT/MND/CHR) increases are displayed for attributes whose values are the same have been changed as given below.
    <table width="650" border="0"><tr><td width="70%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Pre-adjustment (example)</td><td width="50%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Post-adjustment (example)</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">　STR+1 DEX+1 VIT+1</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">　STR/DEX/VIT+1</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">　STR+15 DEX+15 VIT+15 AGI+15 INT+15 MND+15 CHR+15</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3">　All Attr.+15</td></tr></table>

    • Storage Slip 22
      Mutsunokami / Mutsunokami +1

System-related

  • Adjustments have been made to high-tier battlefields occurring in Walk of Echoes [P] in order to decrease waiting time.
    Depending on instance congestion, players may be placed in either Walk of Echoes [P1] or Walk of Echoes [P2].
    * Which instance players will enter is automatically decided upon time of application.
    * The exact order of party entry may vary based on instance status.
    * The instance area name has no effect on the content itself.

  • The issue wherein the regain effect granted by the job ability Companion’s Roll would be incorrect under certain circumstances.
  • The issue with Ambuscade wherein the screen would go black and players would be booted to Mhaura after entering the instance under certain conditions.

Event-related

  • Records of Eminence has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The monthly objectives have been swapped out.
    • A new category has been added for Odyssey.

Battle-related

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes in Normal and Intense Ambuscades have been swapped out.
      * As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.
      Attachment 12723
    • Certain items obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain items obtainable for total hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain items obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been swapped out.
  • Sheol B has been added to Odyssey.
    In Sheol B, players are able to receive materials different to those in Sheol A. These materials can be used to augment equipment described later.
    Attachment 12722
    • Conditions for Entry
      • Be in possession of a moglophone key item.
      • Have completed the Records of Eminence objective Sheol A.
    • Enjoying Odyssey

      1.Examine the ??? in Rabao (G-6) and obtain a moglophone.
      * Players will be able to obtain another moglophone by examining the ??? once 20 hours have passed since obtaining the previous one.

      2.While in possession of the molophone key item, examine the veridical conflux in Rabao (G-8) and select “Sheol B (C. Lvl. 124)”.
      * The moglophone will be consumed upon entry.
      • Player limit: 1-6 person party
      • Odyssey duration: 30 minutes
    • Leaving Odyssey
      • Examine the otherworldly vortex at the end of Sheol B.
      • Reach the time limit.
      • Have 3 minutes pass since being fully defeated.
      • Use the moglophone temporary item.
        * Players will be awarded a moglophone temporary item upon entering the battlefield.
  • Alluvion Skirmishes have undergone and following additions and adjustments.
    • The maximum HP of certain monsters and objects has been decreased.
    • The maximum HP of certain objects has been increased.
    • The amount of capacity points earned from certain monsters has been increased.
    • Alluvion Skirmishes in Yorcia Weald (U) has undergone the following adjustments.
      • Players will be awarded 1,000 puissance upon beginning each stage.
      • The amount of puissance required to summon certain friendly monsters has been decreased.
      • The amount of puissance required to level up certain friendly monsters has been decreased.
    • New ways to receive the following Eudaemon swords, Eudaemon shields, Eudaemon sashes, Eudaemon capes, and Eudaemon rings have been added.
      These items may now be obtained from colonization, lair, and wildskeeper reives.
      * As such, the vendor prices for these items have been decreased to one-tenth of their previous value.
    • The chance of acquiring transmelange has been increased.
    • The odds of receiving higher amounts of higher-quality versions of the following items have been increased.
      Ghastly Stones / Verdigris Stones / Wailing Stones / Snoworb Stones / Leaforb Stones / Duskorb Stones / Snowtip Stones / Leaftip Stones / Dusktip Stones /
      Snowdim Stones / Leafdim Stones / Duskdim Stones / Snowslit Stones / Leafslit Stones / Dukslit Stones

      • In addition to its previous effects, the magic spell Reprisal now also increases Shield skill.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue with Odyssey wherein several log messages would not display properly when receiving rewards after examining the otherworldly vortex.

Known Issues

  • Certain augments with “Haste+%” and “Slow+%” do not display the percentage sign.
    * This is a display error only. The effects of these augments are functioning properly.

Camaraderie Shield / Huactzin Shield / Coalition Shield

body:
