Event-related

  • A new entry has been added to The Voracious Resurgence.
Attachment 12756<br>
Receive the quest by speaking with Gumbah in Bastok Mines (J-7) after having completed the quest The Brygid Cup.
  • Records of Eminence has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
  • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.
  • A new entry has been added to the Content: Odyssey category.
  • A new designation has been added.

Battle-related

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
  • The foes in Normal and Intense Ambuscades have been swapped out.
    * As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.
Attachment 12757
  • Certain items obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been swapped out.
  • Certain items obtainable for total hallmarks have been swapped out.
  • Certain items obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been swapped out.
  • Sheol C has been added to Odyssey.
    Sheol C provides materials different to those found in Sheols A and B. These materials may be used to augment equipment as described below.
Attachment 12758
  • Requirements
    • Be in possession of the moglophone key item.
    • Have completed the Records of Eminence objective Sheol B.
  • Enjoying the content.
    1. Examine the ??? in Rabao (G-6) and receive a moglophone key item.
    * A new moglophone may be obtained 20 hours later by reexamining the ???.

    2. While in possession of a moglophone key item, examine the Veridical Conflux in Rabao (G-6) and select “Sheol C: Lv. 129+”.)
    * Your moglophone will be consumed upon entry.
    • 1 to 6 Person Party
    • The time limit is 30 minutes.
  • Leaving Odyssey
    • Examine the Otherworldly Vortex in Sheol C.
    • Reach the time limit.
    • Have 3 minutes pass after having been wiped out.
    • Use the moglophone temporary item.
      * Players will automatically receive a moglophone temporary item upon entering Odyssey.

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • The following items may now be augmented.
Comeuppance +1 / Tanmogayi +1 / Flyssa +1 / Combuster +1 / Septoptic +1 / Malison +1 / Montante +1 / Nullis +1 / Habilitator +1 / Comtemplator +1 / Antitail +1 / Loess Barbuta +1 / Obviation Cuirass +1 / Tatenashi Haramaki +1 / Tatenashi Haidate +1 / Tatenashi Sune-Ate +1 / Loricate Torque +1 / Vim Torque +1 / Forfend +1 / Tatenashi Gote +1 /Dominance Earring +1
* These augments may be obtained by completing a specific Records of Eminence objective and speaking with the Unity Concord NPCs in our of the three nations.

Event-related

Battle-related

      Attachment 13084

    • Certain items obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been swapped out.

  • A new area, Sheol: Gaol has been added to Odyssey.
    Attachment 13085
    In the Gaol, players will battle fierce monsters to earn currency that can be used to augment equipment.
    • Requirements for Participation
      • Have completed the Records of Eminence objective Sheol C.
      • Be in a party whose members all have three or more jobs at level 99 and all participating players have non-duplicate jobs.
      • Be in possession of a Moglophone II key item.

    • Obtaining a Moglophone II
      • Speak with the ??? in Rabao (G-6) (First time only).
      • Purchase one from the ??? in Rabao (G-6) in exchange for 3000 mog segments.

    • Staging Grounds
      • Players may use the staging grounds for a total of 15 minutes.
      • If this time expires, players will be removed from Odyssey.
      • Alter egos may not be called forth.
      • Speak to the Pilgrimage Moogle to change jobs and retrieve equipment from storage.
      • The Pilgrimage Moogle cannot increase mog locker storage time, so make sure everything is all squared away at your Mog House first.

    • How to Participate

      1.Interact with the veridical conflux in Rabao (G-6) while in possession of three moglophone II key items and select “Sheol: Gaol (Level 124+)” to head to the staging grounds.
      • Parties may have up to six players.

      2.Once your preparations are complete, examine the verifical conflux in the staging grounds and select a monster to engage in combat to proceed.

      　* One moglophone II will be consumed when you enter the select monster’s area.
      • Each battle has a time limit of 15 minutes.
      • Players cannot attempt a boss if there are any duplicate jobs among the party’s members.
      • Once alter egos are called forth, they are removed from the list and cannot be called again until you leave Sheol: Gaol.

      3.Players will be transported back to the staging grounds once the battle is complete.
      To attempt another boss, players must once again examine the veridical conflux in the staging grounds and select a new boss.

      　* This will once again consume one moglophone II.
      • The staging grounds countdown will commence where it left off when you attempted the previous boss.
      • Jobs previously used by you and your party members will be locked for the remainder of your stay in Sheol: Gaol.

    • How to Leave
      • Use the moglophone II temporary item received upon entering Sheol: Gaol.
      • Have emerged victorious from battle three times, thereby consuming three moglophone II key items.
      • Have time expire from using the moglophones during boss battles.
      • Have three minutes pass after being wiped out in a boss area.
      • Have the staging grounds time expire.

    • Spoils
      • Bosses do not drop items or equipment.
      • Special records are obtained the first time you defeat a particular monster, enabling you to purchase its specific rewards.
      • These items can be purchased from the ??? in Rabao (G-6).

    • Prices
      • Equipment prices fluctuate based on the amount of times a given monster has been vanquished on your server.
      • A modifier is applied based on difficulty level and number of party members.

    • Augments
      Purchased equipment can be augmented using RP earned from the applicable boss monster.

    • Augmenting Equipment
      1. Purchase a piece of equipment
      2. Augmenting equipment earned from defeating monster A is done by defeating monster A.
      3. You must defeat the monster on a level equal to or greater than that of your equipment’s current augment level.
      4. RP can be earned from defeating a boss or reducing its HP.
      5. Use RP by interacting with the ??? in Rabao (G-6) and trading your desired piece of equipment.
      * Excess RP can be converted into segments.

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • New items can be stored via the Porter Moogle.
    • Storage Slip 22
      Adenium Masque / Adenium Suit

System-related

  • Assist Channel functionality has been expanded.
    • Mentor searches accessible via the Help Desk section of the main menu now search across all areas rather than a small subset.
    • After completing the Records of Eminence objective Assist Channel, new players and returnees, who have a limit on how long they can use the Assist Channel, can view when their chat rights expire.
      * New players and returnees are able to chat in the Assist Channel for 48 hours of time spent logged in, calculated from the moment they obtain the ability to use the channel.
  • Assist Channel Tutorial NPC.

    A.M.A.N. Liaisons will provide players with an explanation on the Assist Channel once they have accepted the Records of Eminence objective Assist Channel.
    Attachment 13086
    • Areas with A.M.A.N. Liaisons

  • An item restoration NPC has been implemented.

    This NPC will restore certain items that have corrupted data.
    • Applicable item:
      Triska Scythe +1
    • Restoring your item
      • Speak with the Repairer Moogle and trade your Triska Scytche +1 to see if its data has been corrupted.
      • If the data is corrupted, the NPC will fix it and return your item to you.
    • Areas with Repairer Moogles
      Southern San d’Oria (G-10) / Bastok Markets (E-11) / Windurst Woods (J-10) / Western Adoulin (H-11)

Resolved Issues

  • The issue wherein the sort function for the following items were incorrect.
    Konjak Tuber / Konjak / Daikon / Chikuwa

    Oden / Oden +1

[English Version Only]

Known Issues

  • The help text for the neo animator is incorrect.
    *The help text does not display an increase to ranged accuracy, but ranged accuracy is correctly increased.

[English Version Only]

title: January 2021 Version Update - Additional Information
body:
Greetings and salutations adventurers!

Due to the most recent emergency lockdown issued in Japan, the January Freshly Picked Vana'diel Digest unfortunately had to be canceled.

However Matsui has made a post on the Japanese side of the forums sharing the contents they had planned to share during the livestream and we've gotten the go ahead to translate and share some of that information with you!

(Please send your warm regards to Zhexos, he worked very hard to get this out to you all! :)

====

Odyssey

In January and February, we're planning to implement new Sheol content, where players will be able to upgrade their gear using points earned by defeating Notorious Monsters under certain conditions.
Up to six players can participate, and time limit is set to 15 minutes per Notorious Monster. You can fight up to 3 Notorious Monsters with each attempt.

Participation Requirements:
  • Complete the Records of Eminence Objective: Content - Odyssey - Sheol C
  • Have 3 Mogolophone II (*Item name may be subject to change.)
  • Have 3 jobs at level 99

Overview

Rabao
After entering the instance from Rabao, you can trade the Moglophone II to the Pilgrim Moogle.


Preparation Area
In the preparation area, you'll be able to change jobs, as well as access the Mog Safe, Mog Satchel, Storage, and Wardrobes.
However, you won’t be able to access the Delivery Box.


Boss Area
You can call out your Alter Egos in the boss area.
Defeating the Notorious Monsters will send you back to the preparation area.


Rules
When participating as a party, on top of the requirement of having 3 jobs at level 99, party members cannot select the same job at the same time.


New Notorious Monsters
Attachment 13074Attachment 13076Attachment 13075


Rewards
Here's an example of some of the rewards. Once you upgrade it all the way, the following augments will be attached:
Attachment 13078

Quote:
N. Stringer
Acc+10 Weapon Skill Damage +5%
Automaton: Lv119 DMG+10
Lv99 - PUP
[1] Automaton: Acc+20 Magic Acc+20
[2] Automaton: HP+20


Opshitena sash
MND+5
Enfeeblement magic duration+5%
LV99 WHM, RDM, BRD, SCH
[1] Magic Accuracy+15
[2] Enfeeblement Magic Skill+5
Obtaining Gear
  1. Defeat the Notorious Monster to obtain a key item.
  2. Purchase the item associated with the key item from the Pilgrim Moogle.
    (There aren't any Notorious Monster drops.)

Upgrading Gear
  1. Purchase the gear item.
  2. Earn reinforcement points (RP) by defeating the Notorious Monster at Veng +1 difficulty or higher.
  3. Trade the gear item with the Pilgrim Moogle.
The amount of RP earned will vary depending on the difficulty level, and is calculated based on the amount of HP the enemy has remaining.
Although you’ll still receive RP even if you run out of time, you’ll earn more if you manage to successfully defeat the Notorious Monster.


Future Updates
We're planning to add new Notorious Monsters and gear starting February. Please look forward to it!


Ambuscade
In February, we're planning to introduce a new Iron Giant with a new design. We're currently working hard to get this implemented, as well as some nice gear for lockstyling.
Attachment 13077


The Voracious Resurgence
We're planning to resume the Voracious Resurgence scenario in February, and this time the story will begin in San d'Oria.
Are my eyes playing tricks, or is that Rahal… dancing? We hope you’ll look forward to it!
Attachment 13079

A Note on the Triska Scythe +1
NPCs will be placed in various nations in order to address the Triska Scythe +1 data issue.
If you have one that can't be delivered, please trade the item with these NPCs to have the data corrected.


Reminders

January 2021 Login Campaign Items
Two new outfit items will be added for this month!
  • Adenium Masque
  • Adenium Suit
The new masque and suit will each be available for 500 points each, so be sure to save your points and exchange them!
(*Please note that there isn’t a HQ item this time around. Players will only need to exchange for one of the items.)


FINAL FANTASY XI BRING ARTS figures are still available for pre-order!
You can reserve either Shantotto & Chocobo or just the Chocobo at their respective links below:
Shantotto & Chocobo
Chocobo

====
That's all for today, but the January Digest will still be coming out this month and will be going over some of this information, as well as additional info on the Assist Channel!

Thank you all for your continued support!

body:

Event-related

  • A new chapter has been added to The Voracious Resurgence.
    Attachment 13273
    Players should speak with Reikuu in Reisenjima (K-8) after having completed the quest The Sea Sage to accept the latest quest.
  • The Quest Inside the Belly has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • Additional fish are now valid turn-ins for the quest.
    • Additional rewards have been added.
    • The chance to receive an item will now increase when a bigger fish is traded.
  • The quest Apocalypse Nigh now has a wait time of one Vana’diel day before the player is able to progress.
  • The ability to start the process for reforging item level 119 relic equipment to +3 has been unlocked.
    • Players will be able to begin the process by defeating a certain number of Squadron enemies in Dynamis – Divergence.
  • The ability to start the process for reforging item level 119 artifacts to +3 has been unlocked.
    • Players will be able to begin the process by defeating a certain number of Sweetwater or Transcended enemies in Omen.
  • The Anniversary Event Mandragora Mania has been added.
    • Players can enjoy the minigame by speaking with the Mandragora Assistant in the following areas.
      Southern San d’Oria (K-10) / Bastok Mines (I-9) / Windurst Walls (C-12)
      Ru’Lude Gardens (G-9) / Rabao (G-6) / Mhaura (G-9)
      Eastern Adoulin (H-10) / Chocobo Circuit (H-9) / Mog Gardens
    • Jingly and Rewards
      • Players will earn a special currency known as jingly through the course of playing the game.
      • Jingly will be reset every month.
      • Players will be able to receive rewards by reaching certain jingly thresholds.
      • Rewards may be reset once in the following month by paying 10,000 gil to the appropriate NPC.
        * Players will be able to enjoy the minigame even if they do not reset the rewards.
  • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.
  • A new designation has been added.

Battle-related

  • A new system, Master Levels, has been added.
    • What are master levels?
      Master levels are a new job advancement system for those jobs for which a player has achieved job master status.
      Increasing one’s master level will increase both basic attributes and the maximum level of one’s support job.
    • Unlocking the Master Levels feature.
      Players must speak with the Nomad Moogle in Ru’Lude Gardens (H-5) after meeting the following conditions in order to receive the Master Breaker key item.
      • Be level 99 in your current job.
      • Have achieved job master status in your current job.
    • Gaining master levels.
      Players will earn exemplar point by defeating enemies while the following conditions are true.
      • Be in possession of the Master Breaker key item.
      • Be level 99 in your current job.
      • Have achieved job master status in your current job.
      • Defeat enemies whose strength as displayed with /check is Easy Prey or higher.
    • Increasing Your Master Level
      Your master level starts at 0.
      Your master level will increase when you accumulate a certain number of experience points, and you will receive the following benefits.
      • For every mastery level you earn, you and your pet’s basic attributes and combat/magic skill caps will be increased.
      • For every five mastery levels your earn, your support job level cap will be increased by 1.
    • Notes
      • Enemy strength as displayed by /check only serves as a rough guide as to whether or not you will earn exemplar points for defeating a foe. Note that enemies who /check as “Too Weak” may still yield experience and limit points.
        * The monsters to which the above applies will be marked as “Very Easy Prey” in the December 2021 version update.
      • “Style-change” abilities such as Composure remain unusable even if your support job is level 50 or higher.
      • Exemplar point gains are unaffected by rings and other equipment earned from various campaigns that confer a bonus to experience point gains.
        * Note that corsair roll effects are properly applied.
      • Players will lose a certain amount of exemplar points if they are defeated.
      • Master level can decrease when knocked out if the amount of exemplar points lost would push them below the threshold of the previous level.
      • A certain amount of lost exemplar points will be returned if a player is brought back from the brink by effects such as the white magic spells Raise and Reraise.
  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes in Normal and Intense Ambuscades have been swapped out.
      * As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.
      Attachment 13274
    • The notorious monsters Blazenought and Frostnought in Intense Ambuscades have been adjusted.
    • Certain items obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain items obtainable for total hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain items obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been swapped out.
  • Monster spawn locations have been adjusted in the following areas.
    • Promyvion – Holla / Promyvion – Dem / Promyvion – Mea / Promyvion – Vahzl / Alzadaal Undersea Ruins
  • Alter Egos have undergone the following adjustments.
    • The shields equipped by the following alter egos will now have increased attributes if the person who called them forth has an item level of 100 or higher.
      Kupipi / Curilla / Trion / Mhili Aliapoh / Valaineral / Mnejing
      Lhu Mhakaracca / Rahal / August / Yoran-Oran
    • The shield equipped by AAEV now has increased attributes.
  • The following items were added to loot tables for certain monsters in Omen.
    Fu’s Scale / Kei’s Scale / Kyo’s Scale / Gin’s Scale / Kin’s Scale
    * This entry was added on November 16

Item-related

  • New Items have been added.
  • The following item may be stored via the porter moogle.
  • Storage Slip 23
    Goujian

System-related

  • A new function has been added to the Search feature.
    • Players can now search by master level.
    • Players are able to switch to Master Level view from the search results window.
      • This feature can be activated by pressing the switch active window key/button to toggle between level and master level.

        Attachment 13275
        Players will be able to toggle to master level view on the search results screen if they meet the following prerequisites.
        • Be in possession of the Master Breaker key item.
        • Be of main job level 99.
        • Have achieved the job master status for their current job.
  • New Level Sync functionality has been added.
    • A master level sync feature has been added.
      Players will be able to set a master level sync in addition to the standard level sync if the following conditions are met.
      • Be in possession of the Master Breaker key item.
      • Be of main job level 99.
      • Have achieved the job master status for their current job.
    • Notes
      Exemplar points may or may not be gained if the level sync feature is activated while player(s) who have master levels unlocked are grouped with player(s) who do not have master levels unlocked. Refer to the following chart for details.

      If the party has a player of master level 10, master level 5, and level 98:

  • The issue in which the value for Valaineral’s alter ego’s Refresh attribute was incorrect.
  • The issue in which Valaineral's alter ego would continually spam Uriel Blade under certain conditions.
  • The issue in which Coelestrox would return male dancer-specific gear if the female dancer-specific gear was scheduled to be reforged but the reforging process was canceled.

Item-related

    ???

Resolved Issues

  • The issue with certain Records of Eminence objectives for which the completion objectives include vanquishing foes while level sync to level 98 or lower would progress even if the condition was not met.

  • The issue with the phantom roll Naturalist’s Roll wherein the effect duration increase would not be reflected with the enhancing magic Reprisal.

title: January 11, 2022 (JST) Version Update
body:
• <a href="https://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/59058?p=641480&viewfull=1#post641480">Event-related</a>

Event-related

  • Records of Eminence has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
  • The monthly objectives have been swapped out.
  • New objectives are unlocked once certain conditions have been met.
  • In the process for refuging item level 119 relic equipment +3, players who have at least one job for which they meet the conditions to upgrade the head, hand, leg, and foot gear will be able to examine the enigmatic footprints in the following areas to receive the corresponding job shard key item.
    Southern San d’Oria (K-10) / Bastok Mines (I-9) / Windurst Walls (H-7) / Ru’Lude Gardens (F-9)
    * Examining the enigmatic footprints once will grant you shards for all jobs for which you meet the conditions.
  • The locations of the ??? at which maps can be received for the following areas are now fixed rather than variable.
    Promyvion - Holla (M-8) / Promyvion - Dem (J-9) / Promyvion - Mean (H-4) / Promyvion - Vahzl (D-8)

Battle-related

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes in Normal and Intense Ambuscades have been swapped out.
      * As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.
      Attachment 13306
    • Certain items obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain items obtainable for total hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain items obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been swapped out.
  • The maximum vengeance level of Odyssey’s Sheol: Gaol has been increased to +20.
    Attachment 13307
    • Players will be able to attempt vengeance levels 16 through 20 for any monsters they have vanquished in Atonement 1 at vengeance +15.
    • For Atonements 2 and later, the vengeance level that can be selected depends on defeating the monster at vengeance +15 as well as the results of the previous level’s atonement battle.
  • The maximum augment level for equipment purchasable after vanquishing a monster in Sheol: Gaol has been increased to rank 25.
    * Players must defeat a monster at vengeance +20 in order to augment a piece of equipment to rank 25.
  • Certain monsters added to Alzadaal Undersea Ruins (G-8) in the November 2021 version update have been removed.
  • The amount of various points earned by alliances of 7-11 players by vanquishing certain monsters has been returned to the pre-December 2021 version update values.
    * The change was initially made as an anti-RMT measure, but we are reverting it due to the major impact that it had on the majority of the player base. We will continue to monitor the situation and take further measures as necessary.

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • A new synergy recipe has been added.
    <table width="560" border="0"><tr><td style="border-style:none;" colspan="3" align="center"><<Required Rank: Amateur>></td></tr><tr style="text-align:center;"><th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="25%">Item</th><th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="25%">Required<br />Synthesis Skill</th><th style="background:#a8d0d7;" width="50%">Materials</th></tr><tr style="text-align:left;"><td style="background:#c6e9ef;text-align:center;">Feline Hagoita +1</td><td style="background:#eaf2f3;text-align:center;">—</td><td style="background:#eaf2f3;">Feline Hagoita, Feline Hagoita</td></tr></table>
  • The following items may be stored via the porter moogle.
    • Storage Slip 22
    Feline Hagoita / Feline Hagoita +1
  • The following items may now be stacked to 99, up from 12.
    Kin’s Scale / Gin’s Scale / Kei’s Scale / Kyou’s Scale / Fu’s Scale

System-related

  • A new key item category has been added for job-specific equipment.
  • Compensation is available in apologies for the issue where a temporary item obtainable for escha silt would be lost in the November 2021 version update. Players will be able to receive one primeval brew for a limited time only.
    Players must speak with the relevant NPC after meetings the following conditions to claim their compensation. This process can only be done once.
    • Conditions
      • Be in possession of the scintillating rhapsody key item by the start of maintenance for the January 2022 version update.
      • 45 days or more have passed since character creation as of the time the item is received.
      • Are not already in possession of a primeval brew.
        * Players who already have a primeval brew must use or otherwise dispose of their current primeval brew to claim their compensation.
    • Applicable NPCs
      Shiftrix in Reisenjima (f-12) / Affi in Escha – Zi’Tah (f-10) / Dremi in Escha – Ru’Aun (H-11)
    • Compensation Period
      Until the start of maintenance for the February 2022 version update.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue with certain quest battles accompanying the quest Dance of the Tengu in which NPC healing magic effects would occasionally not activate or display in the log.
  • The issue in the quest Treasures of Aht Urhgan wherein players would be unable to progress or cancel the quest in cases where they possessed a mythic weapon of the same name after obtaining a Serpentking Zahak relief shard or if they accidentally threw away their mythic weapon.
    Players affected by the above issue can resolve it by the following steps.
    • If you possessed a mythic weapon of the same name
      The quest can be cancelled by trading a non-reforged mythic weapon to Abquhbah.
    • If you accidentally discarded a non-reforged mythic weapon
      The quest can be cancelled by trading a different vigil weapon to Abquhbah.
  • The issue in Abyssea wherein players were able to maintain visitant status in excess of the number of traverser stones they possessed.
  • The issue with Intense Ambuscades wherein some of the Bozzetto Incanter’s action logic was incorrect.
  • The issue wherein leaving battlefields would occasionally cause some pets to despawn.
  • The issue with master levels wherein a PC with master level status was partied with a player below level 99 and the level sync was set to the master level player’s level, alter egos would occasionally fail to perform actions on the PC below level 99.
  • The issue with the flashward earring wherein the MP+10 attribute was not described on the item help text.
    * This is a help text issue only. The functionality of the item remains the same.
  • The issue wherein certain graphics for the Qiqirn sack’s icon were incorrect.
  • The issue with the Iron Giant mounts wherein movement sound effects would not properly play under certain conditions.

[English Version Only]
  • Various issues with inconsistent or misleading item help text.

Known Issues

  • The “Augments ‘Conspirator’” effect described on the help text of the following items does not activate properly.
    Raider’s Vest +2 / Skulker’s Vest / Skulker’s Vest +1

body:
• <a href="https://forum.square-enix.com/ffxi/threads/59174?p=642097&viewfull=1#post642097">Event-related</a>

Event-related

  • A new entry has been added to The Voracious Resurgence.
    Attachment 13329
    Players must have completed the quest Dance of the Tengu and speak to Gumbah in Bastok Mines (J-7) to accept the new quest.
  • The monthly records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.
  • A new designation has been added.

Battle-related

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes in Normal and Intense Ambuscades have been swapped out.
      * As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.
      Attachment 13330
    • Certain items obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain items obtainable for total hallmarks have been swapped out.
    • Certain items obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been swapped out.
    • New items obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been added.
  • The Master Level cap has been raised to 30.
  • Level adjustments have been abolished in the Quicksand Caves.

Item-related

  • New items have been added
  • The following items may be stored via the Porter Moogle.
    • Storage Slip 3
    ???
    • Storage slip 22
    Besigiled Table
    • Storage slip 23
    Profane Staff
  • In the quest An Imperial Heist, players are no longer able to trade Vigil weapons corresponding to Mythic weapons they have already completed to Abquhbah in Aht Urhgan Whitegate (I-10).

System-related

  • The Primeval Brew compensation period has concluded.
    Eligible players are no longer able to claim their complimentary Primeval Brew, provided in compensation for the bug affecting the temporary item purchasable with Escha silt.
  • New storage systems—Mog Wardrobe 5, 6, 7, and 8—have been added as optional paid services.
    • About Mog Wardrobes
      • Mog Wardrobes are storage systems that allow players to store up to 80 items each.
      • Mog Wardrobes are accessible in all in-game areas.
      • Items may be equipped directly from a Mog Wardrobe.
      • All players are able to access Mog Wardrobes 1 and 2 at no additional charge. Mog Wardrobes 3 through 8 are available as optional paid services.
      • Read on for more information on Mog Wardrobes. [/URL]』。
  • The item list display method has been revamped.
  • Players are now able to access the menu for changing equipment as soon as the inventory data download process is complete.
  • Mog Houses have undergone the following improvements.
    • A new storage button has been added to accompany the storage system additions.
    • All existing storage system menu options have been added under the Storage button.
      Attachment 13331
  • Players are now able to move items directly between storage systems.
    • Players are now able to move items between two different storage systems directly without having to first access their inventory.
      • How to move items directly between storage systems
        • Open up the item list from the Main Menu or Mog House Menu and press the newly added Switch button to display a list of storage systems.
          *Storage systems that you do not have unlocked, are unavailable in your current area, or have already opened will be greyed out.
        • Selecting the storage system you wish to move the item to will open the item list, from which you are able to move your desired items.
        • Shortcuts for storage system switching are available for your conveniences
          Keyboard: Alt + Left or Alt + Right
          Gamepad: Macro Button (Ctrl) + Macro Button (Alt) + Left or Macro button (Ctrl) + Macro Button (Alt) + Right
  • A new storage system, the Recycle Bin, has been added.
    • The Recycle Bin temporarily stores up to ten types of items that you have discarded from your inventory.
      ※Linkshells (other than Linkpearls and Pearlsacks) and temporary items cannot be stored in the Recycle Bin.
    • Press the Recycle Bin button, added in the inventory list options, to access the Recycle Bin.
    • Items may be returned to your inventory from the Recycle Bin.
    • Items in the Recycle Bin may not be sorted.
      • Deleting items from the Recycle Bin
        • If the Recycle Bin ever exceeds ten types of items, the oldest item (the one at the top of the list) will be deleted first.
        • All items will be deleted from the Recycle Bin when you change areas, log out, or are disconnected.
        • Deleted items may not be moved back to your inventory.
  • The maximum limit of the macro book has been raised to 40.
  • The maximum number of equipment sets has been raised to 200.
  • The following entries have been added to the auto-translate dictionary.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue where the following items wherein the Conspirator effect was not properly active.
    Raider’s Vest +2 / Skulker’s Vest / Skulker’s Vest +1
  • The issue wherein the potency of Regen effects received+ effect of Type C augments for the following pieces of equipment contained incorrect text.
    Mogelai / Futhark Claymore / Peord Claymore
    This bug fix affects the help text only. No change has been made to the actual effect.
  • The issue wherein synthesis skill ranks could not be returned under certain conditions while the skill range was Artisan or higher.
  • The issue with the temporary item list options wherein the button for manual sorting occasionally displayed an improper graphic.
  • The issue wherein speaking with the Nomad Moogle and then moving away would cause certain menus to not close properly.
  • The issue with Abyssea wherein consuming traverser stones to extend visitant status would allow players to consume stones in excess of the 120 minute limit.
  • The issue with the /equipset text command wherein players would be able to input an improper value outside of the normally allowable amount.
  • Various issues with misleading text command help text.
  • The names for the following items are not displayed correctly.
    Feline Hagoita / Feline Hagota+1

Known Issues

  • When activating Level Sync with a player of Master Level status with an active beastmaster pet, summoner avatar/spirit, or puppetmaster automaton, the level and attributes of the said pet will become abnormally low.
    * These pets’ levels and attributes will return to normal if they are dismissed and then summoned again after level syncing.
  • Selecting the Recycle Bin option from the item list menu while under the effects of an Enchantment: Costume effect or performing a synthesis will cause the inventory list to display in an unnatural manner.

Event-related

  • A new entry has been added to The Voracious Resurgence.

    Attachment 13362
    • Players must complete the quest Uran-Mafran of the Maelstrom and speak with Shantotto in Windurst Walls (K-7) to accept the quest.
  • The quest Inside the Belly has undergone the following additions.
  • Additional fish are now eligible for turn in.
  • Additional items are now available.
  • A.M.A.N. Trove has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
  • Various new visual and audio effects have been added.
  • New items have been added, including some equipment exclusive to A.M.A.N. Trove.
  • Some existing items have been removed from the list of available spoils.
  • Greyson in Lower Jeuno (G-11) will now provide players with additional and adjusted explanations.
  • Players will now receive a random item by trading used Mars orbs and Venus orbs to Greyson in Lower Jeuno (G-11).
  • Records of Eminence has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
  • The monthly objectives have been swapped out.
  • New objectives are now available once certain conditions are met.
  • A new designation has been added.

Battle-related

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes in Normal and Intense Ambuscades have been swapped out.
      * As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.

      Attachment 13363
    • The HP of the following foes in Ambuscade has been lowered.
      Symbiotic Marid／Symbiotic Dhalmel／Symbiotic Coeurl／Symbiotic Tiger／
      Symbiotic Rabbit／Symbiotic Buffalo／Symbiotic Opo-opo
    • This month’s Intense Ambuscade battle has undergone the following adjustments.
      • The Malice of Gu’Dha ability used by the Bozzetto High Vicar on Very Difficult has undergone the following adjustments.
        • The cooldown has been increased from 20 seconds to 30 seconds.
        • The maximum number of uses has been increased from 8 to 11.
      • The minimum amount of time it takes for the Bozzetto Berserker and Bozzetto Devour to spawn has been increased from 20s to 60s.
      • The intensity of the random weakness placed on the Bozzetto Disruptor and Bozzetto Defiler has been increased from 400% to 1,000%.
  • Certain items obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been swapped out.
  • Certain items obtainable for total hallmarks have been swapped out.
  • Certain items obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been swapped out.

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • New items are now storable via the Porter Moogle.
  • Storage Slip 03
    ??? / ???

System-related

*There are no system-related updates this month.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue wherein the following monsters added to Crawler’s Nest [S] in the March 2022 version update did not have the proper curse resistance.
    * Apex monsters are intended to have high HP but reward proportionally more exemplar points. This issue caused these monsters to be defeated with instant kill effects, thereby bypassing their high HP levels and making it easier than intended to earn exemplar points.
    Apex Lugcrawler／Apex Worker Lugcrawler／Apex Soldier Lugcrawler／Apex Rumble Lugcrawler／
    Apex Knight Lugcrawler／Apex Mycelar／Apex Nest Elytra／Apex Blazer Elytra／Apex Helm Elytra／
    Apex Doom Scorpion／Apex Lugcrawler Hunter／Apex Hornfly／Apex Dragonfly／
    Apex Fire Elemental／Apex Water Elemental
  • The issue wherein changing areas while in possession of one or more temporary items and using a useable item while item data is still loading would occasionally cause an item other than the intended one to be used.
  • The issue wherein opening the item list while in possession of one or more temporary items would occasionally cause the cursor to display in an unintended location.

body:

Event-related

  • The ability to further reforge item level 119 empyrean armor has been added.
  • Starting the process
    Speak with Ruspix in Leafallia (H-8) to get started.

    Attachment 13449
  • Reforging
    In order to get started reforging empyrean armor, you must participate in the new battle content known as Sortie as the job for which you want to reforge the armor.
  • Required Items
    Reforging requires currency known as gallimaufry as well as Ra’Kaznar sapphires.
    Each of these are obtainable by defeating foes in Sortie or opening coffers that appear when certain conditions are met.
    Ra’Kaznar sapphires may also be purchased with gallimaufry.
  • Time Required
    When you turn in a piece of armor for reforging, the process will be complete once one day (Vana’diel time) has passed.
  • A new chapter has been added to The Voracious Resurgence.

    Attachment 13450

    To accept the quest, speak with Andreine in Eastern Adoulin’s Celennia Memorial Library (F-10) after completing the quest Delkfutt the Great.
  • Records of Eminence has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.
  • A new designation has been added.

Battle-related

  • New battle content known as Sortie has been added.

    Sortie is instanced battle content that plays out in Outer Ra’Kaznar [U].

    Attachment 13451
  • Prerequisites
    • Have completed Adoulin Mission Chapter 5 (up through The Light Within).
    • Be in possession of the Scintallating Rhapsody key item.
  • Requirements to Participate
    • Be in possession of the shiny Ra’Kaznarian plate key item.
      * Players may only possess one of these items at a time.
  • Enjoying Sortie
    1. Speak with Ruspix in Leafallia to obtain a shiny Ra’Kaznarian plate key item.

    2. The party leader should interact with the diaphanous transposer in Kamihr Drifts (F-6) and select Sortie.

    3. If all party members meet the requirements for participation, the party will be entered into the queue.

    4 Interact with the diaphanous transposer again to join.
    * Upon entering the instance, the shiny Ra’Kaznarian plate will transform into a dull Ra’Kaznarian plate.
  • Second and subsequent attempts
    Players approaching the diaphanous transposer after at least 20 hours have passed since their previous attempt will find that their dull Ra’Kaznarian plate will transform back into a shiny Ra’Kaznarian plate. You will then be able to enter Sortie again.
  • Between one and six players may participate.
    * Alter egos may be called forth.
    * All participating players must be in possession of a shiny Ra’Kaznarian plate to join.
  • The time limit is one hour.
  • Rewards
    • Vanquishing foes in Sortie will reward you with gallimaufry, the currency require for reforging item level 119 empyrean armor.
    • Ra’Kaznarian sapphires, also required for reforging, will drop from notorious monsters in Sortie and can also be purchased with gallimaufry.
    • Treasure chests that appear once certain conditions are met can also yield gallimaufry and Ra’Kaznarian sapphires.
    • In addition to the above, players can also obtain old cases, which contain augmented job-specific earrings.
      * Gallimaufry and Ra’Kaznarian sapphires are personal rewards.
      * Gallimaufry is retained between Sortie attempts and can be viewed at any time via the Currencies 2 menu.
  • Decreasing Time Required for Reentry
    • After you complete Sortie for the first time, you can receive a Ruspix’s plate by speaking with Ruspix in Leafallia (H-8).
    • After entering Sortie a second time, your Ruspix’s plate will charge up with energy, accumulating time equal to one-fifth (1/5) of the time that exceeded the 20 hour waiting period since your previous Sortie.
      (Example: You first entered Sortie at 8:00 p.m. on Thursday. You next enter Sortie at 9:00 p.m. on Friday. Since 25 hours has passed since your first Sortie, you are 5 hours past the minimum waiting period. One-fifth of that time (1 hour) is stored in your Ruspix’s plate upon entry into the second Sortie.)
    • Once your Ruspix’s plate has stored up an amount of time equivalent to the amount of time you must wait before entering Sortie again, you can speak with Ruspix in Leafallia (H-8) to have him convert your dull Ra’Kaznarian plate into a shiny Ra’Kaznarian plate.
      * The amount of time is recorded and displayed in-game in seconds.
      * Ruspix’s plate can store up to 72,000 seconds (20 hours) of time.
  • Leaving Sortie
    • Use the spell Warp/Teleport or similar effects.
    • Use the obsidian wing temporary item, obtainable upon entry into Sortie.
    • Reach the time limit.
    • Have three minutes elapse after all party members are knocked out.

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes in Normal and Intense Ambuscades have been swapped out.
      * As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.

      Attachment 13452
  • Exemplar points are no longer gained or lost in Normal or Intense Ambuscades when completing an Ambuscade or being knocked out.
    * This change was made in response to feedback from players who found it difficult to participate in Ambuscade because of this penalty.
  • Intense Ambuscades have undergone the following adjustments.
    • A visual effect will now display when Bozzetto Ramuh activates a special ability when using Astral Passage.
    • The Bozzetto Doppelganger will find it more difficult to flee when afflicted with weight or bind.
    • The Bozzetto Doppelganger now has resistance against all forms of damage.
      * The amount of damage reduction is unchanged.
  • Normal Ambuscades have undergone the following adjustments.
    • Bozzetto Jody, Bozzetto Julika, and Bozzetto Vivian have had their attack delay increased from 240 to 320.
    • Bozzetto Jody, Bozzetto Julika, and Bozzetto Vivian have had the damage adjustment of their Impale ability decreased from 2.0 to 1.5.
    • A golden bomb will now appear when certain conditions are met.
  • Certain items obtainable in exchange for hallmarks have been swapped out.
  • Certain items obtainable for total hallmarks have been swapped out.
  • Certain items obtainable in exchange for badges of gallantry have been swapped out.

    These status ailments cannot be removed by white magic, abilities, or items.

Item-related

    ???

    • To receive one of the applicable items you may have lost, speak with the Munitions Moogle in Port Jeuno (E-6) and trade one of the applicable base weapons.
      * Each item may only be re-obtained once.

System-related

  • Sortie has undergone the following adjustments.
    • A new instance area, Out Ra’Kaznar [U3] has been added.
    • The auto-transport option has been returned to the instance reservation system.
    * The updates to the instance reservation system originally announced on January 27, 2023, have been postponed to a future version update so that they may be further refined.

  • The Term Filter, a function for hiding chat log messages that contain user-designated terms, has been added.
    • The files used for the Term filter must be stored in the subfolder named “ffxiuser” contained within the settings and screenshot folder section in the FINAL FANTASY XI Config Features tab.
      * The default location for this file is C:/Users/[User Name]/Documents/My Games/FINAL FANTASY XI/ffxiuser
      Attachment 13581
  • Required Files
    • Create text files titled “prohibited.txt” and “allowed.txt”

      Attachment 13582
      • prohibited.txt
        Add the terms you would like to hide to this file. Any chat log messages containing these terms will be hidden from view in-game.

      • allowed.txt
        Add the terms you would like to whitelist to these file. Any chat log messages containing these terms will be displayed in game, even if other terms contained in the message are found in prohibited.txt.
      * Each text file can have up to 100 lines of text, with each line consisting of no more than 30 characters.
      *The Term Filter will not reference terms listed after the 100th line.
      * Registered text must be in UTF-8 format. The filter is not guaranteed to function properly if other formats are used.
      * The maximum file size for each file is 9200 bytes. The file will not load properly if the size exceeds this maximum.
      Attachment 13583
  • Applying the Filter
    • From the in-game config menu, select Term Filter from the Misc. 4 category and choose between “On", "Display Name Only", or "Off.”
      * The default setting is Off.
      * Selected settings will be applied only to new messages sent to the chat log. Existing messages will be unaffected.
      * The term filter applies to the Shout, Yell, Assist, and AssistE channels.

      Attachment 13584
      • On
        Hides chat messages containing terms found in prohibited.txt and allowed.txt.

      • Display Name Only
        Hides chat messages containing terms found in prohibited.txt and allowed.txt, but the name of the sender will continue to be displayed.

      • Off
        Disables the Term Filter.
      * If either of the two files are changed while the game is running, pressing any button will apply the latest settings.
  • Notes
    • It is possible that your intended recipient may not see your chat message if it contains any terms located in their filter. If your intended recipient does not respond, you may wish to contact them via channels to which the term filter does not apply.

  • A new feature to copy chat log lines to the clipboard has been added.
    • Using the log
      1. Open the chat log window.
      2. Select the line you wish to copy.
      3. Open the menu.
      4. Select “Copy to Clipboard” to copy the selected line.
      5. Lines copied to the clipboard may be copied to any file you wish.

      Attachment 13585

    • Applicable channels
      Say / Shout / Yell / Tell / Party / Link shell / Link shell2 / Unity / Assist / AssistE
      * System messages cannot be copied.
  • We plan to expand Term Filter functionality in upcoming version updates.

  • Setting Multiple Arguments
    The three terms can be combined in any permutation by including one or more within the same set of parentheses.
    Ex.: If prohibited.txt contains the term “(is)chocobo,” then terms such as “ChocoBo” and ”CHO co bo” will all be prohibited.

* The arguments will not function properly if any of the following are true.
  • Double byte characters are used
  • The parentheses are not closed
  • Arguments other than i, s, or n are contained in the parentheses.

  • We plan to expand Term Filter functionality in upcoming version updates.
  • The linkshell concierge will now only accept linkpearls from characters for whom 45 days or more (Earth time) have passed since character creation.
    * This change has been made to address reports of the linkshell concierge being used to harass players in game.

title: How to Use the Term Filter
body:
◆ Basic Term Filter Functionality
The Term Filter feature enables you to filter out chat log messages that contain text which you have pre-designated.

  • The Term Filter, a function for hiding chat log messages that contain user-designated terms, has been added.
    • The files used for the Term filter must be stored in the location used by the settings and screenshot folder section in the FINAL FANTASY XI Config Features tab.
      * The default location for this file is C:/Users/[User Name]/Documents/My Games/FINAL FANTASY XI/ffxiuser
      Attachment 13648
  • Required Files
    • Create text files titled “prohibited.txt” and “allowed.txt”

      Attachment 13649
      • prohibited.txt
        Add the terms you would like to hide to this file. Any chat log messages containing these terms will be hidden from view in-game.

      • allowed.txt
        Add the terms you would like to whitelist to these file. If creating a text file named “prohibited.txt” or “allowed.txt” displays the following error when enabling the filter in-game, try changing the file name to “prohibited” or “allowed”.
      * An individual term must contain 30 characters or fewer, and up to 100 terms may be registered. Any characters over 30 and any number of terms over 100 will be ignored.
      * Registered text must be in UTF-8 format. The filter is not guaranteed to function properly if other formats are used.
      * The maximum file size for each file is 9200 bytes. The file will not load properly if the size exceeds this maximum.
      Attachment 13650
  • Applying the Filter
    • From the in-game config menu, select Term Filter from the Misc. 4 category and choose between “On/Display Name Only/Off.”
      * The default setting is Off.
      * Selected settings will be applied only to new messages sent to the chat log. Existing messages will be unaffected.
      * The term filter applies to the Shout, Yell, Assist, and AssistE channels.

      Attachment 13651
      • On
        Hides chat messages containing terms found in prohibited.txt and allowed.txt.

      • Display Name Only
        Hides chat messages containing terms found in prohibited.txt and allowed.txt, but the name of the sender will continue to be displayed.

      • Off
        Disables the Term Filter.
      * If either of the two files are changed while the game is running, pressing any button will apply the latest settings.
  • Notes
    • It is possible that your intended recipient may not see your chat message if it contains any terms located in their filter. If your intended recipient does not respond, you may wish to contact them via channels to which the term filter does not apply.



◆ Expanded Term Filter Functionality to Enable more Precise Designations of Text
Adding specific arguments at the start of each line in prohibited.txt and allowed.txt—the two files used by the Term Filter—will enable you to take advantage of these new features.

  • Setting Multiple Arguments
    The three terms can be combined in any permutation by including one or more within the same set of parentheses.
    Ex.: If prohibited.txt contains the term “(is)chocobo,” then terms such as “ChocoBo” and ”CHO co bo” will all be prohibited.

    Ex.: If prohibited.txt contains the term “(isn)chocobo,” then terms such as “ChocoBo” and “CHO co bo” will be prohibited, but messages from the character “Blackchocobo” will continue to be displayed.

* The arguments will not function properly if any of the following are true.
  • Double byte characters are used
  • The parentheses are not closed
  • Arguments other than i, s, or n are contained in the parentheses.

◆ Copying Chat Log Lines to the Clipboard
  • Using the log
    1. Open the chat log window.
    2. Select the line you wish to copy.
    3. Open the menu.
    4. Select “Copy to Clipboard” to copy the selected line.
    5. Lines copied to the clipboard may be copied to any file you wish.

    Attachment 13652

  • Applicable channels
    Say / Shout / Yell / Tell / Party / Link shell / Link shell2 / Unity / Assist / AssistE

      Attachment 13717

      • Requirements
        • Complete the Rhapsodies of Vana'diel storyline.
        • Be in possession of the Crystal Paradise item.
          * Players joining the instance must be in possession of this item.
        • Be of a main job level of 99 and have achieved the Job Master title.
          * Players must have achieved Job Master status in the job they desire to play in the content.
      • Content game flow

        1. Speak with Emporox in Reisenjima and exchange 250 potpourri for the Crystal Paradise item.
        　* You must have completed the Rhapsodies of Vana'diel storyline.
        2. Trade the Crystal Paradise to the Celestial Gate in the Celestial Nexus and then select Crystal Paradise to enter the battlefield.
        3. Vanquish all of the designated foes.
        • Your party may consist of one to six players.
        • The time limit is sixty minutes.
          * Players will exit the arena once the time limit is reached.
        4. Claim your individual rewards.
        　* A system message will be displayed if you are unable to obtain the rewards.

    • Selection options

        The boss's behavior will not change and the Prime Weapon upgrade material Mesosiderite will not drop during the battle.
      • Select "To the deepest dark!"
        The boss's behavior will change and there is a possibilitythat the Prime Weapon upgrade material Mesosiderite will drop during the battle for players that have a stage 4 Prime Weapon.

    • Requirements

      • Have not yet obtained the titles from each of the beastman kings.
        * You are unable to enter battlefields for titles that you have already acquired.

      Batallia Downs (K-8) / Rolanberry Fields (J-5) / Sauromugue Champaign (E-6)

title: April 3, 2025 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • The following additions and changes have been made to the minigame portion of the Wings of the Goddess mission "Traitor in the Midst" where you have to attach a shadow bug to each of the potential suspects.
    • Increased the likelihood that the Cait Sith will be facing away from you diagonally to the right.
    • Added a visual effect that indicates when the Cait Sith is facing away from you diagonally to the right.
      * When the Cait Sith is facing away from you diagonally to the right, it is easier to complete the mission objective.
  • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.

Battle-related

  • Besieged has undergone the following additions and adjustments:
    • Increased the army's movement speed.
    • A special "Escape Route" will now appear in Al Zahbi (F-6) and allow you to teleport back inside the gate after exiting it.
  • The Cardian Macro Test feature has undergone the following additions and adjustments:
    Once you incur enmity with the NPC Macro Test, you will be assigned the "Macro Test" status condition.
    * While assigned the "Macro Test" status, your damage dealt, HP recovery, and MP recovery will be set to zero.
    * While assigned the "Macro test" status, your TP will be set to 1,000.
    * You must incur additional enmity with the NPC in order to maintain the "Macro Test" status, and the status cannot be made permanent.
  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments:
    • The foes in Normal and Intense Ambuscades have been swapped out.
      * As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.

      Attachment 13965 Attachment 13966

Item-related

  • New items are now storable via the Porter Moogle.
    • Storage Slip 22
      Tajawwul
  • The items that can be exchanged within the Limbus Clomper Goodness 2 category have been updated to include the following:
    Enif Corazza / Enif Manopolas / Enif Cosciales / Enif Gambieras / Enif Zucchetto / Adhara Manteel / Adhara Gages / Adhara Seraweels / Adhara Crackows / Adhara Turban / Murzim Corazza / Murzim Manopolas / Murzim Cosciales / Murzim Gambieras / Murzim Zucchetto / Shedir Manteel / Shedir Gages / Shedir Seraweels / Shedir Crackows / Shedir Turban

System-related

* There are no system updates.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue wherein using weapon skills with weapons that record their usage, such as trial weapons and mythic weapons, would count toward the requirement when used against monsters that do not give experience points.
  • The issue wherein text stating that monsters within Abyssea were ineligible was included within the Records of Eminence objective "Gain Experience [Limited-time Challenge]."
  • The issue wherein certain items that can be exchanged with the NPC Emporox were incorrect.
  • The issue wherein significant damage could be unintentionally incurred when both the player and monster were simultaneously targeted and readied for a skillchain.
    Examples of when such damage was incurred:
    • When wearing the following equipment:
      Creed Cuirass +1 / Creed Cuirass +2 / Chevalier's Cuirass / Chevalier's Cuirass +1 / Chevalier's Cuirass +2 / Chevalier's Cuirass +3
    • When being hit by a monster with the special ability "Mijin Gakure" in Dynamis – Divergence.
  • The issue wherein you could not purchase the following Limbus-related items from the NPC Curio Vendor Moogle in Port San d'Oria (J-9), Port Bastok (K-13), or Port Windurst (M-4).
    Luminian Thread / Flameshun Cloth / Silkworm Thread / Canvas Toile / Pantin Wire / Corduroy Cloth / Filet Lace / Gold Stud / Brilliantine / Electrum Stud

Known Issues

  • Using a weapon skill when under the "Macro Test" status sometimes allows the usage of the skill to be counted in certain situations.
  • Using the weapon skill "Myrkr" when under the "Macro Test" status enables recovery from status ailments.
  • The target cursor is canceled immediately after opening treasure chests in certain game content.
  • The text for certain objectives in Records of Eminence "Content (Ambuscade)" is displayed incorrectly. (English version only)
  • The status name for the "Macro Test" status is displayed incorrectly. (English version only)

      Before change: Ride the boat traversing Selbina and Mhaura and fish up bastore sardines the requisite number of times.
      　 ↓
      After change: Ride the boat traversing Selbina and Mhaura and fish up bastore sardines or quus the requisite number of times.

Battle-related

  • The following additions and changes have been made to Besieged.
    • The new Morale Gauge has been added to help in Al Zahbi's defense.
      Attachment 13983

      • What is the Morale Gauge?
        The Morale Gauge is a visual representation of the morale for the Five Serpent Generals and other allied NPCs. It increases or decreases based on their performance, as well as that of other players.
        Note: The starting value for the gauge is based on the current Al Zahbi defense value and the number of prisoners.
        • Drive back the beastman hordes and boost the morale of the Five Serpent Generals!
          Attachment 13990

          The easiest way to increase the Morale Gauge (the morale of the Five Serpent Generals) is to defeat as many of the beastmen that are attacking Al Zahbi as possible. The Five Serpent Generals' morale will rise based on your performance, and once the Morale Gauge exceeds half full, they will provide special support to those adventurers they know they can depend on!
        • Five Serpent Generals' support effects & conditions
          You can receive these support effects (*1) when near the corresponding Five Serpent General.

          • The higher the Five Serpent Generals' morale, the more powerful their support effects are!
            Attachment 13986
            The effects get stronger as the gauge increases, and once it is full, you will also receive the following special bonus effects.
            * Once the Morale Gauge is full, it will begin to deplete after a certain period of time has elapsed.
            * The strength of these special bonus effects changes depending on the battle situation.

    • The amount of experience points earned for completing Besieged has been increased.

    • The behavior of the invading monsters has been adjusted.

    • Level 11 beastmen have been added.
      As such, the Besieged-related monsters that appear in the following areas are now even more powerful.
      Mamook / Halvung / Arrapago Reef
      * The strength of each monster changes based on their level and your number of consecutive defenses.
      * The attacking monsters will feature a content level of 109.
      Attachment 13987

      * As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.
      Attachment 13991 Attachment 13992

title: June 10, 2025 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • The ability to reforge Item Level 119 artifact and relic armor even further has been added.

    Artifact armor
  • About the reforging process
    In order to begin the reforging process, you will need to open one or more of the treasure chests that can be found in the Apollyon area, and then examine the Apollyon Furnace that can be found near its entrance (Entrance #1 or #2).
    Attachment 14042
  • Items needed
    You will need the "Apollyon verification key" key item that can be obtained in Apollyon, and also the special "Apollyon Unit" currency in order to perform the reforging.

    Once you have the required amount of Apollyon Units, trade your Level 119+3 artifact armor to the Apollyon Furnace and you will receive your equipment once the reforging is complete.

    You can obtain Apollyon Units by defeating monsters in Apollyon to accumulate the floor data, and also from inside treasure chests.
Relic armor
  • About the reforging process
    In order to begin the reforging process, you will need to open one or more of the treasure chests that can be found in the Temenos area, and then examine the Temenos Furnace that can be found near its entrance.
    Attachment 14043
  • Items needed
    You will need the "Temenos verification key" key item that can be obtained in Temenos, and also the special "Temenos Unit" currency in order to perform the reforging.

    Once you have the required amount of Temenos Units, trade your Level 119+3 relic armor to the Temenos Furnace and you will receive your equipment once the reforging is complete.

    You can obtain Temenos Units by defeating monsters in Temenos to accumulate the floor data, and also from inside treasure chests.
Note: Support for storing your reforged relic and artifact armor with the Porter Moogle is scheduled to be added with a future update.

  • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.

  • As part of the content renewal, the "Content: Limbus" entry has been removed from the Records of Eminence.

Battle-related

  • Limbus has been renewed.
    The new content includes non-occupying battle content with no time limit where multiple players can participate. In addition to playing at your own pace, you can also adjust the level of the monsters that appear within the content.

    Attachment 14044 Attachment 14045
    • Prerequisites
      • Complete the Chains of Promathia mission - Chapter 8: Garden of Antiquity
      • You must be in possession of the "scintillating rhapsody" key item

        <table width="500" border="0"><tr><td width="30%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Key Item</td><td width="70%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">How to obtain</td></tr><tr><td width="30%" bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Scintillating rhapsody</td><td width="70%" bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Complete the Rhapsodies of Vana'diel mission - Chapter 3: The Orb's Radiance</td></tr></table>
    • Requirements for participation
      • You must be in possession of the following key items:

        <table width="650" border="0"><tr><td width="10%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Area</td><td width="15%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Necessary key item</td><td width="75%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">How to obtain<br>* You must meet one of the following conditions</td></tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Temenos</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">White Card</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="left">
        • Examine the ??? in Al'Taieu (H-5)<br><br>
        • Defeat Aw'euvhi after entering Al'Taieu from the Dimensional Portal at the Crag of Holla
        </td></tr><tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Apollyon</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Black Card</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="left">
        • Examine the ??? in Al'Taieu (D-8)<br><br>
        • Examine the ??? in Al'Taieu (L-8)<br><br>
        • Defeat Aw'euvhi after entering Al'Taieu from the Dimensional Portal at the Crag of Dem<br><br>
        • Defeat Aw'euvhi after entering Al'Taieu from the Dimensional Portal at the Crag of Mea
        </td></tr></table>
        Note: Upon entering, all participating party members must be in possession of the "scintillating rhapsody" key item as well as the card for the relevant area.
        Note: The White Card and Black Card will change from temporary key items to permanent key items, so they will not be consumed upon entry.
        Note: If you already have a White Card and Black Card from before the version update, you can enter Limbus and do not need to reacquire them.
      • You can play solo or together with a party.
        Note: You can summon up to three alter egos.
    • Content game flow
      Temenos
      1. Go from Al'Taieu (H-4) to the north and enter Temenos.
        Note: If you do not have the "scintillating rhapsody" key item and a White Card, you will be removed from the area after 15 seconds.
      2. Speak to the Temenos Operator on the floor of your destination (entrance) and set the level from between 119 and 130.
      3. Defeat the monsters within Temenos to collect the data for the floor, and once you've accumulated the maximum amount of data, obtain the temporary item.
      4. Acquire the temporary item from all of the floors and open the treasure chest at the end of the sector.
      Apollyon
      1. Examine the Swirling Vortex in either Al'Taieu (E-6) or Al'Taieu (K-6) to teleport to Apollyon.
        Note: If you do not have the "scintillating rhapsody" key item and a Black Card, you will be unable to teleport.
      2. Speak to the Apollyon Operator on the floor of your destination (entrance #1 or #2) and set the level from between 119 and 130.
      3. Defeat the monsters within Apollyon to collect the data for the floor, and once you've accumulated the maximum amount of data, obtain the temporary item.
      4. Acquire the temporary item from all of the floors and open the treasure chest at the end of the sector.
    • About the monsters
      • The monster level will be the level that the first player detected by a monster chose at the entrance.
        Note: When playing in a party, the level for everyone will also be that which the first player detected by a monster chose at the entrance. Additionally, all participating party members must select a level.
        Note: All of the monsters' HP and stats will be restored at the start of the battle.
        Note: The monster level will not change until the battle with the monsters is over. If a monster is engaged in combat, the monster level will not change even if it targets a different player.
      • The monster respawn time is one minute.
    • Acquiring the data
      This is a gameplay system unique to Limbus that allows you to acquire data after defeating monsters. The amount of data obtained changes depending on factors such as the difference in level between you and the monsters as well as the number of members in your party. The amount of acquirable data differs between each floor in Temenos and Apollyon, and both your selected level and the data accumulated so far will be displayed for your current floor.

      Attachment 14046
      Note: When fighting a monster of a lower level than the one selected at the entrance, the amount of acquirable data will be reduced based on the level difference between you.
      Note: If you are a fighting a monster that is 10 or more levels lower than your selected level, you will be unable to acquire any data.
      Note: The data acquired from each floor will be reset once you leave Temenos or Apollyon. Also, your accumulated data will be reset if you select a level higher than your currently selected level.
    • Temporary items
      Once you've accumulated the maximum amount of data for a floor, you will get a key for the treasure chest. These temporary items that can be obtained vary by floor, and you must acquire all of the temporary items in the area in order to open the treasure chest.

      There is one treasure chest for each sector within Temenos and Apollyon. Also, from the second chest onward, you may also receive special support effects that can boost your stats across all of Limbus's areas.
      Note: You can open up to five treasure chests per week in both Temenos and Apollyon.
      • Effects obtainable from treasure chests
        • Depending on the number of treasure chests opened, the maximum amount of Temenos Units and Apollyon Units you can carry will increase.。
        • You can also obtain special support effects for the area that are only active within Limbus.
          • Support effects
            • The support effects grow more effective based on how many treasure chests you open. The number of times the treasure chests have been opened are recorded for each World, so all of the adventurers within each World can receive the same support effects.
              Note: Any support effects that you have earned will be activated automatically upon entering Temenos or Apollyon. There is no time limit for these support effects.
              Note: The same effects will be activated whether you are in Temenos or Apollyon.

You can check how many units you have acquired by going to the Currencies 2 menu.

        Note: Temenos Units and Apollyon Units are personal rewards.
        • You can acquire up to 50,000 of both Temenos Units and Apollyon Units per week. If you have not reached the limit after the week changes, the amount you were short will be added to your acquisition limit for the new week. Including any added amounts, the most Temenos Units/Apollyon Units you can have is 100,000 of each one.
  • How to leave
    • Use a warp/teleport spell or item.
    • Change areas from the Temenos entrance.
    • Change areas by examining the Radiant Aureole at the Apollyon entrance.

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • The foes have been swapped out. As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.

      Attachment 14048 Attachment 14049

  • The level difference adjustment has been removed for the following areas:
    Temenos / Apollyon

Item-related

  • New items have been added.

  • The drop rate of the Halvung brass key has been increased.

  • You can now stack up to 12 of the following items:
    Mamook blackscale key / Halvung brass key / Lamian bone key

System-related

  • The following items have been added to the Currencies 2 menu under Status in the main menu:
    Temenos Unit / Apollyon Unit
  • The following items will be added to the tradeable items that can be exchanged with the Ancestry Moogle in Port San d'Oria (J-10), Port Bastok (J-12), and Windurst Walls (C-13).
    Maxixi Tiara +4 / Maxixi Casaque +4 / Maxixi Bangles +4 / Maxixi Tights +4 / Maxixi Toe Shoes +4

Resolved Issues

  • The issue in The Voracious Resurgence mission "Cornelia's Call to Action" wherein the blur effect remained on-screen after the cutscene ended.

  • The issue in Vana'Bout wherein the text for some objectives was incorrect. (English version only)

  • The issue in Vana'Bout wherein the text for some dialogue choices wasn't displaying when trading for rewards with the Coordinator Moogle. (English version only)

  • Various issues with incorrect text in Besieged. (English version only)

Known Issues

  • Various issues with incorrect text. (English version only)
  • The numerical values listed within the Ankusa Jackcoat +4 description are lower than the actual values. (English version only)
  • The upgrade level stated in the item name is incorrect for the items listed below. (English version only)
    * The correct name should be +4.
    Plunderer's Poulaines +5 / Caballarius Coronet +5 / Horos Toe Shoes +5

title: July 10, 2025 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • The following change has been made to the Mog Gardens.
    Reared creatures will be twice as likely to transform as they were before.
    Note: The contents of the Monster Rearing Campaign will now be the standard specification for the game.
  • Geas Fete equipment obtained from Reisenjima can be engraved with arcane glyptics by Oseem in Norg (I-7) at no additional charge.
    * You can engrave your equipment up to six times per day. This restriction is lifted at 8:00 a.m. (PDT) each day and you will be able to engrave your equipment up to six times again.

    * You can engrave your equipment up to six times per day. This restriction is lifted at 3:00 p.m. (GMT) / 4:00 p.m. (BST) each day and you will be able to engrave your equipment up to six times again. The abilities assigned will be the same as when using the Dark Matter item.
    Note: The contents of the Dark Matter Arcane Glyptics Campaign will now be the standard specification for the game.
  • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.

Battle-related

  • The following adjustments have been made to Limbus.
    • When a monster is outside its spawn radius and is not currently engaged in battle, it will no longer detect players until it has returned to its spawn radius.。
      Note that monsters of the same type can link with other monsters outside their spawn radius.
    • The monsters' level setting when inactive has been increased.
    • The monsters' HP and status conditions will not recover once enmity has been generated.
      Note: In regards to the HP recovery, we plan to increase the monsters' level in the future, which should make this adjustment even more effective. Currently, when a monster's level is changed to one selected by the player, its maximum HP also changes, making it appear as if its HP has been restored.
    • The HP for a monster under the player's control will no longer be restored once the Charmed status has been lifted.

    • In Temenos, the behavior of monsters that have generated enmity has been adjusted so that when they approach each other, it is harder for them to move to locations where they cannot be targeted, such as outside the field.

    • In Temenos, the requirements for getting the ??? to appear under special conditions have been adjusted, making it easier for it to appear.
