title: August 12, 2025 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • Someone has sprayed herbicide in Yorcia Weald, causing some obstacles located within it (bushes) to die off.

    Attachment 14186
  • The amount of time before the "???" reappears in the quest "The Siren's Tear" has been reduced.
  • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.

Battle-related

  • The following adjustments have been made to Besieged.
    • Level 12 beastmen have been unlocked, and Besieged monsters that appear in Mamook / Halvung / Arrapago Reef are even more powerful. In response, the strength of allied NPCs including the Five Serpent Generals has also been adjusted.
      * The strength of the monsters and allied NPCs changes based on the level and your number of consecutive defenses.
      * In the event that the attacking monsters are Level 12, it will feature an approximate content level of 114.


      Attachment 14187


    • New forces have been added to each beastman army.

      <table width="300" border="0"><tr><td width="40%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Beastman Army</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Monster Name</td></tr><tr><td width="40%" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Mamool Ja Savages</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">- Gandaberunda<br>- Ravenous Colibri</td></tr><tr><td width="40%" bgcolor="#f5fafb">Troll Mercenaries</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#f5fafb">- Garma<br>- Wicked Dahak</td></tr><tr><td width="40%" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">Undead Swarm</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#eaf2f3">- Akhty<br>- Restless Apkallu</td></tr></table>* These new additions to the beastman armies will appear at Level 12 or higher.

  • The following adjustments have been made to Limbus.
    • The color of the effect for the "???" that appears within Temenos under certain conditions has been changed.

      Attachment 14188


    • The Matter Diffusion Module teleportation portal in Temenos and the Swirling Vortex teleportation portal in Apollyon will now display your "Current Floor" at the top of the floor list.

      Attachment 14189

  • Ambuscade has undergone the following adjustments.
    • The foes have been swapped out. As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.

      Attachment 14190 Attachment 14191

Item-related

  • The cost of purchasing the Ahriman Tears item from the NPC has been increased from 200 gil to 1,000 gil.
  • The price of selling Eye Drops to an NPC has been reduced to 1/4th of its previous amount.
  • New items have been added.

System-related

  • The character display limit has been removed for the following areas:
    Monarch Linn / Al Zahbi
    Note: It is possible that the display limit will be restored in the event of unexpected errors or other related issues.

Resolved Issues

  • The following issues within Limbus have been fixed.
    • The issue wherein immediately canceling after examining a treasure chest causes only the chest opening animation to be played.
    • The issue wherein you are unable to obtain a Temenos Unit or Apollyon Unit from the "???" under certain conditions.
    • The issue wherein the corsair's Quick Draw ability is not affected by monsters with the "reduce damage taken" ability.

Known Issues

  • The value displayed on the confirmation screen while selecting job points for the Gold tier personal rewards when trading with the Coordinator Moogle in Vana'Bout is incorrect. (English version only)
    Note: This only affects the display of the text and not the actual number value or other related details.

Event-related

  • The Goblin Stew 880 item that can be used in place of the necessary materials for the inventory expansion quest can now be purchased at any time.

    Attachment 14218

  • Boisterous Jackal in Lower Jeuno (H-7) will now give you a hint regarding the password for the “♪Omega whistle” key item.

    Attachment 14219

  • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.

  • Matsui-P offers his sincere gratitude for taking him on your journeys.
    The deletion will be done automatically upon logging in after the Wednesday, September 10, 2025, version update.

Battle-related

  • The second round of updates to Limbus have been made.
    Multiple new pieces of equipment that can be crafted/reforged have been added.

    Attachment 14220

    • Crafting equipment
      Trade "matter" (see the explanation below) to the Temenos Furnace and Apollyon Furnace to craft the following equipment. The type of equipment that can be crafted will differ by area.
      • Temenos
        Attachment 14221 Attachment 14222
      • Apollyon
        Attachment 14223 Attachment 14224
    • Reforging equipment
      • Trade the equipment and "matter" (see the explanation below) to the same NPC that crafted the equipment while possessing the necessary number of units in order to add an augment to the equipment.
      • After the augment has been added, you can use the units as RP (Reinforcement Points) to upgrade the augment in stages. You will need the corresponding matter for each upgrade.

    • "Matter" overview
      Matter is a new item that is needed to craft and reforge the equipment. It can be acquired from Worlds that defeat notorious monsters in Limbus.
      <table width="450" border="0"><tr><td width="50%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Item Name</td><td width="50%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Eligible Area</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Alabaster Matter</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Temenos</td></tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Murky Matter</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Apollyon</td></tr><tr></table>


    Powerful notorious monsters will now appear within Limbus for a set period of time.
    Defeating these notorious monsters will alter the treasure chest that appears within Limbus the following week, giving you a chance to acquire matter.

    Attachment 14225 Attachment 14226
    • About the battles
      • The level set within Limbus does not apply to the battles.
      • Since the battles are not exclusive, you can fight alongside other adventurers.
      • There is no time limit for the battles.
      • The notorious monsters' HP will not recover automatically.
      • The monsters will remain until they are defeated.
    • About the obtainable rewards
      The color of the treasure chest will change for the following four-week period in the Worlds and areas where the notorious monsters were defeated, giving you the opportunity to earn matter.

      The number of victories against the notorious monsters will be counted for both Temenos and Apollyon, and will be reset when the conquest results are tabulated every four weeks
      Note: This information has been updated to reflect changes made to the specifications as part of the October 2025 version update.

      Attachment 14275 Attachment 14274
      • The treasure chest change applies to each World. Therefore, any players residing in a World that defeated notorious monsters will be given the chance to acquire matter for the applicable area, not just those who actually participated in defeating the monsters.
        * The area-specific support effects and the quantity of units that can be acquired from the treasure chest are the same as before.
      • The player's chances of acquiring matter are based on the number of victories over notorious monsters that were earned in the player's World.

        [Unlocking the content for the first time]
        • Characters that have never acquired Alabaster Matter or Murky Matter are guaranteed to acquire them the first time they unlock the content*.
          * This only applies once per character and is not affected by the treasure chest reset when the conquest results are tabulated.
    　
    • "131–135" has been added to the level selection choices for the Temenos Operator and Apollyon Operator.

  • The following additions and adjustments have been made to Besieged.
    • You can now trade for the following items using Imperial Standing.
      • General items

        <table width="600" border="0"><tr><td width="25%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Item Name</td><td width="20%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Points Required</td><td width="55%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Notes</td></tr></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Arrapago Ring</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">100</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Use this item to warp to The Ashu Talif.</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Cotton Coin Purse (Alexandrite)</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">300</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">You can trade for up to 50 per month.</td></table>

      • Escutcheon materials

        <table width="600" border="0"><tr><td width="25%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Item Name</td><td width="20%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Points Required</td><td width="55%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Notes</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Fire Crest Card</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" rowspan="8" align="center">20</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" rowspan="12" align="center">You can use desynthesis to obtain spheres.<br>* This process requires the "reassembling technique" key item.</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Ice Crest Card</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Wind Crest Card</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Earth Crest Card</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Water Crest Card</td><tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Lightning Crest Card</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Light Crest Card</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Dark Crest Card</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Radiance Card</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" rowspan="4" align="center">30</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Aqua Card</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Storm Card</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Gloom Card</td></tr></table>

    • The system for evaluating a player's contribution to the city's defense has been adjusted.
      The system that was applied to certain monsters has been revised, with players now earning a contribution level based on their actions rather than a set amount, and experience points will be awarded according to their performance.

  • The rank increase requirements for acquiring the Fame needed to trade for the following key items in Wildskeeper Reive have been relaxed.
    Brier-proof net / compass of transference / magma mitigation set / resurrection retardant axe / insulator tablet / anti-glaciation gear

  • The foes in Ambuscade have been swapped out.
    As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.

    Attachment 14229 Attachment 14230

Item-related

  • The following change has been made to the Ancestry Moogles located in Port San d'Oria (J-10) / Port Bastok (J-12) / Windurst Walls (C-13).
    • You can now trade for the following items:
      Straw Hat / Overalls / Work Gloves / Thatch Boots
      * This change is in response to no longer being able to equip these items after using the Character Race Change Service.
      Attachment 14231
    • Speak to the Ancestry Moogle after using the Character Race Change Service to learn which of your items can no longer be equipped due to your character's gender change.
      * This excludes items that are being held with the Porter Moogle or other NPCs.
  • You can now purchase the following items from the Curio Vendor Moogles in Port San d'Oria (J-9) / Port Bastok (K-13) / Windurst Walls (M-4) while in possession of the "Rhapsody in Umber" key item.

  • New items have been added.

    Storage Slip 31
    Arthro's Scepter

System-related

    * This change is for players who already have an existing character on the Asura World. Please see the update from August 29, 2025 for more details.

Resolved Issues

title: December 10, 2025 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • The following additions and changes have been made to the Gobbie Mystery Box.
    Attachment 14415
  • A new festival dial has been added.
    The festival dial requires the use of an #FES dial key that can be obtained during seasonal events.
    * You can acquire one #FES dial key per day, and it will be reset at 12:00 a.m. JST (Earth time).

    In addition to items that can be obtained from the existing anniversary dial, spoils from high-tier mission battlefields and high-tier avatar battlefields will also be included.
    Also, for every ten treasure chests that you open, the chest will change to a rainbow color and boost your chances of getting high-tier mission battlefield and high-tier avatar battlefield spoils.

    ≪Gobbie Mystery Box locations≫
    <table width="450" border="0"><tr><td width="50%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Area / Coordinates</td><td width="50%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">NPC</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Southern San d'Oria (L-7)</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Mystrix</td></tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Port San d'Oria (I-10)</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Habitox</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Bastok Mines (K-9)</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Bountibox</td></tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Bastok Markets (I-7)</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Specilox</td></tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Windurst Walls (C-14)</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Arbitrix</td></tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Windurst Woods (G-7)</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Funtrox</td></tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Upper Jeuno (I-10)</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Priztrix</td></tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Lower Jeuno (I-6)</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Sweepstox</td></tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Aht Urhgan Whitegate (F-11)</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Wondrix</td></tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Western Adoulin (H-10)</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Rewardox</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Eastern Adoulin (G-10)</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Winrix</td></tr><tr></table>
  • You can now trade in additional copies of a dial key in order to open multiple treasure chests in a row.
  • Corneila's alter ego will be returning for a limited time due to everyone achieving the Vana'Bout - Round 7 target goal.
    Attachment 14416
    • Acquiring the Alter Ego
      • If you have completed the "Trust" quest:
        You will automatically obtain the alter ego upon logging in after the Wednesday, December 10, 2025, version update.
        No message will be displayed signifying that you have acquired the alter ego.
      • If you have not completed the "Trust" quest:
        You must first complete it after the Wednesday, December 10, 2025, version update and then relog or change areas.
        No message will be displayed signifying that you have acquired the alter ego.
      • Period when the alter ego may be used
        Cornelia's alter ego may be used between the version update on Wednesday, December 10, 2025, and the version update in March 2026.
        * Exact dates are subject to change.
  • You can now reacquire the following titles in Limbus.
    Temenos Liberator / Apollyon Ravager
    • How to Acquire
      • If you are participating in Limbus for the first time
        Talk to Temenos Operator or Apollyon Operator and set the monsters' level.
      • If you have already participated in Limbus
        Talk to Temenos Operator or Apollyon Operator.
  • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.

Battle-related

  • The third round of updates to Limbus have been made.
  • Multiple new notorious monsters have been added.
    Numerous notorious monsters even more powerful than the previous ones will now appear.
    The notorious monsters are divided into three groups and by defeating them in order, the treasure chests within Limbus will change in appearance and give you materials needed for crafting equipment. Note that the notorious monster conquest status resets every four weeks (Earth time).

    Attachment 14417 Attachment 14418
  • About the appearance conditions
    In order to get the notorious monsters to appear, each World must complete the conditions that have been set for each group. You can check the conditions when they are displayed upon entering Temenos / Apollyon, or by talking to the following NPCs.

    【Temenos】
    Select "CN Opening" from the Temenos Operator.
    【Apollyon】
    Select "CN Opening" from the Apollyon Operator.
    * If all of the notorious monsters in each group have already been defeated, the selections will not be displayed until the next tabulation period.
  • About the dedicated area
    The notorious monsters will appear within a dedicated area.
    You can travel to this area via the following teleportation portals once the necessary conditions have been met.

    【Temenos】
    Select "Central Temenos – Basement 1" from the Matter Diffusion Module teleportation portal located near the entrance.
    【Apollyon】
    Select "Central Apollyon" from the Swirling Vortex teleportation portal located near the entrance.
  • About the battles
    • The level set within Limbus does not apply to the battles.
    • Since the battles are not exclusive, you can fight alongside other adventurers.
    • There is no time limit for the battles.
    • The notorious monsters' HP will not recover automatically.
    • The monsters will remain until they are defeated.
  • About the obtainable rewards
    The treasure chest will change to a new color for the following four-week period in Worlds and areas where the notorious monster group was defeated. There are three different colors, depending on how many of the groups were defeated. Based on the color, you can get new materials to appear in addition to the usual units and matter.

    Attachment 14419 Attachment 14420

    The treasure chest change applies to each World. Therefore, any players residing in a World that defeated the notorious monsters will be given the chance to acquire the rewards for the applicable area, not just those who actually participated in the battle to defeat the monsters.
    * The area-specific support effects and the quantity of units that can be acquired from the treasure chest are the same as before.
  • Multiple new pieces of equipment that can be crafted/reforged have been added.
    Attachment 14421
    You can craft new equipment by trading purification items and cursed items made from materials acquired within Temenos / Apollyon to the Temenos Furnace or Apollyon Furnace.
  • Crafting equipment
    • Crafting purification items
      Use the shards, Alabaster Matter, and Murky Matter that can be obtained from the treasure chests and trade them to the Temenos Furnace or Apollyon Furnace.
      * Players that have yet to open a treasure chest within Temenos / Apollyon are unable to craft purification items.

      There are five types of shards in total, and you can obtain those specific to your character's race from the treasure chest by defeating one or more groups.

      <table width="450" border="0"><tr><td width="50%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Race</td><td width="50%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Obtainable Shard</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Hume</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Shard of Hope</td></tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Elvaan</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Shard of Trust</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Tarutaru</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Shard of Bravery</td></tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Mithra</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Shard of Justice</td></tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Galka</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Shard of Mercy</td></tr><tr></table>
      You can also trade two of a particular race's shards to the Temenos Furnace or Apollyon Furnace for one shard of a different race.

    • Crafting cursed items
      Use the materials available from the treasure chests within Limbus to synthesize the equipment. You can check the synthesis recipes once you have reached mid-tier crafting status in each guild.
  • Reforging equipment
    You can add and reforge augmentations to your crafted equipment with the Temenos Furnace or Apollyon Furnace.
    The process requires purification items and units corresponding to the relevant equipment.

    Also, the augmentation can be transferred to a different piece of equipment.
    In order to transfer the augmentation, trade both the original and new pieces of equipment to the Temenos Furnace or Apollyon Furnace after meeting the requirements listed below.
    Note: The source item will be lost during the transfer process.
    1.Both items are the same type of attire and for the same body part.
    2.The target item is of higher quality than the source item.
    3.3The target item does not already have an augmentation.
  • The following changes have been to Temenos.
    • The monsters listed below will no longer link with other monsters.
      Temenos Orc／Temenos Quadav／Temenos Yagudo／Temenos Sahagin／Temenos Cryptonberry／Temenos Antica／Temenos Gigas／Temenos Goblin／Temenos Moblin／Temenos Meeble／Temenos Aern／Temenos Euvhi／Temenos Pixie／Temenos Unseelie
    • The detection radius for the following monsters has been reduced.
      Temenos Euvhi／Temenos Ghrah
    • When Temenos Euvhi appears within the area, it will randomly appear in either its open or closed state.
  • The following additions and changes have been made to the Dynamis – Divergence shared area.
  • The starting location when entering the content during Wave 2 has been adjusted.
  • The area of effect damage inflicted on monsters outside of the main target has been reduced.
    * This does not apply to pet-type monsters.
  • The boss monster's HP will be displayed constantly in the upper left corner of the screen.
    Attachment 14422
  • The foes in Ambuscade have been swapped out.
    As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.
    Attachment 14423 Attachment 14424

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • A new synergy recipe has been added.
  • New items are now storable via the Porter Moogle.
Storage Slip 31
Ethereal Fists / Ethereal Dagger / Ethereal Sword / Ethereal Great Sword /
Ethereal Axe / Ethereal Great Axe / Ethereal Scythe / Ethereal Spear / Ethereal Katana /
Ethereal Tachi / Ethereal Club / Ethereal Staff / Ethereal Bow / Ethereal Gun /

System-related

* There are no system updates.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue in Apollyon wherein "NPC" could be displayed when targeting the Swirling Vortex teleportation portal.
  • The issue wherein the display of "Unity Info" was displayed incorrectly when opened under certain conditions.
  • The issue in the Records of Eminence wherein the confirmation window was displayed when deleting an objective from the offer list even when its progress was 0.

body:

  • System-related

  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.

Battle-related

  • The following additions and changes have been made to Limbus.

    Attachment 14439
  • When you inflict damage on notorious monsters in Limbus, you will earn a new kind of points known as Unique data.
  • About Unique data
  • The points earned are based on the damage directly inflicted by any party or alliance members within a 30-meter radius of the target.
  • Unique data is earned separately for Temenos and Apollyon.
  • You can use a certain amount of Unique data to open one of the treasure chests found in the innermost area of Temenos or Apollyon.

    <table width="420" border="0"><tr><td width="45%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Area </td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Applicable Sector</td></tr><tr><td width="40%" bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Temenos</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Northern Tower / Western Tower / Eastern Tower / Central Temenos</td></tr><tr><td width="40%" bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Apollyon</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">NW / SW / NE / SE </td></tr></table>* You can open the treasure chest even when not in possession of the necessary temporary item.
    * Even if you have already opened five treasure chests in both Temenos and Apollyon, you can open an additional treasure chest by using Unique data.
    * If you are in possession of a temporary item, it will be used first.
  • Unique data that can be used to open a treasure chest can be stored for up to 10 uses, and there is no time limit on its usage.
  • You can use the dedicated gauge displayed within Limbus to check how much Unique data you have accumulated.

    Attachment 14440
  • The number of Temenos Units and Apollyon Units that can be acquired per week has been increased.
    * This change will take effect with the conquest tabulations conducted on Monday, January 19.
<table width="600" border="0"><tr><td width="32%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center"></td><td width="18%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Before change</td><td width="10%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center"></td><td width="18%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">After change</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Unit limit per week</td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center"> 50,000 </td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center"> → </td><td bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center"> 70,000 </td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Total unit limit, including any carryover</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center"> 100,000 </td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center"> → </td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center"> 140,000 </td></tr></table>

<table width="300" border="0"><tr><td width="45%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Beastman Army</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#a8d0d7" align="center">Monster Name</td></tr><tr><td width="40%" bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Mamool Ja Savages</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Illuyankas</td></tr><tr><td width="40%" bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Troll Mercenaries</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#f5fafb" align="center">Gere</td></tr><tr><td width="40%" bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Undead Swarm</td><td width="60%" bgcolor="#eaf2f3" align="center">Nemean Lion</td></tr></table>Just like before, you will receive a contribution level for helping to defeat these monsters.
  • Monsters that are marching on the city will no longer detect your alter egos.
  • You will no longer lose experience points or exemplar points upon being knocked out in the Dynamis – Divergence shared area.
    This effect is attained by the new "resolved" status that provides the "You are currently losing fewer experience points and exemplar points after being knocked out." effect once you enter the content.

title: March 10, 2026 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.
  • New reward items have been added to the monthly Records of Eminence objectives.
  • An additional starting requirement has been added to certain objectives in Quest #3 of the Records of Eminence.
New requirement
You must be in possession of the "cipher bracelet" key item.
Affected objective
Filled to Capacity
* If you were able to attempt Filled to Capacity before the March update, you can still take on the Filled to Capacity and Way Over Capacity quests even without the "cipher bracelet" key item.
  • The limited-time alter ego of Cornelia has been removed.
    Cornelia offers her sincere gratitude for taking her on your journeys.
    The deletion will be done automatically upon logging in after the Tuesday, March 10, 2026, version update.
  • You must now hold down the button to cancel a daily objective in Vana'Bout.
    Attachment 14490

Battle-related

  • As part of the first round of updates to the Trust magic system, alter egos' basic stats can now be upgraded with alter ego points.

    Unlocking alter ego points
    Once you have met the requirements listed below, speak to Syndella in Ru'Lude Gardens (H-5) to obtain the "cipher bracelet" key item and unlock the ability to earn alter ego points.
    Prerequisites
    You have completed the "Trust" quest.
    You must be in possession of the "job breaker" key item.
    How to earn alter ego points
    You can earn alter ego points by using the items listed below.
    <table width="600" border="0"><tr><td width="25%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Item Name</td><td width="50%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">How to Earn</td><td width="25%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Points Earned</td></tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Trust Primer</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Reward for completing Records of Eminence monthly objectives</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">20</td></tr><tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Trust Tome</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Reward for certain events</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">100</td></tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Marjory's Thesis</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Speak to Marjory after completing the objective “Way Over Capacity” in Quest #3 of the Records of Eminence. (*) </td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">200</td></tr></table>* If you have already completed the quest, you can speak to Marjory to obtain the "Marjory's Thesis" item.
    How to upgrade your alter egos
    Go to Main Menu > Stats > Alter ego points to open the upgrade screen and then assign the alter ego points to the stats you wish to upgrade.
    The alter egos can be upgraded within your Mog House.
    All alter egos can be upgraded.
    Points cannot be reassigned.
    * We plan to eventually make enough points available so that all of the alter egos' stats can be upgraded to the limit.
    * Your current main job must be Level 99 in order to perform the upgrade.
    * Some alter egos may have different HP/MP caps based on their traits.
    Attachment 14491
    The effect of the "filled memory gem" key item will be lost.
  • In Limbus, job points and exemplar points have been added as rewards to the blue or better treasure chests that can be opened with Unique data.
    The number of points earned depends on the number of mannequin-type notorious monsters and notorious monsters appearing in Central Temenos - Basement 1 and Central Apollyon that you defeat.
    * If you defeat fewer than five mannequin-type notorious monsters, you will not receive any points.
  • In Colonization Reives, Lair Reives, and Wildskeeper Reives, the waiting period before rejoining the battle after leaving the battle area has been reduced from 5 minutes to 1 minute.
  • The foes in Ambuscade have been swapped out.
    As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.
    Attachment 14492 Attachment 14493

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • The following changes and additions have been made to the “bronzite” item that can be purchased from Ghebi Damomohe within Neptune's Spire in Lower Jeuno (I-7).
    New uses for the item have been added.
    * This item may be required when trading with the Curator Moogle that appears from the March 2026 version update onward.
    The “Ex” designation has been removed.
    You can now sell the item in the Shop.
  • New items are now storable via the Porter Moogle.
    Storage Slip 31
    Bud Rod

System-related

  • Added "Wing Skill" as a numerical value to indicate your skill level when chocobo digging.

    Leveling up the skill will now be displayed in the log.
    Attachment 14494
    You can check your current Wing Skill level by speaking to the following NPCs.
    Arvilauge in Southern San d'Oria (I-11)
    Gonija in Bastok Mines (I-9)
    Kiria-Romaria in Windurst Woods (K-12)
  • In Conquest, knockouts that occur while experience loss is disabled will no longer be counted in the conquest tally.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue in Limbus wherein notorious monsters that had not been defeated at the end of the tabulation period would not disappear.
  • Various issues with incorrect text.

Known Issues

  • The item name "Bud Rod" is incorrect. This issue occurs only in the English version.

Event-related

  • The following additions and changes have been made to the Records of Eminence.
    ・A feature for automatically accepting objectives related to character development has been added.
    These objectives appear in a dedicated section and do not use slots reserved for any existing Records of Eminence objectives that you have accepted.
    Attachment 14591
    ・The following additions have been made to the "Tutorial" Records of Eminence objective.
    ・Added a new "Intermediate 2" category.
    ・Added a new "Quests (Growth)" category.
    ・Added new objectives to the "Basics" category.
    ・Added new objectives to the "Intermediate" category.
    ・The following additions have been made to the Records of Eminence "Content" category:
    ・New objectives have been added to the "Content (Dynamis 1)" category.
    ・New objectives have been added to the "Content (Dynamis 2)" category.
    ・The monthly objectives have been swapped out.
  • In the following missions for The Voracious Resurgence, the key item acquisition log did not always display properly, so we have taken steps to address the issue.
    ・"Claidie's Concern"
    ・"Altennia Burns Bright"

title: June 10, 2026 (JST) Version Update
body:
• Event-related
  • Battle-related
  • Item-related
  • System-related
  • Resolved Issues
  • Known Issues

Event-related

  • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.

Battle-related

  • Limbus has undergone the following additions and adjustments.
    • New notorious monsters have been added.

      Starting with this update, the notorious monsters will be divided into four different groups. By defeating them in order, the treasure chests within Limbus will change in appearance and give you materials needed to craft equipment. Note that the notorious monster conquest status resets every four weeks (Earth time).
      Attachment 14654 Attachment 14655
      • Notorious Monster Status

        The newly added notorious monsters will appear after a set period of time has elapsed upon defeating all of the Phase 2 notorious monsters. Also, you can check the progression status when they are displayed upon entering Temenos/Apollyon, or by talking to the following NPCs.

        Temenos
        Select "Central Temenos - Basement 1" from the Temenos Operator.

        Apollyon
        Select "CN Opening" from the Apollyon Operator.

        * If all of the notorious monsters in each group have already been defeated, the selections will not be displayed until the next tabulation period.

      • About the dedicated area

        The newly added notorious monsters will appear within a dedicated area. You can travel to this area via the following teleportation portals once the necessary conditions have been met.
        * The overall background music for Temenos and Apollyon will change while the newly added notorious monsters are present.

        Temenos
        Select "Central Temenos - Basement 1" from the Matter Diffusion Module teleportation portal located near the entrance.

        Apollyon
        Select "Central Apollyon" from the Swirling Vortex teleportation portal located near the entrance.

      • About the battles
        • The level set within Limbus does not apply to the battles.
        • Since the battles are not exclusive, you can fight alongside other adventurers.
        • There is no time limit for the battles.
        • The notorious monsters' HP will not recover automatically.
        • The monsters will remain until they are defeated.
      • About the obtainable rewards

        With the addition of the notorious monster groups, the color of the treasure chests will change from 3 stages to 4 stages. The color of the chest is determined by how many groups you defeated, and that color will remain for the next four weeks. You can then obtain units and various synthesis materials depending on the chest's color.
        Attachment 14656 Attachment 14657

        The treasure chest change applies to each World. Therefore, any players residing in a World that defeated the notorious monsters will be given the chance to acquire the rewards for the applicable area, not just those who actually participated in the battle to defeat the monsters.
        * The area-specific support effects and the quantity of units that can be acquired from the treasure chest are the same as before.
    • Multiple new pieces of equipment that can be crafted/reforged have been added.
      Attachment 14658

      You can craft new equipment by trading purification items and cursed items made from materials acquired within Temenos/Apollyon to the Temenos Furnace or Apollyon Furnace.
      • Crafting purification items

        The five types of shards, Alabaster Matter, and Murky Matter can be traded to the Temenos Furnace or Apollyon Furnace to craft the items.
        * Players that have yet to open a treasure chest within Temenos/Apollyon are unable to craft purification items.
        * You can obtain the shards specific to your character's race from the treasure chest after defeating one or more groups of enemies.
        * You can also trade two of a particular race's shards to the Temenos Furnace or Apollyon Furnace for one shard of a different race.

      • About the new materials

        You can now obtain new materials for crafting weapons from the newly introduced black treasure chests.

        <table width="450" border="0"><tr><td width="50%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Area </td><td width="50%" bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center">Obtainable Materials</td></tr><tr><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Temenos</td><td bgcolor="#EAF2F3" align="center">Alabaster material</td></tr><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Apollyon</td><td bgcolor="#F5FAFB" align="center">Murky material </td></tr><tr></table>
      • Crafting cursed items

        Use the materials available from the treasure chests within Limbus to synthesize the equipment. You can check the synthesis recipes once you have reached mid-tier crafting status in each guild.

      • Reforging equipment

        You can add and reforge augmentations to your crafted equipment with the Temenos Furnace or Apollyon Furnace. The process requires purification items and units corresponding to the relevant equipment.

        The augmentation can also be transferred to a different piece of equipment.
        In order to transfer the augmentation, trade both the original and new pieces of equipment to the Temenos Furnace or Apollyon Furnace after meeting the requirements listed below.
        Note: The source item will be lost during the transfer process.
        1. Both items are the same type of attire and for the same body part, or are the same type of weapon.
        2. The target item is of higher quality than the source item.
        3. The target item does not already have an augmentation.
    • The following additions and changes have been made to unique data.
      • The new notorious monsters are included with the monsters that can be defeated to earn the unique data.
      • The maximum amount of job points/exemplar points that can be acquired when opening blue treasure chests and above has been increased.
  • The foes in Ambuscade have been swapped out.

    As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.
    Attachment 14659 Attachment 14660

Item-related

  • New items have been added.
  • A new synergy recipe has been added.
  • New items are now storable via the Porter Moogle.
    Storage Slip 03
    CS Tunic +1 / CS Slacks +1 / CS Vest +1 / CS Pants +1 /
    MG Jerkin +1 / MGM Chausses +1 / MG Bodice +1 / MGF Chausses +1 /
    WN Kaftan +1 / WN Braccae +1 /
    SV Separates +1 / SV Loincloth +1 /
    EL Surcoat +1 / EL Braguette +1
    Storage Slip 31
    Ja Ja Sword / Ja Ja Mace / Cactuar Shield

System-related

  • New background music has been added.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue wherein the effects of the jubilee ring are not activated under certain conditions.
  • The issue wherein the effects of Pining Nocturne were incorrect when used by monsters.
  • The issue wherein the contents of certain lists were incorrect when speaking to Tuh Almobankha in Lower Jeuno (I-8) after completing the Jeuno quest "A Chocobo's Tale."
  • The issue wherein the completion timing for the Records of Eminence objective "Mog House Exit" is incorrect under certain conditions.
  • The issue in the battlefield "Swarm!" wherein unnecessary text is added to the message when receiving additional TP.
  • Various issues with incorrect text. (English version only)

Known Issues

  • Equipment in your Mog Wardrobe does not display properly when viewing the change equipment screen under certain conditions.
    * If your equipment is not displayed, you can resolve the issue by selecting View House from the menu and transferring the affected items from each wardrobe to your inventory.
  • The Mog Locker cannot be used under certain conditions, despite having an active lease.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue in Limbus wherein the Magic Shield effect of the monster Temenos Magic Pot's special ability "Spectral Barrier" is not activated.
    * In conjunction with this fix, the Temenos Magic Pot will no longer use its "Spectral Barrier" special ability.
  • The issue in Limbus wherein all of your exchanged race fragments can be lost when creating an Auge Scintistone at the Temenos Furnace under certain conditions.
  • The issue in Limbus wherein certain monsters' behavior while fighting against the notorious monsters Ultima Forerunner and Omega Forerunner is incorrect.
  • The issue wherein the icons for the following pieces of equipment are incorrect:
    Auge Scythe / Daduchos Scythe / Telopanos Scythe /
    Auge Shield / Daduchos Shield / Telopanos Shield
  • The issue wherein Item Level 119 high-level equipment is not included in the help text for Storage Slip 03.
  • The issue wherein equipment in your Mog Wardrobe does not display properly when viewing the change equipment screen under certain conditions.
  • Various issues with incorrect text.
  • The following items were incorrectly able to be stored in wardrobes despite not being intended for wardrobe storage:
    Skia Grip / Arctus Grip / Telognophos Grip
    * Added on Jul. 10, 2026

Known Issues

  • In the "Lost Chick" quest, selecting "No" when asked to confirm if Violitte in Southern San d'Oria is the chick's owner, maps you have already acquired will be added to the list of purchasable maps, allowing them to be purchased again.
    * While playing the "Lost Chick" quest, please do not select "No" when asked whether she is the chick's owner.

title: August 12, 2026 (JST) Version Update

Event-related

  • The following additions and changes have been made to Vana'Bout.

      A Kupon I-Amb (*) x3 will be added to the Silver Tier.

    • New time-based objectives (VB) have been added.

    • New daily objectives (VBD) have been added.

    • The listed details for some objectives have been revised.

      There are no changes to the contents or difficulty level of these objectives.

    • Changes between the daily objectives each day have been minimized.

      Example 1: The following objective will be available each day of the event:

(VBD)</td> <td>Defeat the requisite number of experience-yielding enemies in non-Abyssea areas.<br>Special Reward: 20 plaudits.</td> </tr></table>
      Example 2: The following objective will be available once every two days:
      <table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="6"> <tr bgcolor="#A8D0D7" align="center"> <th>Objective</th> <th>Description</th> </tr> <tr bgcolor="#F5FAFB"> <td>This Chain Shall Not Be Broken (VBD)</td> <td>Achieve an experience point chain bonus of 5.<br>Special Reward: 30 plaudits.</td> </tr> </table>* Depending on the timing with which you cancel an objective, the same objective may appear again after the previous one is canceled.

    • The monthly Records of Eminence objectives have been swapped out.

Battle-related

  • Multiple new notorious monsters have been added to the Seekers of Adoulin areas.

    Attachment 14802 Attachment 14803

    • Rewards

      Attachment 14804
      Once a notorious monster is defeated, a locked treasure box will appear in its location.

      The treasure box will disappear three minutes (Earth time) after it spawns, so be sure to open it before it's gone.

    • How to open treasure boxes

      Attachment 14805

      【Players who defeat the monster】
      • Any party/alliance members who earn experience points upon defeating the monster can unlock the treasure box without using the necessary item. However, if they travel to another area before opening the box, they will lose the ability to open it.

      • You can also use the Orvail Box Key item to open the box.

        Attachment 14806

      【Players not in the party/alliance that defeats the monster】
      • Use the Orvail Box Key to open the box.

    • Orvail Box Key

      Attachment 14807

      This item can be purchased from Shabi in Western Adoulin (I-9).
      * You can only buy one Orvail Box Key per hour (Earth time).

  • The foes in Ambuscade have been swapped out.

    As such, the corresponding Records of Eminence objectives have changed.

    Attachment 14808 Attachment 14809

Item-related

  • New items have been added.

    Attachment 14810 Attachment 14811

  • New items are now storable via the Porter Moogle.
    Storage Slip 31
    Abyssal Mask

    Attachment 14812
    * The Abyssal Mask is a special piece of equipment designed to celebrate the collaboration event with Wizardry Variants Daphne.
    * Read on for more details regarding the collaboration event.

System-related

  • Added a temporary fix for instances of reduced game performance under certain conditions when logging in or changing areas with a character who is in possession of a large number of items.

Resolved Issues

  • The issue wherein using the Character Race Change Service with the Ancestry Moogle in Port Bastok can prevent the background music from switching or your character's original appearance from displaying in some cases, even if "Display old" is selected in the character display settings.
  • The issue wherein notorious monsters such as Assimilator in Limbus (Apollyon) can reappear after being defeated.
  • The issue wherein using Dark Shot with the corsair job ability "Quick Draw" can prevent the damage-over-time effect of an active Bio, Bio II, or Bio III black magic spell that has been applied to the target from activating.
  • The issue wherein the following items cannot be delivered to other characters under the same account.
    Prophetic Knife / Prophetic Axe / Prophetic Sword / Prophetic Club / Prophetica / Reciente Coselete / Mirce Wardecors / Noble Redingote
  • The issue wherein the following monsters names were incorrect.
